text.completion: Thank you for recovering these artifacts. I will see to it that they are displayed in the Ironforge museum along with the story of those who died to recover them.
text.completed: Return to Prospector Drugan at the Gol'Bolar Quarry.

english.title: Priceless Treasures
english.objectives: Recover 8 Frozen Artifacts from inside the Gol'Bolar Quarry Mine.
english.description: Mining wasn't the only thing going on in the quarry, you know. I led a team of Explorers' League excavators recovering priceless ancient artifacts.$B$BI managed to escape, but my colleagues were much deeper in the mine and didn't survive the initial trogg attack.$B$BThey took great pride in their work and they risked their lives to learn more of our history. If you're going into the mines, take this pick with you and see if you can find anything in the digs the prospectors started.
english.progress: Were you able to find any artifacts down there?
english.completion: Thank you for recovering these artifacts. I will see to it that they are displayed in the Ironforge museum along with the story of those who died to recover them.
english.completed: Return to Prospector Drugan at the Gol'Bolar Quarry.

text.title: 凄凉之地求救
text.objectives: 去找凄凉之地塔迪萨兰的军官金妮。
text.description: 我从凄凉之地的尼耶尔哨站收到一份令人不安的消息。看来地壳大变动给他们制造了一些不好对付的新麻烦。我这里缺乏进一步的情报。$B$B去找凄凉之地的军官金妮。她会指引你前往尼耶尔哨站的。$B$B祝你好运，$N。
text.completion: Hold there, stranger!

english.title: Help for Desolace
english.objectives: Report to Officer Jankie at Tethris Aran in Desolace.
english.description: I've received a disturbing message from Nijel's Point in Desolace. It would seem as if the great upheaval has created some new problems for them, which they are ill-equipped to handle. I was given no further information.$B$BReport to Office Jankie in Desolace. She will direct you to Nijel's Point.$B$BGood luck, $N.
english.completion: Hold there, stranger!

text.title: 看在泥炭的份上
text.objectives: 用受祝福的深水百合扑灭7处沼泽大火。
text.description: 横行于恶铁岭的元素把这片土地化作了焦炭。在这种沼泽里，厚厚的地衣和泥炭给了火苗死灰复燃的空间。$B$B你必须在火势蔓延之前把它们扑灭。带上这朵花……它经过了自然之雨的祝福，能助你熄灭大火。$B$B这朵花也能在你同元素交战时助你一臂之力。
text.completion: In sparing the land further suffering, you've also helped us soothe the Greenwarden. Many thanks, $n.
text.completed: Return to Ferilon Leafborn at Greenwarden's Grove in the Wetlands.

english.title: For Peat's Sake
english.objectives: Use the Blessed Floodlily to extinguish 7 Marsh Fires.
english.description: The elementals rampaging across Direforge Hill are setting the very land beneath them ablaze. In a marsh such as this, fire can find many places to smoulder through the deep moss and peat.$B$BYou must quench the fires before they spread further. Take this flower... blessed by nature's rain, it will let you douse the fires.$B$BThe blossom may also prove useful against the elementals themselves.
english.completion: In sparing the land further suffering, you've also helped us soothe the Greenwarden. Many thanks, $n.
english.completed: Return to Ferilon Leafborn at Greenwarden's Grove in the Wetlands.

text.title: 呼啸林地背水一战
text.objectives: 去找海加尔山呼啸林地的丛林守护者塔尔德罗斯。
text.description: 感谢你在炼狱火海中的努力，我们也许能控制住这场大火。$B$B可是，更多的野生动物处于危险之中。丛林守护者塔尔德罗斯冲出火场，向北边的呼啸林地去了。$B$B去看看你能不能帮他！
text.completion: The forest is being devoured!
text.completed: Report to Keeper Taldros at Whistling Grove in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Last Stand at Whistling Grove
english.objectives: Report to Keeper Taldros at Whistling Grove in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: We might have a chance to beat these flames back thanks to your work in the Inferno.$B$BStill, more wildlife is threatened. Keeper Taldros ran north through the flames, to Whistling Grove.$B$BSee if you can help him!
english.completion: The forest is being devoured!
english.completed: Report to Keeper Taldros at Whistling Grove in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 我需要休息
text.objectives: 跟军团士兵纳兹戈林谈一谈。
text.description: $R，你表现得很好。要做的事还很多，但是我已经疲惫不堪了。$B$B我消耗了大量能量，向大地之环的首领发出了船难消息，希望得到他们的帮助。$B$B我必须休息一会，才能继续贡献力量。$B$B跟军团士兵谈一谈，尽你所能地帮助他们做好战斗的准备。纳迦必然会再次来犯，这不过是时间问题，而且反攻的势头肯定会更加凶猛的。
text.completion: I hear you, $r. I understand the urgency, but these men are in no condition to fight.

english.title: Rest For the Weary
english.objectives: Speak to Legionnaire Nazgrim.
english.description: You have done well, $r, but there is much more to do and I grow weary.$b$bI have expended a great deal of energy sending a distress message to Earthen Ring leadership, pleading for their help.$b$bI must rest if I am to be of further use to us here.$b$bSpeak to the leader of the men you've saved and do what you can to help them prepare for battle.$b$bThe naga are scouring the waters for us. It is but a matter of time before they return - and they will surely come in even greater force.
english.completion: I hear you, $r. I understand the urgency, but these men are in no condition to fight.

text.title: 争取时间
text.objectives: 在军团之劫杀死8名金加塔尔袭击者。
text.description: 我们损失了很多优秀的士兵。$B$B如果萨满祭司的话属实，我们必须尽快采取措施，不然也难逃死亡的命运。$B$B纳迦正在这片水域中搜寻幸存者。$B$B但是我们还没有准备好跟他们作战，$R。你必须为我们争取时间。$B$B杀死追踪我们的纳迦，减缓他们前进的步伐。
text.completion: Let us hope that your work has bought us the time we need...
text.completed: Speak with Legionnaire Nazgrim at The Immortal Coil.

english.title: Buy Us Some Time
english.objectives: Kill 8 Zin'jatar Raiders at Legion's Fate.
english.description: Many good warriors have been lost today.$b$bIf what the shaman says is true, then we must act swiftly or we will add to their numbers.$b$bThe naga are out there, scouring these waters looking for survivors.$b$bWe are not yet ready to fight, $r. You must buy us time to make preparations.$b$bFind the naga that hunt us and delay their efforts.
english.completion: Let us hope that your work has bought us the time we need...
english.completed: Speak with Legionnaire Nazgrim at The Immortal Coil.

text.title: 吃饱了好上路
text.objectives: 从裂钳诱捕蟹那里收集6块多汁的蟹肉。
text.description: 希望你能帮我做好战前的准备。$B$B任何像样的指挥官都知道，将士们吃得饱才能经得起长途跋涉和激烈战斗的考验。没有食物，打不了胜仗。$B$B我们的士兵最近历经艰险，身体十分虚弱。他们需要食物，才能做好与纳迦战斗的准备。$B$B俗话说吃饱了好上路，那边的海床上生活着不少肥美的螃蟹……
text.progress: You got food for the troops, $r?
text.completion: Good grub. Soon we'll be back to fighting strength.
text.completed: Speak to Legionnaire Nazgrim in The Immortal Coil.

english.title: Traveling on Our Stomachs
english.objectives: Collect 8 Succulent Crab Meat from Splitclaw Skitterers.
english.description: I'll need your help if I am to get these orcs ready for battle.$b$bAny worthy leader knows that his warriors travel and fight on their stomachs. No food, no victory.$b$bThese warriors are weary from their struggle out there. They need food before they're ready to overcome a naga attack.$b$bSpeaking of traveling on stomachs, I saw plenty of crabs out on the sea floor...
english.progress: You got food for the troops, $r?
english.completion: Good grub. Soon we'll be back to fighting strength.
english.completed: Speak to Legionnaire Nazgrim in The Immortal Coil.

text.title: 勒紧裤腰带
text.objectives: 收集5把奥格瑞玛战斧、5件奥格瑞玛胸铠以及5个奥格瑞玛头盔。你可以在军团之劫的海床以及海地精抢劫者身上找到这些装备。
text.description: 在努力避免被溺亡的过程中，我们不得不放弃了武器和大部分的护甲。$B$B埃鲁纳克说纳迦很快就会发动一场猛攻，我觉得应该相信他。$B$B请帮我们找到丢弃的军备，这样我们才有获胜的机会。你可以在这里以及北面船只残骸附近的海床上找到它们。$B$B抓紧时间，$R。敌人会随时来犯的。
text.progress: Were you able to gather up our gear, $r?
text.completion: You have done well, $r. Our chances of survival are increasing.
text.completed: Speak with Legionnaire Nazgrim in The Immortal Coil.

english.title: Girding Our Loins
english.objectives: Collect 5 Orgrimmar Axes, 5 Orgrimmar Breastplates and 5 Orgrimmar Helms from the sea floor and from Gilblin Plunderers in Legion's Fate.
english.description: As we struggled not to drown, my orcs and I were forced to abandon our weapons and much of our armor.$b$bErunak says to expect a major attack from the naga soon and I believe him.$b$bIf we're going to be victorious, we'll need your help to recover our lost equipment.$b$bYou should find it scattered around the sea floor near our shipwrecks here and to the north.$b$bMake haste, $r. The enemy could arrive at any moment.
english.progress: Were you able to gather up our gear, $r?
english.completion: You have done well, $r. Our chances of survival are increasing.
english.completed: Speak with Legionnaire Nazgrim in The Immortal Coil.

text.title: 我们来是做一件，也许是两件事的……
text.objectives: 乘克罗姆加马车前往石爪山脉的皱石岗。
text.description: 你现在是地狱咆哮麾下的一名士兵了，$N，在地狱咆哮的部队里，我们横着走。咱们的人在奥格瑞玛饿肚子，还要跟精灵签条约的日子一去不复返了。现在我们要什么就拿什么。卡利姆多是部落的！$B$B联盟一有机会就要阻挠我们的扩张，占着东部王国的大部分还不够，这些猪猡什么都想要！$B$B克罗姆加大王要求在石爪山集结更多的部队。到西边上车出发！
text.completion: While you remain in Stonetalon and fight as a Krom'gar soldier you will remain suited up! Am I clear? DO you hear me, grunt? If I see you without Hellscream's beloved tabard I will put my foot so far up your backside that you'll be spitting up laces.
text.end: Krom'gar Wagon taken to the Fold
text.completed: Report to Saurboz at the Fold in Stonetalon Mountains to join the Krom'gar army.

english.title: We're Here to Do One Thing, Maybe Two...
english.objectives: Take the Krom'gar Wagon to the Fold in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: You're in Hellscream's army now, $N, and in Hellscream's army we kick butt and take names. Gone are the days of our people starving in the streets of Orgrimmar as we sign treaties with elves. We take what we need now. Kalimdor belongs to the Horde!$B$BThe Alliance attempts to stop our expansion every chance they get. Unsatisfied with owning most of the Eastern Kingdoms, those pig-lickers want it all!$B$BOverlord Krom'gar has called for more troops in Stonetalon. Get on the caravan west of here and go!
english.completion: While you remain in Stonetalon and fight as a Krom'gar soldier you will remain suited up! Am I clear? DO you hear me, grunt? If I see you without Hellscream's beloved tabard I will put my foot so far up your backside that you'll be spitting up laces.
english.end: Krom'gar Wagon taken to the Fold
english.completed: Report to Saurboz at the Fold in Stonetalon Mountains to join the Krom'gar army.

text.title: 神秘的头盔
text.objectives: Take the Alliance S.E.A.L. Equipment to Legionnaire Nazgrim at The Immortal Coil.
text.description: 这顶头盔以及附属的部件上都盖有暴风城的印章。它很可能是从联盟的战船上滚落的，看来大家的遭遇都差不多。$B$B细看起来，它比普通的潜水装备要精致厚实得多。或许纳兹戈林知道点什么……
text.completion: Blood and Thunder! This changes everything, $c!
text.completed: Speak to Legionnaire Nazgrim at The Immortal Coil.

english.title: Helm's Deep
english.objectives: Take the Alliance S.E.A.L. Equipment to Legionnaire Nazgrim at The Immortal Coil.
english.description: This helm and its associated components are marked with the seal of Stormwind. It was no doubt cast off from an Alliance ship that suffered a similar fate to yours.$b$bLooking closer, this seems far too intricate and sturdy to be everyday diving equipment. Perhaps Nazgrim can make some sense of this...
english.completion: Blood and Thunder! This changes everything, $c!
english.completed: Speak to Legionnaire Nazgrim at The Immortal Coil.

text.title: 谁捡到就归谁
text.objectives: 收集5套暴风城海豹突击队员装备。
text.description: 我认得这顶头盔，$R。你将它交给我是明智的决定。$B$B联盟有一支特种部队，精于水下探索以及作战。$B$B看来他们在这里的行动不仅仅只是为了抵抗我们的进攻。$B$B海底应该还有很多类似的装备。如果你能找到的话，我们的先头部队倒是可以用得着。
text.progress: Were you able to locate more of the Alliance gear, $n?
text.completion: Well done! Now, more than ever, we are prepared to face the naga!
text.completed: Speak to Legionnaire Nazgrim at The Immortal Coil.

english.title: Finders, Keepers
english.objectives: Gather 5 pieces of Stormwind S.E.A.L. Equipment.
english.description: I recognize this helm, $r. You were wise to bring it to me.$b$bThe Alliance have a special unit, trained and equipped to explore and fight beneath the sea.$b$bIt would seem that they are in this region to do more than just defend against our attack.$b$bThere must be more of these down here, and if you can find them it could turn things around for the Vanguard.
english.progress: Were you able to locate more of the Alliance gear, $n?
english.completion: Well done! Now, more than ever, we are prepared to face the naga!
english.completed: Speak to Legionnaire Nazgrim at The Immortal Coil.

text.title: 动手吧！
text.objectives: Speak with Legionnaire Nazgrim aboard the Immortal Coil.
text.description: It is time, $c.$b$bWe are as ready as we ever will be!$b$bI shall address the Vanguard, and then we shall swim into the sea to meet our fate.
text.completion: No time to address the Vanguard. Just as well...
text.completed: Speak to Legionnaire Nazgrim in The Immortal Coil.

english.title: Bring It On!
english.objectives: Speak with Legionnaire Nazgrim aboard the Immortal Coil.
english.description: It is time, $c.$b$bWe are as ready as we ever will be!$b$bI shall address the Vanguard, and then we shall swim into the sea to meet our fate.
english.completion: No time to address the Vanguard. Just as well...
english.completed: Speak to Legionnaire Nazgrim in The Immortal Coil.

text.title: 鲜血与雷鸣！
text.objectives: Assist Legionnaire Nazgrim in the defense of The Immortal Coil.
text.description: The time has come to make our stand, $r.$b$bWe'll defend this ship to our last breath, and make these naga scum think twice before approaching it again!$b$bFor the Horde!
text.completion: The Earthen Ring has received my distress message and sent help - just in time it would seem. Hopefully more can be sent soon. We are but few against a great many.
text.completed: The Immortal Coil has been lost. Speak to Erunak at Shallow's End.
text.objective1: Defense of The Immortal Coil Complete

english.title: Blood and Thunder!
english.objectives: Assist Legionnaire Nazgrim in the defense of The Immortal Coil.
english.description: The time has come to make our stand, $r.$b$bWe'll defend this ship to our last breath, and make these naga scum think twice before approaching it again!$b$bFor the Horde!
english.completion: The Earthen Ring has received my distress message and sent help - just in time it would seem. Hopefully more can be sent soon. We are but few against a great many.
english.completed: The Immortal Coil has been lost. Speak to Erunak at Shallow's End.
english.objective1: Defense of The Immortal Coil Complete

text.title: 进攻希拉柯丝
text.objectives: 杀死10只希拉柯丝纳迦。
text.description: 你就是大家都在谈论的那个$N吗？亲爱的，很高兴见到你。要不我带你四下转转啊。$B$B嗯，闲聊时间到，谈正事吧。我要你游到西北边的希拉柯丝前哨去，跟那些蛇形人打个招呼。$B$B也没有什么特别的事。他们正想招惹是非呢，那就给他们点颜色瞧瞧。
text.completion: Chicken and rice, $n! That will show those sorry and sad snakes who's the ol' pitch and toss! Now it's bird lime for that tiddlywink. Finger and thumb or plink plonk?
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant "Foxy" Topper at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Sira'kess Slaying
english.objectives: Slay 10 Sira'kess Naga.
english.description: You're the $N everyone's been talking about? Good to meet ya, love. Let's have a butcher's hook.$B$BWell, enough rabbit, right? Let's get down to it. I need you to swim out northwest to the Sira'kess Front and read and write them snakes something quick.$B$BNothing fancy. They're looking for a bother, and we'll give 'em a right good one in the ol' boat race.
english.completion: Chicken and rice, $n! That will show those sorry and sad snakes who's the ol' pitch and toss! Now it's bird lime for that tiddlywink. Finger and thumb or plink plonk?
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant "Foxy" Topper at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 最终审判
text.objectives: Hold the bridge on Quel'Dormir Terrace until Lady Sira'kess' allies arrive.$B$BThis task is part of a Naz'jar Battlemaiden vision. If needed, use the Blade of the Naz'jar Battlemaiden at a time focus to return to the vision.
text.description: Get to the bridge on the east, quickly. Lady Naz'jar and the Fathom-Lord should be there with whatever forces remain.$B$BFollow our Lady's direction, as always. Hold the bridge until we can complete the ritual.$B$BOnce our allies arrive, the Kvaldir will be doomed.
text.completion: I could ask for no more proficient a Battlemaiden than you. You have done yourself a great honor this day.
text.completed: Speak to Lady Naz'jar upon Quel'Dormir Terrace.
text.objective1: Hold the eastern end of Quel'Dormir Terrace
text.objective2: Push the Kvaldir back across the bridge

english.title: Final Judgement
english.objectives: Hold the bridge on Quel'Dormir Terrace until Lady Sira'kess' allies arrive.$B$BThis task is part of a Naz'jar Battlemaiden vision. If needed, use the Blade of the Naz'jar Battlemaiden at a time focus to return to the vision.
english.description: Get to the bridge on the east, quickly. Lady Naz'jar and the Fathom-Lord should be there with whatever forces remain.$B$BFollow our Lady's direction, as always. Hold the bridge until we can complete the ritual.$B$BOnce our allies arrive, the Kvaldir will be doomed.
english.completion: I could ask for no more proficient a Battlemaiden than you. You have done yourself a great honor this day.
english.completed: Speak to Lady Naz'jar upon Quel'Dormir Terrace.
english.objective1: Hold the eastern end of Quel'Dormir Terrace
english.objective2: Push the Kvaldir back across the bridge

text.title: 毫无防备
text.objectives: 杀死10名艾萨尔巡逻兵。
text.description: 我们从贝壳里逃出来不可能没被发现，废墟这里的纳迦要么是没得到消息，要么就根本不把我们当回事。我不想坐等良机——我们马上出击。$B$B我要你摸到西边的废墟下层去，尽可能多地干掉他们的巡逻兵。我们不能冒险让他们发现我们这座山洞的位置——一个都别放跑。
text.completion: Excellent work, $c.$B$BI will get some patrols out of our own to make sure that no more naga get within sight of this cave. We should have the area secured within the hour.
text.completed: Return to Captain Vilethorn in the Legion's Rest.

english.title: Caught Off-Guard
english.objectives: Kill 10 Azsh'ir Patrollers.
english.description: Our escape from the shell can't have gone unnoticed, but either the naga at these ruins weren't informed or they don't consider us a threat. I don't intend to take the opportunity for granted - we strike now.$B$BI need you to slip into the lower level of the ruins to our west and take out as many of their patrols as you can. We cannot risk any of those patrols finding out about our occupation of this cave - make sure none escape.
english.completion: Excellent work, $c.$B$BI will get some patrols out of our own to make sure that no more naga get within sight of this cave. We should have the area secured within the hour.
english.completed: Return to Captain Vilethorn in the Legion's Rest.

text.title: 蹑手蹑脚
text.objectives: 摧毁8个艾萨尔监控器。
text.description: 我已着手展开初步的侦查。纳迦也许没有意识到我们的存在，但他们也不是对入侵者毫无防备。$B$B在巡逻线后面，他们设置了魔法警戒装置，一旦有不速之客随时报警。幸运的是，它们为数不多，因此绝对有隙可乘，可以在触发之前摧毁这些装置。$B$B我相信你可以在我们的士兵到来之前处理好这件事。
text.completion: Well done, $n, and just in time too. The Captain just started sending more men out. Strong axe arms, but I doubt they possess quite the same awareness and finesse that you do.$B$BWe were lucky to have you here when things went south. I suspect you will have a large role to play in things to come as well.
text.completed: Return to Legionnaire Nazgrim in the Legion's Rest.

english.title: Swift Approach
english.objectives: Destroy 8 Azsh'ir Monitors.
english.description: I've taken the liberty of performing some preliminary scouting. The naga may not be aware of our position, but they are not entirely unprepared for intruders.$B$BBeyond their patrols, they have set up magical sentry devices that will warn them of unwelcome guests. Fortunately, they seem to have sacrificed quality for quantity, and there is definitely a window in which the devices can be destroyed before their alarms are answered.$B$BI trust that you can see to this before our other soldiers arrive.
english.completion: Well done, $n, and just in time too. The Captain just started sending more men out. Strong axe arms, but I doubt they possess quite the same awareness and finesse that you do.$B$BWe were lucky to have you here when things went south. I suspect you will have a large role to play in things to come as well.
english.completed: Return to Legionnaire Nazgrim in the Legion's Rest.

text.title: 时光的记录
text.objectives: 调查瓦丝琪尔花园4处完好的雕像。
text.description: Look--$n is it?--I need your help. I know most everyone in this cave thinks that we're not in a position to be worrying about anything but our own hides right now, but I cannot dismiss my ancestors so readily.$B$BThis was one of the royal cities of the elves in the days when Azshara was queen. In this city lie the keys to lore long lost and artifacts of unimaginable historical value. All I want from you, while you're out in the city proper, is to keep a watchful eye out for objects of significance.
text.completion: Thank you so much for taking this seriously.$B$BThis is some of the first definitive proof of other members of the Vashj family. Very interesting. And I'd never even heard of either of the other two figures you mentioned until now.$B$BSo much of our history was lost during the sundering - it's exciting to have a chance at reclaiming some of it.
text.completed: Return to Elendri Goldenbrow in the Legion's Rest.

english.title: An Occupation of Time
english.objectives: Investigate the 4 intact statues in the Vashj'ir Gardens.
english.description: Look--$n is it?--I need your help. I know most everyone in this cave thinks that we're not in a position to be worrying about anything but our own hides right now, but I cannot dismiss my ancestors so readily.$B$BThis was one of the royal cities of the elves in the days when Azshara was queen. In this city lie the keys to lore long lost and artifacts of unimaginable historical value. All I want from you, while you're out in the city proper, is to keep a watchful eye out for objects of significance.
english.completion: Thank you so much for taking this seriously.$B$BThis is some of the first definitive proof of other members of the Vashj family. Very interesting. And I'd never even heard of either of the other two figures you mentioned until now.$B$BSo much of our history was lost during the sundering - it's exciting to have a chance at reclaiming some of it.
english.completed: Return to Elendri Goldenbrow in the Legion's Rest.

text.title: 奇袭点
text.objectives: 去废墟最下层，调查奎尔多米尔花园北边的尽头，在花园以西的废墟下面有条小路可以通往那里，还有废墟东南角落的建筑群，就在桥下。
text.description: 这个洞穴是我们唯一的避难所，已经退无可退，也毫无外援。无论发生什么，这个洞穴的安全是放在第一位的，不然我们都得死在这儿。$B$B我们需要一个前哨站来实施打击。$B$B去废墟东部最下层，调查花园北边的尽头。然后是花园以西、主建筑之下的通道。此外还有废墟东南角落的建筑群，就在桥下。$B$B去搜集一些情报给我。
text.completion: This is good intel. You have a sharp eye, $c.$B$BIt sounds like the building north of the gardens will make a suitable forward post. I will send some men immediately to start defensive preparations and we will reposition there as soon as possible.
text.completed: Return to Captain Vilethorn in the Legion's Rest.
text.objective2: Tunnel west of Quel'Dormir Gardens scouted
text.objective3: Structures south of Quel'Dormir Gardens scouted

english.title: A Better Vantage
english.objectives: On the lowest level of the ruins, scout the northern end of the Quel'Dormir Gardens, the passage that leads under the ruins west of the gardens, and the structures at the southeast corner of the ruins, below the bridges.
english.description: This cave is our only refuge. There's no help on the way. Whatever happens, this cave must remain safe or we are all sure to die down here.$B$BWe need a forward post to launch our attacks from. Something defensible.$B$BIn the eastern portion of the ruins on the lowest level, scout the north end of the gardens, the passage leading under the main structure just west of the gardens, and the cluster of buildings at the southeast corner of the ruins, under the bridges.$B$BBring me back any information you can.
english.completion: This is good intel. You have a sharp eye, $c.$B$BIt sounds like the building north of the gardens will make a suitable forward post. I will send some men immediately to start defensive preparations and we will reposition there as soon as possible.
english.completed: Return to Captain Vilethorn in the Legion's Rest.
english.objective2: Tunnel west of Quel'Dormir Gardens scouted
english.objective3: Structures south of Quel'Dormir Gardens scouted

text.title: 在战斗现场
text.objectives: Bring the broken shard back to the Legion's Rest.
text.description: 你周围曾经发生过一场激烈的战斗。纳迦骷髅不稀奇，但这些武器和他们对手留下的痕迹却出人意料。$B$B在骸骨中间，你发现一块奇怪得惹眼的金属从其中一个颅骨中扎出来。很难说它曾经是什么武器上的，不过它是如此地惹人注意，你无法不把它作为证据带走。$B$B洞里肯定会有人对这一发现感兴趣的。
text.progress: 再次欢迎你，$N!你是来向我展示你完成狩猎的证明的吗?
text.completion: A shard of metal?$B$BThe remains you describe sound much like the sea vrykul we encountered in Northrend. We'll not be striking any alliances with their sort, no matter the cause. Still, this information may prove useful in the future.$B$BI will think on it further if time permits. Thank you for bringing it to my attention.

english.title: Upon the Scene of Battle
english.objectives: Bring the broken shard back to the Legion's Rest.
english.description: All around you lie the remnants of a fierce battle. The naga skeletons are no surprise, but the weapons and remains of their apparent opponents are somewhat more unexpected.$B$BAmidst the bones, you spot a strangely prominent piece of metal jutting out from one of the skulls. It's difficult to tell what sort of weapon it might have once been part of, but it stands out sufficiently to prompt you to retrieve it as evidence.$B$BSurely someone back at the cave would be interested in this revelation.
english.progress: Yes, $c?
english.completion: A shard of metal?$B$BThe remains you describe sound much like the sea vrykul we encountered in Northrend. We'll not be striking any alliances with their sort, no matter the cause. Still, this information may prove useful in the future.$B$BI will think on it further if time permits. Thank you for bringing it to my attention.

text.title: 过去的影像：瓦丝琪尔的入侵
text.objectives: 在花园东南部尽头的战斗现场使用纳兹夏尔女武士之刃。
text.description: 你发现的碎片看来源自纳迦。我一直希望能找到像这样一件具有强大聚焦能力的物体，好将我一直钻研的法术释放出来，以便窥视不远的过去。$B$B我已经将这片利刃附魔，但你还是要把它带到其主人曾经所在之地。我想让你回到发现它的地方，使用这片利刃。$B$B也许我们能明白纳迦究竟在这里干什么，或许运气好的话，还能找到他们的弱点，给我们一线生机。
text.completion: A Battlemaiden? I never heard of such a thing.$B$BThe way you explain it, it sounds like the naga forces are far greater in scope than the Captain could possibly have realized. We might be able to learn more through the blade if we can find other locations where this Battlemaiden was present, but the information you gave me makes me fear for the captain and his soldiers. We must warn them.
text.completed: Speak to Wavespeaker Tulra in the Ruins of Vashj'ir.
text.objective1: Attune With the Broken Blade's Owner

english.title: Visions of the Past: The Invasion of Vashj'ir
english.objectives: Use the Blade of the Naz'jar Battlemaiden at the battle site at the southeast end of the ruins.
english.description: The shard you recovered looks to be of naga origin. I had hoped to find a strong focal object like this for a spell I've been working on that would allow us to glimpse into the recent past.$B$BI've enchanted the blade, but you'll have to take it to a place where we know its owner was. I want you to travel back to the site where you found it and use the blade.$B$BPerhaps we can uncover more behind what the naga are doing here. Or even better, maybe we'll uncover a weakness that will give us a better chance.
english.completion: A Battlemaiden? I never heard of such a thing.$B$BThe way you explain it, it sounds like the naga forces are far greater in scope than the Captain could possibly have realized. We might be able to learn more through the blade if we can find other locations where this Battlemaiden was present, but the information you gave me makes me fear for the captain and his soldiers. We must warn them.
english.completed: Speak to Wavespeaker Tulra in the Ruins of Vashj'ir.
english.objective1: Attune With the Broken Blade's Owner

text.title: 朝前看
text.objectives: Find and speak to Captain Vilethorn north of the Quel'Dormir Gardens.$B$BUse Wavespeaker Tulra's sea horse to reach the forward post quickly.
text.description: The Captain used the information you gathered for him to make a forward post under the terrace to our west. He's been preparing there for some kind of attack against the naga.$B$BYou should go to him immediately and inform him of the scope of what you've witnessed. Our force is small, and I fear for our soldiers if we charge in too recklessly.$B$BTake my sea horse. It knows the way.
text.completion: Good to see you again, $c. I almost thought we'd lost you to the Wavespeaker's fool errand.$B$BDid anything come of it?

english.title: Looking Forward
english.objectives: Find and speak to Captain Vilethorn north of the Quel'Dormir Gardens.$B$BUse Wavespeaker Tulra's sea horse to reach the forward post quickly.

english.completion: Good to see you again, $c. I almost thought we'd lost you to the Wavespeaker's fool errand.$B$BDid anything come of it?

text.title: 清晰的目标
text.objectives: 消灭10名在西南部平台下聚集的纳迦。
text.description: I see. The news you bring is grim, but I was not entirely unprepared for such possibilities. Without any effective scouting of naga numbers, I knew our plan was risky, but that's why we established this forward post.$B$BLet me put it to you plainly, $c. If we do not keep the naga off-balance, they will bring the fight to us. We do not have the structures or the men to mount a defense, so that is not an option.$B$BWe need more time. Can you thin their numbers to the south, under the far terrace?
text.completion: More naga are amassing to the south than reported too it seems. We shall have to move quickly then.
text.completed: Return to Captain Vilethorn north of the Quel'Dormir Gardens.

english.title: Clear Goals
english.objectives: Kill 10 of the naga forces building up on the ground level, under the southwestern terrace.
english.description: I see. The news you bring is grim, but I was not entirely unprepared for such possibilities. Without any effective scouting of naga numbers, I knew our plan was risky, but that's why we established this forward post.$B$BLet me put it to you plainly, $c. Can you thin their numbers to the south, under the far terrace?
english.completion: More naga are amassing to the south than reported too it seems. We shall have to move quickly then.
english.completed: Return to Captain Vilethorn north of the Quel'Dormir Gardens.

text.title: 并非毫无准备
text.objectives: Deliver 8 Bundles of Crossbow Bolts to Horde Lookouts on ledges around the north end of Quel'Dormir Gardens.
text.description: I overheard your conversation with the Captain. I know what we're doing sounds insane, but we really don't have much choice. There are people back at that cave that are depending on us.$B$BI've stationed lookouts on various ledges in the immediate area. They're burning ammo fast on the scattered naga scouts. Bring them more crossbow bolts to buy us some extra time.
text.completion: You are perhaps the most dependable $r I've ever met. I wish I could have more men that showed half as much pride as you do.
text.completed: Return to Legionnaire Nazgrim north of the Quel'Dormir Gardens.

english.objectives: Deliver 8 Bundles of Crossbow Bolts to Horde Lookouts on ledges around the north end of Quel'Dormir Gardens.

english.completed: Return to Legionnaire Nazgrim north of the Quel'Dormir Gardens.

text.title: Curious Distraction
text.objectives: Transcribe the 4 Highborne Tablets.
text.description: Hah! Did you see the Captain giving me dirty looks and decide you'd throw some sympathy my way? I've pretty much lost hope of making him understand that these ruins offers us some opportunity to salvage some usefulness out of this whole  mess.$B$BI'd actually hoped that you might turn up again - you seem like the only one I can rely on. I've seen a few tablets like this one spread about the nearby ruins and I put together a rubbing kit for transcribing them. Up to the task?
text.completion: Brilliant! I can't have expected much more with the tools I gave you. I should be able to fill in the blanks and get this all written out shortly. There's no knowing if we will make it out of this place, but if it comes down to it, I will find a way to float this to the surface in hopes that it will one day be found. Thank you again, $n. You're not bad.
text.completed: Return to Elendri Goldenbrow north of the Quel'Dormir Gardens.

text.title: 备受启发
text.objectives: 在西南部平台下收集8颗胀大的海藻球。
text.description: 曾到过很多地方，什么玩意都炸过。我想我有点跟不上形势了，倒不是水的问题，而是创造力。$B$B我发现了某种足以制成炸弹的不稳定物！西南边的平台下就挂着好多。通常来说海藻储存的气体是为了让自身漂浮——但这些海藻产生的是一种完全不同的重瓦斯。漂浮还是可以的，但同时也让它成为极好的爆破物。$B$B去给我弄些来？
text.progress: Tick, tock, tick, tock. Always in such a hurry. No time for innovation. What I wouldn't give for a lab again!
text.completion: You are brave indeed! I've seen you battling all manner of murloc, naga, and pointy-toothed fish, but that was nothing! The way you just sling those kelp bulbs under your arm like that is a whole new kind of fearless. BOOM! You could blow up at any second.$B$BYou're my kind of $r.
text.completed: Return to Fiasco Sizzlegrin north of the Quel'Dormir Gardens.

english.title: Properly Inspired
english.objectives: Gather 8 Bloated Kelp Bulbs hanging under the southwestern terrace.
english.description: Been all over the place. Blown all kinds of things up. I thought I might have some trouble carrying on the trend, what with the water and all, but it's all just a matter of inspiration.$B$BI found something volatile enough to make bombs out of! There's a bunch of kelp hanging under the terrace to the southwest. Normally kelp stores gas that makes it float - this kelp produces a different kind of heavy gas. It keeps it hanging, but also makes for great explosions.$B$BGather me some?
english.progress: Tick, tock, tick, tock. Always in such a hurry. No time for innovation. What I wouldn't give for a lab again!
english.completion: You are brave indeed! I've seen you battling all manner of murloc, naga, and pointy-toothed fish, but that was nothing! The way you just sling those kelp bulbs under your arm like that is a whole new kind of fearless. BOOM! You could blow up at any second.$B$BYou're my kind of $r.
english.completed: Return to Fiasco Sizzlegrin north of the Quel'Dormir Gardens.

text.title: 动如脱兔
text.objectives: Speak to Fiasco Sizzlegrin just outside of the building to join the assault, then use your improvised explosives to kill 100 Azsh'ir Soldiers, 20 Azsh'ir Wave Screamers, and 12 Azsh'ir Archaens.
text.description: We have everything we need to begin the attack.$B$BIf your claims were correct, you would do well to make sure you cling tight to your mount as we make the run. Anyone who gets caught in the open water isn't likely to out-swim a naga.$B$BKill as many as you can as we make the attack run and we'll rendezvous on the broken ledge of the southern terrace above once we've expended our explosives. Hopefully by that point there will be few enough that we can finish them off the old-fashioned way.
text.completion: You did great up there, soldier! You devastated their ranks, but there were far more than we accounted for, and most of my men went down out there in the masses of naga.$B$BWe'll need to hold this position as long as possible to buy them time. Hopefully some of them will still make it to the rendezvous.
text.completed: Speak to Captain Vilethorn on Nar'shola Terrace.

text.title: 任何人都不能落下
text.objectives: 营救6名受伤的突击志愿兵。
text.description: 真是一场灾难！我们的人大部分还没挺到汇合就被消灭了。$B$B我们只能尽可能地守住这个地方，直到纳迦把我们彻底包围。我们需要从这里逃到西南去，沿途尽量多救一些人——尽你的所能吧。$B$B他们撑不了多久。请快些！
text.progress: These guys aren't in good shape. We may need to retreat sooner than we'd like.
text.completion: Thank you. Truly.$B$BWe need to get these men moving as soon as possible. I'll meet you back at the forward post soon, I'm sure.
text.completed: Return to Legionnaire Nazgrim on Nar'shola Terrace.

english.title: Fallen But Not Forgotten
english.objectives: Rescue 6 Injured Assault Volunteers.
english.description: That was a disaster! Most of our men went down to spears before making it anywhere near the rendezvous.$B$BWe're only going to be able to hold this position for so long before the naga overrun us. We need to get out there to the southwest and save as many of the men as we can find - do anything you can.$B$BThey won't last long. Please hurry!
english.progress: These guys aren't in good shape. We may need to retreat sooner than we'd like.
english.completion: Thank you. Truly.$B$BWe need to get these men moving as soon as possible. I'll meet you back at the forward post soon, I'm sure.
english.completed: Return to Legionnaire Nazgrim on Nar'shola Terrace.

text.title: 估测胜算
text.objectives: 侦查圆形平台的西北边缘，以及北部主台阶下的隧道。这两个地点都在废墟的中层。
text.description: Vicious louts... they did a lot of damage with those spears.$B$B<The captain winces slightly as he clutches a wound on his side.>$B$BWe'll hold here as long as we can for all the men to make it. I need someone to scout their numbers to see how much damage we did.$B$BOne of the biggest groups of them was around the corner on the northwest portion of this round terrace, and the other was a bit farther to the north in the small tunnel, also on this middle level of the ruins.$B$BUp for some scouting?
text.completion: Still so many? They must want something very important here to come in such numbers.$B$BI will be honest with you, $n, because you deserve at least that: I don't know how much hope there is. We will retreat shortly, but we won't be able to defend ourselves when they strike back. We don't have anywhere to run... we're running out of options.$B$BI'm sorry, I should keep such thoughts to myself. Do me a favor and don't mention any of that to the men. I'll figure something out.
text.completed: Return to Captain Vilethorn on Nar'shola Terrace.
text.objective1: Scout the Tunnel to the North

english.objectives: Scout the northwestern portion of the circular terrace and the tunnel under the main stairs to the north. Both locations are on Nar'shola Terrace, the middle level of the ruins.

text.title: 过去的影像：贝耶拉兰山惨案
text.objectives: 在克瓦迪尔将军的阵亡之地使用女武士的断剑，目睹她随后的经历。
text.description: 瞧，我知道在这种时候提这样的要求很过分，但我要你暂时从失败的悲伤中振作起来。$B$B我会照顾这些士兵，你得找到之前你所说克瓦迪尔将军在西边的战场。在那里，你能窥视到女武士更多的经历。我有种强烈的预感，那名女武士是我们打败纳迦的关键。$B$B请你赶快——我会尽我所能为你争取时间。
text.completion: You're finished! Just in time. I don't think we could have held them much longer.$B$BAn artifact? Could this be something we can use against the naga? I suppose that would require finding it.$B$BWe may have to attend to more pressing matters first, until an opportunity to pursue this further presents itself.
text.completed: Speak to Wavespeaker Tulra on Nar'shola Terrace.
text.objective1: Witness the Continuing Story of the Battlemaiden

english.title: Visions of the Past: The Slaughter of Biel'aran Ridge
english.objectives: Witness the continuing story of the Battlemaiden by using her broken blade at the site of the Kvaldir General's death.
english.description: Look, I know this is asking a lot during a time like this, but I need you to tear yourself away from this defeat for a moment.$B$BI will tend to these soldiers - you need to find the location of that battle with the Kvaldir General to the west that you told me about. You should be able to glimpse more of the Battlemaiden's experiences from there. I have a strong feeling that the key to defeating these naga will lie with that Battlemaiden.$B$BPlease hurry - I will do everything I can to buy you time.
english.completion: You're finished! Just in time. I don't think we could have held them much longer.$B$BAn artifact? Could this be something we can use against the naga? I suppose that would require finding it.$B$BWe may have to attend to more pressing matters first, until an opportunity to pursue this further presents itself.
english.completed: Speak to Wavespeaker Tulra on Nar'shola Terrace.
english.objective1: Witness the Continuing Story of the Battlemaiden

text.title: 失地
text.objectives: Use Wavespeaker Tulra's sea horse to return to Captain Vilethorn just north of the Quel'Dormir Gardens.
text.description: 你稍后再向我汇报吧。现在，我们得趁纳迦反扑之前离开这里。先返回下层前哨站。$B$B骑上我的海马，稍后我们再碰头。
text.completion: You made it! After the attack at the forward post, I thought we might be the only ones left. It's good to see you in one piece, $c.
text.completed: Retreat to Legion's Rest.

english.title: Losing Ground
english.objectives: Use Wavespeaker Tulra's sea horse to return to Captain Vilethorn just north of the Quel'Dormir Gardens.
english.description: You'll have to catch me up more later. Right now, we need to get out of here before more naga push in. Make your way back to the forward post on the level below us.$B$BTake my sea horse. We will meet you back there shortly.
english.completion: You made it! After the attack at the forward post, I thought we might be the only ones left. It's good to see you in one piece, $c.
english.completed: Retreat to Legion's Rest.

text.title: 绝望的计划
text.objectives: Meet with Fiasco Sizzlegrin on Biel'aran Ridge.
text.description: Toldrek and Fiasco left to find a way to contact help. The trade lanes aren't far, so there might be a chance of success, but I'm wary to let anyone get their hopes up.$B$BIn truth, we don't have any other options. We're not likely to last much longer here. The naga will find us eventually, and... well... you saw how many of them there were.$B$BYou should go find the two of them on Biel'aran Ridge to the southeast. I'll keep everyone here safe as long as I can.
text.completion: Look at you, a regular aquatic hero! Trouble comes. You come. Save the day.  You must be proud of yourself!$B$BWe've devised our brilliant plan. Gloriously simple, barring the hostility of local life. Simpler yet with a you available!

text.title: 敌对水域
text.objectives: 消灭10名污皮拾荒者。
text.description: Fiasco came out here with a balloon of some sort that he retrieved from one of our ships. He tried to float it to the top, but those Muckskin Scroungers came out of nowhere and swarmed the thing.$B$BHe's got an idea for another balloon, but we need to make sure that the past doesn't repeat itself. I need you to kill off those giblins. Or at the very least, enough of them to make them fear us.
text.completion: Less gilblins is good.$B$BI'm glad that they're so primitive. I don't think I'd want to be dealing with a race of aquatic tech-freaks right now.
text.completed: Return to Fiasco Sizzlegrin on Biel'aran Ridge.

text.title: 有备而来
text.objectives: Retrieve a Horde Survival Kit.
text.description: It's a short swim to the top. Not much trouble really. Hard to get any supplies up there though. Too heavy.$B$BAll of the ships in all of the Horde fleets stow a survival kit. I had a balloon from the old survival kit, but it fell on hard times recently. I need another survival kit.$B$BThere's a ship to the southeastish. Let's hope that the survivors were dumb and didn't take the survival kit. More survival kit for us.
text.progress: A whole big box of amazing! That's what it is. I need more amazing in my life.$B$BDon't worry, I'll share.
text.completion: Let me see, let me see... flare gun... balloon... no rope. Never any rope. Terribly impractical if you do ask me. Rope should be mandatory.
text.completed: Return to Fiasco Sizzlegrin on Biel'aran Ridge.

text.title: 展开计划
text.objectives: 收集8根克瓦迪尔套索。
text.description: Survival kits never have any rope. It makes no sense! Rope and bombs, that's all they should store. The rest of this stuff is just a waste of space.$B$BExcept maybe the balloon. That's coming in handy right now.$B$BI bet those Kvaldir have rope. They're always riding around in boats, tying knots, dressing in nets. Go take some rope from them! I must have it for our plan to work. It is non-optional.
text.progress: The rope ties the whole plan together!
text.completion: This is great! I love it. It should work per... ewww! Is this stuff braided with hair?$B$BDoesn't matter. Almost done. This thing will be ready in the twist of a rope.
text.completed: Return to Fiasco Sizzlegrin on Biel'aran Ridge.

text.title: 荣幸与特权
text.objectives: Swim to the surface, retrieve the flare gun, and fire a rescue flare towards the Horde Ships.
text.description: All done! I'm confident it will work. And not a scrounger in sight to pop a hole in it this time! Well played.$B$BToldrek already swam up to catch it, all concerned about currents and what not. He said you'd get the honors though. Nice guy - don't know how he lasts.$B$BGo to the top with the balloon, take the flare gun from the crate, and scan the horizon for Horde ships. If you see any, fire the flare towards them. That's it! All there is to it.$B$BSwim. Float. Flare. Rescue! That last part's my favorite.
text.completion: Perfect! There's no way they missed that, fighting or not.
text.completed: Speak to Bloodguard Toldrek on the surface above Biel'aran Ridge.
text.objective1: Swim up to the rescue balloon on the surface
text.objective2: Fire a rescue flare towards the Horde ships

text.title: 好消息
text.objectives: Return to Legionnaire Nazgrim at Legion's Rest.
text.description: 他们可能会发一个小船，可能会花一点时间。我将留在这里联系。$B$B你需要立即返回山洞，让他们知道救援正在进行中。我们只能希望娜迦还没有找到他们。$B$BGo。游得快，$N。
text.completion: That is the best news I've ever heard. We'll get the survivors moving over there to the surface as soon as possible. Perhaps we can forget that this whole nightmare ever happened.$B$BThank you, $n. You've shown your worth down here. There will be a glorious spot in the Horde for you.$B$BYou should consider meeting us at the ships later, when you finish saying your goodbyes to the naga.

english.title: Welcome News
english.objectives: Return to Legionnaire Nazgrim at Legion's Rest.
english.description: They'll probably send a skiff over, which may take a bit. I'll stay here to make contact.$B$BYou need to return to the cave immediately and let them know that rescue is on its way. We can only hope that the naga have not found them yet.$B$BGo. Swim fast, $n.
english.completion: That is the best news I've ever heard. We'll get the survivors moving over there to the surface as soon as possible. Perhaps we can forget that this whole nightmare ever happened.$B$BThank you, $n. You've shown your worth down here. There will be a glorious spot in the Horde for you.$B$BYou should consider meeting us at the ships later, when you finish saying your goodbyes to the naga.

text.title: 进攻希拉柯丝
text.objectives: 杀死10只希拉柯丝纳迦。
text.description: So, you're the $N everyone's been talking about? It's good to finally meet you.$B$BWell, enough talk, right? Let's get down to it. I need you to swim out northwest to the Sira'kess Front and kill those naga real quick.$B$BNothing fancy. They're looking for a fight, and we'll give them one! Well, you will.
text.completion: Nice, $N! That will show those naga who's the boss!$B$BNow it's time for that drink. You want rum or wine?
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Gertrude at the Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 夺回财宝
text.objectives: 收集6份深鳍战利品。
text.description: 援军到了，但我们总得想办法筹到军饷吧。他们跑这一趟，军需开支可不便宜。$B$B海地精们将偷来的各种财宝堆放在西北方的深鳍海崖上。我觉得取走一些充当军饷也挺不错的。
text.progress: How much plunder have you managed to reclaim, $n?
text.completion: That should be enough for now. We know where there's more should the need arise.
text.completed: Return to Jorlan Trueblade at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Treasure Reclamation
english.objectives: Collect 6 Deepfin Plunder.
english.description: We've got our reinforcements, but we still need to find a way to pay them. That kind of action doesn't come cheap.$B$BUp on Deepfin Ridge to the northwest, the slimy gilblin have stolen all sorts of treasure. I think that it's time to reclaim some of it for the cause.
english.progress: How much plunder have you managed to reclaim, $n?
english.completion: That should be enough for now. We know where there's more should the need arise.
english.completed: Return to Jorlan Trueblade at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

text.progress: How much plunder did you get, $N?
text.completion: That's a lot! And we know where there's more should the need arise.
text.completed: Return to Bloodguard Toldrek at the Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 阿泽拉夏的末日
text.objectives: 将联盟旗帜插在深渊召唤者阿泽拉夏的躯体旁。
text.description: $N，蛇形人正在追赶我们的军队。我要你返回西北边的深鳍海崖，将这面好看的旗帜插在那个白痴头目身旁。$B$B蛇形人肯定会吓得屁滚尿流，夹起尾巴四下逃命的。当然，他们是没有腿的。
text.completion: Nice Uncle Bob of pokin' their general.
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant "Foxy" Topper at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.
text.giverWindow: Plant a banner in his corpse!
text.objective1: Banner planted in Fathom-Caller Azrajar's corpse

english.title: A Standard Day for Azrajar
english.objectives: Plant the Alliance Standard in Fathom-Caller Azrajar's corpse.
english.description: $N, the snakes are after our daft and barmy. Go back northwest to Deepfin Ridge and plant some do me good in that pot and pan pitch and toss of theirs.$B$BThey'll kick and prance away with their alderman's nails tucked between their nutmegs when they see that. Not that they've got any nutmegs mind you.
english.completion: Nice Uncle Bob of pokin' their general.
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant "Foxy" Topper at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.
english.giverWindow: Plant a banner in his corpse!
english.objective1: Banner planted in Fathom-Caller Azrajar's corpse

text.title: 冰中之棺
text.objectives: 在盔枕湖打破六口冰墓，解救困在里面的被冻结的巡山人。
text.description: 库格恩告诉我大灾变扰乱了世界各地的元素平衡。南边的盔枕湖往常美丽而宁静，现在那儿却充斥着躁动的水元素。它们离开了湖水的约束，我只好派人去对付它们，结果他们大多数人都被冻到冰块里了。$B$B如果我们能把他们解救出来的话，他们康复的机会或许还不小。我没法腾出人手来对盔枕湖进行第二次远征。你愿不愿意试试？
text.completion: You've done it! The mountaineers are returning to camp and our medics will have their hands full. We are all in your debt, $n.
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Bahrum at Bahrum's Post.

english.title: Entombed in Ice
english.objectives: Break open six Icy Tombs to free the Frozen Mountaineers trapped inside at Helm's Bed Lake.
english.description: Khurgorn tells me the cataclysm upset the balance of the elements all over the world. Helm's Bed Lake, to the south, used to be beautiful and tranquil, but it is now overrun with agitated water elementals. When they started to leave the confines of the lake, I sent my troops in to keep them busy, but most have been frozen in blocks of ice.$B$BIf we can break them free, they have a good chance of recovering. I cannot spare the men for a second expedition out onto the lake. Would you be willing to try?
english.completion: You've done it! The mountaineers are returning to camp and our medics will have their hands full. We are all in your debt, $n.
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Bahrum at Bahrum's Post.

text.title: 情绪澎湃
text.objectives: 在盔枕湖杀死6只盔枕湖涌动者。
text.description: 元素处于混乱之中，$C。大灾变打扰了南边盔枕湖长年蛰伏的水灵。它们愤怒、迷惑，不愿意听从我的请求。$B$B我把我所知道的所有方法都试过了，想让它们平静下来，劝说它们不要攻击中士的巡山人。$B$B我很不情愿这么说，但没有别的选择——我们必须杀掉那些元素。
text.completion: It is never easy to countenance violence against the very elements whose powers I wield, but sometimes there is no other solution. Our duty to the people of Dun Morogh comes first.
text.completed: Return to Khurgorn Singefeather at Bahrum's Post

english.title: Dealing with the Surge
english.objectives: Kill 6 Helm's Bed Surgers at Helm's Bed Lake.
english.description: The elements are in turmoil, $c. The cataclysm stirred up the long-dormant water spirits of Helm's Bed Lake, just to the south. They're angry, confused, and unwilling to hear my pleas.$B$BI have tried everything I know to calm them, to persuade them to stop lashing out and attacking the sergeant's mountaineers.$B$BIt pains me to say this, but no other options remain -- we must kill the elementals.
english.completion: It is never easy to countenance violence against the very elements whose powers I wield, but sometimes there is no other solution. Our duty to the people of Dun Morogh comes first.
english.completed: Return to Khurgorn Singefeather at Bahrum's Post

text.objectives: Plant the Horde Standard in Fathom-Caller Azrajar's corpse.
text.description: $N, the naga are after our forces. I need you to go back northwest to Deepfin Ridge and stick our standard in their general, Fathom-Caller Azrajar.$B$BThey'll swim away with their tails tucked between their... er. Well, I guess they don't have any legs, now do they?
text.completion: Stuck him right through, did you? I would have loved to have seen that!
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Gertrude at the Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.

text.objectives: 收集6个无悯之头。
text.description: $N，那些恶魔章鱼控制了海地精，将他们的思想占为己有！这也是获得奴隶的方法之一。$B$B游往西北边的深鳍海崖或是希拉柯丝前哨，带回一些无悯之头来。
text.progress: How many you got?
text.completion: Ah, they're ugly, but they mostly look harmless. Smelly though. Here, let me clean the gilblin stuff out of these. I've got an idea....
text.completed: Return to Engineer Hexascrub at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Those Aren't Masks
english.objectives: Collect 6 Merciless Heads.
english.description: $N, there are these demon squid-things out there that are eating gilblins' heads and then taking them over! That's one way to get slaves.$B$BThink you could swim out northwest onto Deepfin Ridge or into the Sira'kess Front and bring me back some of those Merciless things?
english.progress: How many you got?
english.completion: Ah, they're ugly, but they mostly look harmless. Smelly though. Here, let me clean the gilblin stuff out of these. I've got an idea....
