text.title: 海角岗哨
text.objectives: 与瓦丝琪尔海角岗哨的泰勒上尉交谈。
text.description: 我们得把这个情报告知海角岗哨的泰勒上尉！他跟石语者埃鲁纳克以及大地之环的成员待在一起，就在西北边。
text.completion: That's very disturbing news, but I believe our Earthen Ring friends here have a plan. And now that you're here....

english.title: Promontory Point
english.objectives: Speak with Captain Taylor on Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.
english.description: We need to get this information up to Captain Taylor on Promontory Point! He's out there to the northwest with Erunak Stonespeaker and the Earthen Ring.
english.completion: That's very disturbing news, but I believe our Earthen Ring friends here have a plan. And now that you're here....

text.title: 海角岗哨
text.objectives: Speak with Legionnaire Nazgrim on Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.
text.description: $N, I need you to get this information to Legionnaire Nazgrim on Promontory Point. He's up there to the northwest with Erunak Stonespeaker and those Earthen Ring people.
text.completion: If it weren't you saying it, I wouldn't believe what that troublesome goblin has to say. This is troubling indeed, but I think our Earthen Ring friends have a few ideas.$B$BAnd now that you're here....

english.title: Promontory Point
english.objectives: Speak with Legionnaire Nazgrim on Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.
english.description: $N, I need you to get this information to Legionnaire Nazgrim on Promontory Point. He's up there to the northwest with Erunak Stonespeaker and those Earthen Ring people.
english.completion: If it weren't you saying it, I wouldn't believe what that troublesome goblin has to say. This is troubling indeed, but I think our Earthen Ring friends have a few ideas.$B$BAnd now that you're here....

text.title: 海加尔山上的鹰
text.objectives: 去找海加尔山艾维娜圣殿的楚伦娜。
text.description: $N，据说你要去尝试跟古神交流，这是真的吗？$B$B西南边就是所有飞行生物的看护者，艾维娜的圣殿。它也是我最爱的导师楚伦娜的家。我从没见过有谁像她一样，同这个世界的灵魂有如此之深的交流。你可以从她那里学到许多！$B$B最近几次进攻已经将圣殿孤立了起来，但从空中还是能很容易进去的——去找海加尔第二大的树就是了。祝你好运！
text.completion: Oh, you were sent here by Tiala? A wonderful student, she'll do many great things. Although I sense even greater potential from you. Please, stay a while in our shrine. There's much to do, but you can't accomplish anything with a troubled mind.
text.completed: Locate Choluna at the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.

english.title: Wings Over Mount Hyjal
english.objectives: Locate Choluna at the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.
english.description: $N, is it true you're going to try to commune with the ancients?$B$BSouthwest of here is the Shrine of Aviana, the matron of all flying creatures. It's the home of my favorite instructor, Choluna. I've never encountered one who was so deeply in touch with the spirits of this world. You could learn a lot from her!$B$BThe recent attacks have isolated the shrine. But it's easily accessible from the air - look for the second biggest tree on Hyjal. Good luck!
english.completion: Oh, you were sent here by Tiala? A wonderful student, she'll do many great things. Although I sense even greater potential from you. Please, stay a while in our shrine. There's much to do, but you can't accomplish anything with a troubled mind.
english.completed: Locate Choluna at the Shrine of Aviana in Mount Hyjal.

text.title: 盔枕湖的麻烦
text.objectives: 跟巴赫隆岗哨的巴赫隆中士谈一谈。
text.description: 你帮助我们保卫了矿洞，并成功地解救了被困的矿工。$B$B参议院如果得知你和萨兰恩队长的巡山人共同保卫了丹莫罗，一定会非常欣慰的。$B$B不过我至今还没有收到来自巴赫隆中士和他的小分队的消息，这令我有点担心。他们朝东边的盔枕湖去了，准备在那里设立一座前哨战。你能去巴赫隆岗哨找他吗？
text.completion: It's a good thing the Senator didn't come out here on his own. It's dangerous, and we're going to need all the help we can get to get the situation under control.

english.title: Trouble at the Lake
english.objectives: Speak with Sergeant Bahrum at Bahrum's Post.
english.description: You've been a great help in securing the mines and rescuing the trapped miners.$B$BThe Senate will be heartened to hear that you and Captain Tharran's mountaineers have made progress in securing Dun Morogh.$B$BWhat worries me is that I haven't seen any reports from Sergeant Bahrum and his detachment. They were sent east, along the road toward Helm's Bed Lake, and ordered to set up a small outpost. Would you go to Bahrum's Post and check in on the sergeant?
english.completion: It's a good thing the Senator didn't come out here on his own. It's dangerous, and we're going to need all the help we can get to get the situation under control.

text.title: 戴上它
text.objectives: 戴上无悯之头，看看会发生什么。
text.description: 嗨，$N。我们来玩玩乔装打扮嘛！挑一个章鱼脑袋戴到你的头上试试嘛。$B$B这能出什么问题啊？$B$B准备好了吗？
text.completion: What happened? That thing wasn't completely dead! Maybe I should stick to mechanical stuff. It gave you a vision? Of killing all of us?! That doesn't sound good. Well, in any case, that Earthen Ring fellow, Erunak Stonespeaker, wants these specimens all taken out to him. I'll make sure he gets them. I don't want them anywhere near me.
text.completed: Speak with Engineer Hexascrub at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Put It On
english.objectives: Witness what occurs when you place the Merciless One on your head.
english.description: Hey, $N, I've got an idea for a disguise! Take one of these merciless whatchamacallits and put it on your head.$B$BWhat could possibly go wrong?$B$BReady to put it on?
english.completion: What happened? That thing wasn't completely dead! Maybe I should stick to mechanical stuff. It gave you a vision? Of killing all of us?! That doesn't sound good. Well, in any case, that Earthen Ring fellow, Erunak Stonespeaker, wants these specimens all taken out to him. I'll make sure he gets them. I don't want them anywhere near me.
english.completed: Speak with Engineer Hexascrub at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 戴上它
text.objectives: 戴上无悯之头，看看会发生什么。
text.description: I've got an idea for a sweet disguise, but I'm going to need your help, $N! Take one of these merciless corpses and put it on your head.$B$BI know, I know, but it's dead, so what could possibly go wrong other than you smelling bad for a day or two?$B$BReady to put it on?
text.completion: My bad. My name is Fiasco for a reason. I should have known that thing wasn't completely dead when it wiggled a little.$B$BYou say it gave you a vision? Of killing all of us?! That doesn't sound good.$B$BHrm, well that Earthen Ring fellow, Erunak Stonespeaker, wants these specimens all taken out to him. I'll make sure they get out there. It's not like I want them stinking up the place around here.
text.completed: Speak with Fiasco Sizzlegrin at the Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Put It On
english.objectives: Witness what occurs when you place the Merciless One on your head.
english.description: I've got an idea for a sweet disguise, but I'm going to need your help, $N! Take one of these merciless corpses and put it on your head.$B$BI know, I know, but it's dead, so what could possibly go wrong other than you smelling bad for a day or two?$B$BReady to put it on?
english.completion: My bad. My name is Fiasco for a reason. I should have known that thing wasn't completely dead when it wiggled a little.$B$BYou say it gave you a vision? Of killing all of us?! That doesn't sound good.$B$BHrm, well that Earthen Ring fellow, Erunak Stonespeaker, wants these specimens all taken out to him. I'll make sure they get out there. It's not like I want them stinking up the place around here.
english.completed: Speak with Fiasco Sizzlegrin at the Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 抓螃蟹
text.objectives: 在奈瑟匹拉体内，使用达鲁的网捕捉一只深渊猎手蟹。
text.description: 我的整个身心都能感觉到奈瑟匹拉正在试图与我交流，但我就是听不到她的声音。也许纳迦对她的声音动了什么手脚。$B$B<达鲁思考了一会。>$B$B奈瑟匹拉的声音也许是被压制了……也就是说……我们要为她找到发声的办法！$B$B我知道了！埃卓凯丝纳迦经常训练深渊猎手蟹作为战斗宠物。用这张网去捉一只螃蟹，把它给我带来。你可以在这间腔室的外缘找到它们。
text.progress: I hope this works.  My skills as a shaman are limited, and I fear that this task may be too much for us.
text.completion: <Duarn looks at the crab and disguises a frown.>$b$bIt doesn't look very impressive, does it?
text.completed: Return to Earthmender Duarn inside Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Capture the Crab
english.objectives: Use Duarn's Net to capture a Deepseeker Crab inside of Nespirah.
english.description: Everything in my body tells me that Nespirah is trying to speak with me, but I cannot hear her.  Perhaps the naga have done something to her voice.$b$b<Duarn thinks to himself for a moment.>$b$bNespirah's voice may be suppressed... that means... we need to find a voice for her!$b$bI've got it!  The Idra'kess have been known to train deepseeker crabs as battle companions.  Use this net to capture a crab, and bring it to me.  You will likely find them prowling the chamber's outer edges.
english.progress: I hope this works.  My skills as a shaman are limited, and I fear that this task may be too much for us.
english.completion: <Duarn looks at the crab and disguises a frown.>$b$bIt doesn't look very impressive, does it?
english.completed: Return to Earthmender Duarn inside Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 过关斩将
text.objectives: 在大地治愈者达鲁尝试与奈瑟匹拉交谈时，在一旁观察。
text.description: 训练有素的萨满祭司可以与四种元素交流——大地，火焰，空气和水。这是众所周知的。$B$B但是，不那么众所周知的一件事是，其实还有第五种元素。这种元素的表述不像其它四种那么清晰，它与所有生物都具备的某种共性相关。$B$B我的想法是，既然这只螃蟹是海洋生物，那么它与奈瑟匹拉就有很相似的地方。借助元素的影响，我们可以说服它给奈瑟匹拉当传声筒。
text.completion: I had assumed that the naga were only here for those pearls.  No, this makes much more sense.  If they had Nespirah's power under their control, the amount of damage the naga could do would be catastrophic!$b$bSomething must be done.
text.completed: Return to Earthmender Duarn inside of Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Breaking Through
english.objectives: Observe as Earthmender Duarn attempts to speak with Nespirah.
english.description: A trained shaman has the ability to communicate with the four elements of earth, fire, air and water.  This is known.$b$bWhat is not as widely known, however, is the presence of a fifth element.  This element is not as clearly described as the other four, but it has to do with the shared... commonality between all living creatures.$b$bMy theory is that the crab, as a creature of the sea, is close enough to Nespirah that, with the elements' coaxing, we can convince it to act as Nespirah's mouthpiece.
english.completion: I had assumed that the naga were only here for those pearls.  No, this makes much more sense.  If they had Nespirah's power under their control, the amount of damage the naga could do would be catastrophic!$b$bSomething must be done.
english.completed: Return to Earthmender Duarn inside of Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 我们并不孤单
text.objectives: Find the Horde survivors inside of Nespirah in Vashj'ir.
text.description: <Duarn closes his eyes, pauses, and nods.>$b$bNespirah has just informed me that we are not the only people fighting inside of this shell.  A small group of Horde slaves has escaped and is currently fighting off the naga on the other side of the shell, up on the ledge that overlooks Nespirah's heart.$b$bGo find them, $N, and see what help they can lend us.  With their aid, we may be able to rouse Nespirah from her torpor.$b$bI will remain here, should you need anything.
text.completion: $N…是你吗？！我以为你和其他人一起死了！$B$B是的，你一直很强，就算当初在赤脊山的时候你就已经很强了。$B$B我们的战斗还未结束，$N。他们曾经攻击过我的家乡。我来到这里就是为了确保这种事情不再发生。$B$B如果你还能像那天一样的战斗，那么就加入我的行列。你可以从南方的雏龙丘陵开始，杀死他们的驭龙者和刚刚孵化的黑龙。$B$B这就像是旧日时光重现。

english.title: We Are Not Alone
english.objectives: Find the Horde survivors inside of Nespirah in Vashj'ir.
english.description: <Duarn closes his eyes, pauses, and nods.>$b$bNespirah has just informed me that we are not the only people fighting inside of this shell.  A small group of Horde slaves has escaped and is currently fighting off the naga on the other side of the shell, up on the ledge that overlooks Nespirah's heart.$b$bGo find them, $N, and see what help they can lend us.  With their aid, we may be able to rouse Nespirah from her torpor.$b$bI will remain here, should you need anything.
english.completion: $N... is that you?

text.title: 手无寸铁
text.objectives: 从奈瑟匹拉里面的武器架上收集4支被盗的长矛。
text.description: 说实话，我都不知道我们是如何撑这么久的。纳迦拿走了我的护甲和武器，只给我留了几件破衣服和一把采矿锄……而且那把锄早就断了。$B$B如果我们还想扳回局面的话，我就需要一些武器装备……我的伙伴们也一样，不过可能他们不太愿意承认这一点。$B$B我在附近的纳迦库房见过武器架。虽然我对三叉戟不是很熟，但用它总比用我自己的拳头好。
text.progress: In my youth, I was given some training on spearfighting.$b$b"Stick them with the pointy end," I think it was.
text.completion: <Captain Vilethorn admires the polearms you present him.>$b$bOh, I'm sorry.  I was just imagining what these will look like with little bits of naga stuck to the ends of them.  Thank you, $N.  We'll put these to good use.
text.completed: Return to Captain Vilethorn inside of Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Hopelessly Gearless
english.objectives: Obtain 4 Purloined Polearms from the weapon racks inside of Nespirah.
english.description: I honestly don't know how we've survived this long.  The naga took my armor and weapons, and left me with rags and a mining pick... and THAT snapped in half long ago.$b$bIf we're to stand any hope of turning the tide, I'm going to need something to fight with... as will my companions, though they may be too proud to admit it.$b$bI've seen weapon racks in the naga storage areas nearby.  I'm not accustomed to fighting with a trident, but it'll sure be better than fighting with my fists.
english.progress: In my youth, I was given some training on spearfighting.$b$b"Stick them with the pointy end," I think it was.
english.completion: <Captain Vilethorn admires the polearms you present him.>$b$bOh, I'm sorry.  I was just imagining what these will look like with little bits of naga stuck to the ends of them.  Thank you, $N.  We'll put these to good use.
english.completed: Return to Captain Vilethorn inside of Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 刺痛躯体
text.objectives: 在奈瑟匹拉的体腔内的墙上攻击7处奈瑟匹拉脓肿。
text.description: <Legionnaire Nazgrim listens intently to your recount of Duarn and Nespirah's conversation.>$b$bI see.  So the creature wants our help waking it up, is that it?$b$bWith hundreds of slaves already picking away at her pearls, the beast seems to be a pretty heavy sleeper.  You might have better luck, though.$b$bMy suggestion?  Look around the creature's flesh for signs of weakness.  Maybe that weapon of yours will find a ticklish spot and force the beast to come to its senses.
text.completion: Hopefully we made some progress.  I'm not sure how we'll know when the creature wakes up, but something tells me that it will be pretty obvious when it does.
text.completed: Return to Legionnaire Nazgrim inside of Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Body Blows
english.objectives: Attack 7 Nespirah Abscesses along the walls of Nespirah's body chamber.
english.description: <Legionnaire Nazgrim listens intently to your recount of Duarn and Nespirah's conversation.>$b$bI see.  So the creature wants our help waking it up, is that it?$b$bWith hundreds of slaves already picking away at her pearls, the beast seems to be a pretty heavy sleeper.  You might have better luck, though.$b$bMy suggestion?  Look around the creature's flesh for signs of weakness.  Maybe that weapon of yours will find a ticklish spot and force the beast to come to its senses.
english.completion: Hopefully we made some progress.  I'm not sure how we'll know when the creature wakes up, but something tells me that it will be pretty obvious when it does.
english.completed: Return to Legionnaire Nazgrim inside of Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 仍有价值
text.objectives: 从奈瑟匹拉里面的埃卓凯丝督军和埃卓凯丝先知手中夺取5颗神秘的珍珠。
text.description: 被困在珍珠采掘场的短暂日子，使我对纳迦的真正目的感到好奇。对，现在我知道纳迦想要把奈瑟匹拉当成无坚不摧的战争机器，不过如果只有这么简单的话，为什么还要把我们绑去采珍珠？$B$B假如我们能逃出去的话，我倒是很想研究一下这些珍珠。我们在采掘场里找到的珍珠都太大了，搬都没法搬，不过我见过那些督军和先知随身带着小珍珠。
text.progress: The naga must have some ulterior motive with these pearls.  If I had time to study them, I'm certain I could figure it out.
text.completion: Brilliant work!$b$b<Tulra tucks the pearls away beneath her armor.>$b$bNow I just need you and Legionnaire Nazgrim to get me safely out of here.  I can handle the studies from there on.
text.completed: Return to Wavespeaker Tulra inside of Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Still Valuable
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Mysterious Pearls from Idra'kess Warlords and Idra'kess Prophets inside of Nespirah.
english.description: My time in the pearl pits, however short, has made me curious about the naga's goals.  Yes, I now know that the naga want to use Nespirah as an engine of war, but if that's the case, then why are they enslaving men to mine her pearls?$b$bAssuming we escape this creature's hull, I would very much like to study these objects.  The pearls we found in the pits were much too large to carry, but I've seen the warlords and prophets occasionally carrying around smaller ones.
english.progress: The naga must have some ulterior motive with these pearls.  If I had time to study them, I'm certain I could figure it out.
english.completion: Brilliant work!$b$b<Tulra tucks the pearls away beneath her armor.>$b$bNow I just need you and Legionnaire Nazgrim to get me safely out of here.  I can handle the studies from there on.
english.completed: Return to Wavespeaker Tulra inside of Nespirah in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 监督者埃卓凯丝
text.objectives: 前往奈瑟匹拉的顶部，杀死监督者埃卓凯丝。
text.description: My men are flagging, $N.  We won't last much longer against these naga, I'm afraid.  With the Idra'kess' weapons, and Nespirah's pearls, we should be ready to bust out of here.$b$bFollow the wall northeast, and look for a ramp to the upper chamber.  I assume their leader is in there, or perhaps the key to Nespirah's awakening.  Hopefully both.$b$bIf you feel strong enough, head up to the top of the shell and look for some answers.  Hellscream's eyes are upon you!
text.completion: No need to bring me up to speed... Nespirah has been narrating your adventures as they happened, and Legionnaire Nazgrim filled me in on the rest.$b$b<Duarn closes his eyes and nods.>$b$bNespirah says that she is quite grateful, and that she has a small surprise ready for the naga.
text.completed: Report to Earthmender Duarn near Nespirah's brain in Vashj'ir.
text.giverWindow: Desecrator of Nespirah.

english.title: Overseer Idra'kess
english.objectives: Head to the top of Nespirah and slay Overseer Idra'kess.
english.description: My men are flagging, $N.  We won't last much longer against these naga, I'm afraid.  With the Idra'kess' weapons, and Nespirah's pearls, we should be ready to bust out of here.$b$bFollow the wall northeast, and look for a ramp to the upper chamber.  I assume their leader is in there, or perhaps the key to Nespirah's awakening.  Hopefully both.$b$bIf you feel strong enough, head up to the top of the shell and look for some answers.  Hellscream's eyes are upon you!
english.completion: No need to bring me up to speed... Nespirah has been narrating your adventures as they happened, and Legionnaire Nazgrim filled me in on the rest.$b$b<Duarn closes his eyes and nods.>$b$bNespirah says that she is quite grateful, and that she has a small surprise ready for the naga.
english.completed: Report to Earthmender Duarn near Nespirah's brain in Vashj'ir.
english.giverWindow: Desecrator of Nespirah.

text.title: 唤醒巨兽
text.objectives: 与奈瑟匹拉里面的大地治愈者达鲁交谈，激活奈瑟匹拉的生物防御机制，然后逃离奈瑟匹拉的身体。
text.description: Thanks to you and the Legionnaire, Nespirah has full control of her body... but most of the naga don't know this yet.  Once we make our escape, she will activate her biological defenses and destroy the naga from within.$b$bMake yourself ready... I will now tell Nespirah to begin the countdown.
text.completion: It appears that I owe you my life, yet again.  Thank Hellscream that you found me before you and your shaman activated those bio-defenses.
text.completed: Report to Legionnaire Nazgrim at Legion's Rest in Vashj'ir.
text.objective1: Listen as Duarn speaks to Nespirah

english.title: Waking the Beast
english.objectives: Speak with Earthmender Duarn inside of Nespirah to activate her bio-defenses, then escape from Nespirah's body.
english.description: Thanks to you and the Legionnaire, Nespirah has full control of her body... but most of the naga don't know this yet.  Once we make our escape, she will activate her biological defenses and destroy the naga from within.$b$bMake yourself ready... I will now tell Nespirah to begin the countdown.
english.completion: It appears that I owe you my life, yet again.  Thank Hellscream that you found me before you and your shaman activated those bio-defenses.
english.completed: Report to Legionnaire Nazgrim at Legion's Rest in Vashj'ir.
english.objective1: Listen as Duarn speaks to Nespirah

text.title: 黑铁的阴谋
text.objectives: 在铁环营地杀死5名黑铁间谍，从贝尔德队长的身上缴获黑铁攻击计划。
text.description: 一批黑铁间谍占据了南面盔枕湖后边的铁环营地。通常巡山人可以阻止他们进入丹莫罗，但现在一切都乱了套。$B$B要是不趁乱混进来，那黑铁矮人才傻呢。我们得查明白他们准备干什么，在他们造成损失之前就将其阻止。$B$B你能否去查看一下，他们到底在铁环营地有什么打算？
text.progress: What are the Dark Irons up to?
text.completion: I knew they weren't here to see the sights. This is more serious than we thought! This is no mere raid. The Dark Irons intend to cripple the defense of Ironforge itself!
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Bahrum at Bahrum's Post.

english.title: Dark Iron Scheming
english.objectives: Kill 5 Dark Iron Spies and capture the Dark Iron Attack Plans from Captain Beld at Ironband's Compound.
english.description: A cadre of Dark Iron spies have taken over Ironband's Compound to the south, beyond Helm's Bed Lake. The mountaineers are normally able to keep them from getting into Dun Morogh, but everything is in disarray right now.$B$BThe Dark Iron dwarves would be fools if they didn't take advantage of the chaos. We have to find out what they're planning and stop them before they do any damage.$B$BWill you see if you can discover what they're doing down at Ironband's Compound?
english.progress: What are the Dark Irons up to?
english.completion: I knew they weren't here to see the sights. This is more serious than we thought! This is no mere raid. The Dark Irons intend to cripple the defense of Ironforge itself!
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Bahrum at Bahrum's Post.

text.title: 前往机场
text.objectives: 在古博拉采掘场乘坐马歇尔的飞行器。
text.description: 根据你缴获的计划书，黑铁矮人打算对铁炉堡飞行器机坪发动一次全面进攻！议会把我们大部分兵力都派往丹莫罗，去处理大灾变造成的不稳定因素，让机坪后防空虚。$B$B我们得想办法把你尽快送到机坪去。沿着路往西，回到古博拉采掘场去找马歇尔·锈钳。他应该有架飞行器你可以用。去吧！
text.completion: Thank goodness you're here, $n. The airfield's been attacked by the Dark Irons and I don't think we can hold out much longer.
text.completed: Speak with Commander Stonebreaker at the Ironforge Airfield.

english.title: Get to the Airfield
english.objectives: Board Mathel's Flying Machine at the Gol'Bolar Quarry.
english.description: According to the plans you captured, the Dark Irons are planning a large-scale attack on the Ironforge Airfield! The council has moved most of our forces down into Dun Morogh to deal with the instability brought by the cataclysm, leaving our defenses weakened at the airfield.$B$BWe need a way to get you to the airfield quickly. Take the road back west toward Gol'Bolar Quarry and find Mathel Rustwrench. He should have a flying machine you can use. Go!
english.completion: Thank goodness you're here, $n. The airfield's been attacked by the Dark Irons and I don't think we can hold out much longer.
english.completed: Speak with Commander Stonebreaker at the Ironforge Airfield.

text.title: 门槛
text.objectives: 埋设8个克罗姆加“精灵杀手”。
text.description: 肮脏下流的暗夜精灵把我们部署在石爪小径的整个雷区都给排掉了。得有人回去把它们重新埋上！这样的任务对像你这样不中用的步兵来说，再合适不过了，$N。但愿你不要把自己炸上天就好。$B$B你可以在北边石爪小径找到四处散落的“精灵杀手”。带上这把扳手开始干活吧，你这只蛆。
text.completion: You have all of your limbs intact. This is a first.
text.completed: Report to Saurboz at the Fold in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Barrier to Entry
english.objectives: Arm 8 Krom'gar "Elf Killers."
english.description: Filthy, good-for-nothin' night elves have managed to disarm our entire minefield in Talondeep Pass. Somebody is gonna have to go back up there and re-arm them all! A perfect task for a worthless grunt like you, $N. Here's to hopin' you don't blow yourself up in the process.$B$BYou'll find our "Elf Killers" scattered across Talondeep Pass, directly north of here. Take this wrench and get to work, maggot.
english.completion: You have all of your limbs intact. This is a first.
english.completed: Report to Saurboz at the Fold in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 洞穴探险
text.objectives: Speak to Gurrok in Deepmist Grotto.
text.description: $N，快！$B$B立即前往洞穴。$B$B我们断后，确保没有敌人跟踪你。
text.completion: ...$r? Here? I must be mad...

english.title: Spelunking
english.objectives: Speak to Gurrok in Deepmist Grotto.
english.description: Hurry, $n!$b$bMake your way to that cavern at once.$b$bWe shall go behind you to ensure that you are not followed.
english.completion: ...$r? Here? I must be mad...

text.title: 失踪的爆破工程师
text.objectives: 找到爆破工程师弗兹维塞。
text.description: 看来你好像也不完全是不中用嘛。也许你可以负责一些更重要的事务。$B$B两天前我派爆破工程师弗兹维塞到狂风矿洞里去。他本该去那里，确保爆破工作一切按计划进行，然后回来汇报。两天过去了，什么消息都没有……$B$B到南边的林子里去找他。他要是侥幸没死，我可得给他好好找点麻烦。
text.completion: Blastgineer Fuzzwhistle is definitely dead. It's probably for the best. It looks like he's holding a note in his hand.

english.title: The Missing Blastgineer
english.objectives: Find Blastgineer Fuzzwhistle.
english.description: It looks like you might not be completely useless after all. Perhaps you can handle something a little more important.$B$BAbout two days ago I sent Blastgineer Fuzzwhistle to Windshear Mine. He was supposed to get there, make sure everything was going according to plan with the bomb, and report back. Two days and nothin'...$B$BHead out to the woods south of here and find him. For his sake, he better be dead.
english.completion: Blastgineer Fuzzwhistle is definitely dead. It's probably for the best. It looks like he's holding a note in his hand.

text.title: 联盟进攻计划书
text.objectives: 从女猎手达文尼娅处获得联盟进攻计划书。
text.description: <你把弗兹维塞的手掰松，拿出纸条。>$B$B他们来了！炸弹的事他们都知道了。正准备进攻克罗姆加壁垒！我想他们派出了搜索队找我。怕是没法逃掉了。我可不会束手就擒。$B$B我想我听到他们过来了！他们的首领是一个名叫达文尼娅的高等精灵女猎手。她说起过进攻计划书。杀掉她，为我复仇，拿到那些计划书！她的帐篷就在附近，朝东便是。$B$B地狱咆哮在注视着你……
text.progress: Did you find Fuzzwhistle?
text.completion: Damn shame... He was a good goblin. As for you, $n, you've done well. These attack plans will help us prepare. I want you to deliver the plans to Overlord Krom'gar personally! There's sure to be a promotion in it for you.
text.completed: Deliver the Alliance Attack Plans to Saurboz at the Fold in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Alliance Attack Plans
english.objectives: Recover the Alliance Attack Plans from Huntress Davinia.
english.description: <You pry the note loose from Fuzzwhistle's hand.>$B$BThey're onto us! They know all about the bomb. Planning an attack on Krom'gar Fortress! I think they sent a search party after me. Won't go out like a chump. They'll get a fight.$B$BI think I hear them coming now! Their leader is a high elf huntress named Davinia. She spoke of attack plans. Avenge me by killing her and getting those plans! Her tent is nearby, to the east.$B$BHellscream's eyes are upon you...
english.progress: Did you find Fuzzwhistle?
english.completion: Damn shame... He was a good goblin. As for you, $n, you've done well. These attack plans will help us prepare. I want you to deliver the plans to Overlord Krom'gar personally! There's sure to be a promotion in it for you.
english.completed: Deliver the Alliance Attack Plans to Saurboz at the Fold in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 失落群岛的教训
text.objectives: 杀死12名达纳苏斯斥候。
text.description: 南边的树林危机重重。到处都是达纳苏斯斥候——从达纳苏斯派来暗杀我们的刺客。也许我们能扭转局势，嗯？$B$B我在失落群岛苦战的时候，一个地精给了我这副红外感温眼镜。它能让佩戴者发现特定生物的体热标识。把这副眼镜带到南边的林子里去。借此你可以轻松地发现那些斥候。尽你所能把他们都杀掉！为了部落！
text.completion: Well done, brother! Now they will know that they cannot sneak up on the Horde!
text.completed: Return to Kilag Gorefang at the Fold in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Lessons from the Lost Isles
english.objectives: Kill 12 Darnassian Scouts.
english.description: There are great dangers in the woods south of here. They are crawling with Darnassian scouts - assassins sent from Darnassus to kill us. Perhaps we can turn the tables on them, eh?$B$BWhen I was marooned on the Lost Isles a goblin gave me these infrared heat focals. They allow the wearer to see heat signatures of certain creatures. Take the focals and use them while in the woods to the south. They will allow you to easily spot the scouts. Kill as many of them as you can! For the Horde!
english.completion: Well done, brother! Now they will know that they cannot sneak up on the Horde!
english.completed: Return to Kilag Gorefang at the Fold in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 克罗姆加壁垒
text.objectives: 将联盟进攻计划书呈给石爪山脉克罗姆加壁垒的克罗姆加大王。
text.description: 我们在石爪山脉的行动大本营是克罗姆加壁垒。在那里，克罗姆加大王监管着该地区所有的部落军事活动。克罗姆加将所发生的一切直接报告给酋长。$B$B你带回来的进攻计划书上，详细描述了不久之后就会有一场针对克罗姆加壁垒的攻击。把计划书带到西南边的壁垒里去，交给监督者。$B$B再会了，$N。真心地愿地狱咆哮眷顾于你。
text.progress: What is the meaning of this interruption? Why does this grunt stand before Overlord Krom'gar?
text.completion: Hmm. Perhaps this grunt is more than he would appear. Perhaps this grunt is in actuality a sergeant. Look now upon Krom'gar Sergeant $n, soldiers. He has come to serve warning of a cowardly Alliance attack. An attack that we will CRUSH!

english.title: Krom'gar Fortress
english.objectives: Deliver the Alliance Attack Plans to Overlord Krom'gar at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: Our main base of operations in Stonetalon Mountains is Krom'gar Fortress. It is from there that Overlord Krom'gar oversees all Horde military activity in the region. Krom'gar reports everything that happens directly to the Warchief.$B$BThe attack plans you brought back detail an assault that's supposed to take place against Krom'gar Fortress soon. Take the plans and head to the fortress, southwest of here. Give them to the Overlord.$B$BSo long, $N. Truly, Hellscream's eyes are upon you.
english.progress: What is the meaning of this interruption? Why does this grunt stand before Overlord Krom'gar?
english.completion: Hmm. Perhaps this grunt is more than he would appear. Perhaps this grunt is in actuality a sergeant. Look now upon Krom'gar Sergeant $n, soldiers. He has come to serve warning of a cowardly Alliance attack. An attack that we will CRUSH!

text.title: 一口新鲜空气
text.objectives: Find Captain Taylor aboard Voldrin's Hold, on the surface above the Ruins of Vashj'ir.
text.description: 泰勒上尉和许多幸存者已经浮出了水面。我相信有一些人急于离开这个地方，但是如果我们要阻止纳迦入侵水元素位面，就得做点什么。$B$B首先，我们需要盯紧那个在一开始摧毁我们船只的触手怪——我们可不想重蹈覆辙。$B$B“洗衣桶”给你留下了这些，应该可以加快你的步伐。
text.completion: You made it out! Good to see you, $n. It's good to be out of the water for a bit, and to have some resources at our disposal again. I'm sure many of the boys would give anything to turn around and head home after what we've been though, but we still have a grim task ahead. What about you? Want to stick it through to the end with us? I wouldn't blame you if you've had your fill.

english.title: A Breath of Fresh Air
english.objectives: Find Captain Taylor aboard Voldrin's Hold, on the surface above the Ruins of Vashj'ir.
english.description: Captain Taylor and many of the other survivors have already made their way to the surface. I'm sure some are just looking to rid themselves of this place for good, but we still have work to do if we're going to stop the naga from invading the plane of water.$B$BFirst, we need to set eyes on the tentacled fiend that destroyed our ships when we first arrived - we don't want a repeat of that nightmare.$B$BHexascrub left these behind for you. They should speed your trip up a bit.
english.completion: You made it out! Good to see you, $n. It's good to be out of the water for a bit, and to have some resources at our disposal again. I'm sure many of the boys would give anything to turn around and head home after what we've been though, but we still have a grim task ahead. What about you? Want to stick it through to the end with us? I wouldn't blame you if you've had your fill.

text.title: 一口新鲜空气
text.objectives: Find Legionnaire Nazgrim aboard the Stygian Bounty, on the surface above the Ruins of Vashj'ir.
text.description: Legionnaire Nazgrim and many of the other survivors have already made their way to the surface. I'm sure some are just looking to rid themselves of this place for good, but we still have work to do if we're going to stop the naga from invading the plane of water.$B$BFirst, we need to set eyes on the tentacled fiend that destroyed our ships when we first arrived - we don't want a repeat of that nightmare.$B$BFiasco left these behind for you. They should speed your trip up a bit.
text.completion: Looks like you make it out in one piece, $c!$B$BIt's good to be out of that foul pit of water for a moment, and to have some resources at our disposal again. Don't get too comfortable though, we still have a grim task ahead.$B$BWhat about you? Had enough honor for one day, or do you want to get back in there and make Hellscream proud?

english.title: A Breath of Fresh Air
english.objectives: Find Legionnaire Nazgrim aboard the Stygian Bounty, on the surface above the Ruins of Vashj'ir.
english.description: Legionnaire Nazgrim and many of the other survivors have already made their way to the surface. I'm sure some are just looking to rid themselves of this place for good, but we still have work to do if we're going to stop the naga from invading the plane of water.$B$BFirst, we need to set eyes on the tentacled fiend that destroyed our ships when we first arrived - we don't want a repeat of that nightmare.$B$BFiasco left these behind for you. They should speed your trip up a bit.
english.completion: Looks like you make it out in one piece, $c!$B$BIt's good to be out of that foul pit of water for a moment, and to have some resources at our disposal again. Don't get too comfortable though, we still have a grim task ahead.$B$BWhat about you? Had enough honor for one day, or do you want to get back in there and make Hellscream proud?

text.title: 最后的汇报
text.objectives: Speak with Gurrok and learn about his ordeal.
text.description: This warrior was near death, but I fear we do not have the time to await his full recovery. He has information we desperately need to know.$b$bBe patient with him, but keep him talking until we've learned all that we can.$b$bWith luck we might discover just what we're up against...
text.completion: Well, it's not encouraging, but it's something...

english.title: Debriefing
english.objectives: Speak with Gurrok and learn about his ordeal.
english.description: This warrior was near death, but I fear we do not have the time to await his full recovery. He has information we desperately need to know.$b$bBe patient with him, but keep him talking until we've learned all that we can.$b$bWith luck we might discover just what we're up against...
english.completion: Well, it's not encouraging, but it's something...

text.title: 减压
text.objectives: Use Moanah's Breathstone on 10 Imprisoned Warriors in The Clutch.
text.description: I simply cannot bear the thought of so many others like this warrior imprisoned, surrounded by naga.$b$bSomething must be done to rescue them!$b$bTry this, $n. Use  it on the prison cells to make them buoyant.$b$bIf we can get them to the surface, at least they stand a chance at being rescued.
text.completion: Let us hope for the safety of those released prisoners. In return for your noble efforts, please accept this gift.
text.completed: Speak with Moanah in Deepmist Grotto.

english.title: Decompression
english.objectives: Use Moanah's Breathstone on 10 Imprisoned Warriors in The Clutch.
english.description: I simply cannot bear the thought of so many others like this warrior imprisoned, surrounded by naga.$b$bSomething must be done to rescue them!$b$bTry this, $n. Use  it on the prison cells to make them buoyant.$b$bIf we can get them to the surface, at least they stand a chance at being rescued.
english.completion: Let us hope for the safety of those released prisoners. In return for your noble efforts, please accept this gift.
english.completed: Speak with Moanah in Deepmist Grotto.

text.title: 搜寻与摧毁
text.objectives: 杀死石爪山脉的20名联盟士兵。
text.description: 联盟在石爪山蚕食着我们的领土。北卫军突破了南面的封锁，占领了西边的风剪山谷。北部前线遭到暗夜精灵士兵的进攻。这一切都必须加以制止！$B$B到石爪山去消灭你遇到的所有联盟士兵。让他们的死亡昭示联盟。$B$B石爪山是属于部落的！
text.completion: Much more blood shall be spilled upon this soil before this war is over. Alliance blood...
text.completed: Return to Overlord Krom'gar at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Seek and Destroy
english.objectives: Slay any 20 soldiers of the Alliance in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: The Alliance encroaches upon our territories within Stonetalon. The forces of Northwatch have broken through our blockade in the south and occupy Windshear Valley, to our west. From the northern front comes an onslaught of night elf soldiers. All must be stopped!$B$BVenture forth into Stonetalon and destroy all Alliance soldiers that cross your path. Let their deaths serve as a message.$B$BStonetalon belongs to the Horde!
english.completion: Much more blood shall be spilled upon this soil before this war is over. Alliance blood...
english.completed: Return to Overlord Krom'gar at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 尘归尘，土归土
text.objectives: 使用克罗姆加火焰喷射器摧毁8座北方城堡帐篷。
text.description: 联盟日益嚣张了起来。就在西边的风剪山谷，北卫军部队建立起了营地。毫无疑问，他们正在准备发动进攻，$N，正如你警告过我们的那样。他们永远不会得逞！$B$B拿上这把火焰喷射器，我的焚化者就是用这个来把藏在森林里的敌人烧出来的。用它摧毁北方城堡帐篷。把一切都烧成灰！
text.completion: Lok'tar! Alliance pigs! Enjoy the victory for it shall be short lived. Your bravery has given us more time to prepare, nothing more.
text.completed: Return to Overlord Krom'gar at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Ashes to Ashes
english.objectives: Use the Krom'gar Flamethrower to destroy 8 Northwatch Tents.
english.description: The Alliance have grown bold. Just west of here, in Windshear Valley, Northwatch troops have set up camp. No doubt they are preparing for the assault you warned us of, $N. They will never get the chance!$B$BTake this flame thrower. It is the same flame thrower my incinerators use to burn our enemies out of hiding in the forests. Use it to destroy the Northwatch tents. Leave only ashes in your wake!
english.completion: Lok'tar! Alliance pigs! Enjoy the victory for it shall be short lived. Your bravery has given us more time to prepare, nothing more.
english.completed: Return to Overlord Krom'gar at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 部落的敌人：帕特劳元帅
text.objectives: 杀死帕特劳元帅。
text.description: 我的斥候追查到最近惨败的原因，都要归功于一个人：帕特劳元帅。他指挥着北卫军前线营地，就建在西边风剪山谷里。把他干掉，联盟的棋盘上就少了一个强大的战地指挥官。$B$B帕特劳必须死，$N。
text.completion: Did you find any suspicious documents at Paltrow's camp? Perhaps on his rotting corpse? Any insight into the Alliance's attack patterns would be extremely helpful in the battle for Stonetalon.
text.completed: Return to Spy-Mistress Anara at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Enemy of the Horde: Marshal Paltrow
english.objectives: Kill Marshal Paltrow.
english.description: My scouts have tracked the cause of this latest fiasco to one man: Marshal Paltrow. He commands the Northwatch forward camp that has established itself in Windshear Valley, west of here. Take him out and you remove a powerful Alliance field commander from the equation.$B$BPaltrow must die, $N.
english.completion: Did you find any suspicious documents at Paltrow's camp? Perhaps on his rotting corpse? Any insight into the Alliance's attack patterns would be extremely helpful in the battle for Stonetalon.
english.completed: Return to Spy-Mistress Anara at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 龙眠之灾
text.objectives: 前往龙骨荒野，和龙眠神殿中的克拉苏斯交谈。
text.description: 我的老朋友克拉苏斯送来消息，说龙骨荒野的龙眠神殿发生了可怕的事情。他的信非常简短。不过看样子，那座神殿下的红玉圣殿正遭受攻击。$B$B然而当下达拉然有些紧迫的事情让我无法立马亲自赶过去。我听说过你在巫妖王城堡中的事迹，相信你一定能胜任这个任务。也许你能代替我去帮助克拉苏斯？
text.completion: Thank you for heeding Rhonin's call, brave adventurer. Let me share with you what we know regarding recent events, and any assistance you might offer would be greatly appreciated.
text.completed: 前往龙骨荒野，和龙眠神殿中的克拉苏斯交谈。

english.title: Trouble at Wyrmrest
english.objectives: Speak with Krasus at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.
english.description: My old friend Krasus sends word of dire happenings at Wyrmrest, in Dragonblight. His missive was brief, but it seems that there has been some sort of attack on the Ruby Sanctum beneath the Temple.$B$BPressing business here in Dalaran keeps me from attending to the matter personally, but I have heard word of your exploits in the Lich King's Citadel and you are doubtless up to the task -- perhaps you could assist Krasus in my stead?
english.completion: Thank you for heeding Rhonin's call, brave adventurer. Let me share with you what we know regarding recent events, and any assistance you might offer would be greatly appreciated.
english.completed: Speak with Krasus at Wyrmrest Temple in Dragonblight.

text.title: 突袭红玉圣殿
text.objectives: 调查龙眠神殿之下的红玉圣殿。
text.description: $R, something terrible has transpired within the Ruby Sanctum beneath the Temple.$B$BThe entry to the Sanctum is in ruins, and its guardians violently slain. We sent scouts to investigate, but they have not returned. I cannot help but fear the worst.$B$BEnter the Ruby Sanctum and discover what has befallen the home of my flight. Once we have more information, we can plan our next steps accordingly.
text.completion: Thank you again, $c, for rescuing me from Baltharus's clutches! There is still much work to be done, however....
text.completed: Investigate the Ruby Sanctum beneath Wyrmrest Temple.

english.title: Assault on the Sanctum
english.objectives: Investigate the Ruby Sanctum beneath Wyrmrest Temple.
english.description: $R, something terrible has transpired within the Ruby Sanctum beneath the Temple.$B$BThe entry to the Sanctum is in ruins, and its guardians violently slain. We sent scouts to investigate, but they have not returned. I cannot help but fear the worst.$B$BEnter the Ruby Sanctum and discover what has befallen the home of my flight. Once we have more information, we can plan our next steps accordingly.
english.completion: Thank you again, $c, for rescuing me from Baltharus's clutches! There is still much work to be done, however....
english.completed: Investigate the Ruby Sanctum beneath Wyrmrest Temple.

text.title: 掘歌兄弟
text.objectives: 前往瓦丝琪尔的光渊海峡，向哈弗雷·掘歌报到。
text.description: 列兵$N，立正！我们遇到了一点小麻烦！$B$B我们派哈弗雷和奥斯卡·掘歌去了西北边的光渊海峡，但他们一直没有回来。他们的任务是侦查该地区，但是现在我们失去了跟他们的所有联络。$B$B列兵$N，你的任务就是找到我们的同志，如果他们还活着的话，就把他们带回来！
text.completion: Of course we haven't returned yet!  We've had our fair share of setbacks... not the least of which was the passing of my dear brother Oskar. He lost his grip and floated away, the poor lad!  He thought he'd grab some fish to bring back to the captain, but he floated off, and was eaten by one o' those... those great-eels!  Bwaaaah ha ha haaaah!

english.title: The Brothers Digsong
english.objectives: Report to Humphrey Digsong at Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.
english.description: Private $N, at attention!  Ve are havink a small problem!$b$bVe have sent Humphrey and Oskar Digsong out to Underlight Canyon, to the northvest, but they are not comink back.  They vere supposed to scout out the area, but ve have lost all contact with them.$b$bYour assignment, Private $N, is to locate our comrades and, if they live, bring them back to me!
english.completion: Of course we haven't returned yet!  We've had our fair share of setbacks... not the least of which was the passing of my dear brother Oskar. He lost his grip and floated away, the poor lad!  He thought he'd grab some fish to bring back to the captain, but he floated off, and was eaten by one o' those... those great-eels!  Bwaaaah ha ha haaaah!

text.title: Phosphora Hunting
text.objectives: Obtain 6 Underlight Phosphora from Pyreshell Scuttlers and Luxscale Groupers in Underlight Canyon.
text.description: Oskar's last wish, before he floated up into that great-eel's gullet, was to bring back food for the captain, so that's what we'll do.$b$bMy brother had a genius plan.  He saw those murlocs luring fish out of the reeds with a phosphorescent antenna, and devised a way to make one of his own.  All ya need is something that glows.$b$bKill the crabs and groupers that roam the canyon's floor.  They aren't edible themselves, but their phosphora is far more valuable than their meat.
text.progress: We need enough phosphora to make a really bright light, especially if you're going to be competing with those murlocs.
text.completion: There ya go.  It's beautiful!  Oskar would be proud.
text.completed: Return to Humphrey Digsong at the bottom of Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Phosphora Hunting
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Underlight Phosphora from Pyreshell Scuttlers and Luxscale Groupers in Underlight Canyon.
english.description: Oskar's last wish, before he floated up into that great-eel's gullet, was to bring back food for the captain, so that's what we'll do.$b$bMy brother had a genius plan.  He saw those murlocs luring fish out of the reeds with a phosphorescent antenna, and devised a way to make one of his own.  All ya need is something that glows.$b$bKill the crabs and groupers that roam the canyon's floor.  They aren't edible themselves, but their phosphora is far more valuable than their meat.
english.progress: We need enough phosphora to make a really bright light, especially if you're going to be competing with those murlocs.
english.completion: There ya go.  It's beautiful!  Oskar would be proud.
english.completed: Return to Humphrey Digsong at the bottom of Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 來自營地的命令
text.objectives: Deliver the Orders from Base Camp to Overlord Krom'gar at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.
text.description: Paltrow, establish a foothold in Windshear Valley. A strong ground assault is vital to our campaign! When we make our assault against Krom'gar, your men will provide the chaos and confusion that the gnome flying machines will need to get close enough to bomb the orc fortress.$B$BThe flying machines will detonate the Krom'gar bomb while it's sitting in their base, taking out the entire fortress in the process.$B$BBurn after reading.$B$B-Force Commander Valen$B$BNorthwatch Expedition Base Camp
text.progress: More gnomes?
text.completion: Gnomish flying machines? Our anti-air cannons are still not functional! We will be sitting ducks. I require time to plan... to think... The hot air balloon and its payload cannot remain at Krom'gar Fortress. I must make arrangements to move the balloon to another location. Our plans to destroy Windshear Hold with it are foiled.

english.title: Orders from Base Camp
english.objectives: Deliver the Orders from Base Camp to Overlord Krom'gar at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: Paltrow, establish a foothold in Windshear Valley. A strong ground assault is vital to our campaign! When we make our assault against Krom'gar, your men will provide the chaos and confusion that the gnome flying machines will need to get close enough to bomb the orc fortress.$B$BThe flying machines will detonate the Krom'gar bomb while it's sitting in their base, taking out the entire fortress in the process.$B$BBurn after reading.$B$B-Force Commander Valen$B$BNorthwatch Expedition Base Camp
