english.completion: Gnomish flying machines? Our anti-air cannons are still not functional! We will be sitting ducks. I require time to plan... to think... The hot air balloon and its payload cannot remain at Krom'gar Fortress. I must make arrangements to move the balloon to another location. Our plans to destroy Windshear Hold with it are foiled.

text.title: 诱饵
text.objectives: 戴上磷光软帽，游过光渊海峡的海藻丛，吸引30条光渊利齿鱼。
text.description: 戴上磷光软帽，然后游过光渊海峡的珊瑚礁。那里生活着各种小鱼，它们肯定难以抗拒这顶帽子发出的光芒。$B$B如此一来，我们就可以带着大量的海鱼返回驱暗海窟了，每个人都能吃到！
text.progress: How many did ya catch?
text.completion: Ya did good, $n!  Ya did real good!
text.completed: Return to Humphrey Digsong at the bottom of Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.

english.title: A Lure
english.objectives: Put on the Phosphora Fedora, then swim through the coral in Underlight Canyon to attract 30 Underlight Nibblers.
english.description: Stick this device on your head, then swim through the kelp and coral along the canyon's edge.  There should be all kinds of little fish in there that find your new antenna irresistible.$b$bWhen we return to Darkbreak Cove, we'll have armfuls of fish for everyone!
english.progress: How many did ya catch?
english.completion: Ya did good, $n!  Ya did real good!
english.completed: Return to Humphrey Digsong at the bottom of Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 猎杀寒光鱼人
text.objectives: 杀死4个寒光猎手和4个寒光智者。
text.description: 哦，对了！我原本要准备一份报告来着！差点给忘了！$B$B看样子这一带都是些人畜无害的野生动物……除了那些该死的鳗鱼……还有一小撮鱼人。我觉得吧，船长肯定对鱼人更感兴趣。$B$B去跟那些鱼人斗一斗，看看它们都有些什么能耐。按照我的观察结果，那些大个的在海藻林里捕鱼，小个的会使用魔法……我就知道这么多了。
text.completion: Hmm... they sound like regular ol' murlocs... just underwater.  That'll make Cap'n Glovaal happy.
text.completed: Return to Humphrey Digsong at the bottom of Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Coldlights Out
english.objectives: Kill 4 Coldlight Hunters and 4 Coldlight Oracles.
english.description: Oh yeah!  I was supposed to put together a report!  I'd almost forgotten!$b$bLooks like mostly harmless wildlife around here... 'cept for those blasted eels... and a few murlocs.  Cap'n will be more interested in the murlocs, I think.$b$bGo engage a few of 'em in combat and see what kinda moves they got.  From what I've seen, the big ones hunt for fish in the kelp, and the little ones practice some kind o' magic or another... but that's all I know.
english.completion: Hmm... they sound like regular ol' murlocs... just underwater.  That'll make Cap'n Glovaal happy.
english.completed: Return to Humphrey Digsong at the bottom of Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 巨大的鳗鱼卵
text.objectives: 将巨大的鳗鱼卵交给瓦丝琪尔光渊海峡底部的哈弗雷·掘歌。
text.description: <这像是光渊海峡中扭曲的巨海鳗的卵。说不定哈弗雷会对此感兴趣呢。>
text.progress: What've ya got there, $n?
text.completion: Whaaa... an egg?  An EEL egg? We can definitely do something with this!  Get ready kid, 'cause it's time for some good ol'-fashioned Digsong revenge!

english.title: Enormous Eel Egg
english.objectives: Deliver the Enormous Eel Egg to Humphrey Digsong at the bottom of Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.
english.description: <This appears to be an egg from one of the devious great-eels that float up above the canyon.  You wonder whether or not Humphrey might be interested in something like this.>
english.progress: What've ya got there, $n?
english.completion: Whaaa... an egg?  An EEL egg? We can definitely do something with this!  Get ready kid, 'cause it's time for some good ol'-fashioned Digsong revenge!

text.title: 去找邦姆古兹
text.objectives: 去找石爪山脉克罗姆加壁垒的首席爆破工程师邦姆古兹。
text.description: 我们必须为即将到来的攻击做好准备。我会让士兵们去做好运送炸弹的准备。你则要去找首席爆破工程师邦姆古兹。她一直在修理我们的防空炮，但直到现在都还没有修好。你去想想办法让她鼓足点干劲，修好我们的炮，$N。
text.completion: Properly motivated? Wha... what does that mean? Listen, Sergeant, I have a built in mechanism for survival called self-interest. That is, it's in my best interest to NOT DIE. With that said, there's no fixing these guns without the right materials.

english.title: Report to Bombgutz
english.objectives: Report to Chief Blastgineer Bombgutz at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: We must prepare for the impending attack. I will have our soldiers prepare the bomb for transport. I want you to report to Chief Blastgineer Bombgutz. She has been working to fix our anti-air cannons, but has thus far failed. Make sure that she is properly motivated to repair our guns, $N.
english.completion: Properly motivated? Wha... what does that mean? Listen, Sergeant, I have a built in mechanism for survival called self-interest. That is, it's in my best interest to NOT DIE. With that said, there's no fixing these guns without the right materials.

text.title: 掘歌兄弟2：鳗鱼卵大爆炸
text.objectives: 在光渊海峡的扭曲的巨海鳗附近使用鳗鱼爆破装置，然后击败被削弱的巨海鳗。
text.description: 那些鳗鱼吃了我的兄弟。我的兄弟，$N！该给它们点颜色瞧瞧了。$B$B<哈弗雷取出了几根雷管，把它们粘在了鱼卵上。>$B$B要独身去对付南边那些巨海鳗是不太现实的，不过有了这枚鱼卵，我们就有机会了。把它放在某条巨海鳗旁边，然后……轰隆！$B$B如果这样都炸不死那条鳗鱼，至少也可以把它炸得奄奄一息，对你来说就是小菜一碟啦。
text.completion: Oskar's alive?  Wait... what did ya say?  Ya let him FLOAT AWAY AGAIN?! Well... ya held up your end of the bargain, and I appreciate everything ya've done, $n. Here... take this.  I've only been hanging onto it as ballast, but it doesn't seem to be doing much good.
text.completed: Return to Humphrey Digsong at the bottom of Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.
text.giverWindow: My poor brother, Oskar.  Eaten by an eel, he was.
text.objective1: Use Eel-Splosive Device on Devious Great-Eel

english.title: The Brothers Digsong 2: Eel-Egg-Trick Boogaloo
english.objectives: Use the Eel-splosive Device near a Devious Great-Eel in Underlight Canyon, then defeat the Weakened Great-Eel.
english.description: Those eels ate my brother.  My brother, $N!  It's time someone showed 'em who's boss.$b$b<Humphrey removes several sticks of dynamite from his vest and shoves them through the egg's outer membrane.>$b$bThe great-eels to the south are too tough to fight one-on-one, but with this egg, we should be able to even the odds.  Place it near one of those creatures, then... kablooie!$b$bIf the bomb doesn't kill the eel outright, it should be near enough to death for you to finish it off.
english.completion: Oskar's alive?  Wait... what did ya say?  Ya let him FLOAT AWAY AGAIN?! Well... ya held up your end of the bargain, and I appreciate everything ya've done, $n. Here... take this.  I've only been hanging onto it as ballast, but it doesn't seem to be doing much good.
english.completed: Return to Humphrey Digsong at the bottom of Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.
english.giverWindow: My poor brother, Oskar.  Eaten by an eel, he was.
english.objective1: Use Eel-Splosive Device on Devious Great-Eel

text.title: 第一滴血
text.objectives: 从辛迪加雇佣兵身上获得10根血石护符。
text.description: 准备好，$N。你将为我们在这片土地洒上第一滴血。$B$B辛迪加，他们是那么自称的，乃是背叛了自己人的懦弱人类。他们的孤立让我们容易得手。$B$B到北方去，杀死你能找到的辛迪加雇佣兵，以被遗忘者的名义占领诺斯弗德农场。把他们的血石护符带给我，作为征服的证据。
text.progress: I won't be swayed by empty claims. Have you proof of your loyalty?
text.completion: This is but a prelude to the slaughter we will visit upon these lands. All will know our name. You have done well, $n. Victory for Sylvanas!
text.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Alina at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: First Blood
english.objectives: Collect 10 Bloodstone Amulets from members of the Syndicate.
english.description: Be prepared, $n. You will cast the first blood upon this land for us.$B$BThe Syndicate, as they call themselves, are cowardly humans who betray even their own kind. Their isolation will make them easy prey.$B$BTravel north, slay any Syndicate members you find, and claim Northfold Manor in the name of the Forsaken. Bring me the Bloodstone Amulets they wear as proof of your conquest.
english.progress: I won't be swayed by empty claims. Have you proof of your loyalty?
english.completion: This is but a prelude to the slaughter we will visit upon these lands. All will know our name. You have done well, $n. Victory for Sylvanas!
english.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Alina at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 被遗忘的托尔贝恩
text.objectives: 跟加林·托尔贝恩谈一谈。
text.description: 让我给你讲一个故事。$B$B从前，有一个愚蠢的巨魔叫做森古。他被指派去执行一个任务，寻找传说中的托尔贝恩家族宝剑托卡拉尔。他成功了，以为自己完成了任务，一个人想要离开阿拉希。在那里他被人类干掉，宝剑也物归原主。$B$B我们不会那么蠢。药剂师们给了我们一个重获托卡拉尔的完美方案：去找曾经拥有它的王子。$B$B他随时准备好来指引你，$N。跟他谈一谈。
text.completion: Yes... I was once Prince of the fallen kingdom of Stromgarde. I was cut down by the one seeking Trol'kalar. I rue my foolish life now. I serve...only Sylvanas.

english.title: The Forsaken Trollbane
english.objectives: Speak with Galen Trollbane.
english.description: Let me tell you a story.$B$BOnce, there was a foolish troll named Zengu. He was tasked to find the sword Trol'kalar, the legendary blade of the human Trollbane line. He succeeded, and thinking his task done, went to leave Arathi by himself. There he was cut down by the humans, and the sword simply reclaimed.$B$BWe will not be so foolish. Our apothecaries have given us the perfect guide to reobtain Trol'kalar: the prince who once held it.$B$BHe stands ready to guide you, $n. Speak with him.
english.completion: Yes... I was once Prince of the fallen kingdom of Stromgarde. I was cut down by the one seeking Trol'kalar. I rue my foolish life now. I serve...only Sylvanas.

text.title: 通缉：玛雷兹·考尔
text.objectives: 把玛雷兹的头颅交给避难谷地的尼艾丝队长。
text.description: 重金悬赏玛雷兹·考尔的项上人头。这个兽人是辛迪加组织的高级顾问和技工，人们最后一次看见她是在激流堡内的辛迪加控制区。$B$B赏金请到尼艾丝队长处领取。$B$B请注意：玛雷兹是一个强大而狡猾的术士，她和恶魔有着非常密切的联系。追杀她时务必非常小心。
text.progress: 你好，$C。有什麽要报告的吗?
text.completion: 你杀死了玛雷兹·考尔?干得漂亮，$N。真是干得漂亮。玛雷兹对激流堡的守军构成了极大的威胁，据说她是辛迪加与某些更黑暗的势力之间进行沟通的使节。除掉她无疑是给我们免去了一个心头大患。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.
text.giverWindow: Bring me her head!

english.title: Wanted!  Marez Cowl
english.objectives: Bring Marez's head to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.
english.description: A bounty has been placed on the head of Marez Cowl, a high-level advisor and operative of the Syndicate.  She was last seen within the Syndicate controlled territory of Stromgarde.$B$BBounty may be collected from Captain Nials.$B$BBe warned: Marez is a skilled and cunning warlock, known for her trafficking with demons.  Extreme caution is advised when hunting her.
english.progress: Greetings, $c.  You have a report to make?
english.completion: You took down Marez Cowl?  Well done, $n.  Well done indeed! Marez menaced our Stromgarde defenders, and it is rumored she was an emissary between the Syndicate and some other, darker power.  We are glad to see that she'll no longer ply her powers against us.
english.completed: Return to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Bring me her head!

text.title: 兽人叛徒
text.objectives: 取回玛雷兹·考尔的邪恶的血石宝珠。
text.description: 我确信有一个强大的术士居住在激流堡城内。这个术士经常通过一种魔法物品来召唤大量的恶魔。我们必须毁掉他的能量源泉。$B$B找到这个术士，杀掉她。把所有你在他身上发现的魔法物品都拿来给我，我会设法销毁它的。我们绝对不能让这片大地再被玷污了！
text.progress: 我血液中的灼烧感与日俱增……我们必须阻止这个术士。
text.completion: My restless nights will turn to peaceful slumber when I have destroyed this orb. Thank you, $n. It is a chilling reminder of the terrible power the demons held over the orcs before Hellscream released them from their curse.
text.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Alina at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.
text.giverWindow: Get her Befouled Bloodstone Orb!

english.title: The Traitor Orc
english.objectives: Retrieve Marez Cowl's Befouled Bloodstone Orb.
english.description: There is no doubt in my mind that a powerful warlock resides within the walls of Stromgarde. From time to time, using an arcane magical relic, this warlock has summoned forth terrible demons in large numbers. We must remove the source of her energy.$b$bFind the warlock and kill her. Bring me whatever magical object you find on her person, and I will take steps to destroy it and see that its power is not used to taint this land any longer.
english.progress: The burning in my blood... it grows by the day. The warlock must be stopped.
english.completion: My restless nights will turn to peaceful slumber when I have destroyed this orb. Thank you, $n. It is a chilling reminder of the terrible power the demons held over the orcs before Hellscream released them from their curse.
english.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Alina at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Get her Befouled Bloodstone Orb!

text.title: 明天会更好
text.objectives: 找到BD-816战斗仪器、机械火焰、机械之冰和机械空气。
text.description: 气泡先生病了，$G先生:小姐;。你能帮帮他吗？你只要找到他的帽子和他的电池，他就会好起来的。我本想自己去，但我不能把气泡先生一个人丢下！$B$B他的帽子被水车那儿的风险投资公司坏蛋偷走了，他的电池藏在狂风峭壁周围。你要使劲地去找！$B$B你能不能行行好，把气泡先生的东西拿回来，好让他给那些联盟的坏人们一个教训？
text.progress: Mr. D is so sad. We need to make him happy!
text.completion: Mr. D you're gonna be ok! Hooray! Oh, Mr. D! I knew it!
text.completed: Return to Clarissa at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Dream of a Better Tomorrow
english.objectives: Recover the BD-816 War Apparatus, Mechanized Fire, Mechanized Ice and Mechanized Air.
english.description: Mr. D is sick, $g mister:miss;. Won't you help him? All you have to do is find his hat and batteries and he'll be all better. I'd go get them myself, but I can't leave Mr. D alone!$B$BHis hat was stolen by the meanies in the Venture Co. over at the water wheel and his batteries are hidden around Windshear Crag. You'll just have to look real hard for those!$B$BWould you kindly bring Mr. D's stuff back so he can teach those baddies in the Alliance a lesson?
english.progress: Mr. D is so sad. We need to make him happy!
english.completion: Mr. D you're gonna be ok! Hooray! Oh, Mr. D! I knew it!
english.completed: Return to Clarissa at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 短兵相接
text.objectives: 杀死激流堡的7个石拳萨满祭司和3个石拳领主。
text.description: 下一战要对付的食人魔在东边的激流堡。活着的对这些废墟还依依不舍。他们的多愁善感真是叫人作呕！$B$B激流堡对我们来说无非就是为数众多的食人魔肮脏老巢，等着被清理。到那里去把他们的萨满祭司和领主杀掉，保证食人魔的领导层全军覆没。
text.completion: Cleared out properly? Good. I doubt we'll even bother to lurk in Stromgarde. That ramshackle hole needs to be razed into dust. The land would make a decent spot for a new Undercity in its place.
text.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Alina at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: Call to Arms
english.objectives: Kill 7 Boulderfist Shaman and 3 Boulderfist Lords in Stromgarde.
english.description: Our next strike against the ogres will bring you further east to Stromgarde. The living consider these gutted ruins worth clinging to. Their sentimentality is disgusting!$B$BAll that Stromgarde holds for us is a foul den of more ogres, waiting to be struck down. Travel there and slay their shamans and lords, and ensure what passes for leadership among the ogres is snuffed out.
english.completion: Cleared out properly? Good. I doubt we'll even bother to lurk in Stromgarde. That ramshackle hole needs to be razed into dust. The land would make a decent spot for a new Undercity in its place.
english.completed: Return to Dark Ranger Alina at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 气泡先生的狂野之旅
text.objectives: 击败20名侏儒工程师和5名侏儒重拳机兵。
text.description: 现在气泡先生需要天使来帮他导航。你愿意做那个天使吗，$G先生:小姐;？有你帮忙，我们就能到峭壁里去杀掉大群大群的联盟！你怎么说？来嘛，$G先生:小姐;！真的求求你了好不好了啦？$B$B如果我们击败足够多的联盟，克罗姆加先生会给我们大家买冰激凌！
text.completion: I am - perhaps for the first time in my life - at a loss for words. I am really not sure where Clarissa even came from...
text.completed: Speak to Overlord Krom'gar at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Mr. D's Wild Ride
english.objectives: Kill 20 Gnome Engineers and 5 Gnome Pounders.
english.description: Now Mr. D just needs an angel to help him navigate. Will you be that angel, $g mister:miss;? With you helping we can go out into the crag and kill bunches and bunches of Alliance! Waddya say? Come on, $g mister:miss;! PRETTY PLEASE WITH SUGAR ON TOP?$B$BIf we kill enough Alliance Mr. Krom'gar will buy us all ice cream!
english.completion: I am - perhaps for the first time in my life - at a loss for words. I am really not sure where Clarissa even came from...
english.completed: Speak to Overlord Krom'gar at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 真正的威胁
text.objectives: 杀死奥卡拉尔，拿下他的徽记。
text.description: 奥卡拉尔是这里食人魔的头目。他已经逃脱追杀多年了。他的出现对黑暗女王来说是一种冒犯。被遗忘者的叛徒玛格索尔在背后操纵他！$B$B我们不容许在被遗忘者的土地上出现食人魔或叛徒。把这个食人魔的徽记拿来，我这次要将它烧个一干二净。
text.progress: Speak quickly.
text.completion: This is the fate of all who would stand in our way.
text.completed: Return to Deathstalker Maudria at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.
text.giverWindow: Or'Kalar stands a head taller than any of his kin.  I'd like you to remedy that.

english.title: The Real Threat
english.objectives: Slay Or'Kalar and take his head.
english.description: Or'Kalar leads the ogres here. He has evaded slaughter for years. His very presence is an affront to the Dark Lady; Mug'thol, traitor to the Forsaken, commands him from afar!$B$BWe do not suffer ogres or traitors on Forsaken land. Bring me this ogre's head and I will make sure it's burned properly this time.
english.progress: Speak quickly.
english.completion: This is the fate of all who would stand in our way.
english.completed: Return to Deathstalker Maudria at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Or'Kalar stands a head taller than any of his kin.  I'd like you to remedy that.

text.title: 激流堡符印
text.objectives: 从激流堡的辛迪加组织成员手中获得激流堡符印。
text.description: 在远古时代，激流堡之王伊格纳乌斯，名唤托尔贝恩，领导着史上第一个人类文明——阿拉索，并在战争中对抗巨魔。他的宝剑唤作托卡拉尔——古语巨魔杀手的意思。$B$B我是他血脉中的最后一任，誓要守护托卡拉尔……然而却不幸失职。但现在，为了我的新主人，我们将再度把它拿到手。$B$B宝剑由三枚符印封印。第一枚在潜伏于激流堡废墟的辛迪加叛徒们手里。杀掉他们，把符印带来给我。
text.progress: Only the Syndicate agents in Stromgarde will have the sigil. Spilling blood outside the fortress's walls will be a waste of your time.
text.completion: I hated the Syndicate in life as much as I do in death. To see the sigil again is a small comfort. But we have much more work to do... for Sylvanas.
text.completed: Return to Galen Trollbane at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: Sigil of Strom
english.objectives: Collect the Sigil of Strom from Syndicate members in Stromgarde Keep.
english.description: In ancient times, Lord Ignaeus of Strom, named Trollbane, led the first human civilization of Arathor in war against the trolls. His blade was Trol'kalar--troll slayer, in their ancient tongue.$B$BI was one of the last of his line, sworn with guarding Trol'kalar...a duty in which I failed. But now, we will obtain it once more, for my new master.$B$BThe sword is bound by three sigils. The first is held by the Syndicate traitors that lurk the ruins of Stromgarde. Slay them, and return the sigil to me.
english.progress: Only the Syndicate agents in Stromgarde will have the sigil. Spilling blood outside the fortress's walls will be a waste of your time.
english.completion: I hated the Syndicate in life as much as I do in death. To see the sigil again is a small comfort. But we have much more work to do... for Sylvanas.
english.completed: Return to Galen Trollbane at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 索拉丁符印
text.objectives: 从激流堡的激流堡防御者身上收集5块符印碎片。
text.description: 在生时，我为了保护索拉丁符印，将它分成了五块，交给了我的心腹。太失败了，然而我的继任者也还是会这么做。$B$B激流堡的防御者还拿着符印的碎片。杀掉它们，把东西带来，我来重新组合。
text.progress: All five pieces are needed to restore the sigil...
text.completion: Thoradin was the founder of Arathor. Just as I join these fragments together, he joined the scattered tribes of humans into their first great nation. But I'm sure you're not interested in such drivel. Forgive me. Old memories are often hard to bury.
text.completed: Return to Galen Trollbane at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: Sigil of Thoradin
english.objectives: Collect 5 Sigil Fragments from Stromgarde defenders in Stromgarde Keep.
english.description: In life, I divided the sigil of Thoradin into five pieces to protect it, spreading it among my most loyal men. This too failed, but my successor will have done the same.$B$BThe defenders of Stromgarde hold the pieces of the sigil yet again. Slay them, and bring the shards to me; I will reassemble them.
english.progress: All five pieces are needed to restore the sigil...
english.completion: Thoradin was the founder of Arathor. Just as I join these fragments together, he joined the scattered tribes of humans into their first great nation. But I'm sure you're not interested in such drivel. Forgive me. Old memories are often hard to bury.
english.completed: Return to Galen Trollbane at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 阿拉索符印
text.objectives: 从瓦罗卡尔中尉身上取回阿拉索符印。
text.description: 我将阿拉索符印托付给了我的骑兵队长瓦罗卡尔中尉。东西被带走的时候他好不容易才逃出生天。$B$B不过这一次可能就不会了。瓦罗卡尔通常在激流堡和避难谷地之间的道路上巡逻。找到他，把符印再次夺回来。
text.progress: Have you the sigil?
text.completion: Valorcall was loyal to me in life. His death will not be something I bear lightly. But bear it I must. I am Forsaken. My old existence means nothing. The sigils are ours; Trol'kalar awaits.
text.completed: Return to Galen Trollbane at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.
text.giverWindow: He was one of my best, most loyal lieutenants.  Oh well!

english.title: Sigil of Arathor
english.objectives: Collect the Sigil of Arathor from Lieutenant Valorcall.
english.description: I entrusted the sigil of Arathor to Lieutenant Valorcall, leader of my cavalry. He barely escaped with his life when it was taken.$B$BIt is unlikely he will do so again. Valorcall patrols the road between Stromgarde Keep and Refuge Point. Find him, and take the sigil from him once more.
english.progress: Have you the sigil?
english.completion: Valorcall was loyal to me in life. His death will not be something I bear lightly. But bear it I must. I am Forsaken. My old existence means nothing. The sigils are ours; Trol'kalar awaits.
english.completed: Return to Galen Trollbane at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.
english.giverWindow: He was one of my best, most loyal lieutenants.  Oh well!

text.title: 托卡拉尔
text.objectives: 从激流堡的托尔贝恩墓室中取回托卡拉尔剑。
text.description: 最后一块符印是我的了……有了它，这四块就能结合形成一块完整的托尔贝恩符印，墓室的钥匙。我们准备好了。$B$B托卡拉尔就同它的主人一同，被埋葬在激流堡墓园的托尔贝恩墓室中。那里将有重兵把守……但有我在你面前显灵，就足以证明那些防御者是可以被打败的。$B$B进入墓室，拿到托卡拉尔剑，把它带回来。
text.progress: Have you Trol'kalar?
text.completion: Trol'kalar, my father's blade... it seems like it's been an eternity since I saw it.
text.completed: Return to Galen Trollbane at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: Trol'kalar
english.objectives: Retrieve Trol'kalar from Trollbane's tomb in Stromgarde Keep.
english.description: The last sigil is mine...and with it, the four combine to the Sigil of Trollbane, key to the tomb. We are ready.$B$BTrol'kalar lies sealed with its master's remains, within Trollbane's tomb in the catacombs of Stromgarde. It will be defended heavily...but my presence before you is proof enough that the defenders can be overcome.$B$BEnter the tomb, retrieve Trol'kalar, and bring it here.
english.progress: Have you Trol'kalar?
english.completion: Trol'kalar, my father's blade... it seems like it's been an eternity since I saw it.
english.completed: Return to Galen Trollbane at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 暮光毁灭者
text.objectives: 击败海里昂和入侵红玉圣殿的敌人。
text.description: 这绝不是无谋的进攻，而是一场预谋已久，处心积虑针对红龙圣地的突袭，敌人的作战计划精细而狡猾。$B$B萨瑞瑟里安正在那边的山崖上指挥着这次攻势，但这支军队真正的首领是一头强大而自负的暮光巨龙——海里昂。他是希奈丝特拉的扭曲试验所塑造的巨龙怪物——继卓贡纳克斯之后的又一头成年暮光龙。$B$B$N，消灭他。击退这次入侵之后，去向克拉苏斯报告你在这里所见到的一切。
text.completion: We owe you a debt of gratitude, mortal, for driving the invaders from the Sanctum. But this news of the Destroyer is troubling beyond words. I have much to discuss with the other members of the Accord. Take these as a token of my thanks, as you gird yourselves for the coming storm.
text.completed: Report back to Krasus atop Wyrmrest Temple.

english.title: The Twilight Destroyer
english.objectives: Defeat Halion and repel the invasion of the Ruby Sanctum.
english.description: This was no reckless attack, but rather a carefully orchestrated strike against the heart of the Red Dragonflight.$B$BZarithrian, on the bluff over there, is overseeing the assault, but the true leader of this force is a brash and powerful Twilight dragon named Halion. Not since Dargonax has a full-grown spawn of Sinestra's twisted experiments been seen.$B$BSlay him, $N, and then when the invasion has been fully repelled, report to Krasus regarding all you have seen here.
english.completion: We owe you a debt of gratitude, mortal, for driving the invaders from the Sanctum. But this news of the Destroyer is troubling beyond words. I have much to discuss with the other members of the Accord. Take these as a token of my thanks, as you gird yourselves for the coming storm.
english.completed: Report back to Krasus atop Wyrmrest Temple.

text.title: 证明实力
text.objectives: 从枯木巨魔身上获得10颗枯木巨魔的獠牙以及4包枯木巨魔的医药包。
text.description: 大法师马林派我到这里来为他收集一些试剂，对于如何收集这些物品，我感到很困惑。不过既然你来了，我想我的问题也解决了。$B$B我需要这些东西：枯木巨魔的獠牙，枯木巨魔的医药包。$B$B你能帮我找到这些吗？枯木巨魔一般都在阿拉希高地的东南一带出没。
text.progress: Have you had any luck so far?
text.completion: Not bad. Since it's clear you've got your head on straight, I was hoping you could help us with a more pressing job.
text.completed: 去找阿拉希高地避难谷地的斯奎尔图。

english.title: Worth Its Weight in Gold
english.objectives: Collect 10 Witherbark Tusks and 4 Witherbark Medicine Pouches from Witherbark Trolls.
english.description: Archmage Malin sent me here to collect reagents for him. I was at a loss as to how I was going to collect the items, but now that you're here, I think my problem's solved.$B$BI need Witherbark tusks and Witherbark medicine pouches.$B$BCould you find those for me? The Witherbark live to the southeast of Arathi.
english.progress: Have you had any luck so far?
english.completion: Not bad. Since it's clear you've got your head on straight, I was hoping you could help us with a more pressing job.
english.completed: Return to Skuerto at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 特雷莱恩的符咒魔杖
text.objectives: 帮避难谷地的斯奎尔图找到特雷莱恩的符咒魔杖，并把它带回来。
text.description: 你好啊，$N，很抱歉我以前对你那么凶……我可以断定特雷莱恩的第一件宝物的所在：它在石拳大厅的考格雷什手里。顺便说一句，他已经可以使用冰爆术来教训不听话的手下，看来离他完全掌握魔杖力量的日子也已经不远了。$B$B石拳大厅就在这里的南边，萨多尔大桥的东边。从那个食人魔手里把那根魔杖拿回来吧。$B$B在你回来之前，我要想想我们要怎样解决激流堡的问题。
text.progress: 我们的目标是魔杖，$N。你要想尽一切办法把它拿回来。
text.completion: 你是个天才，$N。你已经找到了一件物品，这样在我的名单上就还有三件要找了……其余三件物品都在激流堡里。$B$B休息一下，恢复你的力量─我下一阶段的计画需要更多的时间和努力。饱餐一顿，稍作休息，然後来找我。$B$B
text.completed: 去找阿拉希高地避难谷地的斯奎尔图。
text.giverWindow: Once we have the wand, we can move forward with our plan.

english.title: Wand over Fist
english.objectives: Find Trelane's Wand of Invocation and return it to Skuerto at Refuge Pointe.
english.description: Hey, $N. Sorry to be so short with ye earlier... and no, that ain't a pun.$B$BI figured out where Trelane's first item ended up: Kor'gresh has it in Boulderfist Hall. An' by the way he was throwing down blasts of ice at his kin to keep them in line, he must be close to figurin' out how to use all of its powers.$B$BBoulderfist Hall's south of here an' then east of Thandol Span. Find the ogre an' get back that wand.$B$BWhile you're gone, I'll figure out what we're gonna do about Stromgarde.
english.progress: Our goal is the wand, $N. Focus on that for now.
english.completion: Brilliant, $n. One item down an' three more to go, based on my list. The other three items are all in Stromgarde. Take a rest an' get your strength back--the next phase of my plan'll require a little more time an' effort. Come back to me after you've gotten a warm meal an' some rest.
english.completed: Return to Skuerto at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Once we have the wand, we can move forward with our plan.

text.title: 特雷莱恩的防御
text.objectives: 找到一块碧蓝玛瑙石，把它交给激流堡的学徒克里汀。
text.description: 休息好了吗？$B$B我们的下一步计划和激流堡中阿拉索之塔周围的食人魔有关。我们必须首先让你免于受到这座塔的防御系统的伤害。为此，首先我们需要一些石拳萨满祭司经常携带着的宝石。他们把宝石从塔里带了出来，但他们没有什么机会再拥有这些宝石了。$B$B从他们那里弄一块宝石，把它送去给克里汀——他能够给这些宝石附魔。
text.progress: $N，你好呀，又见面了。你找到碧蓝玛瑙石了吗?
text.completion: 你太让我吃惊了，$N。好样的!$B$B给我些时间，让我给这块宝石施加魔咒，然後你就可以带着它出发了。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Apprentice Kryten at Stromgarde Keep in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: Trelane's Defenses
english.objectives: Find an Azure Agate and bring it to Apprentice Kryten at Stromgarde Keep.
english.description: All rested?$B$BHere's our next step: there're ogres all around the Tower of Arathor in Stromgarde. We're gonna need to ward you against the tower's defenses. To do that, we're gonna need some gems the Boulderfist shaman have taken a liking to. They took 'em from the tower, but they're not gonna stay in their possession for long.$B$BGet one of them gems an' bring 'em to Kryten--he knows the spell to enchant it.
english.progress: $N, hello again. Have you found an azure agate yet?
english.completion: You amaze me, $n. Well done again. Give me a moment to cast the proper spell an' you'll be ready.
english.completed: Return to Apprentice Kryten at Stromgarde Keep in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 进攻高塔
text.objectives: 找到特雷莱恩的护符匣、特雷莱恩的宝珠和特雷莱恩的黑玛瑙，把它们交给避难谷地的斯奎尔图。
text.description: 以下是你要找的东西：特雷莱恩的护符匣、特雷莱恩的宝珠和特雷莱恩的黑玛瑙。$B$B所有这三样东西应该都在塔中的箱子里，你打开这些箱子应该不会有什么问题，只是要当心那些食人魔就成。$B$B你必须时刻准备战斗。如果那些食人魔发现你在偷他们的东西，你就少不了一场恶战。$B$B多加小心，祝你好运。
text.progress: 干得好!马林一定会为你感到高兴的。
text.completion: $N，你是马林派来帮助我们的人里最能干的一个啦，你干得太出色了!$B$B他一定会很高兴看到任务成功完成的。$B$B
text.completed: 去找阿拉希高地避难谷地的斯奎尔图。

english.title: Attack on the Tower
english.objectives: Find Trelane's Phylactery, Trelane's Orb, and Trelane's Ember Agate, and return them to Skuerto at Refuge Pointe.
english.description: Here's what you're looking for: Trelane's phylactery, Trelane's orb, and Trelane's ember agate.$B$BAll three should be in chests within the tower.  You shouldn't have a problem opening the chests on your own; you just have to be careful of the ogres.$B$BYou'll need to have your weapons at the ready. Those ogres find out you're there and stealing from them, and they'll be sure to put the hurt on you.$B$BBe careful, and good luck.
english.progress: You do this, an' I'm sure Malin'll be more than pleased with you.
english.completion: Malin couldn't've asked a worthier person to come here an' aid us, $n. You've done a grand job! He'll be pleased to see what an overwhelming success our mission's been.
english.completed: Return to Skuerto at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 被困的公主
text.objectives: 从枯须狗头人身上收集12份密斯莱尔之尘。
text.description: 我叫密斯莱尔，我是大地的公主。巨人们俘获了我，把我拘禁在阿拉希高地的地下深处。这些水晶碎块是我和外界交流的唯一途径。$B$B帮帮我。这些巨人的盟友——枯须狗头人——就在东边的枯须峡谷里活动，那里有一块类似水晶碎块。要激活那块水晶，你必须从狗头人那里收集到密斯莱尔之尘，然后把它们放在水晶上。$B$B求求你了，$N，帮帮我吧！
text.progress: 这簇水晶裂片很像密斯赖尔水晶裂片，但是却没有那种安全感。
text.completion: 啊!你启动了这些水晶裂片。我感觉自己已经恢复不少了!$B$B可是，唉，我离自由还很遥远……$B$B
text.completed: Find the Iridescent Shards at Drywhisker Gorge in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: The Princess Trapped
english.objectives: Gather 12 Motes of Myzrael from Drywhisker Kobolds.
english.description: My name is Myzrael.  I am a princess of the earth, and my captors, the giants, have trapped me deep beneath the Arathi Highlands.  These crystal shards are the only way I can speak with the surface world.$B$BPlease help me.  Allies of the giants, the Drywhisker kobolds, have a shard like this one in their Drywhisker Gorge, to the east.  To power the cluster, you must gather motes of Myzrael from the kobolds and apply them to it.$B$BI beg you, $N, aid me!
english.progress: This cluster of shards looks much like the Shards of Myzrael.  But the same feeling of security does not pulse through them.
english.completion: Ah!  You activated these shards.  Already I feel more myself! But alas, I am still far from free...
english.completed: Find the Iridescent Shards at Drywhisker Gorge in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 啊……痛！我的肚子……
text.objectives: 从关押所里的光脊收割者身上收集7株蜷草苗芽。
text.description: 啊……这是怎么回事！？$B$B我的肚子……痛得厉害。$B$B痛……啊……他们肯定下了毒！$B$B他们在要塞里种植了奇怪的海草，强迫我们吃下……$B$B如果不继续服食，恐怕疼痛会加剧的……$B$B求求你了，$R。快给我找些海草来！
text.progress: Were you able to find me any of their seaweed, $r?
text.completion: Yes, yes. This is the stuff. Maybe I can wean off of it and avoid the side-effect. Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Speak to Gurrok in Deepmist Grotto.

english.title: What? What? In My Gut...?
english.objectives: Collect 7 Wiggleweed Sprouts from Shimmerspine Harvesters in The Clutch.
english.description: Wha...what IS this!?$b$bThere's great pain growing... from deep in my bowels.$b$bI think... ugh... they must have poisoned me!$b$bThey fed us strangely glowing seaweed that they grow around their stronghold...$b$bI think these cramps will worsen if I don't get more soon...$b$bPlease, $r. Try to find me some!
english.progress: Were you able to find me any of their seaweed, $r?
english.completion: Yes, yes. This is the stuff. Maybe I can wean off of it and avoid the side-effect. Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Speak to Gurrok in Deepmist Grotto.

text.title: 禁锢之石
text.objectives: 从西禁锢之石、东禁锢之石和外禁锢之石中搜集烈焰钥匙、海浪钥匙和雷霆钥匙。
text.description: 在阿拉希高地上散布着4块禁锢之石，这些石头将我牢牢地钉在地下。$B$B要想解除它们，你就必须解除最坚固的那块：内禁锢之石。首先，你必须搜集到其它三块石头的钥匙。$B$B这些石头都有守护者在看守，但是如果你足够聪明或者足够幸运的话，就能找到消灭这些守卫的办法。
text.progress: 这里是内禁锢之石，它是所有禁锢之石中最坚固的一块，必须先於其他三块解开。
text.completion: You have done it!  You opened the Stones of Binding!  I can feel the shackles about me loosen, and freedom draws ever closer. You are a noble $c, $n.  My rescuer!
text.completed: Go to the Stone of Inner Binding at the Circle of Inner Binding in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: Stones of Binding
english.objectives: Gather the Burning Key, the Cresting Key and the Thundering Key from the Stone of West Binding, the Stone of East Binding and the Stone of Outer Binding.
english.description: Four Stones of Binding are scattered throughout Arathi.  These stones keep me pinned beneath the earth.$B$BTo unlock them you must unlock the strongest: the Stone of Inner Binding.  And to do that, you must gather keys from the other three.$B$BThese stones are watched by guardians, but if you are clever, or lucky, you may find ways to banish them.
english.progress: This is the Stone of Inner Binding.  It is the strongest of the binding stones and must be unlocked for the others to open.
english.completion: You have done it!  You opened the Stones of Binding!  I can feel the shackles about me loosen, and freedom draws ever closer. You are a noble $c, $n.  My rescuer!
english.completed: Go to the Stone of Inner Binding at the Circle of Inner Binding in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 打开钥匙之石
text.objectives: 从弗兹鲁克那里得到秩序魔棒。
text.description: 禁锢之石的开启基本解开了这些束缚着我的东西，可还有一把牢不可破的锁让我无法动弹。你看到这圈石头中的那块钥匙之石了吗？开锁的钥匙在弗兹鲁克手中，他是囚禁我的巨人之一，也是这石锁的看护人。$B$B你必须从弗兹鲁克那里获得一把名叫“秩序魔棒”的钥匙来打开钥匙之石。$B$B你已经为我做了这么多，$N，只是再帮个微不足道的小忙……我会对你更加感激不尽的！
text.progress: 钥匙之石充满了巨大的能量。
text.completion: 你把魔棒放入钥匙之石，随即感受到了地面开始震动……$B$B
text.completed: Return to the Keystone at the Circle of Inner Binding in Arathi Highlands.
text.giverWindow: Get the Rod of Order!

english.title: Breaking the Keystone
english.objectives: Obtain the Rod of Order from Fozruk.
english.description: Opening the Stones of Binding loosened much of my confinement, but a lock still holds me chained.  It is the Keystone you see among this circle of stones.  And the key is held by one of my captors, the stone watcher Fozruk.$B$BYou must obtain that key, which the stone watchers call the Rod of Order, from Fozruk and use it to open the Keystone.$B$B$N, you have done so much to aid me.  Just a little more...and my gratitude will shake the very foundations of the earth!
english.progress: The Keystone is charged with tremendous geomantic energy.
english.completion: You place the rod in the keystone.  And a shudder is felt beneath you...
english.completed: Return to the Keystone at the Circle of Inner Binding in Arathi Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Get the Rod of Order!

text.title: 当心峭颚！
text.objectives: 杀死峭颚，拿到峭颚的巨齿。
text.description: 受克罗姆加大王之命，峭壁湖禁止入内！$B$B凶残的野兽峭壁之腭让此湖危险异常。除掉峭壁之腭，将它的巨齿作为战利品带给间谍女王安娜拉，自然有赏。
text.progress: What is it that you require?
text.completion: A testament to the might of the Horde!
text.completed: Deliver Cragjaw's Huge Tooth to Spy-Mistress Anara at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: BEWARE OF CRAGJAW!
english.objectives: Kill Cragjaw and take Cragjaw's Huge Tooth.
english.description: By order of Overlord Krom'gar, Cragpool Lake is OFF LIMITS!$B$BThe ferocious beast known as Cragjaw has made the lake a death trap. Should you dispatch of Cragjaw, take his huge tooth as a trophy and return it to Spy-Mistress Anara for a reward.
english.progress: What is it that you require?
english.completion: A testament to the might of the Horde!
english.completed: Deliver Cragjaw's Huge Tooth to Spy-Mistress Anara at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 零件在哪儿？
text.objectives: 跟石爪山脉幽暗曲径的多特拉格中士谈一谈。
text.description: 这些炮的零件我已经等了好几天了！五天前我把最好的一个爆破工程师和两打矿工派到幽暗曲径里去拿零件。三天以后谁都没有带消息回来，我有点担心了。监督者派了他两个最好的兽人去查看发生了什么事。从那以后我们就一点音信都没有收到……$B$B到幽暗曲径里去，它就在这座壁垒的下面，查查发生了什么事！我需要零件！
text.completion: Um... Well you see, it's quite simple... THIS CAVE IS SWARMING WITH SOULLESS KILLING MACHINES!

english.title: Where Are the Parts?
english.objectives: Speak to Sergeant Dontrag inside the Deep Reaches in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: I've been waiting on parts for these guns for days! I sent one of my best blastgineers and two dozen miners into the Deep Reaches five days ago for the parts. After not hearing from anybody for three days I began to get a little worried. The Overlord sent two of his best orcs in to see what was going on. We've received no reports since then...$B$BHead into the Deep Reaches, directly below this fortress, and find out what's going on! I need parts!
english.completion: Um... Well you see, it's quite simple... THIS CAVE IS SWARMING WITH SOULLESS KILLING MACHINES!

text.title: 你的零件就在这儿……
text.objectives: 收集10个备用零件。
text.description: 眼下有个困难：我可以在以下两件事中选择其一，像所有人一样下去然后被杀掉；或是让克罗姆加意识到我们丢了矿洞，在克罗姆加壁垒被杀掉。我选择第三项，什么都不做。目前情况还不错。$B$B你需要零件？矿洞里丢垃圾似的到处都是。你只要去拿就好了。$B$B祝你好运！也许你拿到零件后，我们就能有脸回克罗姆加壁垒了。
text.progress: How's that part hunt going?
text.completion: I'll be damned! You managed to get the parts and not die. How are you only a sergeant?
text.completed: Return to Sergeant Dontrag inside the Deep Reaches in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: I Got Your Parts Right Here...
english.objectives: Collect 10 Spare Parts.
english.description: Here's the dilemma: I could do one of two things, get killed down here like everyone else or get killed up at Krom'gar Fortress when Krom'gar realizes we've lost the mine. I'm choosing the third option, do nothing. So far, so good.$B$BYou need parts? Plenty from the left over junk scattered about in this mine. You just gotta go get 'em.$B$BGood luck! Maybe if you get those parts we might be able to show our faces at Krom'gar Fortress.
english.progress: How's that part hunt going?
english.completion: I'll be damned! You managed to get the parts and not die. How are you only a sergeant?
english.completed: Return to Sergeant Dontrag inside the Deep Reaches in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 进退两难
text.objectives: 消灭12个愤怒的土元素。
text.description: 多特拉格可以解释得比我清楚。基本上，我们进退两难了。在这里什么都做不了，因为随便什么都能把我们给杀了；也没法儿回去，因为随便什么都能把我们给杀了——明白了？$B$B假如我们同心协力，或许可以从这糟糕的局面里摆脱出来。那些元素显然已经把矿洞里的东西都给杀了，你不如先从它们开刀，如何？
text.completion: Get the parts, kill the elementals and rescue the peons... We get all of that done and we're as good as promoted!
text.completed: Return to Scout Utvoch inside the Deep Reaches in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Between a Rock and a Hard Place
english.objectives: Kill 12 Raging Earth Elementals.
english.description: Dontrag can explain it better than me. Basically, we're stuck between a rock and a hard place. Can't do anything down here due to all of the things that can kill us and can't go back to the base due to all of the things that can kill us - you know?$B$BPerhaps if we worked together we might be able to get this mess sorted out. How about you get started by clearing out some of these elementals that have apparently killed everything in the mine, ok?
english.completion: Get the parts, kill the elementals and rescue the peons... We get all of that done and we're as good as promoted!
english.completed: Return to Scout Utvoch inside the Deep Reaches in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 这就是他们为什么叫苦工的原因……
text.objectives: 营救10名受惊吓的苦工。
text.description: 这两个没用的家伙！他们刚来的时候我以为有救了。根本不是！相反，多特拉格和乌图克朝矿洞里瞧了一眼，出了个馊主意，就是傻站在这儿，直到……我猜，直到大家都挂了为止。$B$B你看来一点也不像是没用的人。不如你来帮把手吧，朋友？我有很多苦工都给吓得精神错乱，躲在幽暗曲径里了。找到他们，把他们救出来！
text.completion: I knew it! You are a hero! If I have anything to do with it, you'll be promoted to legionnaire!
text.completed: Return to Blastgineer Igore inside the Deep Reaches in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: And That's Why They Call Them Peons...
english.objectives: Rescue 10 Frightened Peons.
english.description: These two are USELESS! When they first arrived I thought we were saved. Not so! Instead, Dontrag and Utvoch took one look at the mine and concocted some idiotic plan that involved standing here until... until we all died, I guess. $B$BYou don't look nearly as useless. How about you lend a hand, friend? I've got dozens of peons, scared out of their gourds, hiding in the Deep Reaches. Find them and get them out!
english.completion: I knew it! You are a hero! If I have anything to do with it, you'll be promoted to legionnaire!
english.completed: Return to Blastgineer Igore inside the Deep Reaches in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 这儿有备用零件！
text.objectives: 将一箱备用零件交给石爪山脉克罗姆加壁垒的首席爆破工程师邦姆古兹。
text.description: 呼，真不容易。我还以为咱们逃不过去了呢，$N。咱们得把这些零件送到首席爆破工程师邦姆古兹那儿去。我想我听到外面侏儒飞行器的声音了。没时间了！
text.progress: Get my parts?
text.completion: Just in time! The flying machines are starting to mass. Attack is imminent!

english.title: Spare Parts Up In Here!
english.objectives: Deliver the Crate of Spare Parts to Chief Blastgineer Bombgutz at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: Whew, that was tough. I didn't think we'd make it, $N. We better get these parts back to Chief Blastgineer Bombgutz. I think I hear the gnome flying machines buzzing outside. We haven't got a minute to lose!
english.progress: Get my parts?
english.completion: Just in time! The flying machines are starting to mass. Attack is imminent!

text.title: 被释放的公主
text.objectives: 在密斯莱尔水晶碎块处召唤并打败密斯莱尔。
text.description: 密斯莱尔可不是什么无辜的公主。她是可怕的敌人，巨人把她关在这里是有道理的。恐怕你也是。$B$B按葛利的说法，你必须到第一次同她交谈的密斯莱尔水晶碎块那里把她召唤出来。打败她，拿到怪异镣铐，将它们同碎块绑定起来。$B$B这卷轴你用得上。要小心啊，这可不是儿戏。祝你好运，$N。
text.progress: 现在，密斯赖尔水晶裂片出奇地安静。
text.completion: 你把怪异镣铐放置在水晶裂片周围。从地下很深的地方传来可怕的尖叫声，紧接着传来的是一声怒吼。$B$B密斯赖尔水晶裂片再也没有那种曾经有过的温暖安适的感觉了。现在，它们越来越猛烈地震动着……就像是有一种潜藏在地下的怨怒即将冲破地表一样。$B$B
text.completed: Return to the Shards of Myzrael in Arathi Highlands.
text.giverWindow: Set her free... then destroy her.

english.title: The Princess Unleashed
english.objectives: Summon and defeat Myzrael at the Shards of Myzrael.
english.description: Myzrael's no innocent princess. She's a terribly dangerous force, and the giants had every reason to chain her down there. I'm afraid you've been had.$B$BAccording to Gerrig, you have to summon her at the Shards of Myzrael where you first spoke with her.  Defeat her and gather her Eldritch Shackles, then bind them to the Shards.$B$BHere's the scroll you'll need. Be careful with it; I risked a few teeth to get it. Good luck, $n.
english.progress: The Shards of Myzrael are now strangely quiet.
english.completion: As the eldritch shackles are placed around the Shards, an unhuman wail is heard from far below.  The scream is followed by a roar. The Shards of Myzrael no longer invoke feelings of warmth and security as they once did.  Now they pulse with an open menace... as if the thing beneath them holds ill will toward the surface.
english.completed: Return to the Shards of Myzrael in Arathi Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Set her free... then destroy her.

text.title: 神奇潜水镜
text.objectives: 护送菲兹索普教授到洞穴里去并平安返回。
text.description: 既然我们已经整装待发，那么帮助奥布里先生寻找丢失的精灵宝藏就是当务之急了！$B$B在黑暗的海底，如果没有任何辅助手段的话，要想找到那些宝藏几乎是不可能的。博士做的潜水镜可以派上大用场，不过他要从山上的洞穴里弄些魔石来，好给他的潜水镜附上魔法。$B$B但是那座洞穴已经被诅咒了！只要我们靠近洞穴就会遭到伏击。你得掩护我，让我控制魔石的能量，将它注入到潜水镜里。
text.completion: 现在潜水镜可以正常工作了!好样的，$N。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Doctor Draxlegauge at Faldir's Cove in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: Goggle Boggle
english.objectives: Escort Professor Phizzlethorpe to the cave and back.
english.description: Now that we are full-fledged Blackwater Raiders it is our job to help Mr. O'Breen locate the lost elven treasure.$b$bIt is next to impossible to find the gems in the dark sea without aid. The doctor has constructed some goggles that will help. He needs the goggles charged with the energy derived from the enchanted stone in the cave just up the hill.$b$bBut the cave is cursed! When we get close, we get ambushed. Defend me and I can harness the energy from the stone into the goggles.
english.completion: The goggles work perfectly now! Well done, $n.
english.completed: Return to Doctor Draxlegauge at Faldir's Cove in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 水下宝藏
text.objectives: 法迪尔海湾的德拉克里格博士要你去收集10块精灵宝石并在完成任务后归还寻宝潜水镜。
text.description: 宝藏在海床上放了那么长时间，早已经被岩石包裹起来了。但是借助潜水镜中的魔法力量，你可以轻而易举地锁定这些宝藏。$B$B侏儒的创造能力实在是让人惊叹！$B$B那么你去把寻宝潜水镜借来用用，$N，看你能不能帮奥布里船长找回些丢失的宝藏。$B$B我可以潜游到那儿，可是……嗯……在这片安全而干燥的土地上，我有些重要的科学研究要做……嗯，是这样的。
text.progress: 潜水镜用得如何?运转还算正常吧?如果需要的话，我可以对它们做一些调整。$B$B哦，如果你用完了，就把潜水镜还给我。我想奥布里船长很快就要用到它了。
text.completion: 好极了，$N!船长一定会很高兴的!现在就等着舰队指挥官卡拉·海角的消息吧。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Doctor Draxlegauge at Faldir's Cove in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: Sunken Treasure
english.objectives: Doctor Draxlegauge in Faldir's Cove wants you to collect 10 Elven Gems and return the Goggles of Gem Hunting once you are done.
english.description: The treasure has been on the sea floor so long that the gems have calcified into thick stone. But the power harnessed in these goggles will allow you to locate them easily.$b$bA little gnomish ingenuity goes a long way!$b$bSo borrow the Goggles of Gem Hunting, $n, and see if you can collect some of the lost treasure for Captain O'Breen.$b$bI'd swim down there myself but...um...well, I have important scientific business to tend to up on the safe, dry land....er, yeah.
english.progress: How did the goggles work? Did everything function properly? Adjustments can be made if necessary.$b$bOh, and I'll need those goggles back when you're done. I am sure Captain O'Breen will have many uses for them later on.
english.completion: Most superb, $n! The Captain will be very pleased! And just wait until word gets back to Fleetmaster Seahorn!
english.completed: Return to Doctor Draxlegauge at Faldir's Cove in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 同沙克斯交谈
text.objectives: 把精灵宝石交给阿拉希高地法迪尔海湾的奥布里船长。
text.description: 我们不要让奥布里船长等了。他急着想看到这些宝藏呢。这不正是我们在这儿的原因吗？$B$B和这些海盗们打了几个星期的交道以后，我和教授都意识到，手里拿着海盗的宝藏永远是不安全的。$B$B拿着这些，$N，把它们交给奥布里。
text.progress: 嘿，$C。是哪阵风把你吹到这里来的?
text.completion: 这些小地精毕竟体现了他们的价值，对吧?它们确实有很大的利用价值!$B$B

english.title: Speak to Shakes
english.objectives: Take the Elven Gems to Captain O'Breen at Faldir's Cove in Arathi Highlands.
english.description: Let's not leave Captain O'Breen waiting. He'll want to see these gems first hand. After all, that's why we're here!$b$bAnd after a few weeks of consorting with these pirates, the professor and I have realized the last thing that's good for our health is to be caught hanging on to their treasure.$b$bHere, $n, take these to O'Breen.
english.progress: Ahoy, $c.  What brings you to the bridge?
english.completion: So the little gnomes proved their worth after all? I knew we kept those ankle biters around for a reason!

text.title: 打扫高地
text.objectives: 杀死8名石拳食人魔和10名石拳执行者。
text.description: 这里所有的潜在威胁都在监控之下。假如我们要把这片土地划归黑暗女王统治，就得从活人手里一块块、一寸寸地夺过来。$B$B东北不远处就是一个食人魔山。定居在那里的石拳食人魔必须被根除，$C。$B$B他们是个妨碍，手下别留情。
text.completion: Excellent. The march of the Forsaken continues.
text.completed: Return to Deathstalker Maudria at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: Clearing the Highlands
english.objectives: Kill 8 Boulderfist Ogres and 10 Boulderfist Enforcers.
english.description: No threat here will go overlooked. If we are to secure these lands under the Dark Lady's rule, we will tear from them everything living, inch by inch, piece by piece.$B$BTo the northeast, not a stone's throw away from this camp is an ogre mound. The Boulderfist ogres that dwell in it must be eradicated, $c.$B$BThey are in the way. Show no mercy or hesitation.
english.completion: Excellent. The march of the Forsaken continues.
english.completed: Return to Deathstalker Maudria at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 洪涛漫漫，尽没其中
text.objectives: 杀死巨型加兹瑞拉，并通知暴风城的马库斯·乔纳森将军。
text.description: 沙怒巨魔跟暮光之锤勾搭上了？！$B$B没关系。那个肮脏的巫婆绝不敢派兵攻打我的城市。$B$B来吧，勇士们！用他们的鲜血染红这片沙漠，然后光荣凯旋。等我们取得胜利，请转告马库斯·乔纳森将军这里发生的事情。我要确保民众恢复安宁，城市得以重建，一切都归于常态。
text.completion: Sandfury trolls and the Cult of Twilight's Hammer, you say? And they meant to send some giant monster into the heart of the city?! Well done! Stormwind is in your debt.
text.completed: Inform General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind City of Kai'ju Gahz'rilla's death.

english.title: Water They Up To?
english.objectives: Slay Kai'ju Gahz'rilla and inform General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind City.
english.description: Sandfury trolls working with the Twilight's Hammer?!$B$BNo matter. That foul witch won't be sending her monster to MY city.$B$BCome, brave ones! We'll slick the sand with their gore and return home triumphant. Tell General Marcus Jonathan what's happened here when we've gotten back; I'll need to oversee the return of the citizenry, repairs, and so on.
english.completion: Sandfury trolls and the Cult of Twilight's Hammer, you say? And they meant to send some giant monster into the heart of the city?! Well done! Stormwind is in your debt.
english.completed: Inform General Marcus Jonathan in Stormwind City of Kai'ju Gahz'rilla's death.

text.title: 船长的复仇
text.objectives: 法迪尔海湾的斯迪加特船长要你去杀掉10个刺脊袭击者和3个刺脊巫师。
text.description: 啊，多么可怕的生活！我本以为我再也不能像现在这样坐在火堆旁呼吸着新鲜的空气了！$B$B船员们为了拯救我那美丽漂亮的处女号尽了全力。愿神保佑他们，保佑他们的心灵。$B$B奥布里船长的船安全地进了港，可我们就没那么幸运了，大浪弄沉了我们的船。$B$B前一秒钟我们还漂浮在海上，转眼间就又被海浪吞没。而那些该死的纳迦还杀死了所有的幸存者！我逃到这里来，算是勉强保住了性命。$B$B我要让那些野兽去死！
text.completion: 干得漂亮，$N。那些混帐东西罪有应得。既然我的船和我的水手们已经不在了，那麽就让这些纳迦的死给我带来一些安慰吧。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Captain Steelgut at Faldir's Cove in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: Drowned Sorrows
english.objectives: Captain Steelgut in Faldir's Cove wants you to kill 10 Daggerspine Raiders and 3 Daggerspine Sorceresses.
english.description: Argh, 'tis a horrible life. I should be in a watery grave right now, not sittin' here by the fire, breathin' fresh air.$b$bThe crew tried so hard to save my beautiful Maiden's Folly. Bless the boys, bless their hearts.$b$bO'Breen made it to shore safely but we weren't so lucky. The seas just sank on us, I swear.$b$bOne second we're afloat and the next water is rushin' in. And those beasts! Killed all the survivors. Horrible naga scum. I went black and ended up here, saved.$b$bI want those beasts dead.
english.completion: Nice work out there, $n. Those scum deserved what they got. While nothin' will ever bring me ship or me crew back, the death of those naga gives me some solace.
english.completed: Return to Captain Steelgut at Faldir's Cove in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 波涛语者
text.objectives: 在瓦丝琪尔的梦魇深渊中找到波涛语者瓦罗伦。
text.description: 大地之环的一名成员，波涛语者瓦罗伦，已经游到东北边的梦魇深渊里去了。我们有段时间没有收到她的消息了。$B$B游到那边去，看看你能不能找到她。
text.completion: I sure am glad you're here!

english.title: The Wavespeaker
english.objectives: Find Wavespeaker Valoren in the Nightmare Depths of Vashj'ir.
english.description: One of the Earthen Ring, Wavespeaker Valoren, swam down into the Nightmare Depths to the northeast. We haven't heard from her in awhile.$B$BSwim out there and see if you can find her.
english.completion: I sure am glad you're here!

text.title: 波涛语者
text.objectives: 在瓦丝琪尔的梦魇深渊中找到波涛语者瓦罗伦。
text.description: 大地之环的一名成员，波涛语者瓦罗伦，已经游到东北边的梦魇深渊里去了。我们有段时间没有收到她的消息了。$B$B游到那边去，看看你能不能找到她。
text.completion: I sure am glad you're here!

english.title: The Wavespeaker
english.objectives: Find Wavespeaker Valoren in the Nightmare Depths of Vashj'ir.
english.description: One of the Earthen Ring, Wavespeaker Valoren, swam down into the Nightmare Depths to the northeast. We haven't heard from her in awhile.$B$BSwim out there and see if you can find her.
english.completion: I sure am glad you're here!

text.title: 防御克罗姆加壁垒
text.objectives: 摧毁15架侏儒飞行器或轰炸机，以及25名侏儒飞将。
text.description: 没时间了。他们来了！操纵重炮把侏儒们从天上打下来！炸弹承受太多次打击会被引爆，到时咱们都得完蛋！$B$B防御基地，$N！你是我们唯一的希望！$B$B如果我们能够安然生还，就去向克罗姆加大王报告。
text.completion: I have never seen such an act of bravery. You saved the base, sergeant - or should I say legionnaire! Lok'tar!
text.completed: Report to Overlord Krom'gar at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: In Defense of Krom'gar Fortress
english.objectives: Destroy 15 Gnomish Flying Machines or Bombers and 25 Gnome Wing Commanders.
english.description: There's no time left. Here they come! Take control of a heavy gun and shoot the gnomes out of the sky! If that bomb takes too many hits it will blow, taking us all with it!$B$BDefend the base, $N! You're our only hope!$B$BIf we somehow make it out of this in one piece, report to Overlord Krom'gar.
english.completion: I have never seen such an act of bravery. You saved the base, sergeant - or should I say legionnaire! Lok'tar!
english.completed: Report to Overlord Krom'gar at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 耳目：玛拉卡金
text.objectives: 去找石爪山脉玛拉卡金的巫医金吉尔。
text.description: 荣耀岗哨失守了。部落对贫瘠之地的掌控就犹如这片土地一样四分五裂。刚才我收到报告说，咱们有可能要在联盟和恐怖图腾的联手进攻下失去玛拉卡金。要是玛拉卡金失陷，半个石爪山就没了！$B$B你已经证明了自己是一名强悍的部落士兵。你是否愿意成为我在玛拉卡金的耳目？巫医金吉尔在那里等待你的到来。$B$B玛拉卡金就在南边。
text.completion: I see that Krom'gar has sent his best! Good, we have much work to do. The filth that is the Alliance have entered into a treaty with the Grimtotem. Now we fend off attacks from both forces. We are spread thin across the Greatwood Vale and will soon fall beneath the concerted effort of our enemies. There is only one hope: VOODOO!

english.title: Eyes and Ears: Malaka'jin
english.objectives: Report to Witch Doctor Jin'Zil at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: Honor's Stand has been lost. The Horde's grip on the Barrens shattered along with the land itself. I now receive reports that we are at risk of losing Malaka'jin to a concerted attack by the Alliance and the Grimtotem. If Malaka'jin falls, half of Stonetalon falls with it!$B$BYou have proven yourself a capable soldier of the Horde. Will you be my eyes and ears at Malaka'jin? Witch Doctor Jin'Zil awaits your arrival.$B$BMalaka'jin is located far to the south.
english.completion: I see that Krom'gar has sent his best! Good, we have much work to do. The filth that is the Alliance have entered into a treaty with the Grimtotem. Now we fend off attacks from both forces. We are spread thin across the Greatwood Vale and will soon fall beneath the concerted effort of our enemies. There is only one hope: VOODOO!

text.title: 巫毒：雷鸣蜥蜴之心
text.objectives: 获得一颗峭壁雷鸣蜥蜴之心。
text.description: 只有借助巫毒魔法，我们的部队才可能有机会击退恐怖图腾的进攻。也就是说，我需要几样材料来施放黑魔法。$B$B清单上的第一种是一颗峭壁雷鸣蜥蜴的心脏。那些野兽几乎被捕杀得要灭绝了，但这附近还有几只存活着。找到一只，把它的心给挖来！
text.progress: I need the cliff stormer heart.
text.completion: Excellent. Once I have everything I need I will mix it all together and unleash the voodoo! Woe unto our enemies!
text.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Jin'Zil at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Da Voodoo: Stormer Heart
english.objectives: Obtain a Cliff Stormer Heart.
english.description: With voodoo, our troops might have a chance at beating back the Grimtotem assault. With that said, I need several ingredients if I am to invoke black magic.$B$BThe first ingredient on my list is a heart from a cliff stormer. The beasts have nearly been hunted to extinction, but a few still exist around these parts. Find one and recover its beating heart!
english.progress: I need the cliff stormer heart.
english.completion: Excellent. Once I have everything I need I will mix it all together and unleash the voodoo! Woe unto our enemies!
english.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Jin'Zil at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 巫毒：山羊角
text.objectives: 获得6只石爪山羊角。
text.description: 要想施放巫毒，我就需要几样特别的材料。从这里的石爪山羊身上把它们的角给我弄来，$N！没有角我们就完了！
text.progress: I need the Stonetalon ram horns!
text.completion: Excellent. Once I have everything I need I will mix it all together and unleash the voodoo! Woe unto our enemies!
text.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Jin'Zil at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Da Voodoo: Ram Horns
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Stonetalon Ram Horns.
english.description: If I am to invoke voodoo, I will need several special reagents. Bring me horns from the Stonetalon rams of the region, $N! Without the horns we are done for!
english.progress: I need the Stonetalon ram horns!
english.completion: Excellent. Once I have everything I need I will mix it all together and unleash the voodoo! Woe unto our enemies!
english.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Jin'Zil at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 巫毒：共鸣水晶
text.objectives: 获得6颗共鸣水晶。
text.description: 巫毒仪式的最后一件材料是一种名为共鸣水晶的特殊晶体。只有在西边的滚岩洞穴里才找得到它。当心狗头人！它们不惜生命守卫着共鸣水晶！
text.progress: I need the resonite crystals!
text.completion: Finally! Now I will create the charm that will hold the voodoo enchantment!
text.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Jin'Zil at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Da Voodoo: Resonite Crystal
english.objectives: Obtain 8 Resonite Crystals.
english.description: The final ingredient for the voodoo ritual is a special type of crystal called resonite. It can only be found in the Boulderslide caverns, west of here. Beware the kobolds! They guard the resonite with their lives!
english.progress: I need the resonite crystals!
english.completion: Finally! Now I will create the charm that will hold the voodoo enchantment!
english.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Jin'Zil at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 皇后及群臣
text.objectives: 在蛛网盆地杀死蛛后西莉丝和任意10只蜘蛛。
text.description: <达恩呻吟着。>$B$B嗯哼。$B$B事情搞砸了。达恩不高兴。达恩的伙伴在蛛网盆地被蜘蛛杀了。达恩要复仇！$B$B帮帮达恩吧？消灭蛛后西莉丝和她的小蜘蛛们？为了达恩？为了达恩的伙伴！$B$B沿着路朝西北，就是蛛网盆地。去吧！
text.completion: Darn still not very happy, but Darn will reward you for what you have done.
text.completed: Return to Darn Talongrip at the Horde blockade in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: The Queen and Her Court
english.objectives: Kill Queen Silith and any 10 spiders in Webwinder Hollow.
english.description: <Darn grunts.>$B$BHrmph.$B$BThings falling apart. Darn not happy. Now Darn's mate killed by spiders at Webwinder Hollow. Darn demands vengeance!$B$BHelp Darn? Kill Queen Silith and her little spiderlings? For Darn? For Darn's mate!$B$BWebwinder Hollow is northwest of here, up the path. Go!
english.completion: Darn still not very happy, but Darn will reward you for what you have done.
english.completed: Return to Darn Talongrip at the Horde blockade in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 为了他们的肚子而战
text.objectives: 收集8枚卡利姆多鹰蛋。
text.description: 部队都饿了，$N。补给线被掐，我们逐渐弹尽粮绝。只要你给我找到食材，我就能给士兵们煮一顿盛宴。$B$B到西边的林子里找卡利姆多鹰巢，把蛋偷来给我。
text.progress: I need eggs!
text.completion: Thank you, $n. These eggs should get us through the week.
text.completed: Return to Denni'ka at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Fight On Their Stomachs
english.objectives: Collect 8 Kalimdor Eagle Eggs.
english.description: The troops are hungry, $N. With our supply lines cut off, we're steadily running out of food. I can cook the soldiers a feast if you can get me some ingredients.$B$BHead into the woods west of here and look for Kalimdor eagle nests. Steal the eggs from the nests and bring them back to me.
english.progress: I need eggs!
english.completion: Thank you, $n. These eggs should get us through the week.
english.completed: Return to Denni'ka at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 释放维尔哈伊
text.objectives: 杀死所有的恐怖触须，释放维尔哈伊。
text.description: 从深渊中伸出的恐怖触须将那只可怜的野兽困住了。$N，你可以杀死它们，挽救困兽吗？$B$B救救维尔哈伊吧。$B$B来，带上我的图腾，将它插在触须附近。图腾催生的寒流可以让这些怪物剧烈地收缩，然后你就能轻松地干掉它们了。
text.completion: Thank you, $N.$B$BThese nightmarish creatures that rise from below give me pause. I fear that our efforts will be for nothing.
text.completed: Return to Wavespeaker Valoren at the Nightmare Depths in Vashj'ir.
text.giverWindow: Free Wil'hai

english.title: Free Wil'hai
english.objectives: Slay all of the Tentacle Horrors to free Wil'hai.
english.description: Those tentacle horrors rising from the depths have trapped that poor beast. Please, $N, can you save it by destroying those things?$B$BWill you free Wil'hai?$B$BHere, take my totem and plant it near the tentacles. The cold it emanates will cause major shrinkage on those monsters and then you'll be able to destroy them.
english.completion: Thank you, $N.$B$BThese nightmarish creatures that rise from below give me pause. I fear that our efforts will be for nothing.
english.completed: Return to Wavespeaker Valoren at the Nightmare Depths in Vashj'ir.
english.giverWindow: Free Wil'hai

text.title: 援兵……
text.objectives: 用征服者德沃的鞭子抽服6名滚岩狗头人。
text.description: 我们似乎没有又大又蠢的兽人可以往战场上派了。这是一个问题。好在，我也许有办法解决。$B$B拿上这根鞭子到西边的滚岩洞穴里去，你可以找到一座脏兮兮的狗头人巢穴。用我的鞭子把那些畜生打服帖。一旦被征服，我们说什么他们就得做什么。$B$B你召集一支狗头人大军后就回来找我。
text.completion: In times of crisis, a desperate act may be all that is needed to secure victory. Sending a swarm of kobolds at the enemy may be the edge that we need to win.
text.completed: Return to Subjugator Devo at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Reinforcements...
english.objectives: Use Subjugator Devo's Whip to Subdue 6 Boulderslide Kobolds.
english.description: It would appear as if we are running out of big, stupid orcs to send at the enemy. This is a problem. Thankfully, I may have a solution.$B$BTake this whip and head west to Boulderslide Cavern. Within the cave you will find a filthy nest of kobolds. Use my whip to subdue the beasts. Once subdued they will do whatever we ask them to do.$B$BReturn to me when you have amassed a sizable army of kobolds.
english.completion: In times of crisis, a desperate act may be all that is needed to secure victory. Sending a swarm of kobolds at the enemy may be the edge that we need to win.
english.completed: Return to Subjugator Devo at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 金吉尔的祝福
text.objectives: 使用金吉尔的巫毒棒在12名克罗姆加掠夺者身上施下巫毒。
text.description: 啊，完成了！现在做一下测试。$B$B到巨木谷主战场去，在与恐怖图腾交战的克罗姆加掠夺者身上使用我的巫毒棒。我的巫毒魔法可以重振他们的勇气，让他们将敌人碾碎！$B$B立刻出发，$N！
text.completion: Victory, at last! Though it stands to reason that without a stable supply line this victory will be short lived. Enjoy it while it lasts, $n.
text.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Jin'Zil at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Jin'Zil's Blessing
english.objectives: Use Jin'Zil's Voodoo Stick to infuse 12 Krom'gar Marauders with Voodoo.
english.description: Ah, it is done! Now to test it out.$B$BTravel to the main point of conflict within Greatwood Vale and use my voodoo stick on the Krom'gar marauders battling the Grimtotem. My voodoo magic should renew their vigor and allow them to crush our enemies!$B$BGo now, $N!
english.completion: Victory, at last! Though it stands to reason that without a stable supply line this victory will be short lived. Enjoy it while it lasts, $n.
english.completed: Return to Witch Doctor Jin'Zil at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 狗头人之怒！
text.objectives: 在不毛之地的部落军旗旁使用狗头人战争号角，释放狗头人大军！
text.description: 现在石爪山狗头人军队听我们的指挥！听上去还挺可观。听上去是的。$B$B<德沃叹了口气。>$B$B联盟在北边的营地严防死守，几乎难以攻破，把守着东北不毛之地的要冲。带上这只狗头人战争号角，到不毛之地去。从东边杀进去，$N！到达我在你地图上所标记的位置后，就朝西走。用这只号角将狗头人之怒释放在联盟头上！
text.completion: Fascinating tale, friend. It would seem that our newfound kobold allies might be somewhat useful after all!
text.completed: Return to Subjugator Devo at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Kobold Fury!
english.objectives: Use the Kobold War Horn near the Horde Banner at the Unearthed Grounds to unleash the Kobold Army!
english.description: We now command the kobold armies of Stonetalon! It almost sounds impressive. Almost.$B$B<Devo sighs.>$B$BThe Alliance base camp north of here is tightly guarded. It is nigh impregnable, save for the entry point by the Unearthed Grounds, northeast of here. Take this kobold war horn and head towards the Unearthed Grounds. Enter from the east, $N! Once there, head west until you arrive at the location I have marked upon your map. Use the horn there to unleash kobold fury upon the Alliance!
english.completion: Fascinating tale, friend. It would seem that our newfound kobold allies might be somewhat useful after all!
english.completed: Return to Subjugator Devo at Malaka'jin in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: 探路者鲁娜
text.objectives: 去找南贫瘠之地高地之路的探路者鲁娜
text.description: 南贫瘠之地正遭到联盟的攻打。牛头人派人来求救，我们不能置之不理。部落所有还具备战斗力的士兵都要前去增援。$B$B你要是想帮忙，从村子里上高地之路，去找探路者鲁娜。
text.completion: The situation is grim, $r. We need all of the help that we can get!

english.title: Nura Pathfinder
english.objectives: Report to Nura Pathfinder on the High Road in Southern Barrens.
english.description: Southern Barrens is under attack by the Alliance. The tauren have sent out a call for help that we simply cannot ignore. All able bodied soldiers of the Horde should assist.$B$BIf you wish to help, take the path to the High Road, located in the village. Seek out Nura Pathfinder.
english.completion: The situation is grim, $r. We need all of the help that we can get!

text.title: 清理被腐蚀的生物
text.objectives: 杀死任意8只碾压巨鳗、深海鮣魚或是海沟猎手。
text.description: 大地之环的朋友希望我们能伸出援手。火烟海沟里的无面者恶魔正在腐蚀海洋里的生物。$B$B能帮我除掉它们吗？
text.completion: Good enough for me. Don't get too complacent, $n. The hard part's about to come.
text.completed: Return to Captain Taylor atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Clearing the Defiled
english.objectives: Slay any 8 Crushing Eels, Deep Remoras, or Chasm Stalkers.
english.description: Our Earthen Ring friends here are wondering if we can lend them a hand. There are faceless down below in the Scalding Chasm that are defiling all of the wildlife.$B$BCan you take care of that for me?
english.completion: Good enough for me. Don't get too complacent, $n. The hard part's about to come.
english.completed: Return to Captain Taylor atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 清理被腐蚀的生物
text.objectives: 杀死任意8只碾压巨鳗、深海鮣魚或是海沟猎手。
text.description: These Earthen Ring want us to do their killing for them. There are faceless down below in the Scalding Chasm that are defiling all of the wildlife.$B$BSwim down there and take care of it.
text.completion: Well done.$B$BDon't get too full of yourself, $N. The hard part's about to come.
text.completed: Return to Legionnaire Nazgrim atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Clearing the Defiled
english.objectives: Slay any 8 Crushing Eels, Deep Remoras, or Chasm Stalkers.
english.description: These Earthen Ring want us to do their killing for them. There are faceless down below in the Scalding Chasm that are defiling all of the wildlife.$B$BSwim down there and take care of it.
english.completion: Well done.$B$BDon't get too full of yourself, $N. The hard part's about to come.
english.completed: Return to Legionnaire Nazgrim atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 图腾的威力
text.objectives: 在限制图腾的范围内消灭5个腐蚀无面者。
text.description: 带上我的图腾潜入火烟海沟。消灭无面者，并使用图腾汲取它们的能量。图腾会防止它们回流到远处。$B$B吸满能量后，将图腾带回来给我。我们可以借助它引诱出藏匿在海底的无面者首领。
text.completion: Yes, $r, can you feel them seething with a desire to break free and destroy us?$B$BThis is good! They will be the perfect lure for their leader.
text.completed: Return to Erunak Stonespeaker atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Into the Totem
english.objectives: Slay 5 Faceless Defilers while they are within range of the Confinement Totem.
english.description: You must take my totem down into the Scalding Chasm. Use it to capture the energies of the faceless as they die. The totem will keep them from returning from whence they came.$B$BWhen the totem is full, bring it back to me and we will use it to lure their leader up from deep down below.
english.completion: Yes, $r, can you feel them seething with a desire to break free and destroy us?$B$BThis is good! They will be the perfect lure for their leader.
english.completed: Return to Erunak Stonespeaker atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

text.title: All's Quiet on the Southern Front
text.objectives: Report to Overlord Krom'gar at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.
text.description: Return now to Overlord Krom'gar, $N. Inform him of our status and of what you have done to ensure that Malaka'jin does not fall.$B$BWe thank you for all that you have done. Perhaps some day soon you will have your own region to command.
text.completion: Lok'tar ogar! You are the embodiment of what it means to be a Horde soldier, $n. If only we had more like you, this war would be over and Kalimdor would belong to the Horde - UNCONTESTED! Rise now as a champion of Krom'gar!

english.title: All's Quiet on the Southern Front
english.objectives: Report to Overlord Krom'gar at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: Return now to Overlord Krom'gar, $N. Inform him of our status and of what you have done to ensure that Malaka'jin does not fall.$B$BWe thank you for all that you have done. Perhaps some day soon you will have your own region to command.
english.completion: Lok'tar ogar! You are the embodiment of what it means to be a Horde soldier, $n. If only we had more like you, this war would be over and Kalimdor would belong to the Horde - UNCONTESTED! Rise now as a champion of Krom'gar!

text.title: Beginning of the End
text.objectives: Take the Krom'gar Hot Air Balloon to the Sludgewerks in Stonetalon Mountains.
text.description: 冠军，我们已经获得了新的目标。我们在“蝙蝠侠谷”的侦察兵报告说，暗夜精灵正在准备自己的大规模杀伤性武器，并将其藏在古树中。他们将永远不会有机会使用他们的武器对付我们$B$B你将护送炸弹到Sludgewerks加油，然后到Cliffwalker Post，从中我们将引爆炸弹并杀死我们所有的敌人。 $B现在，$N。当你到达Sludgewerks时，报告给Jibbly Rakit。
text.completion: Krom'gar has sent his champion! Well you haven't a thing to worry about, Champion. We'll get the balloon all fueled up in no time. How about you lend a hand around here while you wait?
text.completed: Report to Jibbly Rakit at the Sludgewerks in Stonetalon Mountains.
text.objective1: Krom'gar Hot Air Balloon safely escorted to the Sludgewerks

english.title: Beginning of the End
english.objectives: Take the Krom'gar Hot Air Balloon to the Sludgewerks in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: Champion, we have acquired a new target. Our scouts in Battlescar Valley report that the night elves are preparing their own weapon of mass destruction and hiding it within an ancient tree. They will never be given the chance to use their weapon against us.$B$BYou are to escort the bomb to the Sludgewerks for refueling and then to Cliffwalker Post, from which we will detonate the bomb and kill all of our enemies.$B$BGo now, $N. Report to Jibbly Rakit when you arrive at the Sludgewerks.
english.completion: Krom'gar has sent his champion! Well you haven't a thing to worry about, Champion. We'll get the balloon all fueled up in no time. How about you lend a hand around here while you wait?
english.completed: Report to Jibbly Rakit at the Sludgewerks in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.objective1: Krom'gar Hot Air Balloon safely escorted to the Sludgewerks

text.title: The Turd Problem
text.objectives: Kill any 6 Pridewing Wyvern.
text.description: We have a little problem...$B$B<Jibbly points to the large turds covering the base.>$B$BWe built the Sludgewerks near a wyvern habitat. Now our initial blueprints for the Sludgewerks were drawn up so as not to disturb the wyvern habitat as the beasts are apparently sacred to tauren and orcs. Do you know what's sacred to me? Not getting pooped on, that's what!$B$BBetween you, me and the wall, the wyvern must die!
text.completion: I sure hope you didn't miss any. I don't think I can take much more of this!
text.completed: Return to Jibbly Rakit at the Sludgewerks in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.completion: I sure hope you didn't miss any. I don't think I can take much more of this!
english.completed: Return to Jibbly Rakit at the Sludgewerks in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: Spy Infestation
text.objectives: Kill 8 Alliance Spies. Use Jibbly's Gas Bomb to uncloak the spies!
text.description: We've got another problem, $N. Alliance spies are all over the place! You haven't seen any? That's because they're invisible! Cloaked! I have a solution, but I need muscle like you to go out there and follow through with my plan.$B$BUse this gas bomb on the cloaked spies and it will reveal them. Once revealed, send them back to their maker.$B$BYou'll know a cloaked spy by the effect they leave in the air. Look closely!
text.completion: And they called me crazy. I knew this place was crawling with spies. Poop too.
text.completed: Return to Jibbly Rakit at the Sludgewerks in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: Final Delivery
text.objectives: Take the Krom'gar Hot Air Balloon to Cliffwalker Post in Stonetalon Mountains.
text.description: Overlord Krom'gar sends word from the base. You are to get back on the Krom'gar hot air balloon and take it to Cliffwalker Post. From there, the plan is to unleash the payload on the Alliance at Battlescar Valley.$B$BYou better get going, $N. It's not wise to keep Krom'gar waiting.$B$BSpeak to General Grebo when you arrive at your destination. He'll be able to brief you on the next course of action.
text.completion: Chieftain Cliffwalker and his tauren seek to commit treason against the Horde! They claim that the ancient tree at the heart of Battlescar Valley is merely a school for druids. They are blind to the fact that desperate measures are taken during war time. My scouts have assured me that the night elves hide a weapon of great power within that tree. We're going to end this now!
text.completed: Report to General Grebo at Cliffwalker Post in Stonetalon Mountains.
text.objective1: Krom'gar Hot Air Balloon taken to Cliffwalker Post

text.title: 灭火
text.objectives: 使用灭火装置，扑灭铁炉堡飞行器机坪的6处大火。
text.description: 黑铁矮人出其不意地偷袭了我们。黑铁破坏者摧毁了不少飞行器、蒸汽坦克以及物资储备。我们好不容易才保住了几架轰炸机。$B$B所有的技师、新兵和守卫都上了战场，想要尽快修理被破坏的地面以及空中装置。步兵团也坚持不了多久了。带上这件装置，帮助我们扑灭大火吧。
text.completion: Well done! My men are working hard on getting our flying machines and steam tanks back into the fight.
text.completed: Return to Commander Stonebreaker at Ironforge Airfield.

english.title: Extinguish the Fires
english.objectives: Using the Firefighting Equipment, extinguish 6 fires at the Ironforge Airfield.
english.description: The Dark Iron attack took us by surprise. Their saboteurs managed to damage most of our aircraft, steam tanks, and supplies. We were only able to get a few of our bombers airborne.$B$BEvery technician, recruit, and guard I can spare is  scrambling to get the others repaired and flight-ready. Our infantry can only hold out for so long. Take this equipment and help extinguish the burning bombers.
english.completion: Well done! My men are working hard on getting our flying machines and steam tanks back into the fight.
english.completed: Return to Commander Stonebreaker at Ironforge Airfield.

text.title: 通缉：奥图和法库雷斯特
text.objectives: 把法库雷斯特和奥图的头颅交给避难谷地的尼艾丝队长。
text.description: 激流堡民兵团重金悬赏法库雷斯特公爵和他的保镖奥图的头颅。法库雷斯特是辛迪加在阿拉希地区的主要领导者，他的死将使该组织在这一地区的活动陷入瘫痪。$B$B他的保镖奥图不是我们的战略目标，但他生性凶残，已经杀死了许多激流堡的士兵。$B$B赏金请到尼艾丝队长处领取。
text.progress: 你好。有什麽事要报告吗?
text.completion: 法库雷斯特和奥图?太好了!$B$B这是对你的奖赏，$N。我代表激流堡民兵团感谢你。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.
text.giverWindow: He will be well-protected.  Go with caution.

english.title: Wanted!  Otto and Falconcrest
english.objectives: Bring Otto's Head and Falconcrest's Head to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe.
english.description: The Stromgarde Militia has placed bounties on the heads of Lord Falconcrest, and his bodyguard Otto.  Falconcrest heads the Syndicate's efforts in the Arathi Highlands, and his death would cause a major disruption in those efforts.$B$BHis bodyguard Otto, although not a strategic target, is a fierce opponent and has killed dozens of our defenders.$B$BTheir bounties may be collected from Captain Nials.
english.progress: Hello.  Do you have a report to submit?
english.completion: Falconcrest and Otto?  Wonderful! Here is your reward, $n.  I am happy to pay it.
english.completed: Return to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.
english.giverWindow: He will be well-protected.  Go with caution.

text.title: 最后的请求
text.objectives: 将掘歌的鲜鱼与便笺包交给驱暗海窟的格罗瓦船长。
text.description: $N，我要你将这个包裹交给格罗瓦船长。以我目前的状态，恐怕要花上一周才能返回驱暗海窟，但是我们的时间不多了。
text.progress: Have you found Oskar and Humphrey?
text.completion: I see.  Yes, I am rememberink now... Humphrey and Oskar vere not the strongest svimmers. The reconnaissance is helpful, and the extra fish look very tasty.  If you are seeink Mister Digsong before he returns, please send him my thanks.

english.title: One Last Favor
english.objectives: Deliver Digsong's Fish and Tips to Captain Glovaal at Darkbreak Cove.
english.description: $N, I'm gonna need ya to bring this back to Captain Glovaal.  With my condition, it'll take me a week to get back to Darkbreak Cove, and we don't have any time to waste.
english.progress: Have you found Oskar and Humphrey?
english.completion: I see.  Yes, I am rememberink now... Humphrey and Oskar vere not the strongest svimmers. The reconnaissance is helpful, and the extra fish look very tasty.  If you are seeink Mister Digsong before he returns, please send him my thanks.

text.title: 阿莉娜的奖赏
text.objectives: 跟黑暗游侠奥丽娜谈一谈。
text.description: 托卡拉尔的传说就到这里结束了。它将以黑暗女王的名义，成为一件为生者带来死亡的武器。$B$B现在退下吧，$N。我的任务是要再一度守护这把宝剑。把你的胜利告诉奥丽娜，我肯定她会大大奖赏你的。
text.progress: 干得好!马林一定会为你感到高兴的。
text.completion: The news of your victory satisfies me, $c... a rare sensation. The Dark Lady herself has mused that our conquest of Lordaeron may be the only way the Forsaken can find true satisfaction, and pehaps even relief. But it matters not. Our victory is inevitable. For your loyal service to the Forsaken, I award you in the name of Sylvanas.

english.title: Alina's Reward
english.objectives: Speak to Dark Ranger Alina.
english.description: The tale of Trol'kalar ends here, then. It will be a weapon to bring death to the living, in the name of the Dark Lady.$B$BLeave me now, $n. My job is once again to guard the blade. Tell Alina of your victory, I'm sure she will have a reward for you.
english.progress: You do this, an' I'm sure Malin'll be more than pleased with you.
english.completion: The news of your victory satisfies me, $c... a rare sensation. The Dark Lady herself has mused that our conquest of Lordaeron may be the only way the Forsaken can find true satisfaction, and pehaps even relief. But it matters not. Our victory is inevitable. For your loyal service to the Forsaken, I award you in the name of Sylvanas.

text.title: To Battlescar!
text.objectives: Use the Krom'gar Demolisher to destroy 5 Darnassian Glaive Throwers and any 20 Alliance soldiers in Battlescar Valley.
text.description: I will allow this old fool time to plead his case. He has assured me that he will bring back proof that the night elves do not harbor a weapon of mass destruction. We shall see.$B$BWhile we await this proof, you will assist our army in the valley. We have prepared a large number of siege tanks for this purpose. Our demolishers are poised for attack.$B$BTake the elevator down to the base of the outpost and take control of a Krom'gar demolisher. Use it to lay waste to our enemies in Battlescar Valley.
text.completion: You possess quite a talent for destruction, $n. Whatever Alliance remain after your rampage across Battlescar Valley will be dealt with by the bomb.
text.completed: Report to General Grebo at Cliffwalker Post in Stonetalon Mountains.
text.objective2: Alliance Soldier in Battlescar Valley slain
