text.title: 你好鲁鲁
text.objectives: 在法迪尔海湾的瞭望台上找到鲁鲁。
text.description: 痛肠被派来侦察。看好多东西。大冒险！$B$B痛肠发现了秘密的海盗船。海盗都害怕，逃跑了。但食人魔鲁鲁不跑。鲁鲁和痛肠做朋友！$B$B痛肠必须得走了，但是想鲁鲁。你去替痛肠跟鲁鲁问好。
text.completion: You friends with Goutgut! Him weird ogre. Smell funny.

english.title: Hello Lolo
english.objectives: Find Lolo the Lookout at Faldir's Cove.
english.description: Goutgut get sent scouting. Look at many things. Big adventure!$B$BGoutgut found secret pirate ship. Pirates all scared, run away. But ogre Lolo not run. Lolo make friend with Goutgut!$B$BGoutgut have to leave, but miss Lolo. You go say hello to Lolo for Goutgut.
english.completion: You friends with Goutgut! Him weird ogre. Smell funny.

text.title: 落锤镇
text.objectives: 去找阿拉希高地落锤镇的戈穆尔。
text.description: 你为我们干得很不错，$N。如今我们已经初有成就，征服计划的下一个阶段尚需从长计议。$B$B我们还有很多工作要做，但我不会让你在这里虚度时光，空等我们修筑防御工事。到东边的落锤镇去。那里的兽人无疑用得着你的帮助。
text.completion: Throm'ka, $c. If your deeds for the undead are as great as you claim, I am honored to help you serve the Horde.

english.title: Hammerfall
english.objectives: Report to Gor'mul at Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands.
english.description: You have served us well here, $n. Now that we've made our mark, the next phase of our conquest will occur over months rather than minutes.$B$BThere is much work yet to be done, and I will spare you the tedium of waiting for our fortifications to trickle in. Travel to the east, to Hammerfall. The orcs there will no doubt have use of your aid.
english.completion: Throm'ka, $c. If your deeds for the undead are as great as you claim, I am honored to help you serve the Horde.

text.title: 鼓舞防御者
text.objectives: 在铁炉堡飞行器机坪的松散的雪堆上插上8面铁炉堡旗帜。
text.description: 在工程师修理轰炸机的同时，铁炉堡守卫和巡山人仍然在抵御入侵者。$B$B攻击行动开始后，他们就一直在奋战在最前线，连小憩和吃饭的时间都没有。铁炉堡拥有艾泽拉斯最优秀的防御者，但是他们的体能也是有极限的。$B$B带上这些旗帜，将它们插在雪堆上。向防御者们昭示为铁炉堡而战的荣耀，并鼓舞他们的士气。
text.completion: The men are finding hidden reserves of strength and courage to deal with the Dark Iron onslaught. The airfield will not fall on our watch!
text.completed: Return to Captain Stonebreaker at the Ironforge Airfield.

english.title: Rallying the Defenders
english.objectives: Plant 8 Ironforge Banners in mounds of Loose Snow throughout the Ironforge Airfield.
english.description: While our engineers work on getting the bombers ready to fly again, our guards and mountaineers continue to fight the invaders.$B$BThey've been out there since the incursion began, without so much as a chance to catch some sleep or have a meal. Ironforge's defenders are among the best on Azeroth, but even they have limits.$B$BTake these banners and plant them in banks of loose snow. Remind the men what they are fighting for and help keep their morale high.
english.completion: The men are finding hidden reserves of strength and courage to deal with the Dark Iron onslaught. The airfield will not fall on our watch!
english.completed: Return to Captain Stonebreaker at the Ironforge Airfield.

text.title: Orako
text.objectives: Report to Orako at Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.
text.description: <Captain Verne looks down at his watch.>$b$bWhere is that hunter?  I sent Orako to Underlight Canyon to prepare a recon report a week ago!  Sure, he's a handful, and I didn't mind getting him out of my hair, but I need his report.$b$bSay, what's your name?  $N?  Would you be willing to go track him down?  It seems strange to send a $c to find a hunter, but I'm running out of options.
text.completion: Gah!  These fish are impossible to hit!$b$b<Orako looks at you.>$b$bMy wolf got eaten by a fish, and I'm not going back until I find her.

text.title: 微光果汁
text.objectives: Obtain 6 gobs of Glow-Juice from Pyreshell Scuttlers and Luxscale Groupers in Underlight Canyon.
text.description: Shooting fish in a barrel is easy.  Shooting fish in an ocean is a little harder.$b$bHave you seen the murlocs down in the canyon, $c?  They don't shoot at all!  They have little balls full of glow-juice on their heads that make the fish come to THEM.  Hey, we should try that!$b$bGo south, and kill the crabs and groupers in the canyon.  They have lots of glow-juice in their skin.  I've seen it!
text.progress: We need lots and lots of glow-juice.
text.completion: Hey, look at how glowy it is!$b$b<Orako looks wistfully off into the distance.>$b$bMy wolf loved things that were glowy...
text.completed: Return to Orako at Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.

text.title: Here Fishie Fishie
text.objectives: Put on the Fish Hat, then swim through the coral in Underlight Canyon to attract 30 Underlight Nibblers.
text.description: <Orako rolls the glow-juice into a ball, then attaches it to a device that he's clearly been working on for a long time.>$b$bHere, I got you this hat.  It has a light on it, and it will make fish follow you.  Just like the murlocs!$b$bThe murlocs like to hunt in the kelp and coral along the sides of the canyon.  If you put on this hat and swim in that kelp, you might catch some fish like they do.
text.progress: How many did you catch?
text.completion: Hmm... you got a lot of fish, but none of these are the ones that ate my wolf.  I think it was probably a bigger fish.
text.completed: Return to Orako at Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.

text.title: Die Fishman Die
text.objectives: 杀死4个寒光猎手和4个寒光智者。
text.description: A fish ate my wolf, and murlocs look like fish.  I'm going to make those murlocs pay!$b$bHead back down to the canyon and kill the fishmen!  My wolf will be avenged!
text.completion: I know, murlocs aren't fish.  I thought that killing them would make me feel better, but I still feel sad about my wolf.$b$b<Orako sighs.>
text.completed: Return to Orako at Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.

text.title: I Brought You This Egg
text.objectives: Deliver the Enormous Eel Egg to Orako at Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.
text.description: <This appears to be an egg from one of the devious great-eels that float up above the canyon.  You wonder whether or not Orako might be interested in something like this.>
text.progress: <Blam!>$b$bYou brought me something?
text.completion: That is a big egg.$b$b<Orako sniffs it.>$b$bIt is big, and it smells like fish.  Maybe the big fish that made this egg is the big fish that ate my wolf!

text.title: Here Fishie Fishie 2: Eel-Egg-Trick Boogaloo
text.objectives: 在光渊海峡的扭曲的巨海鳗附近使用鳗鱼爆破装置，然后击败被削弱的巨海鳗。
text.description: <Orako removes an explosive trap from his sack and shoves it through the egg's outer membrane.>$b$bThis will make the egg explode.  Place the egg down next to one of those giant eels, and wait for them to come close.  When the egg explodes, the big fish will be almost dead, and you can finish killing it.$b$bSave my wolf!  With this egg, you can do it.
text.completion: <Orako is busy playing with Wolf.>$b$bOh, thank you, $N!  I knew Wolf was alive!$b$bHere, take one of these.  I don't need them anymore.
text.completed: Return to Orako at Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.

english.completed: Return to Orako at Underlight Canyon in Vashj'ir.
english.giverWindow: Help me find my wolf!
english.objective1: Use Eel-Splosive Device on Devious Great-Eel

text.title: 歐拉寇的報告
text.objectives: Deliver Orako's Report to Captain "Jewels" Verne in Tenebrous Cavern.
text.description: <You remind Orako that he was supposed to send a report back to Captain Verne.>$b$bRight, a report.  All that I've seen here is fish.  Lots and lots of fish.$b$b<Orako looks over at the sack of fish that you brought for him.>$b$bBring this back to the captain.  This is my report.
text.progress: Where was he?  What happened?
text.completion: This is his report?!  That idiot...$b$bI suppose we can use the food.  Thanks, $N.  You've done as well as can be expected.

english.title: Orako's Report
english.objectives: Deliver Orako's Report to Captain "Jewels" Verne in Tenebrous Cavern.
english.description: <You remind Orako that he was supposed to send a report back to Captain Verne.>$b$bRight, a report.  All that I've seen here is fish.  Lots and lots of fish.$b$b<Orako looks over at the sack of fish that you brought for him.>$b$bBring this back to the captain.  This is my report.
english.progress: Where was he?  What happened?
english.completion: This is his report?!  That idiot...$b$bI suppose we can use the food.  Thanks, $N.  You've done as well as can be expected.

text.title: 诺斯弗德农场
text.objectives: 在诺斯弗德农场杀死10名辛迪加雇佣兵。
text.description: 我们正在为激流堡而战，然而我们却逐渐落入下风。我们、食人魔以及辛迪加分别控制着这座城市的一部分，现在我们这三方势力陷入了整日互相征战却毫无突破的僵局。$B$B然而，当敌人们力量开始逐渐增强的时候，我们却在慢慢地变弱。$B$B尽管南海镇陷落了，我们还是不能让任何一寸土地落到敌人手中。$B$B到辛迪加在诺斯弗德农场的基地去干掉他们，我们必须在部落能够挺进之前收复失地。
text.completion: Very good, $n.  The last thing we need with the undead looming is a gang of common thieves distracting us.
text.completed: Return to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: Northfold Manor
english.objectives: Kill 10 Syndicate members at Northfold Manor.
english.description: We are fighting a war for Stromgarde, and we are losing.  The ogres, the Syndicate and we have divided our once great city, and each faction battles the other into a bloody stalemate.$B$BBut our forces dwindle while our enemy grows.$B$BThough Southshore has fallen, we must not let any further ground be yielded to our enemies.$B$BGo to the Syndicate base in Northfold Manor and slay them. We must reclaim the land for ourselves before the Horde has a chance to creep further.
english.completion: Very good, $n.  The last thing we need with the undead looming is a gang of common thieves distracting us.
english.completed: Return to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 反击
text.objectives: 登上修复的轰炸机，使用铁锤炸弹杀死30名黑铁矮人。铁炉堡飞行器机坪上的任何黑铁矮人以及他们的盟友都算。
text.description: 首席工程师修好了一架轰炸机，说是可以正常飞行了。带上这些炸弹，去跑道起点处找到那架修好的轰炸机。$B$B起飞后，瞄准黑铁矮人投弹吧。有传闻说他们在此次攻击行动中派出了一批新研制的作战傀儡。我要你多多留意，作战傀儡是最优先的投弹目标。
text.completion: The momentum is starting to shift, $n, largely due to your efforts. Now, it is time to strike at the Dark Iron leadership.
text.completed: Return to Commander Stonebreaker at Ironforge Airfield.

english.title: Striking Back
english.objectives: Board the Repaired Bomber and use the Iron Hammer Bomb to kill 30 Dark Iron attackers. You may kill any of the Dark Iron dwarves or their allies at the Ironforge Airfield.
english.description: My chief engineer tells me that he's managed to get one of the bombers repaired and airworthy. Take these bombs with you, and look for the repaired bomber at the start of the runway.$B$BOnce you're airborne, use the bombs to do as much damage to the attacking Dark Iron dwarves as you can. I've heard rumors that they're preparing to deploy a new kind of war golem. Keep your eyes peeled for those golems and make them your highest priority targets.
english.completion: The momentum is starting to shift, $n, largely due to your efforts. Now, it is time to strike at the Dark Iron leadership.
english.completed: Return to Commander Stonebreaker at Ironforge Airfield.

text.title: 激流堡徽章
text.objectives: 从激流堡的敌人身上获得7枚激流堡徽章。
text.description: 我们的民兵分队正在和控制着激流堡的辛迪加成员激战。为了刺激他们那群乌合之众与我们作战，辛迪加的头目们使出了重金悬赏的手段，只要有人能杀死我们的民兵，并从他们身上缴获激流堡徽章，辛迪加都会给予奖励。$B$B我们必须夺回那些徽章——决不能让刽子手们用我们的战士的性命来换取金钱！$B$B到激流堡城内的辛迪加控制区去杀掉那些歹徒，取回我们的徽章。
text.progress: $N，你取必了激流堡徽章了吗?要让辛迪加明白，他们绝对没法从我们阵亡的士兵那里得到任何好处。
text.completion: 谢谢你，$N。我们会将这些战士的死讯通知他们的家属。$B$B这是很残酷的消息，但总比不能确定心爱的人是死是活要好得多。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: Stromgarde Badges
english.objectives: Collect 7 Stromgarde Badges from Syndicate enemies in Stromgarde Keep.
english.description: The Syndicate in Stromgarde do battle with our contingent of militia there. In order to urge the rabble to fight our more disciplined troops, the Syndicate leaders have placed a bounty on our soldiers, awarding gold for each Stromgarde Badge gathered off killed militiamen.$B$BWe want those badges retrieved - we cannot allow the cutthroats to take trophies from our brave fallen!$B$BEnter the Syndicate-controlled area of Stromgarde and hunt them for our badges.
english.progress: Have you retrieved any Stromgarde Badges, $N?  The Syndicate must learn they cannot profit from our dead.
english.completion: Thank you, $n.  We will inform the families of these fallen soldiers that they were killed in battle. It will be grim news to bear, but it is better than the uncertainty of a missing loved one.
english.completed: Return to Captain Nials at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 烫灼之菇
text.objectives: 收集5颗烫灼之菇。
text.description: 我们倒是用得着无悯者，你洞里的朋友给我们带来的。不过我需要一份防腐剂。$B$B火烟海沟里生长着某种奇特的蘑菇。摘一些回来给我，我就可以自己试着做做看。
text.progress: I heard that you had an unpleasant encounter with putting one of the demons on your head. I can assure you that they are now all quite dead.
text.completion: I will use the mushrooms as a reagent to treat the corpses. We will have one ready for you soon.
text.completed: Return to Wavespeaker Tulra atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Scalding Shrooms
english.objectives: Collect 5 Scalding Shrooms.
english.description: We think that we have a use for the merciless ones that your friend from the cave delivered to us. But I need a preservative for it.$B$BDown below in the Scalding Chasm are some mushrooms with the properties that I need. Bring some back up to me and I'll see what I can do.
english.progress: I heard that you had an unpleasant encounter with putting one of the demons on your head. I can assure you that they are now all quite dead.
english.completion: I will use the mushrooms as a reagent to treat the corpses. We will have one ready for you soon.
english.completed: Return to Wavespeaker Tulra atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.

text.title: Proof of Lies
text.objectives: Find Orthus at Thal'darah Grove in Stonetalon Mountains.
text.description: At the heart of Battlescar Valley stands an ancient tree - a tree that has withstood the force of ages and has served as a place of peace and learning for generations. My kin have studied druidism at the grove, alongside the night elves, for as long as I can recall. Now I am to believe that the tree holds within it an Alliance weapon of mass destruction?$B$BKrom'gar is wrong and I will prove it!$B$BI have sent my son, Orthus, to Thal'darah Grove in search of this weapon. Go there now and meet him.
text.completion: Orthus is dead. He is clutching something in his hand.

english.title: Proof of Lies
english.objectives: Find Orthus at Thal'darah Grove in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: At the heart of Battlescar Valley stands an ancient tree - a tree that has withstood the force of ages and has served as a place of peace and learning for generations. My kin have studied druidism at the grove, alongside the night elves, for as long as I can recall. Now I am to believe that the tree holds within it an Alliance weapon of mass destruction?$B$BKrom'gar is wrong and I will prove it!$B$BI have sent my son, Orthus, to Thal'darah Grove in search of this weapon. Go there now and meet him.
english.completion: Orthus is dead. He is clutching something in his hand.

text.title: Betrayal at the Grove
text.objectives: Take the Krom'gar General's Insignia back to High Chieftain Cliffwalker at Cliffwalker Post in Stonetalon Mountains.
text.description: Druid corpses litter the room. Something seems amiss, as you see no signs of a struggle.  Bloody drag marks lead in from the doorway.$B$BYou pry Orthus' death grip open to find something disturbing in his hand: a Krom'gar General's insignia.$B$BTake the Krom'gar General's insignia back to High Chieftain Cliffwalker.
text.progress: He... My child is dead?

english.title: Betrayal at the Grove
english.objectives: Take the Krom'gar General's Insignia back to High Chieftain Cliffwalker at Cliffwalker Post in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: Druid corpses litter the room. Something seems amiss, as you see no signs of a struggle.  Bloody drag marks lead in from the doorway.$B$BYou pry Orthus' death grip open to find something disturbing in his hand: a Krom'gar General's insignia.$B$BTake the Krom'gar General's insignia back to High Chieftain Cliffwalker.
english.progress: He... My child is dead?

text.title: Is This Justice?
text.objectives: Defend yourself.
text.description: He was a good boy, $N. Young, loving. He would have never killed any of the young druids. They were his friends! No... Not Orthus.$B$BThe General must be called to answer for this crime. I will have justice!
text.completion: You saw with your own eyes, $n. General Grebo attacked us! Now what will we do? Surely the Warchief will have us all executed for treason.
text.completed: Speak with Masha Cliffwalker at Cliffwalker Post in Stonetalon Mountains.

english.title: Is This Justice?
english.objectives: Defend yourself.
english.description: He was a good boy, $N. Young, loving. He would have never killed any of the young druids. They were his friends! No... Not Orthus.$B$BThe General must be called to answer for this crime. I will have justice!
english.completion: You saw with your own eyes, $n. General Grebo attacked us! Now what will we do? Surely the Warchief will have us all executed for treason.
english.completed: Speak with Masha Cliffwalker at Cliffwalker Post in Stonetalon Mountains.

text.title: The General is Dead
text.objectives: Speak to Overlord Krom'gar at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.
text.description: Perhaps if you spoke to Overlord Krom'gar, $N. Maybe he would listen to what you had to say? You are a Champion in his army, after all. You saw everything. Please help us, $N. We simply wish to be left alone - in peace.$B$BTalk to Overlord Krom'gar and try to help him see that we did not mean for any of this to happen.
text.completion: WHAT? My General has been killed by the tauren? This is treason! HIGH TREASON! They will pay for this grievous error.

english.title: The General is Dead
english.objectives: Speak to Overlord Krom'gar at Krom'gar Fortress in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: Perhaps if you spoke to Overlord Krom'gar, $N. Maybe he would listen to what you had to say? You are a Champion in his army, after all. You saw everything. Please help us, $N. We simply wish to be left alone - in peace.$B$BTalk to Overlord Krom'gar and try to help him see that we did not mean for any of this to happen.
english.completion: WHAT? My General has been killed by the tauren? This is treason! HIGH TREASON! They will pay for this grievous error.

text.title: Might Makes Right
text.objectives: Meet Overlord Krom'gar at Cliffwalker Post in Stonetalon Mountains.
text.description: You have done well to report this crime. The perpetrators of this heinous act will be punished. There will be blood.$B$BI will need a new General now that Grebo is dead. You shall take his place.$B$BMeet me at Cliffwalker Post, General. Together we will end this nonsense.
text.completion: The traitorous tauren will now stand by as we destroy his precious grove and burn his village to the ground!

english.title: Might Makes Right
english.objectives: Meet Overlord Krom'gar at Cliffwalker Post in Stonetalon Mountains.
english.description: You have done well to report this crime. The perpetrators of this heinous act will be punished. There will be blood.$B$BI will need a new General now that Grebo is dead. You shall take his place.$B$BMeet me at Cliffwalker Post, General. Together we will end this nonsense.
english.completion: The traitorous tauren will now stand by as we destroy his precious grove and burn his village to the ground!

text.title: 恐斧的末日
text.objectives: 杀死铁炉堡飞行器机坪的恐斧将军。
text.description: 在你的指引下，我们重挫了黑铁矮人的突袭计划。黑铁矮人的首领恐斧将军正在南面结冰的湖泊处重新集结军队，那里就是他们的指挥中心。$B$B恐斧站在一只新研制的作战傀儡头上，对士兵们发号施令。如果他成功地组织起新的军队，其兵力很可能会超过我们。你必须阻止他，$N。摧毁他的傀儡守卫，然后杀死恐斧将军。他是我们获胜的关键人物。
text.completion: We've done it! Without your help, Ironforge Airfield would surely be occupied by the enemy and the Dark Irons would have a clear road to Ironforge itself. The Council of Three Hammers must be informed of what happened here.
text.completed: Return to Commander Stonebreaker at Ironforge Airfield.

english.title: Grimaxe's Demise
english.objectives: Kill General Grimaxe at the Ironforge Airfield.
english.description: With you leading the way, we've finally broken the momentum of the Dark Iron attack. General Grimaxe, the Dark Iron leader, is attempting to rally his troops from the center of their lines on the frozen lake to the south.$B$BHe stands atop one of their new dark iron golems, shouting orders to his men. If he succeeds in rallying them, they may still be able to overpower us. You must prevent that, $N. Destroy the golem guarding him, then kill General Grimaxe himself. He is the key to our victory.
english.completion: We've done it! Without your help, Ironforge Airfield would surely be occupied by the enemy and the Dark Irons would have a clear road to Ironforge itself. The Council of Three Hammers must be informed of what happened here.
english.completed: Return to Commander Stonebreaker at Ironforge Airfield.

text.title: 生物燃料
text.objectives: 前往库图恩之末，对画笔海岭潜水龟、亮腹鮣魚和脊鳞锤头鲨的尸体使用油脂吸收泵，收集4份龟油、4份鮣魚油和4份锤头鲨鱼油。
text.description: 潜水艇燃料是很贵的！$B$B诺莫瑞根的有关部门非常慷慨，给我们送来了好几桶燃料，但我们消耗的速度比预期的更快。也就是说，我们需要赶紧补充燃料储备。$B$B众所周知，海洋生物富含各种乱七八糟的化学成分……比如油。把这件设备拿到库图恩之末去，从海龟、鮣魚、锤头鲨之类的海洋生物尸体上提取油料。如果潜水艇燃料补给跟不上，它们的油就是我们唯一的希望了。
text.progress: How did the device work, $n?
text.completion: Yes, I think this will do.
text.completed: Return to Engineer Hexascrub at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Bio-Fuel
english.objectives: Use the Oil Extrusion Pump on the corpses of Seabrush Terrapins, Scourgut Remoras, and Spinescale Hammerheads in Kothrun's End to obtain 4 Terrapin Oil, 4 Remora Oil, and 4 Hammerhead Oil.
english.description: Submarine fuel is expensive!$b$bThe powers-that-be in Gnomeregan were generous enough to deliver several fuel barrels, but we're burning through it faster than expected.  That means we're going to need to improvise.$b$bIt's a well-known fact that sea creatures are full of all kinds of interesting chemicals... like oil.  Take this device up to Kothrun's End and stick it into the corpses of terrapins, remoras, and hammerhead sharks.  If we don't get more submarine fuel, their oil might be our only hope.
english.progress: How did the device work, $n?
english.completion: Yes, I think this will do.
english.completed: Return to Engineer Hexascrub at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 海中的邻居
text.objectives: 在库图恩之末台柱顶端的海藻丛附近使用海马套索，捕获5只惊慌的海马。
text.description: 祝你好运。$B$B援军已经到了，他们还带来了食物和坐骑。可是我们的坐骑完全不能下水啊。$B$B洞穴正上方的高柱顶端生长着红色的海藻。海马就藏身在那些海藻丛中。抛出套索，捕获一些海底坐骑来。
text.completed: Return to Captain Glovaal at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Our Aquatic Neigh-Bors
english.objectives: Use the Seahorse Lasso near the kelp atop the pillars in Korthun's End to capture 5 Panicked Seahorses.
english.description: Good fortune to you, comrade.$b$bThe reinforcements are here, and they are bringink food, and men, and fresh mounts.  The problem is that our mounts are highly immobile when placed under the water.$b$bDirectly above this cave, you vill find tall pillars with red, leafy kelp on their tops.  Seahorses hide in the kelp.  Throw this lasso into the kelp and catch us some mounts for usink in the water.
english.completed: Return to Captain Glovaal at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 保卫库图恩之末
text.objectives: 在库图恩之末杀死7名地狱咆哮水兵。
text.description: 部落在这一区域部署了间谍？附近就是驱暗海窟，里面停泊着扳钳X2号！绝对不能让部落接近它！$B$B得把部落入侵这事告诉洞穴里的某人……等你干掉那些肮脏的部落间谍之后就去报告一下吧。
text.completion: You did well, $n.  We need to be especially wary of Horde attacks right now.  The Pincer X2 has plenty of firepower at sea, but in the back of this cave, she is exceptionally vulnerable.
text.completed: Report to Jorlan Trueblade at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Claim Korthun's End
english.objectives: Kill 7 Hellscream Seadogs in Korthun's End.
english.description: The Horde has spies in this area?  Darkbreak Cove is nearby, and inside lies the Pincer X2!  The Horde must not be allowed anywhere nearby!$b$bSomeone in Darkbreak Cove will want to hear of this... after you finish slaying some more of these dirty Horde spies.
english.completion: You did well, $n.  We need to be especially wary of Horde attacks right now.  The Pincer X2 has plenty of firepower at sea, but in the back of this cave, she is exceptionally vulnerable.
english.completed: Report to Jorlan Trueblade at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 初级燃料学
text.objectives: 使用驱暗海窟的燃料采样站制造完美的生物燃料。
text.description: 你对燃料学了解多少呢，$N？要制造出完美的燃料是相当费神的，有很多因素要平衡：过氧化态参数、混合燃烧变量以及速燃标准……只是随便举些例子。$B$B希望你取回的样本可以以适当的比例混合，制造出……完美的生物燃料。使用那边的台子，试着做出一些样品来！完成任务后告诉我结果。
text.completion: Have you considered a career in science, $n?  If you ever get tired of this $c nonsense, come see me!  I could use an assistant with your devotion to experimentation and the scientific method.
text.completed: Return to Engineer Hexascrub at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Fuel-ology 101
english.objectives: Use the Fuel Sampling Station in Darkbreak Cove to create the perfect bio-fuel.
english.description: How much do you know about fuel, $N?  Constructing the perfect fuel is a tricky job, as there's plenty of factors to balance: chrono-pyroxidation parameters, tempero-incendiary variables, conflagrational siltification criteria... and that's only naming a few.$b$bHopefully the samples you brought me can be combined in the right proportions to create... the perfect bio-fuel.  Use that table over there and try combining some samples!  Bring the result to me when you're done.
english.completion: Have you considered a career in science, $n?  If you ever get tired of this $c nonsense, come see me!  I could use an assistant with your devotion to experimentation and the scientific method.
english.completed: Return to Engineer Hexascrub at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

text.title: 振奋精神
text.objectives: 从高地阔步龙和高地长尾龙身上取得10个高地迅猛龙的眼球。
text.description: 我们族人的萨满祝福令我从多年的沮丧中苏醒了过来。如今我为所有人提供祝福，将赋予我的新生力量同样赐福给他们。$B$B高地迅猛龙是一种狡诈而凶猛的野兽。它们的精神可以给予战士们无比的力量。给我带些迅猛龙的眼球来，我好按照托尔甘传授的方法制作一些护符。
text.progress: The fierceness in the eyes of the raptors will be matched by those of our warriors.
text.completion: The lethargy that overcame me even after the camps fell was so strong, I refused this gift when it was first given to me. Now, I am proud to do my part in the name of the Horde.
text.completed: Return to Gor'mul at Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: Raising Spirits
english.objectives: Collect 10 Highland Raptor Eyes from Highland Striders or Highland Thrashers.
english.description: Our race's gift of shamanism stirred me from a years-long lethargy. Now I provide for all here, crafting the same boons that gave me newfound strength.$B$BThe Highland raptors are cunning and fierce beasts. Their spirits can grant our warriors great strength. Bring me raptor eyes, so I may make the amulets as Tor'gan taught me.
english.progress: The fierceness in the eyes of the raptors will be matched by those of our warriors.
english.completion: The lethargy that overcame me even after the camps fell was so strong, I refused this gift when it was first given to me. Now, I am proud to do my part in the name of the Horde.
english.completed: Return to Gor'mul at Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 迅猛龙的狡诈
text.objectives: 从高地猎兽龙身上获取12颗迅猛龙的心脏。
text.description: 南部的高地猎兽龙比其同类要更为凶猛。它们不仅力量过人，也狡诈非凡。$B$B当我沉浸在昏聩中时，即便是力量护符我也不为所动。但托尔甘用猎兽龙的心脏激起了我的精神，打消了我的疑虑，解放了我的心灵。$B$B我们的战士应该也拥有迅猛龙的狡诈。去帮我收集一些猎兽龙的心脏来，$N。
text.progress: My preparations are made, all I need are the raptor hearts.
text.completion: As Tor'gan taught me, I transfer the power and the spirit of the raptors into this orb. It will imbue our warriors with the fiery strength and intelligence of the raptor. The guile of the raptor is yours now as well, $c. Take it with pride, for the Horde!
text.completed: Return to Gor'mul at Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: Guile of the Raptor
english.objectives: Collect 12 Raptor Hearts from Highland Fleshstalkers.
english.description: The highland fleshstalkers to the south are even fiercer than the others of their kind. They possess not just strength, but true cunning.$B$BWhen I was trapped by lethargy, even the amulets of strength failed to move me. But Tor'gan used the hearts of the fleshstalkers to imbue me with spirits that conquered my doubt, freeing me.$B$BOur soldiers deserve the guile of the raptor. Collect the fleshstalker hearts for me, $n.
english.progress: My preparations are made, all I need are the raptor hearts.
english.completion: As Tor'gan taught me, I transfer the power and the spirit of the raptors into this orb. It will imbue our warriors with the fiery strength and intelligence of the raptor. The guile of the raptor is yours now as well, $c. Take it with pride, for the Horde!
english.completed: Return to Gor'mul at Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 法迪尔海湾
text.objectives: 跟阿拉希高地法迪尔海湾的奥布里船长谈一谈。
text.description: 鲁鲁看见了一个小$R！鲁鲁总是待在哨所上！$B$B欢迎来到法迪尔海湾。奥布里船长说过，我们在这里待不了多久。我们只要搜集宝藏然后返回藏宝海湾就行了。$B$B但是鲁鲁认为我们要在这儿待很长很长的时间，我们失去了两艘船。可怜的银松之魂号和处女号！她们长眠在海底！$B$B鲁鲁说，如果你想在这逗留的话，就去和奥布里船长谈谈吧。

english.title: Land Ho!
english.objectives: Talk to Captain O'Breen at Faldir's Cove in Arathi Highlands.
english.description: Lolo sees a tiny $r! Always on the lookout, Lolo is!$b$bWelcome to Faldir's Cove.  Captain O'Breen said we'd only be here for a few hours.  Just long enough to gather the treasure and get back to Booty Bay.$b$bBut Lolo thinks we're going to be here a lot longer than that.  We lost the other two ships from our formation.  Poor Spirit of Silverpine and Maiden's Folly.  On the bottom of the sea they rest now!$b$bLolo suggests you talk to Captain O'Breen if you plan on sticking around here.

text.title: 就像以前
text.objectives: 从被遗忘者信使身上拿到密封的信件。
text.description: It's funny. Kin and I have been through so much together, and here we find ourselves back in Arathi, like so many years ago.$B$BWe broke up a plot to create a new plague right here, her and I. It doesn't look like the horde learned their lesson, because they're all over this farm yet again.$B$BTheir undead courier is shuffling around as obvious as daylight. If you want to help, find the courier and bring back whatever they're carrying.
text.progress: 感谢你帮我们找到了那个信差，$N。$B$B你走了以後，基恩洛看见有一个药剂师走出那间房子朝南边去了。我确信他们不会是在做什麽好事─但是我可不想草率行动，所以首先，我们得有一些确切的证据。$B$B怎麽样，你要不要帮忙?
text.completion: Apothecaries yet again. You think they'd get the message. Let's see what it is this time...
text.completed: Return to Quae at the Go'shek Farm in Arathi Highlands.
text.giverWindow: Find her on the road.

english.title: Just Like Old Times
english.objectives: Collect the Sealed Folder from the Forsaken Courier.
english.description: It's funny. Kin and I have been through so much together, and here we find ourselves back in Arathi, like so many years ago.$B$BWe broke up a plot to create a new plague right here, her and I. It doesn't look like the horde learned their lesson, because they're all over this farm yet again.$B$BTheir undead courier is shuffling around as obvious as daylight. If you want to help, find the courier and bring back whatever they're carrying.
english.progress: We appreciate your help in looking for that courier, $N.$B$BWhile you were gone, Kin saw an apothecary come out of that same house to the south of here. I'm confident that they're up to no good--I just need proof of it before we go off and do something rash.$B$BHave you had any luck yet?
english.completion: Apothecaries yet again. You think they'd get the message. Let's see what it is this time...
english.completed: Return to Quae at the Go'shek Farm in Arathi Highlands.
english.giverWindow: Find her on the road.

text.title: ……它会现身的
text.objectives: 取得不可估量者的触须。
text.description: 现在，我要将腐蚀无面者的能量注入你的体内。$B$B游往插在东北方海沟里的引诱图腾。通过它释放出你体内的能量。将无面者首领的触须取回来。$B$B召唤不可估量者埃库塞斯吧……它会现身的。
text.progress: Do you have it, $N?$B$BWith the Unfathomable's brain, we still may yet be able to communicate with L'ghorek, the dying ancient one in front of us.
text.completion: And now we will see if we can get you into L'ghorek to speak with it before it dies.
text.completed: Return to Erunak Stonespeaker atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.
text.giverWindow: You need its brain!

english.title: ... It Will Come
english.objectives: Obtain the Brain of the Unfathomable.
english.description: I now imbue you with the energies of the corrupting faceless.$B$BSwim down to my luring totem in the trench to the northeast. Release the energies through it. Bring back the brain of their leader.$B$BCall forth to Ick'thys the Unfathomable... it will come!
english.progress: Do you have it, $N?$B$BWith the Unfathomable's brain, we still may yet be able to communicate with L'ghorek, the dying ancient one in front of us.
english.completion: And now we will see if we can get you into L'ghorek to speak with it before it dies.
english.completed: Return to Erunak Stonespeaker atop Promontory Point in Vashj'ir.
english.giverWindow: You need its brain!

text.title: 寻求答案
text.objectives: 将碎石的报告交给铁炉堡王座厅的茉艾拉·铜须。
text.description: 为什么这些黑铁战士会跑来铁炉堡的大门口撒野，还妄想攻击我们的主城？$B$B尊敬的三锤议会成员茉艾拉“女皇”难道不是黑铁矮人的统治者吗？如果没有她的首肯，又怎么可能发生攻击事件呢。这帮敌人显然不是乌合之众，而是精心组织装备精良的军队啊。$B$B我准备了一份关于飞行器机坪突袭战的报告。将它带去铁炉堡的王座厅，当面质问艾茉拉！
text.progress: What is the meaning of this intrusion?
text.completion: And just what is this? This is impossible!
text.completed: 将碎石的报告交给铁炉堡王座厅的茉艾拉·铜须。

english.title: Demanding Answers
english.objectives: Take Stonebreaker's Report to Moira Thaurissan in Ironforge's High Seat.
english.description: So just how did all those Dark Iron warriors end up here, on the doorstep of Ironforge, on the verge of invading our city?$B$BDoes not 'Empress' Moira, a member of our esteemed Council of Three Hammers, rule the Dark Iron? This cannot have happened without her knowledge and consent. This was no ragtag band of rebel dwarves, but a well-organized and fully equipped invasion force.$B$BI have prepared a report on the battle for the airfield. Take it to Ironforge, to the High Seat and confront her!
english.progress: What is the meaning of this intrusion?
english.completion: And just what is this? This is impossible!
english.completed: Take Stonebreaker's Report to Moira Thaurissan in Ironforge's High Seat.

text.title: 奎艾和基恩洛
text.objectives: 在俯瞰格沙克农场的山丘上找到奎艾。
text.description: The Horde have held Go'shek farm to the east for a long time; it's never been of much concern compared to the rest of our problems here. But there's been reports of undead activity in the area.$B$BAnything more alarming than shuffling peons over there warrants investigation. This isn't the first time the undead have been up to no good at the farm, so I've sent my best scouts there to check it out. Report to Quae and Kinelory and they'll fill you in.
text.completion: Refuge Pointe sent you? Good to know they're still there. We've got some interesting things to check into here, $c.

english.title: Quae and Kinelory
english.objectives: Find Quae on the hill overlooking Go'shek Farm.
english.description: The Horde have held Go'shek farm to the east for a long time; it's never been of much concern compared to the rest of our problems here. But there's been reports of undead activity in the area.$B$BAnything more alarming than shuffling peons over there warrants investigation. This isn't the first time the undead have been up to no good at the farm, so I've sent my best scouts there to check it out. Report to Quae and Kinelory and they'll fill you in.
english.completion: Refuge Pointe sent you? Good to know they're still there. We've got some interesting things to check into here, $c.

text.title: 奎艾信任你
text.objectives: 跟阿拉希高地格沙克农场的基恩洛谈一谈。
text.description: <奎艾开始通读信件。>$B$B扩张……控制领土……这些亡灵还是老一套，不过他们打算侵吞的是阿拉希。咱们得粉碎他们的计划。$B$B我在这里把守，你和阿基去，拿到那些入侵计划。我们不能让那些行尸知道日子。$B$B记得保护她的安全，你听见了吗？
text.completion: The plague took our friends and family, but it was the Forsaken that took Phin. They're just as bad as the Scourge. I'll destroy every one of them with my own hands if I have to. When you're prepared, come let me know. We'll get started right away.

english.title: Quae Trusts You
english.objectives: Speak to Kinelory near Go'Shek Farm in Arathi Highlands.
english.description: <Quae begins to go through the folder.>$B$BExpansion...control of territory... these undead aren't cooking up anything new, but they're planning to roll over all of Arathi. We need to disrupt their plans.$B$BI'll keep a lookout from up here. You go with Kin, and get those invasion plans. We're not going to let these walking corpses even know what day it is out here.$B$BAnd keep her safe, you hear me?
english.completion: The plague took our friends and family, but it was the Forsaken that took Phin. They're just as bad as the Scourge. I'll destroy every one of them with my own hands if I have to. When you're prepared, come let me know. We'll get started right away.

text.title: To Be Horde...
text.objectives: Learn what it means to be Horde.
text.description: Stand by me, $N, and watch as our mighty weapon destroys our enemies!$B$BLearn what it means to be Horde!
text.completion: Now you truly know what it means to be a member of the Horde, $n.
text.completed: Speak with High Chieftain Cliffwalker at Cliffwalker Post.
text.objective1: Learn what it means to be Horde.

english.title: To Be Horde...
english.objectives: Learn what it means to be Horde.
english.description: Stand by me, $N, and watch as our mighty weapon destroys our enemies!$B$BLearn what it means to be Horde!
english.completion: Now you truly know what it means to be a member of the Horde, $n.
english.completed: Speak with High Chieftain Cliffwalker at Cliffwalker Post.
english.objective1: Learn what it means to be Horde.

text.title: 基恩洛出击
text.objectives: 保护基恩洛，直到她回到奎艾身边。
text.description: 好了，$N。我已经准备好了。$B$B可以出发了吗？
text.completion: 你帮了我们的大忙，$N，谢谢你。$B$B但愿基恩洛刚才的凶狠善战没有吓到你。她对朋友很和善，但是对於敌人，她决不会有半点怜悯之心。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Quae in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: Kinelory Strikes
english.objectives: Protect Kinelory until she returns to Quae.
english.description: All right, $N. I'm ready if you are.$B$BShall we?
english.completion: You've done a great service for us, $n. Thank you. I hope Kin wasn't too much of a handful down there. She's very friendly, but can be just as deadly when you're her enemy.
english.completed: Return to Quae in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 为了南海镇
text.objectives: 去找避难谷地的阿玛伦指挥官。
text.description: 基恩洛在酒馆里待了一整晚出来时可比现在还糟。你显然出色地保护了她。$B$B避难谷地会愿意听到我们的喜讯的。我会和阿基留在这里，让她歇口气。你可以先走。
text.completion: I admit I'm impressed, $c. It's a small comfort amidst all that's happened here. You have fought the undead, struck back against the Horde, and honored the memory of the victims of Southshore. On behalf of the kingdom of Stromgarde, I present you with an official commendation, and this reward.

english.title: For Southshore
english.objectives: Return to Commander Amaren at Refuge Pointe.
english.description: I've seen Kinelory look way worse after a night in the tavern than she does now. You obviously did a good job protecting her.$B$BRefuge Pointe will want to know of our success. I'm going to stay here with Kin and let her catch her breath. Go on ahead without us.
english.completion: I admit I'm impressed, $c. It's a small comfort amidst all that's happened here. You have fought the undead, struck back against the Horde, and honored the memory of the victims of Southshore. On behalf of the kingdom of Stromgarde, I present you with an official commendation, and this reward.

text.title: 逮捕大使
text.objectives: 找到黑铁大使馆，使用坚实的镣铐逮捕熔锤大使。
text.description: 大使的背叛行为令我难以释怀。你必须逮捕他，否则他会制造更大的麻烦，甚至可能逃离铁炉堡并策划下一场进攻行动。有熔锤大使在的一天，铁炉堡就不安全。$B$B带上这些镣铐，找到黑铁大使馆。就在王座厅以北，大熔炉旁边。逮捕熔锤大使，带他来见我。
text.completion: The ambassador will trouble us no more. He is not the only Dark Iron $r whose heart still belongs to Twilight's Hammer. We must remember that and remain vigilant against their schemes, else my son will inherit only ruins and ashes.
text.end: Arrest Ambassador Slaghammer and bring him to the High Seat
text.completed: Return to Moira Bronzebeard at the High Seat in Ironforge.

english.title: Seize the Ambassador
english.objectives: Go to the Dark Iron Embassy and use the Sturdy Manacles to arrest Ambassador Slaghammer.
english.description: The ambassador's betrayal will long haunt me. You must arrest him before he can do further harm, or worse, before he can escape and start planning the next attack. Ironforge is not safe with Ambassador Slaghammer free inside the city.$B$BTake these manacles and go to the Dark Iron embassy. It's just to the north of the High Seat, around the rim of the Great Forge. Arrest Ambassador Slaghammer and return with him.
english.completion: The ambassador will trouble us no more. He is not the only Dark Iron $r whose heart still belongs to Twilight's Hammer. We must remember that and remain vigilant against their schemes, else my son will inherit only ruins and ashes.
english.end: Arrest Ambassador Slaghammer and bring him to the High Seat
english.completed: Return to Moira Bronzebeard at the High Seat in Ironforge.

text.title: 疯狂的龙喉
text.objectives: 杀死12名龙喉偷猎者。
text.description: 附近的龙喉兽人变得越来越烦人了。他们对林子发动的自杀性攻击无关痛痒，正好给我们的哨兵提供必要的训练。$B$B然而我的斥候发现他们在用网子抓捕黑龙幼崽。这块土地也不允许残忍的驯龙活动再度冒头。打到东边去，$C，打倒那些偷猎者，确保他们的愚行得以制止。
text.completion: The orcs will know better than to press further west now. Well done.
text.completed: Return to Huntress Iczelia at Greenwarden's Grove in Wetlands.

english.title: The Crazed Dragonmaw
english.objectives: Kill 12 Dragonmaw Whelpstealers.
english.description: The Dragonmaw orcs nearby are fast becoming a nuisance. Their suicidal attacks on the grove are merely annoying, though they provide my sentinels with some needed practice.$B$BMy scouts, however, have seen them rounding up black dragon whelps in nets. The last thing these lands need is a crude revival of dragon-taming. Strike out to the east, $c, and cut down the whelpstealers; make sure their folly does not come back to haunt us later.
english.completion: The orcs will know better than to press further west now. Well done.
english.completed: Return to Huntress Iczelia at Greenwarden's Grove in Wetlands.

text.title: 保卫库图恩之末
text.objectives: 在库图恩之末杀死7名地狱咆哮水兵。
text.description: 你在上面看到了间谍？这可真不妙……非常糟糕，同志。$B$B回到库图恩之末去干掉他们吧，我的朋友。
text.completion: You did well, $n.  We need to be especially wary of Horde attacks right now.  The Pincer X2 has plenty of firepower at sea, but in the back of this cave, she is exceptionally vulnerable.
text.completed: Report to Jorlan Trueblade at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

english.title: Claim Korthun's End
english.objectives: Kill 7 Hellscream Seadogs in Korthun's End.
english.description: You are seeink spies up above?  This is not good... not good at all, comrade.$b$bReturn to Korthun's End and destroy them, my friend.
english.completion: You did well, $n.  We need to be especially wary of Horde attacks right now.  The Pincer X2 has plenty of firepower at sea, but in the back of this cave, she is exceptionally vulnerable.
english.completed: Report to Jorlan Trueblade at Darkbreak Cove in Vashj'ir.

text.title: Environmental Awareness
text.objectives: Use the Oil Extrusion Pump on the corpses of Seabrush Terrapins, Scourgut Remoras, and Spinescale Hammerheads in Seabrush to obtain 4 Terrapin Oil, 4 Remora Oil, and 4 Hammerhead Oil.
text.description: Have you ever smelled submarine fuel, $N?  It's nasty stuff.  Unfortunately, we need to burn huge amounts of it to get the Verne to move, and it's both bad-smelling AND deadly to the local wildlife.  We need to be more environmentally conscious.$b$bThe sea creatures nearby have particularly oily flesh.  Take this device up to Seabrush - just above this cave - and use it on the corpses of terrapins, remoras, and hammerhead sharks.  Their oil might save the lives of hundreds of other sea creatures.
text.progress: Please... don't tell the other goblins that I'm an environmentalist!  I don't think I can take the mocking!
text.completion: <Fiasco sticks a finger into each sample and sniffs it.>$b$bYes, I think this will do.
text.completed: Return to Fiasco Sizzlegrin at Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.

text.title: When in Vashj'ir...
text.objectives: Use the Seahorse Lasso near the kelp atop the pillars in Seabrush to capture 5 Panicked Seahorses.
text.description: Welcome, friend!$b$bReinforcements have arrived, and they've brought food, orcs, and fresh mounts.  Wait a minute... mounts?!$b$bHow are we supposed to get around underwater on WOLFBACK?!$b$b<Captain Verne sighs.>$b$bDirectly above this cave, in Seabrush, you will find tall pillars with red, leafy kelp on their tops.  Seahorses hide in the kelp.  Throw this lasso into the kelp and catch us some USEFUL mounts.
text.completed: Return to Captain "Jewels" Verne at Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.

english.title: When in Vashj'ir...
english.objectives: Use the Seahorse Lasso near the kelp atop the pillars in Seabrush to capture 5 Panicked Seahorses.
english.description: Welcome, friend!$b$bReinforcements have arrived, and they've brought food, orcs, and fresh mounts.  Wait a minute... mounts?!$b$bHow are we supposed to get around underwater on WOLFBACK?!$b$b<Captain Verne sighs.>$b$bDirectly above this cave, in Seabrush, you will find tall pillars with red, leafy kelp on their tops.  Seahorses hide in the kelp.  Throw this lasso into the kelp and catch us some USEFUL mounts.
english.completed: Return to Captain "Jewels" Verne at Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.

text.title: Secure Seabrush
text.objectives: Kill 7 Alliance Sea-Scouts in Seabrush.
text.description: The Alliance has spies in this area?  Tenebrous Cavern is nearby, and inside lies the Horde's new submarine, the Verne!  The Alliance must not be allowed anywhere nearby!$b$bSomeone in the cavern will want to hear of this incursion... after you finish slaying some more of these scheming Alliance spies.
text.completion: You did well, $n.  We need to be especially wary of Alliance attacks right now.  The Verne's got plenty of firepower out at sea, but in the back of this cave, she's far too vulnerable.
text.completed: Report to Bloodguard Toldrek at Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.

text.objectives: Kill 7 Alliance Sea-Scouts in Seabrush.
text.description: You saw spies up above?  This is not good... I won't have it.$b$bReturn to Seabrush and get rid of them before they start trickling into our hideout.
text.completion: You did well, $n.  We need to be especially wary of Alliance attacks right now.  The Verne's got plenty of firepower out at sea, but in the back of this cave, she's far too vulnerable.
text.completed: Report to Bloodguard Toldrek at Tenebrous Cavern in Vashj'ir.
