text.title: 孤儿也喜欢点心！
text.objectives: 收集4袋精制细砂糖，把它们交给暴风城的罗比·弗雷。
text.description: 暴风城的孤儿们常常被人遗忘，但今天不同了，我的朋友。国王特别要求我们制作一些点心，然后尽快给孤儿院送去。最后一批点心就快要做好了，但不巧的是精制细砂糖正好用光了。你能去帮我弄一些回来吗？暴风城里所有的杂货店和旅店都有出售。
text.progress: Were you able to find the Confectioner's Sugar?
text.completion: These sacks look like just enough, $n.  Can't wait to see the smiles on the orphans faces.
text.completed: Return to Robby Flay in Stormwind City.

english.title: Orphans Like Cookies Too!
english.objectives: Obtain 4 sacks of Confectioners' Sugar.  Deliver the sugar to Robby Flay in Stormwind City.
english.description: The orphans of Stormwind are often forgotten, but not today my friend.  The king has requested a special batch of cookies be baked and sent immediately over to the orphanage.  I was almost finished with the final batch when I ran out of confectioners' sugar.  Can you run out and get some more for me?  You should be able to find it at any of the general stores or inns inside of Stormwind.
english.progress: Were you able to find the Confectioner's Sugar?
english.completion: These sacks look like just enough, $n.  Can't wait to see the smiles on the orphans faces.
english.completed: Return to Robby Flay in Stormwind City.

text.title: 保卫深渊裂口
text.objectives: Speak to Erunak in Darkbreak Cove to enter the battle for the Abyssal Breach.
text.description: The whispers of the elements are crowding my thoughts, $n...$b$bThe Throne of Tides is under siege!$b$bWe cannot stand idly by while the naga threaten Neptulon's realm.$b$bMake ready! With this submarine and its armaments, perhaps we can make a difference.$b$bSpeak to me when you are prepared for battle.
text.completion: NO! This is NOT over!
text.completed: Speak with Captain Taylor at the rim of the Abyssal Breach.
text.objective1: Fight in the Battle for the Abyssal Breach.

text.title: 谁来守卫绿色守卫者
text.objectives: 同湿地绿色守卫者林地的费里隆·叶生交谈。
text.description: The greenwarden was a local legend. Many thought him a myth... the plant-man, protector of the wetlands. The night elves came here just to find him, and after they succeeded they ended up settling down to the east.$B$BThey've got a whole grove over there to watch over the Greenwarden, and I've heard he's been acting up, enraged by the flooding and damage to the land.$B$BThe elves are good people. They could use the help of someone like you. If you get a chance, go tell the head druid what you've done here.
text.completion: Welcome to the Greenwarden's grove, $c. I am glad Whelgar has told you of us. If you are able to lend us your assistance, I will be most grateful.

english.title: Who Wards The Greenwarden
english.objectives: Talk to Ferilon Leafborn at Greenwarden's Grove in the Wetlands.

english.completion: Welcome to the Greenwarden's grove, $c. I am glad Whelgar has told you of us. If you are able to lend us your assistance, I will be most grateful.

text.title: 坚毅者长须
text.objectives: 将费里隆的补给包交给丹莫德的坚毅者长须。
text.description: 丹莫德的矮人日以继夜地与侵略他们故乡的黑铁矮人战斗。我们不能让哨兵们冒着性命危险去替他们战斗，但我们还是给他们送了不少补给以保证后勤。$B$B要是你力所能及的话，帮我把这包裹带给北边的坚毅者长须，他的人应该用得上。
text.progress: Aye, what've ye got for me?
text.completion: Supplies from Ferilon? Bless his heart. We're good on food, but we're runnin' out of bullets!

english.title: Longbraid the Grim
english.objectives: Take Ferilon's Care Package to Longbraid the Grim at Dun Modr.
english.description: The dwarves of Dun Modr fight day and night against the Dark Iron that have invaded their old home. While we cannot yet send our sentinels to risk their lives for them, we do send much needed supplies that they may sustain their vigil.$B$BIf you would, bring this package to Longbraid the Grim, north of here. His men must certainly need its contents.
english.progress: Aye, what've ye got for me?
english.completion: Supplies from Ferilon? Bless his heart. We're good on food, but we're runnin' out of bullets!

text.title: 诺莫瑞根的未来
text.objectives: 到新工匠镇去找贝西·冰雹。
text.description: 每帮助一个幸存者逃出饱受污染的诺莫瑞根，对我们来说都是一场胜利。诺莫瑞根的未来的希望就寄托在像你这样的$C身上。因此，我们的领袖大工匠梅卡托克组建了一支培训团队，帮助你们学习本职业的技能。$B$B贝西·冰雹将会帮助你进行训练并适应地表生活。她正在东北方那幢高大建筑物外面等着你呢。
text.completion: $n, isn't it? It's a pleasure to finally meet you. While you were getting cleaned up, Nevin's team told me about your escape from Gnomeregan.

english.title: The Future of Gnomeregan
english.objectives: Meet with Bipsi Frostflinger in New Tinkertown.
english.description: It's a victory for us every time we're able to help another survivor escape from the contaminated halls of Gnomeregan. $Cs like you will play an important part in the future of Gnomeregan. To that end, our leader, High Tinker Mekkatorque has assembled a team of trainers to help you learn your arts.$B$BBipsi Frostflinger will help oversee your training and adjustment to life on the surface. She's waiting for you outside the tall building to the northeast.
english.completion: $n, isn't it? It's a pleasure to finally meet you. While you were getting cleaned up, Nevin's team told me about your escape from Gnomeregan.

text.title: 法师的技艺
text.objectives: Speak to Bipsi Frostflinger to train Arcane Missiles. Once you've learned the spell, successfully cast Arcane Missiles twice at a Training Dummy in New Tinkertown.
text.description: I want to show you a simple technique. It will allow you to focus and channel bursts of arcane power toward an opponent.$B$BAs you grow in power, you'll learn how to add more and more missiles to each volley.$B$BFind one of the training dummies setup in the middle of town. You won't always be able to cast arcane missiles right away. First, you'll need to cast other spells at the dummy until you've created an opportunity to use arcane missiles. Try it out for yourself.
text.completion: You picked that one up quickly. I can't wait to show you some of my other favorite tricks.
text.completed: Return to Bipsi Frostflinger in New Tinkertown.

english.title: The Arts of a Mage
english.objectives: Speak to Bipsi Frostflinger to train Arcane Missiles. Once you've learned the spell, successfully cast Arcane Missiles twice at a Training Dummy in New Tinkertown.

You won't always be able to cast arcane missiles right away. First, you'll need to cast other spells at the dummy until you've created an opportunity to use arcane missiles. Try it out for yourself.
english.completion: You picked that one up quickly. I can't wait to show you some of my other favorite tricks.
english.completed: Return to Bipsi Frostflinger in New Tinkertown.

text.title: 诺莫瑞根的未来
text.objectives: 到新工匠镇去找“怪医”克斯宾。
text.description: 每帮助一个幸存者逃出饱受污染的诺莫瑞根，对我们来说都是一场胜利。诺莫瑞根的未来的希望就寄托在像你这样的$C身上。因此，我们的领袖大工匠梅卡托克组建了一支培训团队，帮助你们学习本职业的技能。$B$B“怪医”克斯宾将会帮助你进行训练并适应地表生活。她正在北边的那片建筑附近等你呢。
text.completion: It's good to meet you, $n. I'm sure your time in Gnomeregan afforded you ample opportunity to practice your arts. Things are somewhat safer here, but your talents will never go to waste.

english.title: The Future of Gnomeregan
english.objectives: Meet with "Doc" Cogspin in New Tinkertown.
english.description: It's a victory for us every time we're able to help another survivor escape from the contaminated halls of Gnomeregan. $Cs like you will play an important part in the future of Gnomeregan. To that end, our leader, High Tinker Mekkatorque, has assembled a team of trainers to help you learn your arts.$B$B"Doc" Cogspin will help oversee your training and adjustment to life on the surface. She's waiting for you near the cluster of buildings to the north.
english.completion: It's good to meet you, $n. I'm sure your time in Gnomeregan afforded you ample opportunity to practice your arts. Things are somewhat safer here, but your talents will never go to waste.

text.title: 学习暗言术
text.objectives: Speak to "Doc" Cogspin to train Flash Heal. Use Flash Heal 5 times on Wounded Infantry in New Tinkertown.
text.description: I have a simple technique I want to show you. It's pretty straightforward, but it's still one of the most useful things I know.$B$BYou can use it to heal yourself or a wounded ally very quickly. It's handy for when you need to treat someone promptly and don't have time for something more complicated.$B$BGive it a try for yourself and let me know when you think you have it mastered.
text.completion: Good work, $n. You have a natural talent for our arts.
text.completed: Return to "Doc" Cogspin in New Tinkertown.
text.objective1: Use Flash Heal on Wounded Infantry

text.title: 术士的技艺
text.objectives: Speak to Alamar Grimm and learn Immolate, then cast Immolate on a Training Dummy in New Tinkertown 5 times.
text.description: I'm not at all surprised that a warlock like you fought your way out of Gnomeregan. Few people, even among the gnomes, truly understand the nature of the power we wield.$B$BLet me show you a conjuration that I find handy. This spell, called Immolate, sets your target aflame, causing damage immediately and over time. Use it well, $N, and your enemies will come to fear you.
text.completion: As you continue to gain power, return to me and I will teach you new spells and techniques.
text.completed: Return to Alamar Grimm in New Tinkertown.

english.objectives: Speak to Alamar Grimm and learn Immolate, then cast Immolate on a Training Dummy in New Tinkertown 5 times.

text.title: 诺莫瑞根的未来
text.objectives: 到新工匠镇去找阿拉玛尔·格里姆。
text.description: 每帮助一个幸存者逃出饱受污染的诺莫瑞根，对我们来说都是一场胜利。我们需要足够多的人手，才能夺回家园，解决掉那些穴居人和受到辐射的侏儒。因此，我们的领袖，大工匠梅卡托克组建了一支培训团队，帮助你们学习本职业的……呃，“技能”。$B$B阿拉玛尔·格里姆就住在西边的建筑物里，他拥有和你相似的力量，可以帮助你适应地表生活。
text.completion: So, another one of Nevin's "rescued" survivors, eh? More than likely, you saved his life from the troggs down there. Did he stumble over his words when he mentioned me? The man has a healthy respect for the demonic powers we channel.

english.title: The Future of Gnomeregan
english.objectives: Meet with Alamar Grimm in New Tinkertown.
english.description: It's a victory for us every time we're able to help another survivor escape from the contaminated halls of Gnomeregan. We're going to need all the help we can get to reclaim our home and rid ourselves of the troggs and irradiated gnomes. To that end, our leader, High Tinker Mekkatorque, has assembled a team of trainers to help you learn your, uh, "arts".$B$BAlamar Grimm has taken up residence in the building just west of this one. He possesses powers similar to yours and can help you get adjusted.
english.completion: So, another one of Nevin's "rescued" survivors, eh? More than likely, you saved his life from the troggs down there. Did he stumble over his words when he mentioned me? The man has a healthy respect for the demonic powers we channel.

text.title: 诺莫瑞根的未来
text.objectives: Meet with Drill Sergeant Steamcrank in New Tinkertown.
text.description: It's a victory for us every time we're able to help another survivor escape from the contaminated halls of Gnomeregan. $Cs like you will play an important part in the future of Gnomeregan. To that end, our leader, High Tinker Mekkatorque, has assembled a team of trainers to help you learn your arts.$B$BDrill Sergeant Steamcrank will help oversee your training and adjustment to life on the surface. He's waiting for you on the small practice field across the road.
text.completion: For a $r who has spent so much time inside Gnomeregan, you look positively fit and healthy, $n. That's good. Before we can complete what Operation: Gnomeregan began, we're going to need more warriors like you.

text.title: 战士的技艺
text.objectives: Speak to Drill Sergeant Steamcrank to learn Charge. Locate a Training Dummy in New Tinkertown and use Charge on it.
text.description: I want to show you a simple but useful technique.$B$BAs I tell all my recruits, a warrior who strikes first can use that momentum to gain the upper hand. This is a technique to use from a distance, before engaging your opponent. It will allow you to charge in, taking your enemy by surprise and stunning him.$B$BTry it out. Let me know when you think you've mastered it.
text.completion: Good work! Keep practicing your charge and you'll have an instant advantage at the start of battle.
text.completed: Return to Drill Sergeant Steamcrank in New Tinkertown.

english.objectives: Speak to Drill Sergeant Steamcrank to learn Charge. Locate a Training Dummy in New Tinkertown and use Charge on it.

text.title: 多功能机器人的工作
text.objectives: 用GS-9x多功能机器人清理剧毒机场的5处剧毒喷泉。当你距离喷泉足够近的时候，你的GS-9x多功能机器人会自动开始工作。
text.description: 如果多功能机器人管用，它就可以替我们做所有侏儒不高兴去做或是觉得危险的事情！$B$B瑟玛普拉格在诺莫瑞根行动最后引爆辐射器之后，毒云和软泥怪就开始在镇子南边的旧机场里滋生。$B$B如果我们不把局面控制住，污染就有可能会蔓延到其他地方去。带上这多功能机器人，把它领到剧毒机场绿色池子里的喷泉旁边。你的机器人会自动工作的！
text.completion: Wow, I never expected it to work on the first trial! Uh, I mean, we've succeeded! I wonder what other uses I we can find for this handy little guy.
text.completed: Return to Engineer Grindspark in New Tinkertown.

english.title: A Job for the Multi-Bot
english.objectives: Use the GS-9x Multi-Bot to clean up 5 Toxic Geysers at the Toxic Airfield. When you get close enough to a geyser, your GS-9x Multi-Bot will automatically begin its task.
english.description: If the multi-bot works, it will help us do all kinds of jobs that are unpleasant or dangerous for us gnomes!$B$BAfter Thermaplugg detonated his irradiator at the end of Operation: Gnomeregan, toxic clouds and ooze began bubbling up at the old airfield south of town.$B$BIf we don't get it under control, the contamination could spread to the rest of our lands. Take the multi-bot with you, and bring it close to the geysers in the green pools at the Toxic Airfield. Your bot should spring into action!
english.completion: Wow, I never expected it to work on the first trial! Uh, I mean, we've succeeded! I wonder what other uses I we can find for this handy little guy.
english.completed: Return to Engineer Grindspark in New Tinkertown.

text.title: 诺莫瑞根的未来
text.objectives: 到新工匠镇去找凯尔希·钢烁。
text.description: 每帮助一个幸存者逃出饱受污染的诺莫瑞根，对我们来说都是一场胜利。诺莫瑞根的未来的希望就寄托在像你这样的$C身上。因此，我们的领袖大工匠梅卡托克组建了一支培训团队，帮助你们学习本职业的技能。$B$B凯尔希·钢烁是诺莫瑞根秘密行动部的要员，她将会帮助你进行训练并适应地表生活。她应该就在西北方的会议营帐里。
text.completion: It's good to meet you, $n. Nevin tells me that you managed to survive the dangers in Gnomeregan by using your wits. That's exactly what we need up here. Clever minds and quick blades.

english.title: The Future of Gnomeregan
english.objectives: Meet with Kelsey Steelspark in New Tinkertown.
english.description: It's a victory for us every time we're able to help another survivor escape from the contaminated halls of Gnomeregan. $Cs like you will play an important part in the future of Gnomeregan. To that end, our leader, High Tinker Mekkatorque, has assembled a team of trainers to help you learn your arts.$B$BKelsey Steelspark, a key member of Gnomeregan Covert Ops, will help oversee your training and adjustment to life on the surface. She should be in the council tent to the northwest.
english.completion: It's good to meet you, $n. Nevin tells me that you managed to survive the dangers in Gnomeregan by using your wits. That's exactly what we need up here. Clever minds and quick blades.

text.title: 潜行者的技艺
text.objectives: Speak to Kelsey Steelspark to learn Eviscerate, then find a training dummy in New Tinkertown and practice using Eviscerate 3 times.
text.description: I have a technique I want to show you.$B$BOne of a rogue's most potent abilities is to chain together moves in a combination, exploiting your enemy's weakness and opening up the opportunity to use stronger maneuvers. The technique I want to teach you is called Eviscerate. It is intended for use at the end of a combination to provide a strong finish to your assault.$B$BTry using it after a landing a couple of Sinister Strikes.
text.completion: I'm not surprised to see you're such a quick study. I look forward to showing you more of our tricks of the trade.
text.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark in New Tinkertown.

english.title: The Arts of a Rogue
english.objectives: Speak to Kelsey Steelspark to learn Eviscerate, then find a training dummy in New Tinkertown and practice using Eviscerate 3 times.
english.description: I have a technique I want to show you.$B$BOne of a rogue's most potent abilities is to chain together moves in a combination, exploiting your enemy's weakness and opening up the opportunity to use stronger maneuvers. The technique I want to teach you is called Eviscerate. It is intended for use at the end of a combination to provide a strong finish to your assault.$B$BTry using it after a landing a couple of Sinister Strikes.
english.completion: I'm not surprised to see you're such a quick study. I look forward to showing you more of our tricks of the trade.
english.completed: Return to Kelsey Steelspark in New Tinkertown.

text.title: 战斗继续
text.objectives: 观看大工匠梅卡托克前面的全息桌面，了解诺莫瑞根行动的内容。
text.description: 当初穴居人入侵，辐射把我们从诺莫瑞根赶出来的时候，铁炉堡的矮人好心地收留了我们。但是朋友的善心并不能填补对家园的渴望。$B$B我发出召集令，呼吁勇敢的侏儒和其他联盟成员帮助我们重新控制诺莫瑞根，彻底打败篡位的瑟玛普拉格。$B$B我们不可能完成诺莫瑞根行动所设下的所有目标，但如今瑟玛普拉格在逃，我们离家又近了一步。
text.completion: Even now, only the S.A.F.E. teams dare to venture far into the city to search for survivors. Meanwhile, Thermaplugg has sent one of his followers, Crushcog, to distract us and buy time for him to dig in.
text.completed: Speak to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown.

english.title: The Fight Continues
english.objectives: Watch the holo-table in front of High Tinker Mekkatorque to learn about Operation: Gnomeregan.
english.description: The dwarves of Ironforge kindly took us in when the trogg invasion and radiation forced us to leave Gnomeregan for the first time. But even the kindness of friends can't quell the longing for home.$B$BI sent out a call for brave gnomes and other members of the Alliance to help us regain control of Gnomeregan and defeat the usurper Thermaplugg once and for all.$B$BWe weren't able to achieve everything Operation: Gnomeregan set out to do, but Thermaplugg is on the run and we're closer to home than ever.
english.completion: Even now, only the S.A.F.E. teams dare to venture far into the city to search for survivors. Meanwhile, Thermaplugg has sent one of his followers, Crushcog, to distract us and buy time for him to dig in.
english.completed: Speak to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown.

text.title: 他们把谋杀案撂我这儿了
text.objectives: 同贾森农场的多名无家可归者交谈，收集法布隆谋杀案的线索。
text.description: 这么说吧，孩子，我们手头上的是灭门的案子。双重谋杀……一宗……杀马案。$B$B更糟的是，我们这是在西部荒野。我闭着眼睛扔颗石子都能砸到一打想要干掉他们（还有马）、动机充分的流浪汉。$B$B我不知道是谁干的，而且我确信来这鬼地方调查几个钉子户的凶杀案不是什么肥差，但要是找不到案犯我就得下课。你想帮忙吗？去找那些无家可归的……盲流谈谈，他们什么都知道。
text.progress: Anything yet?
text.completion: Gnolls and murlocs? Horse poopy, pal! Gnolls and murlocs didn't kill these people. I've seen what gnolls and murlocs do to people that they kill and this... isn't it. Too pretty. Too... perfect. Furthermore, the Furlbrow's had been squatting on this farm for 5 years. No, whoever wiped them out had a reason. This is murder, plain and simple and we're gonna get to the bottom of it...
text.completed: Return to Lieutenant Horatio Laine at the Jansen Stead in Westfall.$B$B

english.title: Murder Was The Case That They Gave Me
english.objectives: Speak to the various homeless people occupying the Jansen Stead to gather clues about the Furlbrow murders.
english.description: Here's the deal, kid, we've got a full-blown murder on our hands. Double homicide... Single horse... icide.$B$BWorse yet, we're in Westfall. I could throw a rock behind me and hit a dozen hobos with motive enough to want to wipe these people (and horse) out.$B$BNow I don't know who did this and I sure don't appreciate having to come to this dump to investigate the deaths of a couple of squatters, but I'll be damned if I don't find the perp. You want to help? Go talk to some bums. The hobo... knows.
english.progress: Anything yet?
english.completion: Gnolls and murlocs? Horse poopy, pal! Gnolls and murlocs didn't kill these people. I've seen what gnolls and murlocs do to people that they kill and this... isn't it. Too pretty. Too... perfect. Furthermore, the Furlbrow's had been squatting on this farm for 5 years. No, whoever wiped them out had a reason. This is murder, plain and simple and we're gonna get to the bottom of it...
english.completed: Return to Lieutenant Horatio Laine at the Jansen Stead in Westfall.$B$B

text.title: 加莫里塔！
text.objectives: 辛特兰恶齿村的钓鱼者卡图姆要你去杀掉加莫里塔，并从它的尸体上找到卡图姆的超级鱼饵。$B$B卡图姆说加莫里塔和其它海龟都在海岸附近活动。
text.description: 嘿，我说，这里的海边有一只特殊的乌龟，她叫加莫里塔，是那帮卑鄙的海水钳嘴龟的头儿。$B$B伙计，她偷了我最好的鱼饵，就在我眼皮底下！而且自从那次以后，鱼儿就再也不咬我的钩了。$B$B找到加莫里塔，把我的鱼饵从她的胃里挖出来！
text.progress: 你拿到它了吗?
text.completion: 夥计!这太棒了!我现在有了最好的鱼饵，而且海水钳嘴龟的数量也下降了不少，我的钓鱼生意一定会好很多的。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in The Hinterlands.
text.giverWindow: The shelled behemoth of the shores.

english.title: Gammerita, Mon!
english.objectives: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill Gammerita and retrieve Katoom's Best Lure from her corpse.$B$BKatoom mentioned that Gammerita hangs out on the coast with the other turtles.
english.description: Yo! There be a turtle out there not like the others. She be the Gammerita, leader of the saltwater snapjaws - a downright dirty thievin' reptile.$B$BMon, she stole my best lure. Snapped it right off my line! Since then, the fish just aren't biting the same.$B$BFind Gammerita and get my lure out of her stomach.
english.progress: Did you get it yet?
english.completion: MON! This is fantastic! With my best lure and the snapjaw population down, the fish will pile up.
english.completed: Return to Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in The Hinterlands.
english.giverWindow: The shelled behemoth of the shores.

text.title: 钳嘴龟！
text.objectives: 辛特兰恶齿村的钓鱼者卡图姆要你去杀掉10只海水钳嘴龟。任务完成后再去找他。
text.description: 不要让它们的大眼睛迷惑了你，伙计！那些海水钳嘴龟真是个麻烦。我钓鱼都不能安宁五分钟，那些巨型鱼罐头就会把我的鱼饵给偷吃掉。$B$B帮恶齿巨魔一个忙吧，干掉它们，伙计。$B$B把它们都干掉！
text.completion: 哦，夥计!我对你感激不尽!希望你喜欢这柄钓鱼竿。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Snapjaws, Mon!
english.objectives: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 10 Saltwater Snapjaw turtles. Return to him when you have completed this task.
english.description: Don't let their big eyes fool you, mon! Those saltwater snapjaws be a menace. I can't fish for five minutes without getting a broken line from one of those oversized fish vacuums stealing my bait.$B$BDo me and the people of Revantusk Village a service and kill em, mon.$B$BKill the whole lot of em!
english.completion: Oh, mon! I can't thank you enough! Hopefully this here fishing pole will be reward enough for the job.
english.completed: Return to Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 拉尔德的午餐
text.objectives: 辛特兰恶齿村的拉尔德要求你去找到拉尔德的午餐。完成任务之后就回到他那里去。$B$B拉尔德说他把午餐留在了北面的岛上。当心邪枝巨魔。
text.description: 拉尔德在一个秘密的地方享用野餐，这时丑陋的邪枝巨魔一棍打翻了我。拉尔德跑回了恶齿村，但是把午餐留在了那里。拉尔德饿了。也许你可以去那个秘密的地方找回拉尔德的午餐？拉尔德害怕。出发吧！北边的岛就是那个秘密的地方。
text.progress: <拉尔德揉着他硕大的肚子。>$B$B拉尔德好饿。
text.completion: Dis hit da spot! Tanks little one. Lard make you special picnic basket for help Lard.
text.completed: Return to Lard at Revantusk Village in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Lard Lost His Lunch
english.objectives: Lard at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Lard's Lunch. Return to him when this task is complete.$B$BLard mentioned that he left it on the island to the north. Watch out for Vilebranch trolls.
english.description: Lard was at secret special spot having picnic when ugly mean Vilebranch hit Lard wit da big stick. Lard run back to Revantusk but forget Lard lunch. Lard hungry. Maybe you go back to secret special spot and get Lard lunch? Lard scared. Go nort! Island der to da nort is da secret special spot.
english.progress: <Lard rubs his enormous belly.>$B$BLard so hungry.
english.completion: Dis hit da spot! Tanks little one. Lard make you special picnic basket for help Lard.
english.completed: Return to Lard at Revantusk Village in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 重要线索：河爪氏族
text.objectives: 收集河爪豺狼人的线索。
text.description: 鉴于我们没别的眉目，那么只好沿着你给的线索查下去了。$B$B这片有几个河爪豺狼人营地，去查查他们。有什么线索就带回来，别把风声走漏给了河爪的豺狼人和探子。
text.progress: Find anything on the gnolls?
text.completion: Is this supposed to be some kind of joke, because I'm not laughing. Bits and pieces of red cloth? What the hell is this supposed to mean?
text.completed: Return the Riverpaw Gnoll Clue to Lieutenant Horatio Laine at the Jansen Stead in Westfall.

english.title: Hot On the Trail: The Riverpaw Clan
english.objectives: Recover the Riverpaw Gnoll Clue.
english.description: Seeing as how we have no other leads, we may as well chase down the information you got.$B$BThere are a couple of Riverpaw gnoll camps in the area. Track them down and search for clues. Bring back anything that you might find. Isolate your search to the Riverpaw gnolls and scouts.
english.progress: Find anything on the gnolls?
english.completion: Is this supposed to be some kind of joke, because I'm not laughing. Bits and pieces of red cloth? What the hell is this supposed to mean?
english.completed: Return the Riverpaw Gnoll Clue to Lieutenant Horatio Laine at the Jansen Stead in Westfall.

text.title: 重要线索：鱼人
text.objectives: 收集鱼人的线索。
text.description: 我觉得这事儿不靠谱，得把手头的线索都查一遍才行。$B$B你得给我到长滩去，就在西边，从海滩上的鱼人嘴里撬点什么出来，线索、消息，只要是能让凶手浮出水面的就行。$B$B有结果了就回来告诉我，新人。
text.progress: How goes the murloc hunt?
text.completion: Nice find, rookie. I think I have a stack of these on my desk back at the station. We're basically back to square one. What do we know? Someone that likes to write fiction about the past sent the Furlbrows a letter. Looks like we got ourselves a real history... mystery.
text.completed: Return the Murloc Clue to Lieutenant Horatio Laine at the Jansen Stead in Westfall.

english.title: Hot On the Trail: Murlocs
english.objectives: Recover the Murloc Clue.
english.description: As pointless as I think that this is going to be, we need to investigate all of our leads.$B$BI need you to head out to the Longshore, west of here, on the coast, and shake up some murlocs. Try to find a clue or some info that can help shed some light on the murders.$B$BReturn to me if you get lucky, rookie.
english.progress: How goes the murloc hunt?
english.completion: Nice find, rookie. I think I have a stack of these on my desk back at the station. We're basically back to square one. What do we know? Someone that likes to write fiction about the past sent the Furlbrows a letter. Looks like we got ourselves a real history... mystery.
english.completed: Return the Murloc Clue to Lieutenant Horatio Laine at the Jansen Stead in Westfall.

text.title: 拜访“老好人”洛伊
text.objectives: 同法布隆南瓜农场的“老好人”洛伊交谈。
text.description: 看来咱们这是在演“推理小说”，新人。不幸的是，本地人貌似都不愿意开口，而你从豺狼人和鱼人那儿得到的线索啥用处都没有。我们不得不将计划启动了……去找一个叫“老好人”洛伊的。“老好人”洛伊是我从前的一个地下线人，讽刺的是，就住在法布隆旧南瓜农场里。到西边的农场去，看看洛伊知道些什么。$B$B他要是跟你打哈哈，就说是霍拉提奥派你去的。
text.completion: Look, we ain't got no room for no more... Horatio sent you? Right then... um, how can I help you? He's not here is he? Heh, he knows I wasn't hidin' from him, right? Was just tryin' to lay low and all that, ya know?

english.title: Meet Two-Shoed Lou
english.objectives: Speak to Two-Shoed Lou at the Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm in Westfall.
english.description: Looks like we got ourselves a real "whodunit" here, rookie. Unfortunately, it looks like the locals aren't willing to talk and the clues you got off the gnolls and murlocs are damn near worthless. We're going to have to initiate plan... be on the lookout for Two-Shoed Lou.$B$BTwo-Shoed Lou is an old confidential informant of mine who, ironically, makes his home at the Furlbrow's old pumpkin farm. Head west to the farm and find out what Lou knows.$B$BIf he gives you any guff tell him that Horatio sent you.
english.completion: Look, we ain't got no room for no more... Horatio sent you? Right then... um, how can I help you? He's not here is he? Heh, he knows I wasn't hidin' from him, right? Was just tryin' to lay low and all that, ya know?

text.title: 完成轮回
text.objectives: 从沃德林之拥号登上扳钳X2号，帮忙清剿驱暗海窟。
text.description: 那头摧毁我们船只的畜牲已经被找到了。它在驱暗海窟筑巢，那里是同深渊接壤的一处水下巨洞。$B$B这一次我们准备好了。侏儒在暴风城为我们造了一艘美妙的潜艇，它搭载的密集火力就连那恶魔也要望而兴叹。$B$B一旦扳钳X2号同本舰接舷，你就上船，有什么忙帮什么忙。我们随后跟上。
text.completion: Vell done, Private $n. The cavern is ours, but the beast escaped. Should it raise it's ugly head again, ve vill make with blastink it out of the vater.
text.completed: Speak to Captain Glovaal in Darkbreak Cove.
text.objective1: Board the Pincer X2 once it arrives

english.title: Full Circle
english.objectives: Board the Pincer X2 from Voldrin's Hold and aid in securing Darkbreak Cove.
english.description: We've located the beast that destroyed our ships. It makes its lair in Darkbreak Cove, a giant underwater cavern bordering the abyss.$B$BThis time we're ready. The gnomes have been engineering a beauty for us back at Stormwind, and it's packing firepower that'll make that fiend wet itself.$B$BWhen the Pincer X2 pulls up to dock beside the ship, make your way on board and help out however you can. We'll be right behind you.
english.completion: Vell done, Private $n. The cavern is ours, but the beast escaped. Should it raise it's ugly head again, ve vill make with blastink it out of the vater.
english.completed: Speak to Captain Glovaal in Darkbreak Cove.
english.objective1: Board the Pincer X2 once it arrives

text.title: 加培根，更美味
text.objectives: 到奥格瑞玛南边去杀几头成年野猪，给我带6份猪腹肉回来。我就在暗巷区里等你。
text.description: 让一支饥饿的兽人大军填饱肚子可不是个简单差事。幸运的是，在奥格瑞玛南边的养猪场及其周边地区的支持下，我们有充足的猪肉储备。帮我个忙，去杀几头猪，把它们那美味可口的猪腹肉给我带回来。我会把这些肉制成培根，供应部队的早餐。
text.progress: Have you finished slaughtering the swine?
text.completion: Good work, $n.  These will do nicely.
text.completed: Return to Marogg in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Everything Is Better with Bacon
english.objectives: Slaughter Mature Swine south of Orgrimmar and bring me back 6 of their Swine Bellies.  I will be waiting for you here in The Drag.
english.description: Feeding a hungry orc army is never an easy task.  Luckily for us, we have a good supply of mature swine meat from the pig farms and surrounding areas south of Orgrimmar.  Do me a favor and slaughter some of those pigs for their delicious belly meat.  I will slice it up and make bacon for the troops' breakfast.
english.progress: Have you finished slaughtering the swine?
english.completion: Good work, $n.  These will do nicely.
english.completed: Return to Marogg in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 完成轮回
text.objectives: Board the Verne from The Stygian Bounty and aid in securing Tenebrous Cavern.
text.description: We've located the beast that destroyed our ships. It makes its lair in Tenebrous Cavern, a giant underwater cave bordering the Abyssal Breach.$B$BThis time we're ready. The goblins have been proving their worth by making a vicious machine for us back at Bilgewater Harbor, and it's packing firepower that'll make that fiend wet itself.$B$BWhen the Verne pulls up to dock beside the ship, make your way on board and find a way to make yourself useful. We'll be right behind you.
text.completion: Well done, $c.$B$BThat slippery beast got away! I'll be making a few upgrades. It won't be so lucky next time.
text.completed: Speak to Captain "Jewels" Verne in the Tenebrous Cavern.
text.objective1: Board the Verne once it arrives

english.title: Full Circle
english.objectives: Board the Verne from The Stygian Bounty and aid in securing Tenebrous Cavern.
english.description: We've located the beast that destroyed our ships. It makes its lair in Tenebrous Cavern, a giant underwater cave bordering the Abyssal Breach.$B$BThis time we're ready. The goblins have been proving their worth by making a vicious machine for us back at Bilgewater Harbor, and it's packing firepower that'll make that fiend wet itself.$B$BWhen the Verne pulls up to dock beside the ship, make your way on board and find a way to make yourself useful. We'll be right behind you.
english.completion: Well done, $c.$B$BThat slippery beast got away! I'll be making a few upgrades. It won't be so lucky next time.
english.completed: Speak to Captain "Jewels" Verne in the Tenebrous Cavern.
english.objective1: Board the Verne once it arrives

text.title: 寻找零件
text.objectives: 将7个备用零件交给新工匠镇的工程师格林德斯巴克。
text.description: 要做的事情太多，能干活的侏儒却太少！大工匠要我从诺莫瑞根行动的旧机器人和零件里找些有用的。我希望不久之后就能有一排全新的多功能机器人等着进行实地测试！$B$B我想你可能也没时间帮忙，对不对？这里到处散落着各种零件。找到什么就捡上带来给我。你永远不会知道这些东西什么时候能派上用场！
text.progress: Did you get those parts?
text.completion: These are fantastic! Let's see what we can put together. Would you be interested in testing out the prototype once I'm done?
text.completed: Return to Engineer Grindspark in New Tinkertown.

english.title: Scrounging for Parts
english.objectives: Bring 7 Spare Parts to Engineer Grindspark in New Tinkertown.
english.description: There's just too much to do around here, and too few gnomes on their feet to help! The high tinker has asked me to start converting some of our old bots and parts from Operation: Gnomeregan. I hope to have a new line of multi-bots ready for a field test soon!$B$BI don't suppose you'd have some time to help, do you? There are all kinds of parts scattered around. Pick up anything you find and bring it back to me. You never know what could turn out to be useful!
english.progress: Did you get those parts?
english.completion: These are fantastic! Let's see what we can put together. Would you be interested in testing out the prototype once I'm done?
english.completed: Return to Engineer Grindspark in New Tinkertown.

text.title: 银鬃捕猎者
text.objectives: 杀死8条银鬃捕猎者。
text.description: 许多勇敢的巨魔都在辛特兰的森林中失踪了，$R。银鬃狼对我们的猎人来说是最大的威胁。它们静静地隐藏在灌木丛中，当时机成熟之后就发起突然袭击。$B$B我们一定要阻止这种残忍的行为！$B$B你必须和银鬃狼一样思考。我们要以牙还牙，猎捕它们！把它们全都干掉！
text.completion: 干得好，$C。恶齿食人妖感谢你的贡献。
text.completed: Return to Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Stalking the Stalkers
english.objectives: Kill 8 Silvermane Stalkers.
english.description: Many brave trolls have been lost to the harsh wilds of the Hinterlands, $r. The Silvermane wolves are one of the biggest threats to our hunters. They lay in wait, hiding amongst the bushes and landscape, then strike out when the opportunity presents itself.$B$BThis type of ferocity will not go unchecked!$B$BYou must think like the Silvermane. Stalk the stalkers! Slay them all!
english.completion: A job well done, $r. The Revantusk thank you for your contribution.
english.completed: Return to Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 野蛮的枭兽
text.objectives: 杀掉10头野蛮的枭兽。
text.description: 辛特兰地区最令人讨厌的生物之一就是那些野蛮的枭兽。很多勇敢的恶齿战士都倒在了那些野兽的利爪和尖嘴之下。$B$B干掉你看到的每个野蛮的枭兽，$R。当你把它们杀得血流成河的时候就回到我这里来，你的贡献一定会得到我们的赞赏。
text.completion: 你已经证明了自己对恶齿食人妖来说是个不可多得的盟友，$N。做得好。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Hunt the Savages
english.objectives: Kill 10 Savage Owlbeasts.
english.description: Among the more ornery of the wildlife of the Hinterlands are the savage owlbeasts. Many a good Revantusk warrior has been lost to the ferocious claws and beak of the beasts.$B$BKill every savage owlbeast you see, $r. Return to me when you can stand no more bloodshed. Your contribution will then be weighed, measured, and judged.
english.completion: You have proven a worthy ally to the Revantusk, $n. Well done.
english.completed: Return to Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 紫葡萄酒
text.objectives: 收集12瓶紫葡萄酒。
text.description: 你！你知道在北部海滩上洒落着没有一百瓶，也有十瓶上好的葡萄酒吗？$B$B……好吧，现在你知道了！$B$B要不是那些乌龟要攻击我，我早就去那儿大把大把地抱回来了。我发誓，它们要我的血。$B$B因此我付钱让你替我干。给我带12瓶紫葡萄酒来，$C，我就从你手上“买”下它们。
text.progress: Do you have 12 bottles? I know how to count, you know!
text.completion: Perfect! I don't know where I'd get this stuff if it wasn't for drunk humans repeatedly crashing their ships. Normally I'd settle down and get ready to haggle with you for an hour, but you're in luck; I'm too eager to crack these open. Cheers!
text.completed: Return to Grognard at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.

english.title: Pupellyverbos Port
english.objectives: Collect 12 bottles of Pupellyverbos Port.
english.description: You there! Did you know that strewn across the northern beach are tens, if not hundreds, of bottles of fine wine?$B$B...well, now you do!$B$BI'd be out there gathering them by the armload, if those turtles weren't out to get me. They crave my blood, I swear.$B$BSo I'll pay you then. Bring me 12 bottles of Pupellyverbos Port and I'll "purchase" it from you, $c.
english.progress: Do you have 12 bottles? I know how to count, you know!
english.completion: Perfect! I don't know where I'd get this stuff if it wasn't for drunk humans repeatedly crashing their ships. Normally I'd settle down and get ready to haggle with you for an hour, but you're in luck; I'm too eager to crack these open. Cheers!
english.completed: Return to Grognard at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.

text.title: 捕捉小龙虾
text.objectives: 在奥格瑞玛城内捕捉10条沾泥龙虾，然后把它们交给玛洛格。
text.description: 奥格瑞玛城里有一些小湖泊，每年都会有许多小龙虾在湖里爬来爬去。这就是你要干的事啦，$N。我想让你去抓一些美味的小龙虾，把它们给我带过来。如果你抓到足够的小龙虾，我们的大兵们今晚就可以大饱口福了。
text.progress: Were you able to dig up some crayfish?
text.completion: Ugh, I never liked cooking these slimy things.  Thanks for the help $n.
text.completed: Return to Marogg in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Crawfish Creole
english.objectives: Catch 10 Muddy Crawfish in Orgrimmar.  Deliver the crustaceans to Marogg when you are done.
english.description: There are a number of small lakes scattered around Orgrimmar.  These lakes fill up with crawfish every year.  That's where you come in, $N.  I need you to catch some of those delicious crustaceans and return to me when you are done.  Assuming your catch is successful, our Horde army will feast tonight.
english.progress: Were you able to dig up some crayfish?
english.completion: Ugh, I never liked cooking these slimy things.  Thanks for the help $n.
english.completed: Return to Marogg in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 当心，果子有刺
text.objectives: 收集8份仙人掌果，把它们交给奥格瑞玛的玛洛格。
text.description: 有时候，士兵们会提出想吃甜点的要求。通常来说我不会答应他们，但这一次就破个例吧。你肯定见过奥格瑞玛城内生长的仙人掌，它们会结出一种美味的果子——仙人掌果。麻烦之处在于，这种果子浑身都是刺！小心别扎到手，给我采一些仙人掌果回来。
text.progress: Were you able to find enough fruit?
text.completion: Let me see your hands... Aha!  Your not any better at collecting these wretched things than I am!
text.completed: Return to Marogg in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Careful, This Fruit Bites Back
english.objectives: Retrieve 8 pieces of Prickly Pear Fruit.  Deliver the fruit to Marogg in Orgrimmar.
english.description: Sometimes the troops want something sweet to eat.  I don't always give them what they want but this time, I am going to make an exception.  I am sure you have seen the local cactus that grows here in Orgrimmar.  These cactus produce a tasty treat called prickly pear fruit.  The trouble is the fruit are covered in spines!  Watch your hands and bring me back a handful of that fruit.
english.progress: Were you able to find enough fruit?
english.completion: Let me see your hands... Aha!  Your not any better at collecting these wretched things than I am!
english.completed: Return to Marogg in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 体验生活
text.objectives: 到西部荒野詹戈洛德矿洞的后面使用“老好人”洛伊的老房子。
text.description: 听着，我真的不该和你谈，但我欠霍拉提奥不少情。法布隆的事儿我是真不知道，不过我或许可以帮你找到眉目。$B$B<洛伊交给你一个大盒子。>我发财之前就住在那个盒子里。现在我过的可是流浪汉梦寐以求的日子！$B$B对，你就带上盒子到西南边的詹戈洛德矿洞去。绕到矿洞后面，藏到盒子里去。
text.progress: Be careful with my old house. I plan to hand that off to my kids when they move out.
text.completion: STOP! STOP! STOP! I don't wanna hear it! I don't wanna know and I don't care! That kind of information is liable to get you killed 'round these parts. I got one more bit of information for you and then we're done!
text.completed: Return to Two-Shoed Lou at the Furlbrow Pumpkin Farm in Westfall.

english.title: Livin' the Life
english.objectives: Use Two-Shoed Lou's Old House at the back of the Jangolode Mine in Westfall.
english.description: Listen, I really shouldn't be talkin' to you, but I owe Horatio a favor or two. I don't really know nothin' about what happened to the Furlbrows, but I might be able to point you in the right direction.$B$B<Lou hands you a large crate.>$B$BThat crate used to be my home before I struck it rich. Now I'm livin' the life every hobo dreams of!$B$BRight, so you take that there livin' crate and head to the Jangolode Mine, southwest of here. Head to the back of the mine and once there, hide in the crate.
english.progress: Be careful with my old house. I plan to hand that off to my kids when they move out.
english.completion: STOP! STOP! STOP! I don't wanna hear it! I don't wanna know and I don't care! That kind of information is liable to get you killed 'round these parts. I got one more bit of information for you and then we're done!
english.completed: Return to Two-Shoed Lou at the Furlbrow Pumpkin Farm in Westfall.

text.title: “我来抢蜡烛！”
text.objectives: Kill 12 Kobold Diggers.
text.description: Back before those damned kobolds gave me a permanent limp I used to be William Pestle's number one candle supplier. Hell, I even came up with the line "I TAKE CANDLE!" Yea, that was me. Kobold would say "You no take candle!" and I'd just respond "I TAKE CANDLE!" and then bash their brains in!$B$B<Jimb drifts off for a second.>$B$BGood times... The best times.$B$BNow? Can't even use the bathroom without assistance. You want to help me? Kill me some kobolds. You'll find a good load of 'em in the nearby mine.
text.progress: I just want those kobolds dead. Dead!
text.completion: Oh SWEET justice! Killin' those kobolds won't make me walk like a normal person and it sure won't get me a job, but damn does it feel good. Here, I think I got somethin' for you from my kobold huntin' days. Maybe you can put it to good use.
text.completed: Return to Jimb "Candles" McHannigan at the Furlbrow Pumpkin Farm in Westfall.

english.title: "I TAKE Candle!"
english.objectives: Kill 12 Kobold Diggers.
english.description: Back before those damned kobolds gave me a permanent limp I used to be William Pestle's number one candle supplier. Hell, I even came up with the line "I TAKE CANDLE!" Yea, that was me. Kobold would say "You no take candle!" and I'd just respond "I TAKE CANDLE!" and then bash their brains in!$B$B<Jimb drifts off for a second.>$B$BGood times... The best times.$B$BNow? Can't even use the bathroom without assistance. You want to help me? Kill me some kobolds. You'll find a good load of 'em in the nearby mine.

english.completed: Return to Jimb "Candles" McHannigan at the Furlbrow Pumpkin Farm in Westfall.

text.title: 盛宴还是饥荒
text.objectives: 收集6条山狗尾和5把新鲜的泥土。
text.description: 西部荒野的日子不好过，孩子！每天就很难熬，有时我们整星期整星期地吃不上像样的一顿。这就是为什么我们要互相帮助才行。也许你可以搭把手，啊？我在做泥土馅饼，还缺些材料。$B$B到门外的南瓜地里给我弄些新鲜的泥土，还有一扎山狗尾。山狗在西部荒野的野地里就能找到。$B$B快快去！咱们有好几口子要等着吃呢。
text.progress: Dirt pies don't make themselves - usually.
text.completion: Just smellin' you comin' got my stomach rumblin'! We're gonna eat like kings tonight!
text.completed: Return to Mama Celeste at the Furlbrow Pumpkin Farm in Westfall.

english.title: Feast or Famine
english.objectives: Collect 6 Coyote Tails and 5 handfuls of Fresh Dirt.
english.description: Life in Westfall's hard, $g sonny:missy;! Every day is a struggle. We can sometimes go weeks without a decent meal. That's why it's important that we all help each other out. Maybe you can lend a hand, eh? I'm making dirt pies and need some ingredients.$B$BGet me some fresh dirt from the pumpkin patch out front and a bundle of coyote tails. You'll find coyotes wandering around in the wilds of Westfall.$B$BGet moving! We got mouths to feed.
english.progress: Dirt pies don't make themselves - usually.
english.completion: Just smellin' you comin' got my stomach rumblin'! We're gonna eat like kings tonight!
english.completed: Return to Mama Celeste at the Furlbrow Pumpkin Farm in Westfall.

text.title: 洛伊的临别赠言
text.objectives: 在西部荒野法布隆南瓜农场的农舍后窃听贼人交谈。
text.description: 最近农场来了好些个贼人，尽惹麻烦。我不知道他们打哪儿来，也不知道他们为谁干，但我知道他们没什么好事。我偶然听到过他们谈话，你可能会感兴趣。$B$B要是你愿意，可以在农舍的后面找到他们。要是你被抓或是被杀，我不认识你，也从没见过你！$B$B祝你好运，孩子。
text.completion: We're dealing with an organization here, rookie. You don't just off the richest bum in Westfall in broad daylight and leave no witnesses. Someone with a lot of power is behind these murders. What have you learned so far?
text.completed: Get back to Two-Shoed Lou's cottage at the Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm in Westfall.

english.title: Lou's Parting Thoughts
english.objectives: Eavesdrop on the Thugs out behind the farmhouse at Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm in Westfall.
english.description: A couple of thugs recently showed up at the farm, causin' all kinds of trouble. I don't know where they came from or who they're working for, but I KNOW they're bad news. I may have overheard 'em talkin' 'bout subjects that might interest you.$B$BIf you're interested, you'll find the thugs back behind the farmhouse. If you get caught or killed, I don't know you. Never seen ya!$B$BGood luck, kid.
english.completion: We're dealing with an organization here, rookie. You don't just off the richest bum in Westfall in broad daylight and leave no witnesses. Someone with a lot of power is behind these murders. What have you learned so far?
english.completed: Get back to Two-Shoed Lou's cottage at the Furlbrow's Pumpkin Farm in Westfall.

text.title: 家贼难防
text.objectives: 收集6桶暗矛香米，把它们交给奥格瑞玛的马洛格。
text.description: As you know, $N, Garrosh has relegated the Trolls of Orgrimmar to the western outskirts of the city.  Fortunately, that means that we have easy access to their supplies.  I am working on a large batch of jambalaya for the infantry and I need as much rice as possible.  Lucky for us, the Trolls keep it stored in barrels near their structures.  Retrieve these barrels of Darkspear rice for me and I should be able to finish up.
text.progress: Were you able to acquire the rice?
text.completion: I see you are a skilled thief as well, $n.  Don't worry, we will return the rice once we are done... or not.
text.completed: Return to Marogg in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Stealing From Our Own
english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Barrels of Darkspear Rice.  Deliver the rice to Marogg in Orgrimmar.
english.description: As you know, $N, Garrosh has relegated the Trolls of Orgrimmar to the western outskirts of the city.  Fortunately, that means that we have easy access to their supplies.  I am working on a large batch of jambalaya for the infantry and I need as much rice as possible.  Lucky for us, the Trolls keep it stored in barrels near their structures.  Retrieve these barrels of Darkspear rice for me and I should be able to finish up.
english.progress: Were you able to acquire the rice?
english.completion: I see you are a skilled thief as well, $n.  Don't worry, we will return the rice once we are done... or not.
english.completed: Return to Marogg in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 家贼难防
text.objectives: 收集6桶科赞香米，把它们交给奥格瑞玛的玛洛格。
text.description: As you know, $N, Garrosh has relegated the Goblins of Orgrimmar to the western outskirts of the city.  Fortunately, that means that we have easy access to their supplies.  I am working on a large batch of jambalaya for the infantry and I need as much rice as possible.  Lucky for us, the Goblins keep it stored in barrels near their structures.  Retrieve these barrels of Kezan rice for me and I should be able to finish up.
text.progress: Were you able to acquire the rice?
text.completion: I see you are a skilled thief as well, $n.  Don't worry, we will return the rice once we are done... or not.
text.completed: Return to Marogg in Orgrimmar.

english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Barrels of Kezan Rice.  Deliver the rice to Marogg in Orgrimmar.

I am working on a large batch of jambalaya for the infantry and I need as much rice as possible.  Lucky for us, the Goblins keep it stored in barrels near their structures.  Retrieve these barrels of Kezan rice for me and I should be able to finish up.
english.progress: Were you able to acquire the rice?
english.completion: I see you are a skilled thief as well, $n.  Don't worry, we will return the rice once we are done... or not.
english.completed: Return to Marogg in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 饥饿的盗贼
text.objectives: 收集3份部落步兵口粮，把它们交给奥格瑞玛的玛洛格。
text.description: 过去这几周，奥格瑞玛城里经常有窃贼光顾，偷走我们的步兵口粮。最近我获得了一些情报，搞清楚了这些罪行发生的地点。如果你看到一堆堆的箱子和补给品，那么附近八成会有窃贼出没。我要你去干掉那些窃贼，把他们偷走的口粮夺回来。搞定这件事之后回来找我。
text.progress: Were you able to recover the rations?
text.completion: Nice work $n!  I will see that these rations are returned to the troops immediately.
text.completed: Return to Marogg in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Even Thieves Get Hungry
english.objectives: Recover 3 Horde Infantry Rations.  Deliver them to Marogg in Orgrimmar.
english.description: We have had a problem with thieves stealing our infantry rations here in Orgrimmar for the last couple of weeks.  I recently received some intelligence of where these crimes are taking place.  Anywhere you see piles of crates and supplies, there are likely to be thieves nearby.  I need you to hunt these thieves down and recover the stolen rations.  Return to me when you are done.
english.progress: Were you able to recover the rations?
english.completion: Nice work $n!  I will see that these rations are returned to the troops immediately.
english.completed: Return to Marogg in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 萨丁的提醒
text.objectives: 同西部荒野萨丁农场的农夫萨丁交谈。
text.description: 那么我们目前都知道了些什么呢？来整理一下。$B$B贾森农场那儿你发现一封浸水的信，还有红色的碎布片。法布隆这儿你监听到了一些人影同一名食人魔法师的对话。同时你得知是一伙强盗自称犯下的命案——就是被你干掉的那些。$B$B事情有点不对劲，新人。$B$B东南边萨丁农场那儿有对老夫妇，去和农夫萨丁谈谈，听听他都怎么说。
text.completion: Horatio Laine? That man is a scumbag. Dirty as my underwear. Listen, friend, I don't often give out advice like this, but you seem like a good man. GET OUT OF WESTFALL. You're already in way over your head. All you're doing now is putting your neck on the chopping block.

english.title: Shakedown at the Saldean's
english.objectives: Speak with Farmer Saldean at Saldean's Farm in Westfall.
english.description: So what do we know so far? We need to follow the clues.$B$BOver at the Jansen Stead you found a water-soaked letter and some scraps of red cloth. Here at the Furlbrow's you overheard a conversation between some shadowy figure and an ogre mage. You also got a confession to the murder from a bunch of thugs - whom you then killed.$B$BSomething isn't adding up, rookie.$B$BThere's an old couple, southeast of here, at the Saldean's Farm. Head over there and speak with Farmer Saldean. Find out what he knows.
english.completion: Horatio Laine? That man is a scumbag. Dirty as my underwear. Listen, friend, I don't often give out advice like this, but you seem like a good man. GET OUT OF WESTFALL. You're already in way over your head. All you're doing now is putting your neck on the chopping block.

text.title: 日子不好过
text.objectives: 击败10个看守傀儡。
text.description: 日子不好过啊，$G兄弟:姐妹;。$B$B随着从暴风城流离失所的人们来西部荒野逃难，本来已经捉襟见肘的资源越发紧张。这些人没有落脚之处，需要有人去帮他们一把。$B$B我们自己的农庄作为中转旅舍开了好多年。萨尔玛尽最大努力好生款待我们的客人，可到头来看守傀儡让他们没能过这一关。这些游荡在我田里的邪恶造物，是迪菲亚兄弟会在被赶走之前留给我们的麻烦。帮帮我们吧！
text.progress: Did you destroy the harvest watchers?
text.completion: Thank you, brother. You've done Salma and I a great service and I promise that it won't soon be forgotten. I don't have much money, but you're welcome to what I do have.
text.completed: Return to Farmer Saldean at Saldean's Farm in Westfall.

english.title: Times are Tough
english.objectives: Kill 10 Harvest Watchers.
english.description: Times are tough, $g brother:sister;. With the downtrodden masses of Stormwind migrating into Westfall, resources are stretched as thin as they've ever been. The people are restless and in need of help.$B$BOur own farmhouse has been serving as a halfway house for years. Salma does the best that she can to keep our guests alive, but sometimes the watchers get 'em. Watchers are those twisted abominations roaming my fields - a little present left behind by the Defias, before they were driven off. Help us!
english.progress: Did you destroy the harvest watchers?
english.completion: Thank you, brother. You've done Salma and I a great service and I promise that it won't soon be forgotten. I don't have much money, but you're welcome to what I do have.
english.completed: Return to Farmer Saldean at Saldean's Farm in Westfall.

text.title: 野蛮的矮人
text.objectives: 杀死10名蛮锤战士或蛮锤萨满。
text.description: 部落为我们恶齿部族做了很多，我们不能知恩不报。其他森林巨魔部落后撤的时候，我们则要以部落的名义积极出击，夺取更多的土地。$B$B但现在蛮锤矮人挡住了我们的去路。如果他们想要战争，那就给他们战争……并且我不打算输给个头只到我腰部的生物。$B$B出去给我杀掉一些矮人。
text.completion: That will show the Wildhammer to stay away from our lands! Crazy dwarves should've stayed in the mountains...
text.completed: Return to Elder Torntusk at Revantusk Village in The Hinterlands.

english.title: The Savage Dwarves
english.objectives: Kill 10 Wildhammer Warriors or Wildhammer Shaman.
english.description: The Horde has done much for us Revantusk, and we're no freeloaders. With the other forest troll tribes pushed back, we're striking out to claim more land in the name of the Horde.$B$BBut now the Wildhammer dwarves are getting in our way. If it's a war they want, it's a war they'll get... and I don't plan to lose a war to creatures half my height.$B$BGet out there and kill me some dwarves.
english.completion: That will show the Wildhammer to stay away from our lands! Crazy dwarves should've stayed in the mountains...
english.completed: Return to Elder Torntusk at Revantusk Village in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 跟着我的节拍
text.objectives: 对6名恶齿战士使用恶齿战鼓。
text.description: 我们的战士在外面奋勇作战，剿除卑鄙的蛮锤矮人，好让我们能在村子里安居乐业。我们只能尽一切可能支援他们。$B$B每一个巨魔都需要一个节拍，来帮他们在战斗中做最出色的发挥。鼓点的打击声能让你战得更勇，呼唤神灵眷顾于你。把我的鼓带到战场上。为战士们敲响，让那些蛮锤知道这片土地到底属于谁！
text.completion: Makes all the difference, doesn't it? That'll teach those dwarves a lesson.
text.completed: Return to Mystic Yayo'jin at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.

english.title: Stomp To My Beat
english.objectives: Use the Revantusk War Drums on 6 Revantusk Warriors.
english.description: Our warriors are out there fightin' hard to kill them nasty Wildhammer dwarves, so we can be safe back here at the village. It's only right we do what we can to support them.$B$BA good beat's what every troll needs to do his best in a fight. The poundin' rhythm of the drums drivin' you to hit harder, callin' the spirits to watch over you. Take my drums to the battlefield wit' ya. Play 'em for our warriors, and let 'em show the Wildhammer who owns these lands!
english.completion: Makes all the difference, doesn't it? That'll teach those dwarves a lesson.
english.completed: Return to Mystic Yayo'jin at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.

text.title: 西部荒野杂味炖肉
text.objectives: 收集6束秋葵，6份碎尸鸟肉条和6块血牙野猪肋排。
text.description: 你好，亲爱的。欢迎来到寒舍。唔，看来你不像是无家可归。你是来帮助我们的吗？要是那样，你可真是及时雨！我正在为小家伙们准备晚饭，还需要一些简单的材料。$B$B要是你能给我弄些秋葵、血牙野猪肋排和碎尸鸟肉条来，我就能做顿我最拿手的杂味炖肉来！食材在农场周围都能找到。小心那些看守傀儡，他们杀人不眨眼。
text.progress: Food will be ready as soon as I have all of the ingredients! Hurry!
text.completion: Bless your heart, dear. These poor orphans haven't had a hot meal in days. It looks like we will have enough left over to help feed many more of the homeless of Westfall.
text.completed: Return to Salma Saldean at Saldean's Farm in Westfall.

english.title: Westfall Stew
english.objectives: Collect 6 Okra, 6 Stringy Fleshripper Meat and 6 Goretusk Flanks.
english.description: Hello, dear. Welcome to our home. Hmm, you don't look like you're homeless. Have you come to help us? If so, you're just in time! I'm planning dinner for the young ones and need a few simple ingredients.$B$BIf you could get me some okra, goretusk flanks and stringy fleshripper meat I can make my famous Westfall stew! You'll find all of the ingredients near our farm. Just be careful of the harvest watchers. They are merciless killers.
english.progress: Food will be ready as soon as I have all of the ingredients! Hurry!
english.completion: Bless your heart, dear. These poor orphans haven't had a hot meal in days. It looks like we will have enough left over to help feed many more of the homeless of Westfall.
english.completed: Return to Salma Saldean at Saldean's Farm in Westfall.

text.title: 世界之柱
text.objectives: 向玛鲁特·缚石询问关于世界之柱的事情。
text.description: 这间屋子里的柱子支撑的不仅仅是大地神殿。$B$B如果我们没能将它恢复原样，这整个位面都将塌陷到我们的世界里来。$B$B行动的时候就要到了，$N。但首先我有些事情必须要告诉你，你得听好。

english.title: The World Pillar
english.objectives: Ask Maruut Stonebinder about the World Pillar.
english.description: The pillar in this room holds up more than just the Temple of Earth.$B$BThis entire plane of existence will soon collapse into our world if we fail to restore it.$B$BThe time to act will come soon, $N.  But first you must listen to what I have to tell you.

text.title: 一切归于土
text.objectives: 摧毁5只深石土元素。
text.description: 我们位于土位面，$N。一切终将被大地所吸收。$B$B风暴之怒号很快就会变成尘土，我们将无法从它的残骸中有所发现。$B$B去把正在拆卸飞船的元素消灭掉。这么做只是拖延时间，但这时间我们一定要争取，不然就无法找到所有的世界之柱碎片。
text.progress: You've returned, $N.
text.completion: You did what was necessary, $n.  I can tell you're the sort of $c I'll get along with well.
text.completed: Return to Seer Kormo at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

english.title: The Earth Claims All
english.objectives: Destroy 5 Deepstone Elementals.
english.description: We're in the plane of earth, $N.  Everything is absorbed by the land eventually.$B$BThe Storm's Fury will soon be turned to dust and we won't be able to gain any insight from its remains.$B$BGo and destroy the elementals that are dismantling the ship.  We're only delaying the inevitable, but we need to buy ourselves some time if we're to track down all the pieces of the World Pillar.
english.progress: You've returned, $N.
english.completion: You did what was necessary, $n.  I can tell you're the sort of $c I'll get along with well.
english.completed: Return to Seer Kormo at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

text.title: 炮艇坠落
text.objectives: 在深岩之洲风暴之怒号残骸里寻找线索。
text.description: 石拱碎片被装在一艘名为风暴之怒号的部落炮艇里进行空运。$B$B飞艇坠落在了南边，我们的占卜表明石拱碎片已经不在上面了。$B$B搜索一下那艘飞艇，看看能不能找到线索，了解到底发生了什么事。
text.completion: The clues point to an obvious conclusion.  Too obvious perhaps.
text.completed: Return to Maruut Stonebinder at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

english.title: Gunship Down
english.objectives: Search for clues at the Storm's Fury Wreckage in Deepholm.
english.description: The Archstone was being transported inside a flying Horde gunship called the Storm's Fury.$B$BThe airship crashed south of here and our scrying has revealed the Archstone's no longer on it.$B$BSearch the ship for clues related to what might've happened.
english.completion: The clues point to an obvious conclusion.  Too obvious perhaps.
english.completed: Return to Maruut Stonebinder at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.

text.title: 船长的日志
text.objectives: 将船长的日志交给深岩之洲大地神殿的玛鲁特·缚石。
text.description: <你翻到最后一条语焉不详的记录。>$B$B……根据新航线，以300节的速度接近大地神殿并展开登陆作业。我们注意到北方有一个低压系，将重新调整我们的……$B$B见鬼！联盟的混账们靠过来了！
text.completion: Why would the Alliance attack the Horde just as they're about to deliver a fragment of the World Pillar to us.

english.title: Captain's Log
english.objectives: Bring the Captain's Log to Maruut Stonebinder at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.
english.description: <You leaf to the final, interrupted entry.>$B$B...approaching the Temple of Earth at 300 knots and commencing landing maneuvers according to new route.  We've made note of a low pressure system in the north and redrawn our...$B$BBLOOD AND THUNDER!  ALLIANCE SCUM APPROACH!!
english.completion: Why would the Alliance attack the Horde just as they're about to deliver a fragment of the World Pillar to us.

text.title: 外交第一
text.objectives: 去找联盟炮艇的风暴召唤者米尔拉。
text.description: 大地之环是一个中立组织，$N。我们不会在部落和联盟的战争中帮助任何一方。$B$B四处看看吧——我们的成员来自五湖四海。把种族情绪凌驾到我们目标之上，只会危及到任务的完成。等我们有了更多的情报，再把这事公之于众吧。$B$B我们现在还不能过早下结论。我要你和我们一位新成员去寻找联盟炮艇。$B$B尽你所能把事情查清楚，不要把我们卷入到纷争中去。
text.completion: Oi, $n!  I was told I'd have company soon.

english.title: Diplomacy First
english.objectives: Meet Stormcaller Mylra aboard the Alliance Gunship.
english.description: The Earthen Ring is a neutral organization, $N.  We cannot pick sides in the war between the Horde and the Alliance.$B$BLook around you -- our members come from all backgrounds.  Our mission would be compromised should racial tensions be put above our goal.  Let's try to keep this under wraps until we have more information.$B$BWe must not jump to conclusions just yet.  I'll send you and one of our new members to look for the Alliance gunship.$B$BFind out what you can without dragging us into the conflict.
english.completion: Oi, $n!  I was told I'd have company soon.

text.title: 我们的朋友都死了
text.objectives: 在6名被杀死的船员的尸体上使用灵魂图腾。
text.description: 有什么地方不对劲，$N。船员都被杀了，船体结构上却没有一丝血迹或是损坏。$B$B这不是部落所为。$B$B同亡者的灵魂谈一谈，我们就能找到答案。它们可能还没有离开这个世界。$B$B把这根图腾插在牺牲人员的尸体旁边。你将有几秒钟的可以听到他们的遗愿。$B$B不过，要当心！说不好亡者的灵魂会对我们的刺激作何反应。
text.completion: We were bound to run into the Twilight's Hammer sooner or later, $n.  If they're behind this, it's quite likely that the World Pillar fragment is in their possession.
text.completed: Return to Stormcaller Mylra at the Alliance Gunship in Deepholm.

english.title: All Our Friends Are Dead
english.objectives: Use the Spirit Totem on the corpses of 6 Slain Crew Members.
english.description: Something's wrong here, $N.$B$BThe ship's crew has been slain.  Yet there is no bloodshed or damage to the ship's structure.$B$BThis was not the Horde's doing.$B$BWe will find the answers we seek by speaking to the spirits of the dead.  They have not yet left this world.$B$BTake this totem and place it near the corpses of the fallen.  You will have a few seconds to listen to their last few thoughts.$B$BBeware, however!  There is no telling how the spirits of the dead will react to our prodding.
english.completion: We were bound to run into the Twilight's Hammer sooner or later, $n.  If they're behind this, it's quite likely that the World Pillar fragment is in their possession.
english.completed: Return to Stormcaller Mylra at the Alliance Gunship in Deepholm.

text.title: 司令室
text.objectives: 到联盟炮艇的司令室里去找找线索。
text.description: 我们在司令室很可能会找到更多的线索。它就在下面。$B$B看看有没有幸存者，或是能让我们接近世界之柱碎片的情报。要当心，$N。把船员干掉的东西可能还在。
text.completion: This ship is filled with rats...

english.title: The Admiral's Cabin
english.objectives: Look for clues in the admiral's cabin of the Alliance Gunship.
english.description: It's possible we'll find further clues inside the admiral's cabin. You will find it directly below us.$B$BSee if there are any survivors or information that will lead us closer to the World Pillar fragment.  Be careful, $N.  Whoever got the crew might still be out there.
english.completion: This ship is filled with rats...

text.title: 转念一想，还是抓个俘虏吧
text.objectives: 制伏深岩之洲联盟炮艇上的仇视者莫诺洛克。
text.description: 还不算晚，$N。邪教徒们可能还在这里。$B$B到甲板下面去，找到领头的，制伏他们。$B$B不管用什么办法，我们都将得到问题的答案。
text.completion: Oi, this was a heavy one!  He nearly broke me gryphon's back! Are you ready to interrogate the ogre, $n?
text.giverWindow: Try not to kill him. We're going to need this one alive.

english.title: On Second Thought, Take One Prisoner
english.objectives: Subdue Mor'norokk the Hateful at the Alliance Gunship in Deepholm.
english.description: It's not too late, $N.  The cultists are probably still here.$B$BGo below decks, find out who's in charge and subdue them.$B$BWe will obtain answers to our questions, one way or another.
english.completion: Oi, this was a heavy one!  He nearly broke me gryphon's back! Are you ready to interrogate the ogre, $n?
english.giverWindow: Try not to kill him. We're going to need this one alive.

text.title: 不抓俘虏
text.objectives: 杀死6名暮光破坏者。
text.description: 看样子，暮光之锤还在船上。到甲板下面去把他们干掉。$B$B要当心，$N。我感觉他们不是来修身养性的，如果你懂我什么意思的话。
text.completion: Well done, $n.  The Twilight's Hammer is an evil that we must fight anywhere we find them.
text.completed: Return to Stormcaller Mylra at the Alliance Gunship in Deepholm.

english.title: Take No Prisoners
english.objectives: Slay 6 Twilight Saboteurs.
english.description: It looks like the Twilight's Hammer's still on the ship.  Go below decks and take them out.$B$BBe careful, $N.  I've a feeling they're not here for a spiritual retreat, if you know what I mean.
english.completion: Well done, $n.  The Twilight's Hammer is an evil that we must fight anywhere we find them.
english.completed: Return to Stormcaller Mylra at the Alliance Gunship in Deepholm.

text.title: 傀儡之心
text.objectives: 将看守傀儡之心交给萨丁农场的农夫萨丁。
text.description: 你所发现的应该是看守傀儡的核心。$B$B从该装置发出的声音来看它应该完好无损。也许你该把它交给农夫萨丁。
text.progress: 你有什麽要给我的吗，$N?
text.completion: Is that... Is that the heart of one of the watchers? I've heard stories about using one of these to power up a watcher for personal use. Of course I'm really in no shape to try such things myself.

english.title: Heart of the Watcher
english.objectives: Return the Harvest Watcher Heart to Farmer Saldean at Saldean's Farm.
english.description: You have found what appears to be the heart of a harvest watcher.$B$BFrom the sound being emitted by the device you can tell that it's still fully functional. Perhaps you should return it to Farmer Saldean.
english.progress: What have you got there, $n?
english.completion: Is that... Is that the heart of one of the watchers? I've heard stories about using one of these to power up a watcher for personal use. Of course I'm really in no shape to try such things myself.

text.title: 听听他有什么说法
text.objectives: 跳上风暴比克，旁观对莫诺洛克的审讯。
text.description: 跳上来，$N。咱们一起看看食人魔先生有什么要说的。这里到处都是敌人，咱们得找个吵闹点的地方，比如那边那个推进器。$B$B别害怕，风暴比克以前只把乘客摔下去过一两次。
text.completion: We have our answers, $n.  Let's report back.
text.completed: Speak to Stormcaller Mylra at the Alliance Gunship in Deepholm.

english.title: Some Spraining to Do
english.objectives: Jump on Stormbeak and watch Mor'norokk's interrogation.
english.description: Hop on, $N.  Let's see what Mr. Ogreface has to say for himself.$B$BDon't be shy, Stormbeak's only ever dropped a passenger a couple of times before.
english.completion: We have our answers, $n.  Let's report back.
english.completed: Speak to Stormcaller Mylra at the Alliance Gunship in Deepholm.

text.title: 回到大地神殿
text.objectives: 跟深岩之洲大地神殿的玛鲁特·缚石谈一谈。
text.description: 你必须把消息带回去，告诉神殿里的其他人。碎片很有可能已经被转移到一个更为安全的地方去了。$B$B把你知道的都告诉玛鲁特。我要调查调查这个暮光议会。
text.completion: We must investigate your findings further, but we must not lose track of the fragment.

english.title: Return to the Temple of Earth
english.objectives: Speak to Maruut Stonebinder at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.
english.description: You must get word back to the others at the temple.  Chances are, the fragment is already getting moved to a more secure location.$B$BTell Maruut what you know.  I'm going to do a little investigating about this Twilight Council in the meantime.
english.completion: We must investigate your findings further, but we must not lose track of the fragment.

text.title: 给塑血者放血
text.objectives: 从死亡之翼陨落地的一名暮光塑血者身上获得暮光的命令。
text.description: 暮光之锤在这里施放着污秽的魔法，$N。他们将死亡之翼血液的残余活化充能，让它生生不息，不致灯尽油枯。$B$B干掉一个塑血者，看他们身上有没有什么线索，可以让我们知道去哪儿找这个“铸炉之主”。
text.progress: We must make haste if we're to rebuild the World Pillar, $N.
text.completion: They're keeping slaves here?  We ought to free them regardless, but perhaps they might also aid us in finding the forgemaster.
text.giverWindow: One of them might lead us to the Forgemaster.

english.title: Bleed the Bloodshaper
english.objectives: Obtain the Twilight Orders from one of the Twilight Bloodshapers at Deathwing's Fall.
english.description: The Twilight's Hammer are wielding foul magic here, $N.  They animate and energize the remains of Deathwing's blood, so that instead of drying out and disappearing it thrives and becomes more abundant.$B$BTake out one of the bloodshapers, see if they have any clues as to where we can find this "forgemaster."
english.progress: We must make haste if we're to rebuild the World Pillar, $N.
english.completion: They're keeping slaves here?  We ought to free them regardless, but perhaps they might also aid us in finding the forgemaster.
english.giverWindow: One of them might lead us to the Forgemaster.

text.title: 它是活的！
text.objectives: Use the Harvest Watcher Heart on an Overloaded Harvest Golem and then use the Overloaded Harvest Golem to kill 25 Energized Harvest Reapers.
text.description: From what I've heard, all you really need to do is find a suitable harvest golem and drop in the heart. Once you've done that you should be able to take full control of the creature.$B$BI think there's a whole field of overloaded harvest golems west of here, at the Molsen Farm. Look for the arcs of electricity.$B$BShould you manage to get it working, use the golem to destroy the energized harvest reapers at the old Molsen farm. Those monsters are much more destructive than the ones on our farm.
text.progress: Did you find the golems?
text.completion: It actually worked? That's incredible, $n. Hopefully that takes care of the harvest golem problem here in Westfall.
text.completed: Return to Farmer Saldean at Saldean's Farm in Westfall.

english.title: It's Alive!
english.objectives: Use the Harvest Watcher Heart on an Overloaded Harvest Golem and then use the Overloaded Harvest Golem to kill 25 Energized Harvest Reapers.
english.description: From what I've heard, all you really need to do is find a suitable harvest golem and drop in the heart. Once you've done that you should be able to take full control of the creature.$B$BI think there's a whole field of overloaded harvest golems west of here, at the Molsen Farm. Look for the arcs of electricity.$B$BShould you manage to get it working, use the golem to destroy the energized harvest reapers at the old Molsen farm. Those monsters are much more destructive than the ones on our farm.
english.progress: Did you find the golems?
english.completion: It actually worked? That's incredible, $n. Hopefully that takes care of the harvest golem problem here in Westfall.
english.completed: Return to Farmer Saldean at Saldean's Farm in Westfall.

text.title: 死亡之翼陨落地
text.objectives: 前往深岩之洲的死亡之翼陨落地。
text.description: 把暮光之锤和世界之柱碎片的消失联系在一起，事情就完全说得通了。但愿我们行动够快，能及时将它夺回来。$B$B<玛鲁特把手放在你的肩膀上。>$B$B我已经和你建立了一道灵魂连接。只要你在深岩之洲，我们就能够联系上。$B$B到东南边的死亡之翼陨落地，去调查暮光之锤在那里的行动。
text.completion: This must be where the world pillar fragment was brought.  Let's have a closer look.
text.giverWindow: Our spirits are now linked so that we may communicate while you're away.
text.turninWindow: They must've brought the fragment here!

english.title: Deathwing's Fall
english.objectives: Go to Deathwing's Fall in Deepholm.
english.description: The Twilight's Hammer involvement in the disappearance of the World Pillar fragment makes complete sense.  Let us hope that we can act swiftly enough to recover it.$B$B<Maruut places his hand on your shoulder.>$B$BI've established a spiritual bond with you.  We should be able to communicate while you remain in Deepholm.$B$BGo to Deathwing's Fall to the southeast and investigate the Twilight's Hammer operation there.
english.completion: This must be where the world pillar fragment was brought.  Let's have a closer look.
english.giverWindow: Our spirits are now linked so that we may communicate while you're away.
english.turninWindow: They must've brought the fragment here!

text.title: 大地的守护者之血
text.objectives: 从死亡之翼陨落地的活体血液身上获得5份奈萨里奥之血的样本。
text.description: 当死亡之翼逃到深岩之洲来的时候，他的堕落达到了巅峰状态，但也许并非绝对的堕落。$B$B死亡之翼陨落地的邪教徒们收集并准备他留下来的堕落之血，将其注入到活体有机物中，汲取它们的力量。$B$B万一大地守护者的灵魂在其中还有一丝残留呢？毕竟，奈萨里奥在成为死亡的象征之前，乃是大地的象征。$B$B从邪教徒制造的活体血液身上收集样本，我们将知道大地的守护者的痕迹是不是还残留在里面。
text.progress: You return, $N.  Did you obtain the blood?
text.completion: There is still great power present in his blood, $n.  I can sense it even now. Yet there is also much corruption.  I am not sure we can salvage the Earthwarder's essence from this.
text.completed: Return to Seer Kormo at the Temple of Earth.

english.title: Blood of the Earthwarder
english.objectives: Gather 5 samples of Blood of Neltharion from Living Blood at Deathwing's Fall.
english.description: When Deathwing escaped to Deepholm, his corruption was extreme, but perhaps not yet absolute.$B$BThe cultists at Deathwing's Fall harvest and shape the corrupted blood he left behind into living organisms to draw from their power.$B$BWhat if a trace of the Earthwarder's essence remains?  After all, Neltharion was the aspect of earth before he was the aspect of death.$B$BGather samples from the living blood the cultists have created and we'll see if any trace of the Earthwarder remains.
english.progress: You return, $N.  Did you obtain the blood?
english.completion: There is still great power present in his blood, $n.  I can sense it even now. Yet there is also much corruption.  I am not sure we can salvage the Earthwarder's essence from this.
english.completed: Return to Seer Kormo at the Temple of Earth.

text.title: 铸炉之主的日志
text.objectives: 在深岩之洲死亡之翼陨落地找到铸炉之主的日志。
text.description: 到那个奴隶所说的塔里去。你应该可以在营地东北端找到它。$B$B如果我们行动足够快的话，或许就能监听到铸炉之主的会议。
text.completion: There is an entry for an upcoming meeting at the Upper Silvermarsh. This must be where the Forgemaster is.

english.title: The Forgemaster's Log
english.objectives: Find the Forgemaster's Log at Deathwing's Fall in Deepholm.
english.description: Go to the tower the slave spoke of.  You should find it on the northeastern end of the camp.$B$BIf we can act fast enough we might be able to eavesdrop on the forgemaster's meeting.
english.completion: There is an entry for an upcoming meeting at the Upper Silvermarsh. This must be where the Forgemaster is.

text.title: 质问奴隶
text.objectives: 获得暮光奴隶的钥匙，释放6名被奴役的矿工。
text.description: 你找到的命令上说，死亡之翼陨落地最东南边的帐篷里有把钥匙。拿到它，把南边采石场里的奴隶们放出来。
text.completion: Let us find this journal.  We're getting close to the World Pillar fragment, I can sense it.

english.title: Question the Slaves
english.objectives: Obtain the Twilight Slaver's Key and free 6 Enslaved Miners.
english.description: According to the orders you found, there is a key inside the tent in the southeastern end of Deathwing's Fall.$B$BObtain it and free the slaves in the quarry to the south.
english.completion: Let us find this journal.  We're getting close to the World Pillar fragment, I can sense it.

text.title: 索纳尔·雷破
text.objectives: 杀死索纳尔·雷破。
text.description: 我们一直想除掉侵害我们土地的蛮锤指挥官，但运气总是不好。$B$B索纳尔·雷破安坐在他的指挥所里，在战场上大声动员着矮人。我们认为他需要安静下来。$B$B杀掉索纳尔，这场战役就能轻松结束。
text.completion: Well done, mon. A fine hero of the Horde you are.
text.completed: Return to Elder Torntusk at Revantusk Village in The Hinterlands.
text.giverWindow: Our troops stand a much better chance once this oaf is dead on the ground.

english.title: Thornar Thunderclash
english.objectives: Kill Thornar Thunderclash.
english.description: We've been trying to take out the commander of the Wildhammer encroaching on our lands, but we've had no luck.$B$BThornar Thunderclash sits in the safety of his command post, his voice booming across the battlefield to rally the dwarves. We're thinking he needs to be quieted.$B$BCut Thornar down and we can clean up the rest of this skirmish with no problem.
english.completion: Well done, mon. A fine hero of the Horde you are.
english.completed: Return to Elder Torntusk at Revantusk Village in The Hinterlands.
english.giverWindow: Our troops stand a much better chance once this oaf is dead on the ground.

text.title: 身后物
text.objectives: 从剧毒机场的毒性淤泥身上获得6份收回的个人财物。
text.description: 我们许多人都见过诺莫瑞根暴露在剧毒和辐射下的侏儒，病痛难耐、精神错乱。他们的情况终将恶化，直到他们变成毫无心智、但基本无害的一滩毒性淤泥。$B$B我的研究表明，我们或许可以把他们从这种状态恢复过来。到南边的剧毒机场去，制服那些我跟你说的毒性淤泥，把他们还是侏儒时的个人财物带回来。
text.progress: Were you able to recover the belongings of any of the irradiated gnomes?
text.completion: I can't wait to give this new technology a try! We've lost more gnomes to radiation than we can count. It's time to turn that around!
text.completed: Return to Tock Sprysprocket in New Tinkertown.$B$B

english.title: What's Left Behind
english.objectives: Retrieve 6 Recovered Possessions from Toxic Sludges at the Toxic Airfield.
english.description: Most of us have seen the sickly and deranged gnomes suffering from exposure to the poisons and radiation of Gnomeregan. Eventually, they will devolve further, until they become mindless, but mostly harmless, puddles of toxic sludge.$B$BMy research suggests that we may even be able to restore them from this state. Go to the Toxic Airfield to the south, subdue the toxic sludge I told you about, and bring back the possessions of the gnomes they once were.
english.progress: Were you able to recover the belongings of any of the irradiated gnomes?
english.completion: I can't wait to give this new technology a try! We've lost more gnomes to radiation than we can count. It's time to turn that around!
english.completed: Return to Tock Sprysprocket in New Tinkertown.$B$B

text.title: 处理辐射
text.objectives: 消灭剧毒机场的6只活体污染物。
text.description: 托克·滑链有个疯狂的理论，说这些毒性淤泥就是侏儒变的，所以我的人接到命令，不准和它们交手。$B$B但是，南边的剧毒机场遍布着活体污染物。它们就是由被污染的水和其他有毒物质组成的元素。置之不理的话，它们就会祸害镇子。你能不能帮我处理掉它们？
text.completion: What a relief! Thank you for your help. I hope that gadget Engineer Grindspark was working on helps get the airfield cleaned up permanently.
text.completed: Return to Corporal Fizzwhistle in New Tinkertown.

english.title: Dealing with the Fallout
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Living Contaminations at the Toxic Airfield.
english.description: Tock Sprysprocket has some crazy theory about these toxic sludges being the last remnants of gnomes, so my men have orders not to engage them for now.$B$BHowever, the Toxic Airfield, just south of us, is teeming with living contamination. They are elementals composed of contaminated water and other toxic materials. Left unchecked, they'll overrun the town. Will you help us dispose of them?
english.completion: What a relief! Thank you for your help. I hope that gadget Engineer Grindspark was working on helps get the airfield cleaned up permanently.
english.completed: Return to Corporal Fizzwhistle in New Tinkertown.

text.title: 人们的希望
text.objectives: 把杂味炖肉带给哨兵岭的希望·萨丁。
text.description: 大约四年前，在一个深夜，有一名小姑娘来到了农庄，倒在了我们屋里。没人知道她的身份，可怜的小家伙也记不起来自己是谁，打哪儿来——真是没了根的孩子。$B$B不久以后，我们就收养了她，给她起名叫希望——因为那就是她对我们的意义。$B$B现在出落成大姑娘啦，照顾着西部荒野贫苦的人们。把杂味炖肉帮我给她带去，就在南边哨兵岭。
text.progress: Good day sir. How may I serve you?
text.completion: I smell Westfall stew! Mother sent you!?

english.title: Hope for the People
english.objectives: Take the Westfall Stew to Hope Saldean at Sentinel Hill.
english.description: About four years ago, in the dead of the night, a little girl walked right into our farmhouse and collapsed on the floor. Nobody had a clue as to her identity. The poor little thing had no recollection of who she was or where she came from - truly a lost soul.$B$BSoon after, we adopted the little girl and named her Hope - for that is what she represented.$B$BShe is now a young lady, caring for the destitute and homeless of Westfall. Take my Westfall stew to her at Sentinel Hill, south of here.
english.progress: Good day sir. How may I serve you?
english.completion: I smell Westfall stew! Mother sent you!?

text.title: 清理隐匿石
text.objectives: Kill 10 Jade Oozes.
text.description: Years ago, there used to be a Horde base deep within Skulk Rock. It's been abandoned since then, but it's still prime territory, worth reclaiming.$B$BThe problem is, it's full of oozes by now. They're nasty things... mindless, corrosive, eat anything they find.$B$BI need someone brave to go to Skulk Rock and get rid of those slimes. Are you brave enough, $n?
text.completion: It's good to see you back... and not missing any limbs, either.
text.completed: Return to Elder Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.

english.title: Skulk Rock Clean-Up
english.objectives: Kill 10 Jade Oozes.
english.description: Years ago, there used to be a Horde base deep within Skulk Rock. It's been abandoned since then, but it's still prime territory, worth reclaiming.$B$BThe problem is, it's full of oozes by now. They're nasty things... mindless, corrosive, eat anything they find.$B$BI need someone brave to go to Skulk Rock and get rid of those slimes. Are you brave enough, $n?
english.completion: It's good to see you back... and not missing any limbs, either.
english.completed: Return to Elder Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.

text.title: 隐匿石补给
text.objectives: 收集5个污泥覆盖的补给箱。
