english.description: You don't want to waste your time talking to me right now, $glad:lass;. Thargas Anvilmar himself is just on the other side of these wagons.$B$BSurely you've heard of him? He fought to defend the Thandol Span from the Dark Iron alongside the King of Stormwind! He's one of the finest heroes of Ironforge.$B$BRight now though, he's in the thick of it! Go out there and let him know you're ready to help. Just keep a good distance, he swings wide.
english.completion: Well met! If you've got a weapon on you, I'll take any help I can get clearing out these crazed fools!

text.title: 磐石关系
text.objectives: 去找崎石废土的东南的耐心者岱亚曼塔。
text.description: <诺莎拉触摸地面想探究岱亚曼塔的位置所在，但不久却惊讶地跳了起来。>$B$B天呐！真没想到。岱亚曼塔根本就不远。当我寻找他时，他立刻回答，并且告诉了我去哪儿能找到他。朝崎石废土的东北角走——岱亚曼塔应该在那里等着你。$B$B$N，当心点。大地的造物虽说不大像是会设埋伏，可一开始这样围攻神殿也不是它们通常作为。
text.completion: Ah... you must be the $r that I was expecting.$B$BYou have come on behalf of the Earthen Ring then?

english.title: Rocky Relations
english.objectives: Find Diamant the Patient at the northeast edge of the Jagged Wastes.
english.description: <Norsala reaches to the ground in an attempt to discern Diamant's location, but jumps back in shock after a moment's contact.>$B$BMy! Dat was unexpected. Diamant ain't far at all. When I reached out ta him, he spoke back wit me and told me where we could be finin' him. Head towards tha northeastern edge of the Jagged Wastes - Diamant will be expectin' ya.$B$B$N, be careful. It may be unlike an earth bein' to lay an ambush, but it was unlike dem to siege the temple in da first place.
english.completion: Ah... you must be the $r that I was expecting.$B$BYou have come on behalf of the Earthen Ring then?

text.title: 还有一件事
text.objectives: 把杰萨普的报告书交给新工匠镇的大工匠梅卡托克。
text.description: 好的，现在是时候收拾收拾，接着干下一件工作了。总有别的东西等着要炸。某个地方，有座山要移走，或是需要弄一个峡谷出来。$B$B我想要不你再帮我一个忙？你能不能把这份报告交给新工匠镇的大工匠梅卡托克？最好让他知道，穴居人永远都不再会打扰他的人了。
text.progress: 欢迎回来，$N。
text.completion: Splendid news! With the troggs taken care of, we should be able to turn our attention to Crushcog's troublemaking.
text.completed: Bring Jessup's Report to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown.

english.title: One More Thing
english.objectives: Bring Jessup's Report to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown.
english.description: Well, it's time to start packin' up and movin' on to the next job. There's always somethin' else to blow up out there. Somewhere, there's a mountain needs movin' or a gorge that needs carvin', and I'll be there to do it.$B$BI don't suppose you'd do me one more favor? Would you take this report back to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown? He needs to know that th' troggs won't be botherin' his people again anytime soon.
english.progress: Welcome back, $n.
english.completion: Splendid news! With the troggs taken care of, we should be able to turn our attention to Crushcog's troublemaking.
english.completed: Bring Jessup's Report to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown.

text.title: 谁是大个子巨魔？
text.objectives: 到祖昆达获得甘祖拉恩的躯体。
text.description: <颅骨再度开口。>$B$B我的灵魂准备好了，但是我的身体还没有。血顶巨魔很久以前就把我的旧身毁坏了。他们在我身上施加的恐惧……我的灵魂看着他们把我的身体撕裂，然后，然后……我说不下去了。$B$B他们的酋长，甘祖拉恩，主持了这场可怕的暴行。事实上，要是我没记错的话，他也是个强大有力的巨魔……差不多和我一般大小。多妙的巧合啊。$B$B你知道该怎么做了，$R。动作快点。
text.progress: Gan'zulah...
text.completion: You have done well, $r.  Only one more step remains before I may return.
text.completed: Return to the Bubbling Cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: HE'S a big troll.

english.title: Who's a Big Troll?
english.objectives: Obtain Gan'zulah's Body from Zul'Kunda.
english.description: <The skull speaks once more.>$b$bMy soul is ready, but my body is not.  The Bloodscalps desecrated my old body long ago.  The horrors that they inflicted upon me... my spirit watched on while they tore my body apart and, and... I can't go on.$b$bTheir chief, Gan'zulah, presided over the gruesome acts.  In fact, if memory serves, he was a strong, powerful troll... about the same size as I was.  What a fine coincidence.$b$bYou know what to do, $r.  Make it quick.
english.progress: Gan'zulah...
english.completion: You have done well, $r.  Only one more step remains before I may return.
english.completed: Return to the Bubbling Cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.giverWindow: HE'S a big troll.

text.title: 碎轮的爪牙
text.objectives: 在碎轮的军械库杀死8名碎轮的爪牙。你可以杀死被辐射的技师或碎轮机动战士。
text.description: 我们的宿敌瑟玛普拉格一直在尽全力阻挠我们完成对诺莫瑞根的重建和改造。他已经派最忠诚的狗腿子拉齐诺·碎轮，带着一支被辐射的侏儒大军来侵扰我们。$B$B他们在路北边占据了一所旧军械库，碎轮的技师正在修理那些武器。我们必须赶在他们让步行坦克重新启动之前阻止他们。到碎轮的军械库去，尽你所能把那些技师消灭掉。
text.completion: That should set back Crushcog's plans a bit, but we can't rest until he is defeated and Chill Breeze Valley is secure.
text.completed: Return to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown.

english.title: Crushcog's Minions
english.objectives: Kill 8 of Crushcog's Minions at Crushcog's Arsenal. You may kill Irradiated Technicians or Crushcog's Battle Suits.
english.description: Our old enemy, Thermaplugg, is doing his best to keep us from rebuilding and finishing our reclamation of Gnomeregan. He's sent one of his most loyal henchmen, Razlo Crushcog, and a force of irradiated gnomes to harry us.$B$BThey've taken over an old arsenal up the road to the north, and Crushcog's technicians are repairing those weapons. We have to stop them before they're able to get those mechano-tanks back online. Go to Crushcog's Arsenal and eliminate as many of the technicians as you can.
english.completion: That should set back Crushcog's plans a bit, but we can't rest until he is defeated and Chill Breeze Valley is secure.
english.completed: Return to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown.

text.title: 劈颅巨魔的魔精
text.objectives: 从赞塔加废墟和巴里亚曼废墟里的劈颅巨魔那里获得6份劈颅巨魔的魔精。
text.description: <颅骨又开口了。>$B$B我有身体了，谢谢你，谢谢你的迅猛龙，还有甘祖拉恩。现在，假如我没记错的话，你和你的巫医朋友还需要魔精才能完成这仪式。$B$B血顶的魔精藏在祖昆达，但它太弱了。你们暗矛的魔精也用不上。不……你要拿的，是东边河对岸劈颅巨魔的魔精。$B$B快去快回，$R。我在这儿看着……
text.completion: Excellent work, $r.  You and your raptor have done a great thing.  Hakkar would be most pleased...
text.completed: Return to the Bubbling Cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Skullsplitter Mojo
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Skullsplitter Mojos from Skullsplitter trolls in the Ziata'jai Ruins and the Balia'mah Ruins.
english.description: <The skull speaks again.>$b$bI have my body, thanks to you, your raptor, and Gan'zulah.  Now, if I remember correctly, you and your witch doctor friend will need some mojo to complete this ritual.$b$bThe Bloodscalps keep mojo in Zul'Kunda, but it is weak.  Your Darkspears' mojo will not work either.  No... you want to take from the Skullsplitter trolls, across the river to the east.$b$bHurry back, $r.  I will be watching...
english.completion: Excellent work, $r.  You and your raptor have done a great thing.  Hakkar would be most pleased...
english.completed: Return to the Bubbling Cauldron at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 没坦克！
text.objectives: 用高新榴弹在碎轮的军械库摧毁5台修复的步行坦克。
text.description: 拉齐诺·碎轮让他手下被辐射的技师们修理步行坦克，我们想弄清楚他们到底要干什么，为此我们损失了不少斥候。$B$B我们拖不起，必须在碎轮让他的追随者拿起武器对抗我们之前赶紧行动。$B$B这种高新榴弹里的装药足够摧毁步行坦克，让碎轮无法使用。带上它沿着路前往北边碎轮的军械库，干掉那些坦克！
text.completion: Mekkatorque will be pleased to hear that you've ruined Crushcog's plans to use our old weapons for his followers. Without the mechano-tanks under his command, he'll be weak and vulnerable.
text.completed: Return to Hinkles Fastblast in New Tinkertown.

english.title: No Tanks!
english.objectives: Use the Techno-Grenade to destroy 5 Repaired Mechano-Tanks at Crushcog's Arsenal.
english.description: We've lost more than a couple scouts trying to find out what exactly Razlo Crushcog plans to do with all those mechano-tanks his irradiated technicians are repairing.$B$BWe can't afford to take it slowly anymore. We must act before Crushcog turns his followers and his weapons on us.$B$BThis techno-grenade packs enough explosive power to destroy the mechano-tanks and deny Crushcog their use. Take it north with you along the road to Crushcog's Arsenal and take out those tanks!
english.completion: Mekkatorque will be pleased to hear that you've ruined Crushcog's plans to use our old weapons for his followers. Without the mechano-tanks under his command, he'll be weak and vulnerable.
english.completed: Return to Hinkles Fastblast in New Tinkertown.

text.title: 血领主曼多基尔
text.objectives: Deliver the Lashtail Raptor Egg Fragment to Bloodlord Mandokir in Grom'gol Base Camp.
text.description: $R.  $R, $r, $r... you didn't think I was a friend, did you, $r?  Ah, ha ha haaaa!$b$bYou've served your purpose.  I've returned to the realm of the living, and it's all thanks to you.  So, instead of killing you, I'm going to make you a deal instead.$b$bGive me the raptor.$b$bYou must already know that she's no normal raptor, and I need a replacement for Ohgan.  Do it, or both you and the witch doctor will taste my rage.
text.progress: All I ask is the raptor, $r.  Give it to me, and the troll lives.
text.completion: I'm glad to see you've come to your senses. Come and visit us in Zul'Gurub sometime, $r.  I'll be watching...

english.title: Bloodlord Mandokir
english.objectives: Deliver the Lashtail Raptor Egg Fragment to Bloodlord Mandokir in Grom'gol Base Camp.
english.description: $R.  $R, $r, $r... you didn't think I was a friend, did you, $r?  Ah, ha ha haaaa!$b$bYou've served your purpose.  I've returned to the realm of the living, and it's all thanks to you.  So, instead of killing you, I'm going to make you a deal instead.$b$bGive me the raptor.$b$bYou must already know that she's no normal raptor, and I need a replacement for Ohgan.  Do it, or both you and the witch doctor will taste my rage.
english.progress: All I ask is the raptor, $r.  Give it to me, and the troll lives.
english.completion: I'm glad to see you've come to your senses. Come and visit us in Zul'Gurub sometime, $r.  I'll be watching...

text.title: 海军预备
text.objectives: 调查荡寇号的船壳。
text.description: 地狱咆哮总攻的时候要的是一支舰队，但码头这儿的进度已经落下几个星期了。成本不少，结果不多。腐败很成问题啊，$N！我要你把事情查个清楚。$B$B泊在西北码头上的荡寇号是艘战舰，理应在几天前就装驳完毕了。你亲自到施工现场监督。$B$B看看究竟是谁在干扰咱们海军作业，对付他们！
text.completion: <Here, in excruciating detail, are the blueprints for the Foebreaker.>$B$B<You twist the documents every which way, trying to make sense of the incomprehensible scribbles, notes, and corrections.>
text.completed: Investigate the Hull of the Foebreaker.

english.title: Ready the Navy
english.objectives: Investigate the Hull of the Foebreaker.
english.description: Hellscream expects an armada of ships for his invasion, but the docks here are weeks behind schedule. Costs are rampant and quality is poor. Corruption is the problem, $N! And I need you to root it out.$B$BThe Foebreaker, a warship berthed at the northwest pier, should have been outfitted days ago. Something reeks. Go there and oversee the construction yourself.$B$BFind out who's disrupting our naval preparations and deal with them!
english.completion: <Here, in excruciating detail, are the blueprints for the Foebreaker.>$B$B<You twist the documents every which way, trying to make sense of the incomprehensible scribbles, notes, and corrections.>
english.completed: Investigate the Hull of the Foebreaker.

text.title: Shakes O'Breen
text.objectives: 去找阿拉希高地法迪尔海湾的沙克斯·奥布里。
text.description: 没关系，$N。你并不是每天都能遇到所谓的英雄，背井离乡还依然脑子清醒的，因此我可以给你点工作来做。$B$B我有个朋友叫作沙克斯·奥布里。他是一船海盗的船长，黑水强盗，他们可是好人啊，在海盗里可算是备受尊敬。法迪尔海湾的码头就藏在南边的海岸。$B$B要是你感兴趣的话，我肯定奥布里有能赚钱的工作给你。
text.completion: Ahoy, $c. Any friend of Skuerto is a friend of mine. You'll find plenty of work needs doin' around here. We're not sittin' in this cove twiddlin' our thumbs by choice.

english.title: Shakes O'Breen
english.objectives: Find Shakes O'Breen at Faldir's Cove in Arathi Highlands.
english.description: You're all right, $n. It's not every day you come across a so-called hero that has a clue what they're doing once they get this far from home, so I'll let you in on some more work.$B$BI've a friend by the name of Shakes O'Breen. He's the captain of a crew of pirates, the Blackwater Raiders; good men, respectable as pirates go. They dock at Faldir's Cove, hidden along the southern shore.$B$BI'm sure O'Breen will have lucrative jobs for you if you're interested.
english.completion: Ahoy, $c. Any friend of Skuerto is a friend of mine. You'll find plenty of work needs doin' around here. We're not sittin' in this cove twiddlin' our thumbs by choice.

text.title: 打压市场
text.objectives: 在锈水港抓住一个锈水工头，给他上一课。
text.description: <不难看出为什么荡寇号工期延误了。每隔一天，一名工头就来把蓝图换掉。>$B$B<最麻烦的是最近一次更换，工人们被要求将铆钉卸下以节约成本！>$B$B<你最好抓住一个干这事儿的锈水工头，趁部落还没因为船难出人命之前，以儆效尤。>
text.completion: So they were trying to skimp on production costs? Unacceptable! I'm glad you knocked some sense into them. If that foreman makes good on his word, our fleet will be ship-shape in time for the invasion.
text.completed: Return to Warlord Krogg at Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara.

english.title: Beating the Market
english.objectives: Track down a Bilgewater Foreman somewhere in Bilgewater Harbor and knock him around a little.
english.description: <It's not hard to see why the Foebreaker is behind schedule. Every other day, a foreman comes in and changes the blueprints.>$B$B<Most troubling are the recent alterations. The workers have been ordered to remove rivets to save on costs!>$B$B<You'd better track down one of the Bilgewater foremen responsible for this and make an example out of him, before any Horde lives are lost in a faulty ship.>
english.completion: So they were trying to skimp on production costs? Unacceptable! I'm glad you knocked some sense into them. If that foreman makes good on his word, our fleet will be ship-shape in time for the invasion.
english.completed: Return to Warlord Krogg at Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara.

text.title: 巨魔人口控制
text.objectives: 杀死7名血顶秘法师、7名血顶猎人、7名血顶斥候，以及1名血顶兽王。
text.description: 我知道你就要出发前往祖昆达了。你到那儿的时候，我有件事要拜托你办。$B$B巨魔在荆棘谷的数量失去了控制。西边的血顶，东边的劈颅……他们从废墟里蜂拥而出，来到丛林，干扰着地区的自然平衡。我们该让平衡恢复了。$B$B祖昆达是血顶的首都，在那里你将会发现血顶巨魔的高层人员。削减一下他们的数量，然后回来告诉我。
text.completion: Balance is restored - for now.  We may call on you again in the future, $n.
text.completed: Return to Far Seer Mok'thardin at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Population Con-Troll
english.objectives: Slay 7 Bloodscalp Mystics, 7 Bloodscalp Hunters, 7 Bloodscalp Scouts, and 1 Bloodscalp Beastmaster.
english.description: I understand you may be headed to Zul'Kunda soon.  While you are there, I have a small task for you.$b$bThe trolls are outgrowing Stranglethorn.  The Bloodscalp in the West, the Skullsplitters in the East... they pour out of their ruins and into the jungle, disrupting the natural balance of the region.  It is time we restored that balance.$b$bZul'Kunda is the Bloodscalp capital.  Inside you will find the most high-ranking Bloodscalps.  Reduce their numbers, then return to me.
english.completion: Balance is restored - for now.  We may call on you again in the future, $n.
english.completed: Return to Far Seer Mok'thardin at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 烈酒村的准备
text.objectives: 跟烈酒村的加尔维·影踪谈一谈。
text.description: 大工匠梅卡托克、他的军事顾问和我敲定对拉齐诺·碎轮发动进攻的计划时，我已经派助手先一步前往烈酒村开始着手准备了。$B$B沿着镇子外的路往东南，就能到达烈酒村。你到了以后，去找加尔维·影踪，看他是否需要帮助。我们的矮人表亲已经从铁炉堡派了一批巡山人来同我们一起征讨碎轮。
text.completion: Ah, yes, Kelsey told me to expect you. There's still much to do before we can take on Crushcog.
text.completed: 跟烈酒村的加尔维·影踪谈一谈。

english.title: Staging in Brewnall
english.objectives: Speak with Jarvi Shadowstep at Brewnall Village.
english.description: While High Tinker Mekkatorque, his military advisors, and I finalize the plans for the attack on Razlo Crushcog, I've sent my assistant ahead to Brewnall Village to begin preparations.$B$BTo get to Brewnall Village, follow the road southeast out of town. Once you arrive, find Jarvi Shadowstep and see if he needs any help. Our dwarven cousins have dispatched a cadre of mountaineers from Ironforge to join us in the fight against Crushcog.
english.completion: Ah, yes, Kelsey told me to expect you. There's still much to do before we can take on Crushcog.
english.completed: Speak with Jarvi Shadowstep at Brewnall Village.

text.title: 狩猎
text.objectives: 去找北荆棘谷奈辛瓦里远征队营地的巴尼尔·石罐。
text.description: 艾泽拉斯有那么多地方好去，我偏偏被困在了格罗姆高。劫掠成性的猛兽，抢劫车队的事件，不断来袭的巨魔……我居然还活着，真是了不起。$B$B事情还可能更糟，我想。至少在格罗姆高咱们还有高墙和守卫呢。有一群猎人在北边搭了个营地，就在丛林深处！$B$B我常看见人们往那儿去。要是你想找麻烦，不妨到那里去看看。我就待在我的格罗姆高好了。
text.completion: Hmm?  Barnil's the name.  And you are...?

english.title: The Hunt
english.objectives: Report to Barnil Stonepot at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.description: Of all the places to end up across Azeroth, I'm stuck here in Grom'gol.  With the marauding wildlife, the caravan raids, and the constant threat of troll attacks, I'm surprised I've survived for this long.$b$bCould be worse, I suppose.  At least here in Grom'gol we have walls and guards.  There's a group of hunters up north that set up camp right in the middle of the jungle!$b$bI see people heading there all the time.  If you're looking for trouble, feel free to head up there.  I'll stick with my Grom'gol.
english.completion: Hmm?  Barnil's the name.  And you are...?

text.title: 石之碎片
text.objectives: 调查密斯莱尔碎片。
text.description: I've scouted all over these highlands, $n, and there's one thing I've found I haven't been able to explain.$B$BTo the northeast of here, there's a circle of stones, like the others you'll find everythwhere in Arathi... but the largest and most imposing of them, built into the mountainside itself.$B$BJust between you and me, I heard voices while I was there. Whispers of the earth. If you're the curious type, you could go see for yourself...
text.completion: Help...

english.title: The Stone Shards
english.objectives: Investigate the Shards of Myzrael.
english.description: I've scouted all over these highlands, $n, and there's one thing I've found I haven't been able to explain.$B$BTo the northeast of here, there's a circle of stones, like the others you'll find everythwhere in Arathi... but the largest and most imposing of them, built into the mountainside itself.$B$BJust between you and me, I heard voices while I was there. Whispers of the earth. If you're the curious type, you could go see for yourself...
english.completion: Help...

text.title: 涂成黑色
text.objectives: 用喷漆枪弄瞎5个碎轮哨戒机器人。
text.description: 我们有可靠情报称，拉奇诺·碎轮在涌冰湖中央小岛建立起了防御阵地。让事情更糟的是，他用哨戒机器人把自己围了起来，可以侦测到所有可能的来犯者。$B$B如果要除掉碎轮，我们就要把机器人给干掉。这个装置可以发射一种黑色的粘稠油漆，能把碎轮哨戒机器人的光学感应器遮罩住。用它把他的预警系统关掉。
text.completion: You've given us just the opening we'll need to get the drop on Crushcog. Excellent work, $n.
text.completed: Return to Jarvi Shadowstep at Brewnall Village.

english.title: Paint it Black
english.objectives: Use the Paintinator to blind 5 of Crushcog's Sentry-Bots.
english.description: We have reliable intelligence that Razlo Crushcog has taken up a defensive position on the island in the middle of frozen Iceflow Lake. To make matters worse, he's surrounded himself with a network of sentry-bots that will detect any possible attackers.$B$BIf we're to take on Crushcog, we'll need to take out those sentries. This device launches a dark, sticky paint that will coat the optical sensors of Crushcog's sentry-bots. Use it to take out his early warning system.
english.completion: You've given us just the opening we'll need to get the drop on Crushcog. Excellent work, $n.
english.completed: Return to Jarvi Shadowstep at Brewnall Village.

text.title: 供与求
text.objectives: 将2张淡水鳄的皮交给奈辛瓦里远征队营地的崔斯里克。
text.description: “前无古人，后无来者，南海一带最好的也是世界最好的皮匠。”他们就是这么叫我的。我！崔斯里克！最好的皮……呃，好吧。$B$B我的皮货以质量优质而远近闻名，都是鉴赏家们的首选之物！$B$B我最近收到了来自工匠行会的雷德沃克斯主管的订单，他需要十二双刨花皮靴。啊，就是那种由我制作的、非常抢手的靴子。$B$B不过要想做那种靴子的话，我需要一些鳄鱼皮才行。在荆棘谷北边的河边有很多鳄鱼，你看能不能……
text.progress: 其他的东西我早就准备好了，$N，就差那些皮啦。我们可不能让雷德沃克斯等太久，对吧?$B$B要是让这位技工协会的首席发明家等得不耐烦了，我可要吃不了兜着走啊。
text.completion: 这些皮我看应该够了。既然是用来做靴子里的鞋垫，那它们的品质就不是非常重要的啦，但至少要足够舒适才行。$B$B不过这皮看来有点硬，我得用些老虎的血来把它们弄得柔软一些。无奸不商，无商不奸，你懂吗?$B$B
text.completed: Return to Drizzlik at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Supply and Demand
english.objectives: Bring 2 Large River Crocolisk Skins to Drizzlik at Nesingwary's Expedition.
english.description: "The finest leathercrafter of the South Seas and the worlds old and new." That's what they call me. Me! Drizzlik! The finest lea... Ahem. Well.$b$bMy leather goods are known far and wide as the most exquisite, a connoisseur's choice!$b$bI've just received an order from Director Riddlevox of the Tinkers' Union for a dozen of his favorite Excelsior-line boots. Our best sellers, actually.$b$bTo start on the basic shape, I'll need crocolisk skins from the crocs along the river in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.progress: My equipment is all ready to go, $n, I just need those skins. We don't want to keep Riddlevox waiting, that's for sure.$b$bIt's not a good idea for anyone to keep the chief inventor of the Tinkers' Union unsatisfied.
english.completion: These skins should do. Their quality isn't too important, given that they'll make up the inside layer of the boots, but it's still important that they're comfortable. If they're a bit too rigid, I'll use some tiger blood to soften it up. Tricks o' the trade, you know?
english.completed: Return to Drizzlik at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 收集鳄鱼皮
text.objectives: 将5张钳嘴鳄鱼皮交给奈辛瓦里远征队营地的崔斯里克。
text.description: 嗯，这些靴子已经基本定型，接下来就要开始打磨表面了。但你带来的皮似乎少了点，做不出足够的鞋垫来。$B$B“那现在我们得干什么呢，崔斯里克？”你肯定会马上问这种问题，哈哈，你跟崔斯里克说话可真不幸啊，因为我马上就要给你派活干啦！$B$B没人会去观察鞋垫的，所以我们只要找点又厚又便宜的鳄鱼皮就行了。纳菲瑞提湖旁边的那种钳嘴鳄鱼就不错。
text.progress: 崔斯里克的刨花皮靴，最好的做工，百分之百海鳄皮。没什麽比这更好的啦!$B$B简直找不出合适的形容词来形容它，不是吗?$B$B还是说，你把那些皮带来给我了吗?
text.completion: 我的靴子……就跟香肠一样好，$N。多麽漂亮的外形，多麽舒适的感觉。我跟你说啊，就像是用最好的材料和最好的肉做成的香肠那样，尝试一次，终身难忘呀!$B$B穿它走路很安全，也非常舒适，你得相信我，另外别问我这里面到底用的是什麽材料。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Drizzlik at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Some Assembly Required
english.objectives: Bring 5 Snapjaw Crocolisks Skins to Drizzlik at Nesingwary's Expedition.
english.description: Well, I've got the basic shape of the boots worked out, and they're coming along fine, but the skins you brought aren't going to be quite enough for the inner layers.$b$b"What are we going to do, Drizzlik?" No doubt the question on your lips, and well, isn't it lucky you're talking to Drizzlik, because he's going to tell you what we're going to do!$b$bThe inner layers will never really be seen, so we'll just get some of the thicker, cheaper skins from the crocs around Lake Nazferiti to fill the boots out.
english.progress: Drizzlik's Excelsior leather boots, finest workmanship, one-hundred percent high quality saltwater crocolisk skin boots. None finer!$b$bCan't beat a glowing description like that, can you?$b$bExcept, maybe, if you have those skins for me?
english.completion: My boots... they're like sausages, $n. Look great, taste great. I tell you they're filled with nothing but the finest ingredients and meats, and you eat it, and you love it. It's safer--and more enjoyable--if you just trust me, and don't ask too carefully what's really inside.
english.completed: Return to Drizzlik at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 木丝
text.objectives: 将一张老鳄鱼的皮交给奈辛瓦里远征队营地的崔斯里克。
text.description: 里面完工了，剩下来就是帮楦了。这部分，我只用最好的老鳄鱼皮。它们更耐久，而且更方便你在上面设计花样图案——如果你愿意的话，这样就可以完成崔斯里克的精制系列啦。$B$B不过这种完美的皮很难找到，唯一符合我要求的就是老海鳄的皮。它们在南边，靠近海角边界的地方可以找到。
text.progress: I read somewhere that the elder crocolisks are slowly dying out... bad news for my business, isn't it?$b$bAnyways, I hope you have that elder snapjaw crocolisk skin for me!
text.completion: 好极了!谢谢你的帮忙，我现在可以完成这笔订单，然後在下次运货的时候把它寄给地下矿坑的主管雷德沃克斯。甚至还可以提早给他!$B$B为了对你的帮助表示感谢，我特别为你多做了一双，拿着吧。是我崔斯里克送你的。$B$B记住，没什麽靴子比崔斯里克的雕花皮靴更完美了!$B$B
text.completed: Return to Drizzlik at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Excelsior
english.objectives: Bring an Elder Crocolisk Skin to Drizzlik at Nesingwary's Expedition.
english.description: With the inside finished, all that's left is to add the outer layer. For this, I use only the best elder croc skins. They are more durable and a better canvas--if you will--for adding the designs and accents that make Drizzlik's Excelsior line.$b$bIt's hard to find that perfect skin though, the only one that fits my plan is the skin of an elder snapjaw crocolisk.  Find them to the south, near the border with the cape.
english.progress: I read somewhere that the elder crocolisks are slowly dying out... bad news for my business, isn't it?$b$bAnyways, I hope you have that elder snapjaw crocolisk skin for me!
english.completion: Great! Thanks to your help I'll have this order filled and sent off to Director Riddlevox on the next boat to Undermine. Ahead of schedule, even! For all your hard work, here, I made some extras, so take a pair. It's on Drizzlik. And remember, there's no boot so fine as one of Drizzlik's Excelsior line!
english.completed: Return to Drizzlik at Nesingwary's Expedition in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 密斯莱尔的传说
text.objectives: 去找阿拉希高地避难谷地的斯奎尔图。
text.description: 石头终于安静了下来，但你却隐约感觉到了一股不安。有什么不对劲。$B$B也许你应该把目前的发现告诉斯奎尔图。
text.completion: Say no more, $n. I followed up with an... "old friend" while you were gone. I should've known better than to send you to those shards. We've both made a grave mistake in involving ourselves in this. Luckily, I "persuaded" my boy Gerrig to tell me what to do if this happened.

english.title: Myzrael's Tale
english.objectives: Return to Skuerto at Refuge Pointe in Arathi Highlands.
english.description: As the stone goes quiet, you're left with a vague sense of unease. Something isn't right.$B$BPerhaps you should tell Skuerto of what you've done so far.
english.completion: Say no more, $n. I followed up with an... "old friend" while you were gone. I should've known better than to send you to those shards. We've both made a grave mistake in involving ourselves in this. Luckily, I "persuaded" my boy Gerrig to tell me what to do if this happened.

text.title: 长明的灯塔
text.objectives: 给西部荒野灯塔的葛瑞森船长带5份裂隙软泥。
text.description: 灯塔看守一家被杀的那晚教人惨不忍睹，而我却只好在老瞎眼杀进去的时候眼睁睁地瞧着。但往事已矣，我眼下关心的是无尽之海那些接近海岸危险礁石的船只，还有上面水手的性命。既然没有人来看管灯火，那我责无旁贷。$B$B去东北方的地怒裂口，从那些裂口软泥怪身上给我收集几块裂隙软泥回来，这样方能帮助我使这些火炬长明不灭。
text.progress: The flame will not burn for long without ooze, $n. We used to use oil back in the day, but it was hard to come by!
text.completion: 我赞美你，勇敢的$C。由於你的努力，西部荒野海岸旁的礁石将会被照亮。长明的灯火会拯救许多人的生命。$B$B我就是因为船只撞进了那片礁石才死去的，我绝对不会再让任何人步上我的後尘了。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse in Westfall.

english.title: Keeper of the Flame
english.objectives: Bring 5 Chasm Oozes to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
english.description: The night the Lighthouse Keeper's family died was horrible.  I watched, helpless, as Old Murk-Eye led the attack.  But what's done is done and now my concern is for the lives of the sailors on The Great Sea whose ships come close to the perilous rocks of the coastline.  With no one to keep watch on the flame the responsibility has fallen upon me.$b$bHelp me keep the torch lit by bringing me chasm ooze from the slimes in the Raging Chasm to the northeast.
english.progress: The flame will not burn for long without ooze, $n. We used to use oil back in the day, but it was hard to come by!
english.completion: Praise you, brave $c.  The rocks of the Westfall Coast shall be lit thanks to your hard work.  Many lives will be spared so long as the torch is kept lit. I died needlessly on this very shore.  My afterlife plight is to see that no others follow my destiny.
english.completed: Return to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse in Westfall.

text.title: 清理海岸
text.objectives: 杀死7名潮行鱼人和7名鱼人智者。
text.description: 你也许注意到岸边的这些船骸了。无尽之海是无情的。西部荒野的海岸必须清理，不然航行到我们这里的水手们就不安全。鱼人们也是个麻烦。$B$B把潮行鱼人和鱼人智者杀掉，我保证有你的好处。
text.completion: 做得好，$N。你的战斗能力非常不错。由於你的努力，西部荒野的海岸变的更安全了。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse in Westfall.

english.title: The Coast Isn't Clear
english.objectives: Kill 7 Murloc Tidehunters and 7 Murloc Oracles.
english.description: You probably noticed all of the shipwrecks along the coast.  The Great Sea is treacherous indeed.  The coast of Westfall needs to be kept clear, so that if sailors find their way to our beaches, they are safe.  The Murlocs are trouble though.$b$bKill murloc tidehunters and oracles and I will see to it that you are rewarded.
english.completion: Well done, $n.  You have quite a knack for combat.  Thanks to you the Coast of Westfall is a safer place.
english.completed: Return to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse in Westfall.

text.title: 海岸上的威胁
text.objectives: 将老瞎眼的鳞片交给西部荒野灯塔旁的葛瑞森船长。
text.description: 当我的生命终结在了那片岩石上之后，我根本不知道死后的世界会是怎样的。那天晚上的灯塔一片漆黑，因为老瞎眼吓跑了管理员全家。他们本已经逃跑了，但那天晚上他们又回来想要点亮灯塔，结果老瞎眼带着一群野蛮的鱼人突袭了灯塔。这一次，管理员的全家都在我面前无助地死去了……$B$B如果你在海岸边看到老瞎眼的话，就杀死它，把它的鳞片给我带回来，我会奖励你的。
text.progress: 你已经消除了老瞎眼的威胁了吗?有人看见它今天早上在西部荒野的海岸线上闲逛。$B$B把这只邪恶的野兽干掉以後再回来找我。
text.completion: 老瞎眼这个邪恶而卑鄙的家伙终於死了。干得好，$N。虽然有一条生命死在你的手上，但更多的生命会因此而获救。无尽之海虽然还是暗藏着数不清的危险，但在你英勇地斩杀了老瞎眼家伙之後，今夜它似乎又安全了许多。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse in Westfall.

english.title: The Coastal Menace
english.objectives: Bring a scale of Old Murk-Eye to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse.
english.description: When my life was ended upon the rocks, I had no clue what the afterlife held for me.  The Lighthouse was black that night because Old Murk-Eye had scared the keeper's family off.  They returned and re-lit the flame but Old Murk-Eye coerced the weaker minded murlocs to raid the Lighthouse with him once again.  The second time the family was not so lucky and before my eyes they perished helplessly.$b$bSlay Old Murk-Eye if you see him along the shore and bring me one of his scales and I shall reward you.
english.progress: Have you laid waste to the menace known as Old Murk-Eye yet?  He has been spotted roaming the coastline of Westfall. Return to me when the foul beast is dead.
english.completion: So the foul heathen, Murk-Eye is dead.  Well done, $n.  By your hands one life was laid to rest but perhaps many more were saved.  The Great Sea, wrought with danger as it is, shall be a wee bit safer this night thanks to your heroics.
english.completed: Return to Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse in Westfall.

text.title: 女祭司胡纳拉
text.objectives: 跟北荆棘谷邦巴拉的女祭司胡纳拉谈一谈。
text.description: 谢谢你，$N。我知道你没有必要救我的命，还有……好吧，我很感谢你。$B$B血领主曼多基尔的回归真是个坏消息。他多年前被消灭在祖尔格拉布，我们以为他是那一族中最后一个了。祖尔格拉布的巨魔一直在尝试举行某种邪恶而可怕的仪式。如果曼多基尔复活了，那么就有理由相信他不是唯一的一个。$B$B东边邦巴拉的巨魔或许知道得更多，去和他们的女祭司谈一谈。
text.completion: Mandokir is alive, yes. You are responsible, yes. You may be able to stop him still, yes.

english.title: Priestess Hu'rala
english.objectives: Speak with Priestess Hu'rala at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.description: Thank you, $n.  I know you didn't have to save my life, and... well, I am thankful.$b$bThe return of Bloodlord Mandokir is ill news.  He was killed inside Zul'Gurub several years ago, and we thought we had seen the last of him and his kind.  The trolls of Zul'Gurub were attempting to perform a hideous, horrible ritual.  If Mandokir is alive, then it stands to reason that he is not the only one.$b$bThe trolls at Bambala in the east may know more.  Speak with their priestess.
english.completion: Mandokir is alive, yes. You are responsible, yes. You may be able to stop him still, yes.

text.title: 心灵视界
text.objectives: 从北荆棘谷丛林捕猎者身上获得5根丛林捕猎者的羽毛。
text.description: To know Mandokir, you must see Mandokir.$b$bTo see Mandokir, you must use eyes of raptor.$b$bYou have formed bond with raptor: Ohgan'aka: daughter of Ohgan.$b$bTo strengthen bond, we need feathers.$b$bYou will go west, and you will find the feathers, yes.
text.progress: Raptor named Ohgan'aka, still your friend.
text.completion: You bring feathers, yes. You can follow directions, yes.
text.completed: Return to Priestess Hu'rala at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Mind Vision
english.objectives: Obtain 5 Jungle Stalker Feathers from Jungle Stalkers in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.description: To know Mandokir, you must see Mandokir.$b$bTo see Mandokir, you must use eyes of raptor.$b$bYou have formed bond with raptor: Ohgan'aka: daughter of Ohgan.$b$bTo strengthen bond, we need feathers.$b$bYou will go west, and you will find the feathers, yes.
english.progress: Raptor named Ohgan'aka, still your friend.
english.completion: You bring feathers, yes. You can follow directions, yes.
english.completed: Return to Priestess Hu'rala at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: Cozzle's Plan
text.objectives: Obtain Cozzle's Key from Foreman Cozzle, then obtain the Fuel Regulator Blueprints.
text.description: I may be of Darkspear birth, but I spent my childhood here, in Stranglethorn Vale.  I've seen everything there is to see here in Stranglethorn, but the most offensive is the devastation that the Venture Company has done to the riverbed.$b$bTo make things worse, Foreman Cozzle and his crew have been increasing their activity, and I suspect they have some new plan.  Succeed where I failed, $N: Kill Cozzle, obtain his key, and steal the blueprints from his apartment.
text.progress: The Venture Company's acts against Stranglethorn cannot be forgiven.
text.completion: A fuel regulator?  This seems important.  At least, I hope it is. We may not have ended the Venture Company's operations, but we at least slowed them down.  Thank you, $n.
text.completed: Return to Kil'karil at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: Foreman Cozzle will be hiding atop his oil rig.  He'll have the key you need.

english.title: Cozzle's Plan
english.objectives: Obtain Cozzle's Key from Foreman Cozzle, then obtain the Fuel Regulator Blueprints.
english.description: I may be of Darkspear birth, but I spent my childhood here, in Stranglethorn Vale.  I've seen everything there is to see here in Stranglethorn, but the most offensive is the devastation that the Venture Company has done to the riverbed.$b$bTo make things worse, Foreman Cozzle and his crew have been increasing their activity, and I suspect they have some new plan.  Succeed where I failed, $N: Kill Cozzle, obtain his key, and steal the blueprints from his apartment.
english.progress: The Venture Company's acts against Stranglethorn cannot be forgiven.
english.completion: A fuel regulator?  This seems important.  At least, I hope it is. We may not have ended the Venture Company's operations, but we at least slowed them down.  Thank you, $n.
english.completed: Return to Kil'karil at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.giverWindow: Foreman Cozzle will be hiding atop his oil rig.  He'll have the key you need.

text.title: 杉德尔船长的宝藏
text.objectives: 找到杉德尔船长的手提箱，在箱子中寻找下一条线索。
text.description: 如果你读到这封信的话，那就意味着我，杉德尔船长，已经长眠在深深的水底了。所以，只要你按我的提示去做，我的宝藏就是你的了。$B$B首先你要找到一只小提箱，它应该就在西部荒野西海岸的某处船只残骸旁，如今八成已经快被沙子埋起来了。海岸边有许多处船只的残骸，但只有一只沉船旁有个锈掉的锚。箱子就在锚的旁边！在箱子里面，你可以找到下一条线索。
text.completion: 这只小箱子慢慢地开启。里面似乎只有沙子和水。慢着!一只小螃蟹冲了出来，宝藏的线索就在它的螯上!$B$B

english.title: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure
english.objectives: Find Captain Sanders' footlocker and search it for the next clue.
english.description: If ye be readin' this, it means that Ol' Captain Sanders is in a watery grave.  So my treasure is yours now, ye jest need to follow the clues. $b$bFirst ye need to find me footlocker.  It's probably half-buried in sand by now, along the Western Coast of Westfall near the shipwreck.  There be lots of shipwrecks but only one rusty anchor on the coast.  Find that anchor and you'll find me locker!  Look in there for the next clue.
english.completion: The footlocker slowly creaks open.  Sand and water seem to be its only contents. But wait!  A small crab scurries out with a clue to the treasure in his claws!

text.title: 杉德尔船长的宝藏
text.objectives: 找到废弃烟囱旁的老木桶，在桶里寻找下一条线索。
text.description: 你开始读小条上的字：干得好，哥们！现在你可以开始向东走，到悬崖边的路旁好好找找，看有没有一处破烟囱，你可以在那旁边的木桶中找到下一条线索。
text.progress: This looks like the right barrel.
text.completion: 做得好，宝藏猎人!$B$B

english.title: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure
english.objectives: Find the old barrel near the ruined chimney and search it for your next clue.
english.description: The clue to the treasure reads: Good work, matey!  Now ye need to head due east.  East up the bluffs, east to the road.  Look for the ol' chimney ruins near the side of the road.  There you'll find an old barrel with your next clue.
english.progress: This looks like the right barrel.
english.completion: Good work, treasure hunter!

text.title: 杉德尔船长的宝藏
text.objectives: 在风车旁的一个空水罐里寻找下一条线索。
text.description: 仔细搜索了木桶了之后，你发现了一小片羊皮纸。上面写着：现在，从桶这里转向北，像乌鸦飞翔一般绝不回头，一直走到你看见了海边悬崖上的风车为止。找到那风车旁的一个空水罐。仔细检查那个水罐，你就可以找到你要找的东西了。
text.progress: There's a clue sticking out of the empty jug.
text.completion: 你正一步步地迈向大奖，我的大探险家!$B$B

english.title: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure
english.objectives: Search the empty jug next to the windmill for the next clue.
english.description: Searching through the barrel you discover another piece of parchment.  This one reads:  Now from this here barrel, face ye North.  Straight as the crow flies, keep ye walkin' till you see the empty jug next to the lone windmill on the sea bluffs.  If ye poke around that jug, ye just might find what you're lookin' for.
english.progress: There's a clue sticking out of the empty jug.
english.completion: You're on your way to the jackpot, treasure seeker!

text.title: 杉德尔船长的宝藏
text.objectives: 找到杉德尔船长的箱子并打开它，取得你的奖励。
text.description: 显然，在这只旧罐子中藏着另一条有关杉德尔的宝藏的线索。纸上有几处墨水已经化开变得模糊不清，而且泛着一股威士忌的味道，不过你还是能从中辨认出这样的字迹：看来你找到我的威士忌罐子了，你离我的财宝已经很近啦！只要向西走到海边，然后一直向西游，你就可以游到放着小宝箱的岛上啦！
text.progress: The lost treasure of Captain Sanders awaits!
text.completion: 尽管这个箱子上的铰链已经锈了，但它仍然还有作用。你暴力的打开箱子，拿到了里面的东西。$B$B恭禧!$B$B

english.title: Captain Sanders' Hidden Treasure
english.objectives: Locate Captain Sanders' chest and open it for your reward.
english.description: Sure enough, deep within the Old Jug there is another clue to Sanders' treasure.  The ink has run in some places and the paper smells like whiskey but you can make out some of the text:  Now that ye found me ol' whiskey jug, you're almost to the treasure!  Just face West from the bottle and walk down to the shore.  Once ye get to the water, keep going!  Swim straight west till you find the island with me treasure chest!
english.progress: The lost treasure of Captain Sanders awaits!
english.completion: The hinges on the old chest are rusty but they still work.  You force the chest open and take the booty. Congratulations!

text.title: 邪恶的面貌
text.objectives: 在辛萨罗用蒂基之炬点燃8张蒂基面具。
text.description: 邪枝巨魔在辛萨罗的墙上到处挂着蒂基面具。神灵已经看不下去了。$B$B带上这把火炬，杀到邪枝中去，$C。点燃他们的蒂基面具。我会在这儿看着他们的结界和妖术消失，看着他们异端的黑巫毒飘散在烟雾中。
text.completion: Such a pretty site ta see the enemy's hopes burnin'...
text.completed: Return to Kotonga at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Faces of Evil
english.objectives: Use the Tiki Torch to set fire to 8 Tiki Masks at Jintha'Alor.
english.description: The Vilebranch have hung their tiki masks all across the walls of Jintha'Alor. The spirits not gonna be watchin' over them much longer.$B$BTake this torch with ya as ya fight through the Vilebranch, $c. Set fire to their tiki masks. I'll be watchin' from here as their wards and hexes fade away, an' their heretical dark voodoo goes up in smoke.
english.completion: Such a pretty site ta see the enemy's hopes burnin'...
english.completed: Return to Kotonga at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 空军预备
text.objectives: 在艾萨拉锈水港的垃圾场里寻找弗利普。
text.description: 我向地狱咆哮拍胸脯保证这个星期就把他的航空舰队准备好，可我们的旗舰——杜隆塔尔之矛——还没有装上主引擎。$B$B弗利普上个星期就答应好了弄台崭新的引擎来。她的垃圾场就在银行后面，看看是哪儿出岔子了。$B$B航空舰队等着咱们哪，$N！
text.completion: What? The Captain said WHAT? It's HIS fault this big beast of an engine is delayed.
text.completed: Look for Fleep at her junkyard within Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara.

english.title: Ready the Air Force
english.objectives: Look for Fleep at her junkyard within Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara.
english.description: I gave Hellscream my personal guarantee that I'd have his airfleet ready this week, but our flagship - The Spear of Durotar - still doesn't have its primary engines installed.$B$BFleep promised me a dangerously shiny new engine last week. Go to her junkyard behind the bank and find out what the holdup is.$B$BThe airfleet is waiting on us, $N!
english.completion: What? The Captain said WHAT? It's HIS fault this big beast of an engine is delayed.
english.completed: Look for Fleep at her junkyard within Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara.

text.title: 看见迅猛龙
text.objectives: Speak with Priestess Hu'rala at Bambala to participate in the Mind Vision ritual.
text.description: 我们有了羽毛。$B$B我们有了$C。$B$B准备好了就跟女祭司谈一谈。
text.completion: What did Priestess tell you? The raptor is daughter of Ohgan, heir to Mandokir's seat. Hah!
text.completed: Return to Priestess Hu'rala at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: See Raptor
english.objectives: Speak with Priestess Hu'rala at Bambala to participate in the Mind Vision ritual.
english.description: We have the feathers, yes.$b$bWe have the $c, yes.$b$bSpeak with Priestess when you are ready.
english.completion: What did Priestess tell you? The raptor is daughter of Ohgan, heir to Mandokir's seat. Hah!
english.completed: Return to Priestess Hu'rala at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 心灵控制
text.objectives: 从祖玛维的布拉多克那里获得他的魔精。
text.description: 心灵视界还不够，不。$B$B心灵控制，强大得多，是的。$B$B强大的魔法，需要强大的材料，巨魔的魔精就是强大的材料。$B$B祖玛维的布拉多克，非常聪明。$B$B去南方，试试看布拉多克的魔精。
text.completed: Return to Priestess Hu'rala at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Mind Control
english.objectives: Obtain Braddok's Big Brain from Braddok in Zul'Mamwe.
english.description: Mind Vision is not enough, no.$b$bMind Control, much more powerful magic, yes.$b$bPowerful magic needs powerful reagents, and troll brain is a powerful reagent.$b$bBraddok in Zul'Mamwe, very smart, yes.$b$bHead south, and check out the big brain on Braddok.
english.completed: Return to Priestess Hu'rala at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 斯姆特的主动式负载平衡器
text.objectives: 在锈水港里找到斯姆特。把他摁倒，拿到感应主动式负载平衡器。
text.description: 是船长他坚持要求在新引擎上装感应主动式负载平衡器的。$B$B可那种玩意儿还没被发明出来呢！$B$B我把任务交给了斯姆特，让他照着从风险投资公司偷来的图纸做一个，他还真把实用模型给捣鼓出来了。$B$B搞出主动式负载平衡器之后，他立马就得意忘形了，跟地精灵魂附体似的满镇子到处跑。$B$B去把斯姆特抽一顿，将主动式负载平衡器给我拿过来，$N。
text.progress: Smoot's a good engineer. A samophlange can kill from thirty yards if you misalign the reduction caliphracts.
text.completion: Excellent! I should have this here engine samophlanginated within the hour.
text.completed: Take the Induction Samophlange back to Fleep at Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara.
text.giverWindow: Find Smoot somewhere in Bilgewater Harbor!

english.title: Smoot's Samophlange
english.objectives: Find Smoot somewhere in Bilgewater Harbor. Tackle him and get the Induction Samophlange.
english.description: It was the Captain who insisted his new engines use an induction samophlange.$B$BThose things hadn't even been invented yet!$B$BI tasked Smoot with creating one based on some stolen Venture Company schematics, and he's finally built a working model.$B$BNow that he's got his samophlange, he's drunk with power. He's running all over town with it like a goblin possessed.$B$BSmack Smoot and snag my samophlange, $N.
english.progress: Smoot's a good engineer. A samophlange can kill from thirty yards if you misalign the reduction caliphracts.
english.completion: Excellent! I should have this here engine samophlanginated within the hour.
english.completed: Take the Induction Samophlange back to Fleep at Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara.
english.giverWindow: Find Smoot somewhere in Bilgewater Harbor!

text.title: 成为迅猛龙
text.objectives: 跟女祭司胡纳拉谈一谈，帮助被抓住的鞭尾幼龙逃出祖尔格拉布。
text.description: 心灵控制，非常强大，是的。$B$B幸运的话，你可以帮助奥根阿卡逃离祖尔格拉布。$B$B然后，奥根阿卡将再度变成$N阿卡！$B$B跟女祭司谈一谈，帮助$N阿卡逃出来。
text.completed: Return to Priestess Hu'rala at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.
text.giverWindow: Trapped in Zul'Gurub!

english.title: Be Raptor
english.objectives: Speak with Priestess Hu'rala, then help the Captured Lashtail Hatchling escape from Zul'Gurub.
english.description: Mind Control, very powerful, yes.$b$bWith luck, you can help Ohgan'aka escape from Zul'Gurub.$b$bThen, Ohgan'aka becomes $N'aka again!$b$bSpeak to Priestess, yes, and help $N'aka escape.
english.completed: Return to Priestess Hu'rala at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.giverWindow: Trapped in Zul'Gurub!

text.title: 命运之巅
text.objectives: 从辛萨罗山峰的邪枝手里取得8尊蜘蛛神像。
text.description: 打倒那些战士，你做得很好，$N。我要你去调查一下辛萨罗的顶峰。$B$B我们打算在那里展开最为猛烈的战斗，袭击他们的黑暗祭坛，但那儿静得出奇。一点声音都没有。那很可能是一个可怕的陷阱，应该有个强者先去打探打探，而不是我们所有人一股脑儿冲进去。$B$B如果那是一个陷阱的话……我倒是想知道会发生什么。有什么线索的话，就带回来给我。
text.progress: What did you find?
text.completion: Dead? All of them, around the altar? And you found these spider idols on them... A mass sacrifice. They threw their lives to Shadra.
text.completed: Return to Primal Torntusk at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Summit of Fate
english.objectives: Collect 8 Spider Idols from the Vilebranch at the summit of Jintha'Alor.
english.description: You've done well cleaving through their warriors, $n. I'd like you to investigate the summit of Jintha'Alor.$B$BWe were prepared for our fiercest battle there, to storm their dark altar, but it's too quiet. Not a sound. It could be a terrible trap, and someone strong should look into it first instead of all of us rushing in.$b$BAnd if it's not a trap... I'm very interested in finding out what happened up there. Bring me back any clues you can find.
english.progress: What did you find?
english.completion: Dead? All of them, around the altar? And you found these spider idols on them... A mass sacrifice. They threw their lives to Shadra.
english.completed: Return to Primal Torntusk at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 碎轮的倒台！
text.objectives: 打败拉齐诺·碎轮。做好战斗准备后，就去跟涌冰湖的大工匠梅卡托克谈谈。
text.description: 我们的表亲：铁炉堡的矮人，答应帮我们同拉齐诺·碎轮作战。巡山人石磨是个老兵，他很熟悉丹莫罗。他和大工匠梅卡托克在北边涌冰湖里一座冰雪覆盖的小岛上待命。到那儿去同他们汇合，让大工匠知道，你做好了面对叛徒碎轮的准备。$B$B拿上这个轨道定位装置，在战斗中使用。它可以为大工匠的特殊武器进行制导。
text.completion: We're finally free of Razlo Crushcog and his interference! With the defeat of Crushcog and his forces, Thermaplugg can't afford to send any more of his followers to the surface. I can't wait for the day when we defeat him for good!
text.completed: Return to Jarvi Shadowstep at Brewnall Village.

english.title: Down with Crushcog!
english.objectives: Defeat Razlo Crushcog. Speak to High Tinker Mekkatorque at Iceflow Lake when you are ready to begin the battle.
english.description: Our cousins, the dwarves of Ironforge, have agreed to help us in the battle against Razlo Crushcog. Mountaineer Stonegrind is a veteran who knows Dun Morogh well. He and High Tinker Mekkatorque stand ready on a small snow-covered island in Iceflow Lake to the north. Meet up with them there and let the high tinker know when you are ready to face the traitor Crushcog.$B$BTake this orbital targeting device and use it during the battle. It will help guide the high tinker's special weapons.
english.completion: We're finally free of Razlo Crushcog and his interference! With the defeat of Crushcog and his forces, Thermaplugg can't afford to send any more of his followers to the surface. I can't wait for the day when we defeat him for good!
english.completed: Return to Jarvi Shadowstep at Brewnall Village.

text.title: 召唤英雄：赤脊山！
text.objectives: 去找赤脊山瞭望塔的卫兵队长帕克。
text.description: 当这里的情况开始变糟时，其他的区域也在这场剧变中摇摇欲坠。$B$B我手上有一份赤脊山的卫兵队长帕克送来的报告，那里是我们在艾尔文森林东边的一片领地。他希望能有一位英雄前去帮助他们。$B$B我们的阵线拉的太长了，我不知道是否还有多余的部队可派。你能去找帕克吗？看看他需要什么？你可以在三角路口的塔顶找到卫兵队长帕克。
text.completion: Heard Westfall was in some deep doody. Well, we got our own set of problems here. See them gnolls out there? Looks like they're actin' up again. I don't like it. Don't like it one bit.

english.title: Hero's Call: Redridge Mountains!
english.objectives: Report to Watch Captain Parker at Tower Watch in Redridge Mountains.
english.description: While the situation here is dire, other parts of the region are literally quaking from the great upheaval.$B$BI have here a report from Watch Captain Parker of Redridge Mountains, one of our territories east of Elwynn Forest. He is asking for a hero to come to their aid.$B$BWe are spread so thin here that I don't know how we can afford to send anymore military. Would you check on Parker and see what he needs? You will find Watch Captain Parker atop the tower at Three Corners.
english.completion: Heard Westfall was in some deep doody. Well, we got our own set of problems here. See them gnolls out there? Looks like they're actin' up again. I don't like it. Don't like it one bit.

text.title: 抬头
text.objectives: 打败“三头怪”昂波达，拿到他的头。
text.description: 邪枝巨魔的昂波达是他们最强壮的战士之一，一个恶心的屠夫。$B$B他把对手杀掉，砍掉他们的脑袋，当成饰品、奖赏……甚至是武器！现在该轮到他自己了。$B$B找到“三头怪”昂波达，杀掉他，把他的脑袋也给我带来！我们倒要看看把它扔过围墙之后，邪枝还怎么打。
text.progress: Let's see it!
text.completion: The look of fear and confusion on his face... this is what he deserved! Let's make sure all the Vilebranch wear the same look.
text.completed: Return to Primal Torntusk at Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands.
text.giverWindow: Bring back his head.  The middle one.

english.title: Heads Up
english.objectives: Defeat Umboda Three-Heads and collect his head.
english.description: Umboda of the Vilebranch is one of their strongest warriors, and a sick butcher.$B$BHe takes the heads of all he slays as trinkets, rewards...even weapons!  It's his turn to be taken.$B$BFind Umboda "Three-Heads", slay him, and bring me HIS head! We'll see how the Vilebranch fight when we throw it back over their walls!
english.progress: Let's see it!
english.completion: The look of fear and confusion on his face... this is what he deserved! Let's make sure all the Vilebranch wear the same look.
english.completed: Return to Primal Torntusk at Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands.
english.giverWindow: Bring back his head.  The middle one.

text.title: 昂格隆格的复仇
text.objectives: 和昂格隆格交手，直到他挣脱束缚。
text.description: 昂格隆格曾是我们的一员。外来者称其为恐怖巨魔，但他是一名恶齿巨魔，像我们所有人一样是个骄傲的战士！$B$B然后邪枝抓住了他。他们把他锁在辛萨罗顶部的斗兽场里，强迫他取悦他们。$B$B没有一条锁链能够绑住昂格隆格。你要做的就是激起他的愤怒，$N。和他交手，直到他被激怒，想起他真正的身份并挣脱桎梏……然后别碍着他就行了！
text.completion: I wish I could have been there to see it, $n! I'll have to hear the story from Ongo'longo himself when this is over.
text.completed: Return to Primal Torntusk at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.
text.giverWindow: Get him angry, then get out of his way!

english.title: Ongo'longo's Revenge
english.objectives: Fight Ongo'longo until he breaks free.
english.description: Ongo'longo was one of us. What outsiders called a Dire Troll, but he was a Revantusk, and a proud warrior like all of us!$B$BThen the Vilebranch took him. They keep him chained up in a pit at the top of Jintha'Alor, made to dance for their sick amusement.$B$BNo chains can hold Ongo'longo. All you need to do is raise his temper, $n. Fight him until he's enraged enough to remember his true spirit and break free... and then get out of the way!
english.completion: I wish I could have been there to see it, $n! I'll have to hear the story from Ongo'longo himself when this is over.
english.completed: Return to Primal Torntusk at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.
english.giverWindow: Get him angry, then get out of his way!

text.title: 剧毒的秘密
text.objectives: 在辛萨罗的沙德拉幼蛛身上收集6份沙德拉毒液样本。
text.description: 如果要召唤沙德拉，就必须多收集一些这种奇异的毒液。$B$B别那么吃惊……被遗忘者以前研究过这片土地，而且我们至少也同毒蜘蛛女王遭遇过一次。过去的经验证明，她的毒液十分有用。$B$B现在要再一次证明，它们对部落也很有用。帮我尽可能地从沙德拉幼蛛身上收集毒液来，它们就潜伏在顶部山洞里……我肯定你反正会被喷得全身都是的。
text.progress: Have you the venom...?
text.completion: Mmm, yes... that old nostalgic smell. You've done well for the Forsaken, and the Horde.
text.completed: Return to Eliza Darkgrin at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Venomous Secrets
english.objectives: Collect 6 Shadra-Spawn Venom Samples from the Spawn of Shadra in Jintha'Alor.
english.description: There's more of this curious venom to be had if Shadra's being summoned.$B$BDon't look so surprised... the Forsaken have studied these lands before, and we've encountered the venom queen at least once. Her toxins have proven quite useful in the past.$B$BThey'll prove useful to the Horde once more, too. Be a dear and fetch me as much poison as you can from the spawn of Shadra that lurk in the cave on the summit... I'm sure you'll be covered in it anyway.
english.progress: Have you the venom...?
english.completion: Mmm, yes... that old nostalgic smell. You've done well for the Forsaken, and the Horde.
english.completed: Return to Eliza Darkgrin at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 捕杀守护者
text.objectives: 杀死守护者莫塔加亚，获得沙德拉石板。
text.description: 科图卡跟我提起过沙德拉。她是毒蜘蛛女王，蜘蛛之神，在黑暗中接受崇拜。如果邪枝在举行仪式，我就不能让他们完成。$B$B到辛萨罗顶部祭坛后面的洞穴里去看看。在那深处，可能还潜伏着沙德拉的一名守护者。杀掉她，把她身上的东西带回来，我们好知道发生了什么事。
text.progress: Be sure you search her body. I don't want any traps laid by the Vilebranch to be hidden by their deaths.
text.completion: The parts scattered, the keepers separated... I see. This is a ritual to summon Shadra. They must not have gotten far. It should be destroyed...
text.completed: Return to Primal Torntusk at Jintha'alor in The Hinterlands.
text.giverWindow: She'll be cowering in the back of the cave, no doubt.

english.title: Hunt the Keeper
english.objectives: Kill Morta'gya the Keeper and obtain the Tablet of Shadra.
english.description: Kotonga has told me of Shadra. She is the venom queen, the loa of spiders, worshipped in darkness. If the Vilebranch are performing rituals, I'm not going to let them finish.$B$BCheck the cave behind the altar at the top of Jintha'Alor. Deep within it, one of Shadra's keepers might still be lurking. Kill her and take whatever she carries back here so we can know what's going on.
english.progress: Be sure you search her body. I don't want any traps laid by the Vilebranch to be hidden by their deaths.
english.completion: The parts scattered, the keepers separated... I see. This is a ritual to summon Shadra. They must not have gotten far. It should be destroyed...
english.completed: Return to Primal Torntusk at Jintha'alor in The Hinterlands.
english.giverWindow: She'll be cowering in the back of the cave, no doubt.

text.title: 回到哨兵岭
text.objectives: 向西部荒野哨兵岭的治安官格里安·斯托曼报告。
text.description: 迪菲亚兄弟会可不是轻易就能对付得了的，$N。你所看到的，是一个残酷犯罪组织的诞生，其目的就是要将暴风城化为沙砾。$B$B我要你回到哨兵岭，让格里安知道我正在给他派兵。希望为时不要太晚。
text.completion: Five years of work burned to the ground in five minutes. Damn the Defias! And this is only the beginning, $n! We have a long, hard road ahead of us.

english.title: Return to Sentinel Hill
english.objectives: Report to Marshal Gryan Stoutmantle at Sentinel Hill in Westfall.
english.description: The Defias Brotherhood are not a force to be taken lightly, $N. What you witnessed was the birth of a ruthless organization of criminals that will stop at nothing to see Stormwind turned to rubble.$B$BI need you to return to Sentinel Hill and let Gryan know that I am sending him troops. I hope it's not too late.
english.completion: Five years of work burned to the ground in five minutes. Damn the Defias! And this is only the beginning, $n! We have a long, hard road ahead of us.

text.title: 葛瑞森船长的传说
text.objectives: 在西部荒野灯塔找到葛瑞森船长。
text.description: 你听说过葛瑞森船长没有？有人说那只是水手喝多了臆想出来的满口雌黄，可在西部荒野人人知道，葛瑞森是真的！他是一个鬼，出没在长滩海面上偏远西部的西部荒野灯塔一带。$B$B你可敢去瞧瞧？
text.completion: Aye... I used to be flesh and blood, just like you, lad. That is, until that fateful day when the murlocs attacked the lighthouse...

english.title: The Legend of Captain Grayson
english.objectives: Find Captain Grayson at the Westfall Lighthouse in Westfall.
english.description: Have you heard of Captain Grayson? Some say that he's the figment of a drunken sailor's imagination, but anyone in Westfall will tell you that Grayson is real! He's a ghost that haunts the Westfall Lighthouse far to the west, off the coast of the Longshore.$B$BDo you dare investigate?
english.completion: Aye... I used to be flesh and blood, just like you, lad. That is, until that fateful day when the murlocs attacked the lighthouse...

text.title: 预飞检查表
text.objectives: 同艾萨拉锈水港的卡拉兹船长交谈。
text.description: 新引擎快的离谱，也很危险。我得说“极不稳定”。$B$B不过船长就是喜欢这样的。$B$B回上面跟他说，我马上就把这坏小子安好，然后他就可以来船坞找我了。
text.completion: My airship has engines? At last! Now we can rip the heavens a new one! Once the ground and naval forces are ready, we're going to light up the skies over the Twilight Highlands.
text.completed: 同艾萨拉锈水港的卡拉兹船长交谈。

english.title: Pre-Flight Checklist
english.objectives: Talk to Captain Krazz at Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara.
english.description: This new engine is extremely fast. And dangerous. I'd use the word "volatile."$B$BThat's the way the Captain likes it.$B$BRun back up the hill and let him know that I'll install this bad boy right now and that he should meet me at the construction site.
english.completion: My airship has engines? At last! Now we can rip the heavens a new one! Once the ground and naval forces are ready, we're going to light up the skies over the Twilight Highlands.
english.completed: Talk to Captain Krazz at Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara.

text.title: 前往卡拉诺斯
text.objectives: 跟卡拉诺斯的萨兰恩队长谈一谈。
text.description: 石磨手下的巡山人曾经跟我讲过卡拉诺斯的情形。石腭怪占领霜鬃要塞后，残余的霜鬃巨魔向西逃窜，来到了矮人家园的中心地带。$B$B他们已经成为卡拉诺斯的威胁。看来卡拉诺斯的矮人们需要一切可能的援助。你应该去那里跑一趟，向萨兰恩队长报到。沿着东面的道路离开烈酒村，一直向前走就是卡拉诺斯了。
text.completion: If Gnomeregan Covert Operations is recommending you, then you must have made quite an impression. Your help will be most welcome here, as we've a wealth of enemies and few enough mountaineers to face them.

english.title: On to Kharanos
english.objectives: Speak with Captain Tharran in Kharanos.
english.description: Some of the mountaineers under Stonegrind's command were telling me about the situation out at Kharanos. When the troggs took over Frostmane Hold, it sounds like the surviving trolls fled westward, deep into the heart of the dwarven homeland.$B$BNow, they threaten the dwarven town of Kharanos. It sounds like they're going to need all the help they can get. You should go to Kharanos and introduce yourself to Captain Tharran. Just follow the road east out of Brewnall and keep going until you see the town.
english.completion: If Gnomeregan Covert Operations is recommending you, then you must have made quite an impression. Your help will be most welcome here, as we've a wealth of enemies and few enough mountaineers to face them.

text.title: 地面部队预备
text.objectives: 搜索锈水港，说服12名擅离职守的兽人步兵回去报到。
text.description: 把部队集结在这个脓疮般的地精大都会真是个馊主意。声色犬马，只在一臂之遥。我们军纪严明的老兵都脱了缰，拿着诺森德服役时整年整年攒下的军饷在城里四下挥霍。$B$B你能不能将城市给我搜一遍，把掉队的和擅离职守都给我抓回来？$B$B我的斧咬战士们在战场上无人能敌，但我可不想让他们在离岸时缺了军纪。
text.completion: Thank you, $n! Most of my soldiers have already reported for duty, some a little worse for the wear. One night in Bilgewater makes a hard orc humble. Still, fresh fighting in the Twilight Highlands should restore discipline.
text.completed: Return to Warlorg Krogg at Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara.

english.title: Ready the Ground Troops
english.objectives: Search Bilgewater Harbor and convince 12 AWOL Grunts to report for duty.
english.description: It was a bad idea to muster the troops in this festering goblin metropolis. Every vice that coin can buy is within arm's reach. Our mighty veterans are running rampant, blowing years of Northrend back-pay in a city-wide debacle.$B$BCan you make a sweep through the city and gather up any stragglers that have gone AWOL?$B$BMy axebite warriors are unmatched on the battlefield, but I won't have them disgrace their uniforms while on shore leave.
english.completion: Thank you, $n! Most of my soldiers have already reported for duty, some a little worse for the wear. One night in Bilgewater makes a hard orc humble. Still, fresh fighting in the Twilight Highlands should restore discipline.
english.completed: Return to Warlorg Krogg at Bilgewater Harbor in Azshara.

text.title: 松动的石头
text.objectives: 用精密锁链粉碎器释放6名石英巨人。
text.description: 暮光教徒带走了我的孩子们。他们折磨他们，吸取他们的精华。$B$B求你，$R，救出我的孩子们。岱亚曼塔和我都无法在不伤着他们的情况下砸碎他们的枷锁。不过我们有件工具你可能用得着。$B$B用这个，把他们救出来。
text.completion: You are a generous $r. You give back to the earth that offers you so much. You have my respect. You shall surely have the respect of the Stone Lords with time.
text.completed: Return to the Quartz Stonetender near Lorthuna's Gate in Deepholm.

english.title: Loose Stones
english.objectives: Use the Delicate Chain Smasher to release 6 Quartz Rocklings.
english.description: The Twilight Cultists are taking my rocklings among them.  They drain them and torture them.  Strip them of the very essence that animates them from the stone.$B$BPlease, $r, free my rocklings. Neither Diamant nor I have the delicacy to smash their chains without hurting them as well.  But we do have a tool you might use.$B$BUse this. Break their chains and set them free.
english.completion: You are a generous $r. You give back to the earth that offers you so much. You have my respect. You shall surely have the respect of the Stone Lords with time.
english.completed: Return to the Quartz Stonetender near Lorthuna's Gate in Deepholm.

text.title: 深仇大恨
text.objectives: 杀死洛苏娜之门的巨人屠夫德拉古尔以及12名暮光异教徒。
text.description: 我为博登表示抱歉，但石头就是顽固的。$B$B不假以时日，本性自然难改。$B$B博登与我，同众石领主一道，受命收回世界之柱。$B$B对此，我们争执难下。$B$B我可以对你多加耐心，$R。$B$B证明你并非暮光教派或死亡之翼之流……$B$B为他们带去我们的愤怒。$B$B攻其我等所不至。$B$B成功之后，我再来听你细述。
text.completion: I have observed you, $r.$B$BYou do not fear shedding Twilight blood.$B$BIn this, I am willing to extend you some degree of trust.$B$BIt is a start.$B$BAll things in time.
text.completed: Return to Diamant the Patient near Lorthuna's Gate in Deepholm.
text.giverWindow: Leader of the forces at Lorthuna's Gate.

english.title: Hatred Runs Deep
english.objectives: Kill Dragul Giantbutcher and 12 Twilight Cultists at Lorthuna's Gate.
english.description: I would apologize for Boden, but stone is stubborn.$B$BIt does not sway from its ways without the wear of time.$B$BThe Stone Lords, Boden and I among them, are charged with retrieving the World Pillar.$B$BIn that, we are at odds.$B$BI would extend my patience upon you, $r.$B$BProve that you are no ally of the Twilight Cult or Deathwing...$B$BCarry our hatred upon them.$B$BStrike swiftly where we cannot.$B$BSucceed and I will listen.
english.completion: I have observed you, $r.$B$BYou do not fear shedding Twilight blood.$B$BIn this, I am willing to extend you some degree of trust.$B$BIt is a start.$B$BAll things in time.
english.completed: Return to Diamant the Patient near Lorthuna's Gate in Deepholm.
english.giverWindow: Leader of the forces at Lorthuna's Gate.

text.title: 不毛之地
text.objectives: 收集6块碧玉水晶簇，组合在一起，在洛苏娜之门营地里砸碎。
text.description: 暮光教派在他们的营地附近开采碧玉水晶。$B$B愚蠢……$B$B鲁莽……$B$B收集开采的水晶。把他们带到营地中央。在地上砸碎。$B$B震动的回响和水晶的力量会让坑道虫对付他们。$B$B他们将随着时间……$B$B一片一片地……$B$B一块一块地……$B$B……学会尊重大地。
text.completion: Time brings respect to all.$B$BThe smallest pebble.$B$BThe largest mountain.$B$BThe most stubborn cultist.
text.completed: Return to Diamant the Patient near Lorthuna's Gate in Deepholm.

english.title: Unsolid Ground
english.objectives: Gather 6 Jade Crystal Clusters, combine them, and shatter them within the Lorthuna's Gate encampment.
english.description: The Twilight Cult are mining jade crystals near their camp.$B$BFoolish...$B$BReckless...$B$BGather the mined crystals. Take them to the center of their camp. Shatter them against the ground.$B$BThe reverberations and the powered crystal will bring the tunnelers upon them.$B$BThey will learn respect for the earth...$B$BPiece by piece...$B$BRock by rock...$B$B...with time.
english.completion: Time brings respect to all.$B$BThe smallest pebble.$B$BThe largest mountain.$B$BThe most stubborn cultist.
english.completed: Return to Diamant the Patient near Lorthuna's Gate in Deepholm.

text.title: 英雄的召唤：西部荒野！
text.objectives: 向西部荒野贾森农场的霍拉提奥·莱因中尉报告。
text.description: 西部荒野面临着一个艰难的时刻，朋友。迪菲亚的威胁不复存在后，这里就变成了无家可归者和难民的天堂。人们为了温饱而互相争斗，犯罪率高居不下。如今我听说还有人犯下命案！!$B$B如果你有意帮助联盟的人民，从西部荒野开始就不错。它就在艾尔文森林西边，去向贾森农场的霍拉提奥·莱因中尉报告。
text.completion: Murder, rookie. That's what you're looking at on the ground in front of us.

english.title: Hero's Call: Westfall!
english.objectives: Report to Lieutenant Horatio Laine at the Jansen Stead in Westfall.
english.description: Westfall has fallen to hard times, friend. With the threat of the Defias extinguished, the region has become a haven for the homeless and downtrodden. The crime rate of the area has skyrocketed as people fight for shelter and food. Now I hear tale of murder!$B$BIf you are interested in helping the people of the Alliance, Westfall would be a great place to start. Report to Lieutenant Horatio Laine at the Jansen Stead. You'll find Westfall directly west of Elwynn Forest.
english.completion: Murder, rookie. That's what you're looking at on the ground in front of us.

text.title: 援助难民
text.objectives: 洛达内尔的哨兵兰德拉要你跟难民营的女祭司艾琳雅谈一谈。
text.description: 我想，你是来帮忙的？你不知道我在说什么，是吧……$B$B我没时间给你详述细节了，我们在黑海岸有个镇子，奥伯丁，大灾变时遭受的破坏最严重。我们正在着手营救幸存者，听说南边还有一个难民营，我需要一些更有经验的人——比如你——去看一看。$B$B把北方的事情交给我们吧，直接去那儿，尽可能地帮助那些难民。

english.title: In Aid of the Refugees
english.objectives: Sentinel Lendra at Lor'danel wants you to speak to Priestess Alinya at the Refugee Camp.
english.description: You're come to help, I hope? You have no idea what I'm talking about, do you...$B$BI don't have time to fill you in on all of the details, but we had a town in Darkshore, Auberdine, that took some of the worst of the Cataclysm. We're in the process of rescuing some of the survivors, but I need someone with a bit more experience--someone like you--to check in on a refugee camp that we heard about in the south.$B$BLeave things to us up north. Head straight down there and help the refugees however you can.

text.title: 前往卡拉诺斯
text.objectives: 将样本桶交给卡拉诺斯雷酒酿制厂的旅店老板贝尔姆。
text.description: 我本打算将这些酒桶送往卡拉诺斯的旅店的。据说那里有一种来自烈酒村某座酿酒厂的神秘麦酒。就在我离开镇子时，遭到了一队霜鬃巨魔的攻击。我要花好几天才能修好马车啦！$B$B不知道你愿不愿意帮我个忙啊？这些大酒桶只能留在车上了，不过我有小型的酒样桶。你愿意替我去卡拉诺斯跑一趟吗？沿着道路往东南方走就到了。
text.progress: Welcome, visitor. Have you come to the inn to rest, or do you need a new hearthstone?
text.completion: These look promising. I've heard great things about the Short and Stout Brewery, but I haven't had the chance to try their ale until now. While you're here, relax a little. If you need a spare hearthstone or wish to make Kharanos your home, just speak to me and I'll be happy to help.

english.title: Bound for Kharanos
english.objectives: Bring the Sample Casks to Innkeeper Belm at the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos.
english.description: I was supposed to be bringing these casks of ale to the inn in Kharanos. They contain a mysterious new ale produced by an upstart brewery based in Brewnall Village. As I was leaving town, I was attacked by a Frostmane troll raiding party. It's going to take me days to repair the wagon!$B$BI don't suppose you'd be willing to do me a favor, will you? These big kegs aren't going anywhere, but I have some smaller sample casks. Would you bring them to Kharanos for me? Just follow the road to the southeast.
english.progress: Welcome, visitor. Have you come to the inn to rest, or do you need a new hearthstone?
english.completion: These look promising. I've heard great things about the Short and Stout Brewery, but I haven't had the chance to try their ale until now. While you're here, relax a little. If you need a spare hearthstone or wish to make Kharanos your home, just speak to me and I'll be happy to help.

text.title: 沙德拉之眼
text.objectives: 在亚戈瓦萨找到沙德拉之眼。
text.description: 一定要把沙德拉召唤出来。要是我们让这样一个机会溜走的话，我们就是傻瓜。药剂师们可以善加利用蜘蛛神的毒液，但他们在仪式魔法上经验不足。$B$B幸运的是，我对此很熟悉。你要把沙德拉碎裂的部件带给我，我会帮你将她带到这个唾手可得的位面里来。$B$B第一个部件是沙德拉之眼，它被守卫在北边的亚戈瓦萨里。
text.progress: If the tablet was a ruse, I will not be pleased. Did you find the eye?
text.completion: I'm pleased, $n. That was quicker than I expected.
text.completed: Return to Dark Cleric Marnal at Hiri'watha Research Camp in The Hinterlands.

english.title: The Eye of Shadra
english.objectives: Recover the Eye of Shadra from Agol'watha.
english.description: Shadra must be summoned, for certain. To allow an opportunity like this to pass us by would be foolish. While the apothecaries can make fine use of the god's venom, they are relatively inexperienced in ritual magic.$B$BFortunately, I am quite familiar with preparing dark convocations. You will bring the scattered parts of Shadra to me, and I will help you bring her to this plane to be taken out.$B$BThe first part is the eye of Shadra, guarded in Agol'watha to the north.
english.progress: If the tablet was a ruse, I will not be pleased. Did you find the eye?
english.completion: I'm pleased, $n. That was quicker than I expected.
english.completed: Return to Dark Cleric Marnal at Hiri'watha Research Camp in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 没材料怎么做煎蛋卷……
text.objectives: 在亚戈瓦萨采集5颗沙德拉之卵。
text.description: 玛尔纳已经用这个沙德拉的事情烦了我好几天。我都对他找到石板要感到后悔了。我这里都准备好了，随时能让他闭嘴。$B$B尽管对仪式魔法高谈阔论，但他还是需要我的帮助，就像我需要他的一样。我得准备一种基础媒介，类似于……$B$B……你知道是什么。我就不和你罗嗦细节了。去亚戈瓦萨把沙德拉之卵给我带来就行。那儿应该有不少，都被邪枝巨魔所守护着。
text.progress: I hope you brought enough.
text.completion: Good, good. Just put them over there, I've got my hands full.
text.completed: Return to Apothecary Surlis at the Hiri'watha Research Camp in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Can't Make An Omelette Without...
english.objectives: Collect 5 Shadraspawn Eggs from Agol'watha.
english.description: Marnal has been pestering me about this Shadra plot for days. I'm almost upset he actually found the tablet; I was ready for him to shut up about it.$B$BDespite his high talk of ritual magic, he's still going to need my help as much as I need his. I've got to whip up a base medium with similar...$B$B...You know what, I'm not going to bother rambling about the details. Just bring me the Shadraspawn eggs from Agol'watha. There should be quite a few, guarded by the Vilebranch trolls.
english.progress: I hope you brought enough.
english.completion: Good, good. Just put them over there, I've got my hands full.
english.completed: Return to Apothecary Surlis at the Hiri'watha Research Camp in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 乘风破浪
text.objectives: 用西达纳苏斯的传送树前往鲁瑟兰村，然后跟维斯派塔斯交谈飞往洛达内尔。
text.description: 你！你看来是个能干的，可能也愿意帮忙？$B$B奥伯丁最终还是沦陷了，尽管那里的许多居民在大灾变把城市夷平之前就撤离了，但还有无数固执的居民不愿离开。现在城市貌似被水元素所掌控。$B$B我的妹妹需要人帮忙营救幸存者。求求你，$C，用西边的大树前往鲁瑟兰，然后同维斯派塔斯交谈飞往洛达内尔。要快！
text.completion: Did the sentinels send you? Thank Elune. We need everyone we can get.

english.title: Breaking Waves of Change
english.objectives: Use the teleportation tree in western Darnassus to reach Rut'theran Village, then speak to Vesprystus to secure a ride to Lor'danel.
english.description: You! You look able. And perhaps willing to help?$B$BAuberdine has finally fallen. Though many of its inhabitants departed long ago when the city first suffered the brunt of the Cataclysm, many of the more stubborn residents are yet unaccounted for. And it now appears that the city may have been overrun by water elementals.$B$BMy sisters need help rescuing the survivors. Please, $c, use the western tree to reach Rut'theran, then speak to Vesprystus to secure a flight to Lor'danel. Be swift!
english.completion: Did the sentinels send you? Thank Elune. We need everyone we can get.

text.title: 黑暗牧师玛尔纳
text.objectives: Bring the Tablet of Shadra to Darkcleric Marnal.
text.description: 我们还不能把石板丢到一边，$N，我们可以利用它……$B$B你瞧，我对这些蜘蛛的毒液十分好奇。它显然含有魔法，也许和巨魔崇拜的蜘蛛之神有关系。而要是这块石板可以让什么人将它召唤出来的话……$B$B好吧，你也看出端倪来了。部落不能放过这样的机会。把石板带给我的被遗忘者同伴。他们就在西边，西利瓦萨废墟的研究站里。
text.completion: Ah, what have we here... Fascinating. Quite fascinating.

english.title: Darkcleric Marnal
english.objectives: Bring the Tablet of Shadra to Darkcleric Marnal.
english.description: We can't toss that tablet aside just yet, $n. We can use it...$B$BYou see, I'm quite taken with the venom of the spiders here. It's clearly magical, probably related to that spider-god the trolls are involved with. And if that tablet will allow someone to summon it...$B$BWell, you can see where this is going. The Horde can't pass up this opportunity. Take the tablet to my fellow Forsaken. They're to the west, at the research station in the Hiri'watha ruins.
english.completion: Ah, what have we here... Fascinating. Quite fascinating.

text.title: 乘风破浪
text.objectives: 跟鲁瑟兰村的维斯派塔斯交谈，然后飞往洛达内尔。
text.description: It seems you have your first charge. You must travel back down to Rut'theran Village, where we first arrived, and speak to Vesprystus to secure a ride to Lor'danel.$B$BOnce in Lor'danel, aid the night elves in any way that you are able. I am trusting you to treat them with the reverence that they deserve in light of all that they have done for us.$B$BI must travel to the distant city of Stormwind to meet with King Varian. I hope to see your face again very soon, $n. Until then, a fond farewell.
text.completion: Our allies have come to our aid? Thank Elune. Tyrande was wise to extend open arms to your people. We need help.  We need everyone we can get.

english.title: Breaking Waves of Change
english.objectives: Speak to Vesprystus in Rut'theran Village to secure a ride to Lor'danel.
english.description: It seems you have your first charge. You must travel back down to Rut'theran Village, where we first arrived, and speak to Vesprystus to secure a ride to Lor'danel.$B$BOnce in Lor'danel, aid the night elves in any way that you are able. I am trusting you to treat them with the reverence that they deserve in light of all that they have done for us.$B$BI must travel to the distant city of Stormwind to meet with King Varian. I hope to see your face again very soon, $n. Until then, a fond farewell.
english.completion: Our allies have come to our aid? Thank Elune. Tyrande was wise to extend open arms to your people. We need help.  We need everyone we can get.

text.title: Surkhan
text.objectives: Report to Surkhan at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.
text.description: Priestess is not very good at speaking Orcish, no.$b$bMaybe you go speak with Surkhan, upstairs.$b$bTell him about what you've seen inside Zul'Gurub, yes.
text.completion: It would seem that Jin'do has survived, and he is rallying his brothers to once again summon Hakkar into this world.  It was good of you to come to speak with me. There is not much we can do now but to wait, and watch.  Jin'do is weak, and prime for striking, but I must wait for word from Rastakhan before issuing orders.  Until then, you and your raptor will have to wait.
text.completed: Report to Surkhan at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Surkhan
english.objectives: Report to Surkhan at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.description: Priestess is not very good at speaking Orcish, no.$b$bMaybe you go speak with Surkhan, upstairs.$b$bTell him about what you've seen inside Zul'Gurub, yes.
english.completion: It would seem that Jin'do has survived, and he is rallying his brothers to once again summon Hakkar into this world.  It was good of you to come to speak with me. There is not much we can do now but to wait, and watch.  Jin'do is weak, and prime for striking, but I must wait for word from Rastakhan before issuing orders.  Until then, you and your raptor will have to wait.
english.completed: Report to Surkhan at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 禁食
text.objectives: 在爬虫废墟消灭6名茧缚受害者。
text.description: 充斥在东边爬虫废墟的蜘蛛一无是处。我们现在称它们为沙德拉蜘蛛，很显然它们同蜘蛛之神有一定的血缘关系，但这并不能改变它们的麻烦比用处大这一事实。我宁愿把这些小害虫都清扫出去。$B$B你到爬虫废墟里去的时候，摧毁所能找到的任何虫茧。里面的尸体能提供给它们几天的养分，让它们饿肚子比碾死它们要更有效。
text.completion: Now we've got a win-win situation. The spiders are going to either starve off, or find some dwarves and elves to replenish their larder, since my colleagues and I would make a poor meal.
text.completed: Return to Apothecary Surlis at the Hiri'watha Research Camp in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Starvation Diet
english.objectives: Destroy 6 Cocooned Victims at the Creeping Ruins.
english.description: The spiders infesting the Creeping Ruin to the east are useless. We're calling them shadraspawn now, and it's clear they're related to the spider god, but that doesn't change the fact that they're more trouble than they're worth. I'd much rather just wipe the little pests out.$B$BWhen you head to the creeping ruin, destroy any cocoons you find. They feed off the bodies inside for days, so depriving them of their meal will be much more effective than trying to squash them all.
english.completion: Now we've got a win-win situation. The spiders are going to either starve off, or find some dwarves and elves to replenish their larder, since my colleagues and I would make a poor meal.
english.completed: Return to Apothecary Surlis at the Hiri'watha Research Camp in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 暮光天空
text.objectives: 为部落航空舰队护航，前往暮光高地。你可以在艾萨拉的南部火箭车终点站高塔处登艇。
text.description: 好，你们都到齐了。在这里等卡拉兹船长把飞艇开过来，然后上船跟空军出发。石拳将军会在龙喉港外面等你们！
text.completion: This is a disaster, $n! Our air fleet was decimated. And reports are coming in that our navy was attacked - unprovoked - by the Alliance in open water. And what of Hellscream? Is the Warchief dead?
text.completed: Speak with Admiral Stonefist outside of Dragonmaw Port in Twilight Highlands.

english.title: Twilight Skies
english.objectives: Accompany the Horde air fleet to Twilight Highlands. Catch your zeppelin from the tower at the Southern Rocketway Terminus in Azshara.
english.description: Okay, you're all checked in. Wait here for Captain Krazz to bring the zeppelin around, then get on board and accompany the air fleet. Admiral Stonefist will be waiting for you outside of Dragonmaw Port!
english.completion: This is a disaster, $n! Our air fleet was decimated. And reports are coming in that our navy was attacked - unprovoked - by the Alliance in open water. And what of Hellscream? Is the Warchief dead?
english.completed: Speak with Admiral Stonefist outside of Dragonmaw Port in Twilight Highlands.

text.title: 黑石兽人的入侵
text.objectives: 收集8把黑石兽人的武器。
text.description: $N，兽人已经开始烧毁森林了！他们占领了东边的葡萄园，正在计划对我们发动总攻！必须阻止他们！$B$B到东边去，跨过河流，把那些黑石兽人杀个片甲不留。收集他们的武器作为你得胜的证据，然后回来找我。$B$B你是我们唯一的希望了，$N！
text.progress: Have you killed the rampaging orc hordes?
text.completion: The Blackrock orcs will surely fall now that their main force has been defeated! Only one task remains.
text.completed: Return to Marshal McBride in front of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Blackrock Invasion
english.objectives: Recover 8 Blackrock Orc Weapons.
english.description: The orcs have begun burning down the forest, $N! They have taken over the vineyard to the east and are planning their final assault against us! They must be stopped!$B$BHead east, across the river, and kill the rampaging Blackrock orcs. Collect their weapons as proof of their demise and return to me.$B$BYou're our only hope, $N!
english.progress: Have you killed the rampaging orc hordes?
english.completion: The Blackrock orcs will surely fall now that their main force has been defeated! Only one task remains.
english.completed: Return to Marshal McBride in front of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: 终结入侵！
text.objectives: 杀死屠杀者库尔托克。
text.description: 这些肆虐的兽人是由一个名叫屠杀者库尔托克的野蛮头目指挥的。库尔托克是这次入侵的领导者，如果我们要保卫北郡山谷，就必须除掉他。$B$B回到东边去，穿越河流和葡萄园，寻找一条通往山里的小路。库尔托克就在那里筹备着下一轮攻势。干掉他，然后回来找我。
text.completion: With Kurtok slain we are safe once again from the orcish hordes. I will send peasants to the pass in an attempt to seal the passage so that no more orcs may come through into our territory. You have the thanks of Stormwind and of the Alliance, hero!
text.completed: Return to Marshal McBride in front of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
text.giverWindow: Kurtok hides amidst the smoke and flames, to the east.

english.title: Ending the Invasion!
english.objectives: Kill Kurtok the Slayer.
english.description: The rampaging orc horde is lead by a savage beast known as Kurtok the Slayer! Kurtok is responsible for the recent invasion and must be killed if we are to have peace in the valley.$B$BVenture back east, across the river and through the vineyard, and look for the passage leading into the mountains. Kurtok will be there, preparing for another assault. Kill him and return to me.
