english.completion: With Kurtok slain we are safe once again from the orcish hordes. I will send peasants to the pass in an attempt to seal the passage so that no more orcs may come through into our territory. You have the thanks of Stormwind and of the Alliance, hero!
english.completed: Return to Marshal McBride in front of Northshire Abbey in Elwynn Forest.
english.giverWindow: Kurtok hides amidst the smoke and flames, to the east.

text.title: 灭火拯救希望
text.objectives: 使用米莉的灭火器，扑灭8处葡萄园的火焰。
text.description: 和眼下的情况比起来，迪菲亚兄弟会四处作恶的日子简直是诗情画意了。天崩地裂的大灾变打通了燃烧平原到这里的路，黑石兽人直接涌进了北郡山谷！他们占领了我的葡萄园，还把它烧成了一片灰烬！一片灰烬！$B$B求你了，$N，那座葡萄园就是我的一切。拿上我的灭火器，去扑灭葡萄园里的烈火吧。也许它还有救呢！
text.progress: Have you put out the fires?
text.completion: Bless your heart, $n. You truly are a hero of the Alliance! Though the land is completely incinerated and there is nothing left of the vineyard but ash and debris, I still might be able to recover. Right? How bad can it be?
text.completed: Return to Milly Osworth at Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest.

english.title: Extinguishing Hope
english.objectives: Use Milly's Extinguisher to put out 8 Vineyard Fires.
english.description: Times like these make me long for when the Defias were still around. The cataclysm has opened a pathway from the Burning Steppes and now Blackrock orcs pour into Northshire Valley! They have taken over my vineyard and are burning it to the ground! TO THE GROUND!$B$BPlease, $N, that vineyard is all I have. Take my fire extinguisher and extinguish the flames at the vineyard. There still might be hope for that land!
english.progress: Have you put out the fires?
english.completion: Bless your heart, $n. You truly are a hero of the Alliance! Though the land is completely incinerated and there is nothing left of the vineyard but ash and debris, I still might be able to recover. Right? How bad can it be?
english.completed: Return to Milly Osworth at Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest.

text.title: 勇氣證明
text.objectives: Deliver the Voucher of Bravery to Marshal McBride at Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest.
text.description: You've driven off the Blackrock orcs, and for that we are grateful! Though the vineyards have been burned to the ground, the rest of Northshire is safe, thanks to you.$B$BPlease accept this voucher outlining your bravery and deliver it to Marshal McBride. He is responsible for the safety of Northshire and he will be happy to hear about what you have done.

english.title: Voucher of Bravery
english.objectives: Deliver the Voucher of Bravery to Marshal McBride at Northshire Valley in Elwynn Forest.
english.description: You've driven off the Blackrock orcs, and for that we are grateful! Though the vineyards have been burned to the ground, the rest of Northshire is safe, thanks to you.$B$BPlease accept this voucher outlining your bravery and deliver it to Marshal McBride. He is responsible for the safety of Northshire and he will be happy to hear about what you have done.

text.title: 快递消息
text.objectives: 将阿古斯的便笺交给狮鹫管理员勇敢的巴特利。
text.description: 虽然我们并没有从暴风城得到多少直接的帮助，但我在城里有一个联系人，经常为我们提供护甲。他叫奥斯瑞克·斯图恩，在暴风城的旧城区开了一家名叫“有限防护”的店。$B$B我们的护甲储备不够了，我必须找奥斯瑞克再要一些。你能把这张便笺交给他吗？$B$B前往暴风城的最快途径是去找勇敢的巴特利，他是我们的狮鹫管理员。他就在铁匠铺外面，把我的便笺交给他，然后乘坐狮鹫飞往暴风城！
text.progress: 你看起来是要急着赶路。嗯，你来对地方了!
text.completion: 你要把这封信送到暴风城去?没问题，骑我的狮鹫兽去吧!$B$B

english.title: A Swift Message
english.objectives: Bring Argus' Note to Bartlett the Brave the gryphon master.
english.description: Although we don't get much aid from Stormwind directly, I do have a contact in the city who helps supply us with armor.  His name is Osric Strang.  His shop, Limited Immunity, is in the Old Town of Stormwind.$B$BOur supply of armor dwindles, and I must contact Osric for more.  Can you take him this note?$B$BThe fastest way to Stormwind is through Bartlett the Brave, our gryphon master.  He's just outside of the smithy; bring him my note, and then take a gryphon to Stormwind.
english.progress: You look like you're in a hurry.  Well, then you came to the right place!
english.completion: You have to get this note to Stormwind?  That's not a problem, you can take one of my gryphons!

text.title: 赶赴暴风城
text.objectives: 从狮鹫管理员勇敢的巴特利那里租一只狮鹫，然后将阿古斯的便笺交给奥斯瑞克·斯图恩，他在暴风城旧城区的“有限防护”商店里。
text.description: 只需一点微不足道的费用，你就可以租一只狮鹫飞往暴风城，然后把阿古斯的便笺交给奥斯瑞克。这是最快捷的办法啦。$B$B如果你觉得可以接受的话，就跟我说一声。我会收取一点费用，不过你要相信我，这绝对物超所值！
text.progress: 你是在到处旅行吗?有没有去过什麽有趣的地方?
text.completion: Ah, a note from Smith Argus?  I'm not surprised he needs more gear.  There are so many new recruits these days. Well thank you, $n.  Here's some money to cover your travel costs.
text.completed: Buy a gryphon ride from the gryphon master Bartlett the Brave, then bring Argus Note to Osric Strang, in the shop Limited Immunity, in the Old Town of Stormwind.

english.title: Continue to Stormwind
english.objectives: Buy a gryphon ride from the gryphon master Bartlett the Brave, then bring Argus' Note to Osric Strang, in the shop Limited Immunity, in the Old Town of Stormwind.
english.description: For a small fee, you can take a gryphon to Stormwind, so you can deliver Argus' note to Osric.  You won't get there faster any other way.$B$BIf that sounds acceptable, then just speak to me again when you're ready for the ride.  I'll charge you a little, but trust me; it'll be worth it!
english.progress: You've been traveling, eh?  Have you been anywhere interesting?
english.completion: Ah, a note from Smith Argus?  I'm not surprised he needs more gear.  There are so many new recruits these days. Well thank you, $n.  Here's some money to cover your travel costs.
english.completed: Buy a gryphon ride from the gryphon master Bartlett the Brave, then bring Argus Note to Osric Strang, in the shop Limited Immunity, in the Old Town of Stormwind.

text.title: 杜加尔·朗德瑞克
text.objectives: 将奥斯瑞克的箱子交给狮鹫管理员杜加尔·朗德瑞克。
text.description: $N，我把阿古斯要的东西都装在这只箱子里了。你能把它交给他吗？$B$B如果你已经跟闪金镇的巴特利交谈过，就可以乘坐狮鹫回到他那里。杜加尔·朗德瑞克是我们的狮鹫管理员，他就在贸易区里。$B$B去跟杜加尔谈谈，然后尽快把这只箱子交给阿古斯。我们可不能让闪金镇的士兵们空手上阵！
text.progress: Is that sweat on your brow, $glad:ma'am;?  You've been running too much.  Next time, take a gryphon!
text.completion: A crate for Goldshire, eh?  People sure are getting lazy. Have you been to Goldshire before?  If so, then it's no problem, my friend.  I have plenty of gryphons trained to fly that route!

english.title: Dungar Longdrink
english.objectives: Bring Osric's Crate to Dungar Longdrink the gryphon master.
english.description: $N, I gathered into this crate everything Argus asked for.  Can you take it to him?$B$BIf you've already spoken to Bartlett at Goldshire, then you can take a gryphon back to him.  Dungar Longdrink is our gryphon master, over in the trade district.$B$BSpeak with Dungar, then get this crate to Argus as fast as you can.  We don't want our fighting men and women in Goldshire to go without fresh equipment!
english.progress: Is that sweat on your brow, $glad:ma'am;?  You've been running too much.  Next time, take a gryphon!
english.completion: A crate for Goldshire, eh?  People sure are getting lazy. Have you been to Goldshire before?  If so, then it's no problem, my friend.  I have plenty of gryphons trained to fly that route!

text.title: 返回阿古斯身边
text.objectives: 从狮鹫管理员杜加尔·朗德瑞克那里租一只狮鹫，飞往闪金镇，然后将奥斯瑞克的箱子交给闪金镇的铁匠阿古斯。
text.description: 闪金镇的狮鹫管理员是巴特利。如果你以前跟他说过话，就可以乘坐我的狮鹫飞回他那里去。$B$B你务必牢记这一点：狮鹫总是能够飞回自己的主城，但是对于那些遥远的城镇来说，只有你跟当地的狮鹫管理员打过招呼，才能乘坐狮鹫飞过去。$B$B你已经跟巴特利谈过话了，所以只需要跟我说一声，就可以直接飞往闪金镇。到了那里之后，把奥斯瑞克的箱子交给铁匠阿古斯。
text.progress: 你从暴风城回来了?奥斯瑞克的护甲拿到了没有?
text.completion: Great, you brought the armor!  We'll get this divvied to those who need it immediately. Thank you, $n.  Your efforts have been a great help to us.  And now that you're no stranger to gryphons, I hope you'll come and lend your aid to Goldshire often!

english.title: Return to Argus
english.objectives: Buy a gryphon ride to Goldshire from the gryphon master Dungar Longdrink, then take Osric's Crate to Smith Argus at Goldshire.
english.description: The gryphon master in Goldshire is Bartlett.  If you've spoken to him before, then you can take one of my gryphons to him.$B$BThat's a good lesson to know: gryphons are always trained to fly to their capital city, but they'll only take you to a remote gryphon master after you've already been there.$B$BYou've already been to Bartlett, so just speak with me again when you're ready to take a gryphon to Goldshire.  Once there, you can deliver Osric's Crate to Smith Argus.
english.progress: You're back from Stormwind?  Did Osric send the armor?
english.completion: Great, you brought the armor!  We'll get this divvied to those who need it immediately. Thank you, $n.  Your efforts have been a great help to us.  And now that you're no stranger to gryphons, I hope you'll come and lend your aid to Goldshire often!

text.title: 与大地母亲同行
text.objectives: Take the Mark of Bloodhoof to Garrosh Hellscream, located in Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.$B$BYou may speak with Tal the Wind Rider Master to travel there, or wait for the zeppelin.
text.description: Much has changed outside of Mulgore, $n. The world is torn, and our Horde allies have turned down dark paths. We must guide them. Even in the darkest hour, we will bravely hold our heads high, and honor the Earth Mother in all we do.$B$BYou must go, $n, and be this example. Go to Orgrimmar. Tell Warchief Hellscream how the Grimtotem were driven out. Let him know our pride and discipline, our strength and sorrow.$B$BTal at the Skytower will send you on your way. Go in peace, and never forget your people.
text.progress: What makes you seek the Warchief of the Horde, $r?
text.completion: The Grimtotem forced from Mulgore... if Baine speaks for this, you are indeed a fierce warrior. From this day, your strength is no longer your own. It belongs to me, and the Horde, as a weapon of war. Hellscream's eyes are upon you, $n. Victory or death!

english.title: Walk With The Earth Mother
english.objectives: Take the Mark of Bloodhoof to Garrosh Hellscream, located in Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.$B$BYou may speak with Tal the Wind Rider Master to travel there, or wait for the zeppelin.
english.description: Much has changed outside of Mulgore, $n. The world is torn, and our Horde allies have turned down dark paths. We must guide them. Even in the darkest hour, we will bravely hold our heads high, and honor the Earth Mother in all we do.$B$BYou must go, $n, and be this example. Go to Orgrimmar. Tell Warchief Hellscream how the Grimtotem were driven out. Let him know our pride and discipline, our strength and sorrow.$B$BTal at the Skytower will send you on your way. Go in peace, and never forget your people.
english.progress: What makes you seek the Warchief of the Horde, $r?
english.completion: The Grimtotem forced from Mulgore... if Baine speaks for this, you are indeed a fierce warrior. From this day, your strength is no longer your own. It belongs to me, and the Horde, as a weapon of war. Hellscream's eyes are upon you, $n. Victory or death!

text.title: 与大地母亲同行
text.objectives: Take the Mark of Bloodhoof to Garrosh Hellscream, located in Grommash Hold in Orgrimmar.$B$BYou may speak with Tal the Wind Rider Master to travel there, or wait for the zeppelin.
text.description: You have fought bravely alongside me, $n, and done much for my people. If every $r could be as noble, the future of the Horde might not disturb me so much.$B$BI would ask you to ease my worries further. Go to Orgrimmar. Tell Warchief Hellscream how the Grimtotem were driven out. Let him know our pride and discipline, our strength and sorrow.$B$BTal at the Skytower will send you on your way. Go in peace, friend.

text.title: 莫什奥格的馈赠
text.objectives: 从莫什奥格食人魔山后的废墟里获得莫什奥格的馈赠。
text.description: Say... have you heard about the ogres?  I got a hot tip from some fella' named Mok'thardin that some $r schmuck in a ridiculous $c getup found this ogre hand, and...$b$b<Skeezy trails off as he looks you over.>$b$bWhat was I just saying?  Oh yes... some $g SWASHBUCKLING HERO: BREATHTAKING HEROINE; found this ogre hand, and Mok'thardin thinks it means that the ogres have some special artifact.  I've seen them guarding a chest up in some ruins behind their mound.  Care to fetch it for me?
text.progress: Why is it that the OGRES always find the priceless artifacts?
text.completion: Those ogres really know how to close a treasure chest, I'll tell you what.  A box is useless to me, hero.  We're going to need to find a way into this crate.
text.completed: Return to Skeezy Whillzap at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: The Mosh'Ogg Bounty
english.objectives: Obtain the Mosh'Ogg Bounty from the ruins behind the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound.
english.description: Say... have you heard about the ogres?  I got a hot tip from some fella' named Mok'thardin that some $r schmuck in a ridiculous $c getup found this ogre hand, and...$b$b<Skeezy trails off as he looks you over.>$b$bWhat was I just saying?  Oh yes... some $g SWASHBUCKLING HERO: BREATHTAKING HEROINE; found this ogre hand, and Mok'thardin thinks it means that the ogres have some special artifact.  I've seen them guarding a chest up in some ruins behind their mound.  Care to fetch it for me?

english.completed: Return to Skeezy Whillzap at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: The Universal Key
text.objectives: Open the Mosh'Ogg Bounty by fighting a Venture Co. Shredder or by using the sawblade in the Venture Company lumber mill.
text.description: We're going to need something even stronger than those beefy $r hands of yours to open this.  And the Venture Company schlubs to the northwest might have just the thing.$b$bLast time I was over there, I saw shredders walking around with giant rotating blades on their hands.  That's one way to open a box!$b$bIf you can't find any shredders, you might also try the giant sawblade in their lumber mill, by the lake.
text.progress: You get that chest open yet?  I can't wait to see what's inside.
text.completion: Whaaaaaa?!? I'm... I'm going to have to send this to... to Flem... in the south.  He'll know what to do with it.
text.completed: Return to Skeezy Whillzap at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 去找维斯提亚
text.objectives: 将黑雾护符交给埃斯图兰之塔的维斯提亚·月矛。
text.description: 基座上柔和的光芒变得强烈起来，你看到有一条简易的锁链就放在后面。这难不成就是学徒要找的东西？
text.progress: You're back... and without him...
text.completion: How horrible... for someone so young and full of promise to fall to demons! I beg your forgiveness for sending you into danger as well, $n. I hope you don't cross paths with that demoness again...

english.title: Return to Vestia
english.objectives: Bring the Darkmist Amulet to Vestia Moonspear at the Tower of Estulan.
english.description: The soft glow from the pedestal brightens, and you can see a simple chain left behind. Is this what the apprentice was searching for?
english.progress: You're back... and without him...
english.completion: How horrible... for someone so young and full of promise to fall to demons! I beg your forgiveness for sending you into danger as well, $n. I hope you don't cross paths with that demoness again...

text.title: 珊蒂斯·羽月将军
text.objectives: 跟菲拉斯羽月要塞的珊蒂斯·羽月谈一谈。
text.description: 我们德鲁伊和哨兵部队走得不是非常近，但我们永远乐意携手保卫我们的土地。既然你已经帮助了我，要是我不让你也帮帮他们，那就太失职了。$B$B哨兵的将军珊蒂斯·羽月坐镇南边新建的羽月要塞，指挥着卡利姆多所有的战事。告诉她是我派你去的，我肯定她会用得上你的。
text.completion: Telaron has already sent word of you, $n. I'm interested in seeing if you're half as skilled as he claims.$B$BI am fighting a war on multiple fronts, while keeping our currently held areas properly defended, as well as overseeing the instruction of our youngest sentinels. If you're a decent fighter, there will be plenty for you to do.

english.title: General Shandris Feathermoon
english.objectives: Speak with Shandris Feathermoon at Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.
english.description: We druids do not keep very close company with the Sentinel army, but we are always willing to work together to defend our lands. Now that you have assisted me, I would be remiss in not requesting you assist them as well.$B$BShandris Feathermoon, general of the Sentinels, commands the war effort for all of Kalimdor from the newly built Feathermoon Stronghold to the south. Tell her I sent you; I am sure she will have need of your skills.
english.completion: Telaron has already sent word of you, $n. I'm interested in seeing if you're half as skilled as he claims.$B$BI am fighting a war on multiple fronts, while keeping our currently held areas properly defended, as well as overseeing the instruction of our youngest sentinels. If you're a decent fighter, there will be plenty for you to do.

text.title: 风险投资公司
text.objectives: Bring 5 Tumbled Crystals to Skeezy Whillzap at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.
text.description: 我讨厌创业公司。他们在荆棘谷有一连串的行动，让像我这样勤劳的哥布林人不再做诚实的黄金！$B$B我的方式？盗窃。位于西北部纳兹费蒂湖附近的Venture Co.地质学家对他们在矿山中发现的那些奇怪的蓝色水晶产生了浓厚的兴趣。带上我的地质学家的样品。我不在乎你得做什么。
text.progress: 你弄到多少水晶啦??我需要它们!!$B$B呃，其实我的意思是……我必须要确切地知道那邪恶的风险投资公司已经失去了在荆棘谷立足的根基。因为，你知道，我们这些老实人也得养家糊口啊!
text.completion: Great!  Wonderful!  I can get a bundle for these!! That Venture Company sure picked the wrong jungle to mine in, didn't they?  We'd all be in better shape if they moved out of here.
text.completed: Return to Skeezy Whillzap at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Venture Company Mining
english.objectives: Bring 5 Tumbled Crystals to Skeezy Whillzap at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.description: Man, I hate the Venture Company.  They have a string of operations through Stranglethorn which keeps hard-working goblins, like me, from making honest gold!$B$BMy way? Theft. The Venture Co. geologists near Lake Nazferiti to the northwest are deeply interested in those strange blue crystals they have been finding in the mines.  Bring me samples of the stone from their geologists.  I don't care what you have to do to get them.
english.progress: Do you have those crystals??  I need them!! I mean...I need to know the evil Venture Company is losing ground in Stranglethorn.  Because, you know, we honest folk have to make a living!
english.completion: Great!  Wonderful!  I can get a bundle for these!! That Venture Company sure picked the wrong jungle to mine in, didn't they?  We'd all be in better shape if they moved out of here.
english.completed: Return to Skeezy Whillzap at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: Above My Pay Grade
text.objectives: Report to Sassy Hardwrench at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
text.description: Hey, have you been to Hardwrench Hideaway yet?  Oh, you've GOT to see it.  It's everything a goblin could ever hope for.$b$bTell you what... you look like a stand-up $c.  Raskha in the vest and the skirt over here can give you a ride, if you don't already know the way.$b$bThe flight's on me.
text.completion: Skeezy sent you to the right place.  Welcome to Hardwrench Hideaway!

english.title: Above My Pay Grade
english.objectives: Report to Sassy Hardwrench at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

Raskha in the vest and the skirt over here can give you a ride, if you don't already know the way.$b$bThe flight's on me.
english.completion: Skeezy sent you to the right place.  Welcome to Hardwrench Hideaway!

text.title: 祖玛维曼波
text.objectives: 杀死祖玛维里的16名劈颅巨魔。
text.description: The Skullsplitters are an embarrassment to the troll empire.  Their petty squabbles with the Bloodscalps have torn Northern Stranglethorn apart.  Where tribes like the Darkspear and the Zandalari thrive, the Skullsplitters fight over ruins.$b$bI have been authorized to issue rewards to mercenaries who are willing to deliver punishment to the Skullsplitters.  I encourage you, and anyone you know, to travel south to Zul'Mamwe and cull their wayward tribe.
text.completion: As promised, your reward.  You do the troll nation proud.
text.completed: Return to Surkhan at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Zul'Mamwe Mambo
english.objectives: Kill 16 Skullsplitter Trolls within Zul'Mamwe.
english.description: The Skullsplitters are an embarrassment to the troll empire.  Their petty squabbles with the Bloodscalps have torn Northern Stranglethorn apart.  Where tribes like the Darkspear and the Zandalari thrive, the Skullsplitters fight over ruins.$b$bI have been authorized to issue rewards to mercenaries who are willing to deliver punishment to the Skullsplitters.  I encourage you, and anyone you know, to travel south to Zul'Mamwe and cull their wayward tribe.
english.completion: As promised, your reward.  You do the troll nation proud.
english.completed: Return to Surkhan at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 沙德拉之牙
text.objectives: 在爬虫废墟中获得沙德拉之牙。
text.description: 下一步，我们需要沙德拉之牙。$B$B它就存放在东边的爬虫废墟，被沙德拉的子嗣保护着。它们的毒很厉害，$N……不要大意。
text.progress: Have you got the fang?
text.completion: There it is... only one left.
text.completed: Return to Darkcleric Marnal at Hiri'watha Research Station.

english.title: The Fang of Shadra
english.objectives: Collect the Fang of Shadra from the Creeping Ruins.
english.description: We'll need the Fang of Shadra next.$B$BIt's kept in the Creeping Ruins to the east, guarded by Shadra's own spawn.  Their venom is strong, $n... don't get careless.
english.progress: Have you got the fang?
english.completion: There it is... only one left.
english.completed: Return to Darkcleric Marnal at Hiri'watha Research Station.

text.title: 莫什奥格的手笔
text.objectives: 把扭曲的莫什奥格之手带给北荆棘谷格罗姆高营地的先知摩克萨尔丁。
text.description: 这个食人魔带着一件非同寻常的物品：另一个食人魔的一条断手。断手被一条绳子绑着，挂在脖子上。手上面全是伤疤，发着淡紫色的光芒。$B$B死人的伤疤还能发光，这已经够奇怪了，它还让另一个食人魔带着，就更是诡异。也许格罗姆高有人知道怎么处理这怪东西。
text.progress: A hand, you say?
text.completion: Strange indeed.  I will pass this on to my contacts in the east, near the Mosh'Ogg's main camp.  I have a feeling that they'll be interested in these strange scars. You have my thanks, $r.
text.completed: Bring the Disfigured Mosh'Ogg Hand to Far Seer Mok'thardin at Grom'Gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Mosh'Ogg Handiwork
english.objectives: Bring the Disfigured Mosh'Ogg Hand to Far Seer Mok'thardin at Grom'Gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.description: This ogre was carrying an unusual item: the severed hand of another ogre, tied to a piece of string, and worn around the neck.  The hand itself is marked heavily with scars that glow a faint purple.$b$bA scar that glows after death is highly unusual, and to find such an item on an ogre is even stranger.  Perhaps someone back at Grom'gol will know what to do with this oddity.
english.progress: A hand, you say?
english.completion: Strange indeed.  I will pass this on to my contacts in the east, near the Mosh'Ogg's main camp.  I have a feeling that they'll be interested in these strange scars. You have my thanks, $r.
english.completed: Bring the Disfigured Mosh'Ogg Hand to Far Seer Mok'thardin at Grom'Gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 灰谷的灰
text.objectives: 跟灰谷奥雷迪尔的居所的哨兵塞雅拉谈一谈。
text.description: 黑海岸或许饱受创伤，但多亏了你，我们在这里找到了安全，找到了和平。我们还有很多重建工作要做。$B$B你应该继续，朋友。加尔鲁什带着他的部落大军全面压境攻打灰谷。要是我们不挺身而出阻止他们的话，他们会把我们统统杀光，把森林夷平。$B$B若想保住这片森林，我们就需要你的帮助。沿着路往南，去找哨兵塞雅拉。
text.completion: Good to see a new face around here! The forest crawls with Horde, but my assignment requires that I keep this outpost safe. I could really use someone who might be up for a good fight.

english.title: Ashes in Ashenvale
english.objectives: Speak to Sentinel Shyela at Orendil's Retreat in Ashenvale.
english.description: Darkshore may be battered and broken, but thanks to you, we've achieved some amount of safety here. Some amount of peace. We've much rebuilding to do.$B$BYou should continue on, friend. Garrosh has pressed the full might of his Horde against us in Ashenvale. They will kill all of us and chop the forest clear if we don't step forward to stop them.$B$BIf we are to have any hope of not losing those forests entirely, we'll need your help. Follow the road to the south and find Sentinel Shyela.
english.completion: Good to see a new face around here! The forest crawls with Horde, but my assignment requires that I keep this outpost safe. I could really use someone who might be up for a good fight.

text.title: 金矿在哪儿？
text.objectives: 去找深岩之洲石英盆地的见习萨满“金矿”。
text.description: 我的地精见习萨满已经去不见了好一会儿了。他的名字叫金矿。$B$B我派他去西南边的石英盆地观察掠石虫。也许你能帮忙找到他，叫他回神殿来？
text.completion: Hiya! Lend a hand, would ya, bub?

english.title: Where's Goldmine?
english.objectives: Find Initiate Goldmine at the Quartzite Basin in Deepholm.
english.description: My goblin initiate has been gone for quite some time. His name is Goldmine.$B$BI sent him out to observe the local rock flayers southwest at the Quartzite Basin. Perhaps you would be willing to find him? When you do, please ask him to come back to the temple.
english.completion: Hiya! Lend a hand, would ya, bub?

text.title: 爆炸接合混合物
text.objectives: 收集5块石英树脂。
text.description: 这人是土灵的王子！他就快要走到神殿的时候，被数不清的掠石虫伏击了！$B$B我们知道土灵之王拥有世界之柱的中部碎片。也许要是我们治好他的儿子，他会把碎片让给我们？$B$B我的治疗对弗林特没作用。但要是我们从这些怪物身上弄些石英树脂来，我想我可以制作一种爆炸混合物用来接合他的伤口。
text.progress: It won't take much resin. Those rock flayers are pretty dangerous though.
text.completion: Good thing that I just happen to be a grand master of all things explosively alchemical. This won't ignite on its own, though.
text.completed: Return to Initiate Goldmine at the Quartzite Basin in Deepholm.

english.title: Explosive Bonding Compound
english.objectives: Collect 5 Quartzite Resin.
english.description: This guy's the son of the Earthen leader! He almost made it to the temple when he got ambushed by more rock flayers than I can count!$B$BWe know that the Earthen Stonefather has the middle fragment of the World Pillar. Maybe if we were to heal his son, the Stonefather would give us the fragment?$B$BMy heals won't work on Flint here. But if we were to get some of the quartzite resin off of these monsters, I think I can make an explosive compound that will bond and cauterize his wounds.
english.progress: It won't take much resin. Those rock flayers are pretty dangerous though.
english.completion: Good thing that I just happen to be a grand master of all things explosively alchemical. This won't ignite on its own, though.
english.completed: Return to Initiate Goldmine at the Quartzite Basin in Deepholm.

text.title: 立敷骤干
text.objectives: 在弗林特·岩幔身上使用爆炸接合混合物。
text.description: 好的，拿上这个敷在他的伤口上。要是骤干炸药的熔接效果没有把他轰开，就肯定能完全治好他了。$B$B我想是的。
text.completion: Looks like that did it. He should come to any moment now. I told you I was a grand master of alchemy! I've got some extra resin leftover. I can make it into all kinds of explosively wonderful stuff. What do you want?
text.completed: Speak with Intitiate Goldmine at the Quartzite Basin in Deepholm.

english.title: Apply and Flash Dry
english.objectives: Use the Explosive Bonding Compound on Flint Oremantle.
english.description: Alright, take this and apply it to his wounds. If the cauterizing effect of the flash dry explosion doesn't crack him wide open, it should completely heal him.$B$BI think.
english.completion: Looks like that did it. He should come to any moment now. I told you I was a grand master of alchemy! I've got some extra resin leftover. I can make it into all kinds of explosively wonderful stuff. What do you want?
english.completed: Speak with Intitiate Goldmine at the Quartzite Basin in Deepholm.

text.title: 莫什奥格的馈赠
text.objectives: 从莫什奥格食人魔山后的废墟里获得莫什奥格的馈赠。
text.description: Say... have you heard about the ogres?  I got a hot tip from some fella' named Mok'thardin that they're hiding some special, magical artifact in their cave.  Skeezy knows better, though.  I can smell money from a Mulgore mile away, and I'll bet that ogre doodad's worth a fortune.$b$bHere's a hint: I've seen them guarding a chest up in some ruins behind their mound.  Care to fetch it for me?
text.completed: Return to Skeezy Whillzap at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: The Mosh'Ogg Bounty
english.objectives: Obtain the Mosh'Ogg Bounty from the ruins behind the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mound.
english.description: Say... have you heard about the ogres?  I got a hot tip from some fella' named Mok'thardin that they're hiding some special, magical artifact in their cave.  Skeezy knows better, though.  I can smell money from a Mulgore mile away, and I'll bet that ogre doodad's worth a fortune.$b$bHere's a hint: I've seen them guarding a chest up in some ruins behind their mound.  Care to fetch it for me?
english.completed: Return to Skeezy Whillzap at Bambala in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 带他去见唤地者
text.objectives: 把弗林特·岩幔介绍给大地神殿的唤地者耶法。
text.description: 我觉得他好像还有点迷糊。他的脑袋一定还晕着。$B$B最好把他带到神殿里去，看唤地者怎么处理。$B$B我想我还得在外面多待上一会儿，“观察”这些掠石虫。
text.completion: We are honored by Flint Oremantle's presence. I am given to understand that the Stonefather is in possession of a fragment of the World Pillar. It is imperative that we recover all of the fragments. The instability between worlds is increasing. Soon it may become too great even for mighty Thrall to hold at bay.
text.completed: Speak with Earthcaller Yevaa at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.
text.objective1: Flint Oremantle introduced to Earthcaller Yevaa

english.title: Take Him to the Earthcaller
english.objectives: Introduce Flint Oremantle to Earthcaller Yevaa at the Temple of Earth.
english.description: He still looks a little loopy to me. His head must still be ringing.$B$BBest get him inside the temple and see what the Earthcaller wants to do with him.$B$BI think I'm going to stay out here a little while longer and "observe" these rock flayers.
english.completion: We are honored by Flint Oremantle's presence. I am given to understand that the Stonefather is in possession of a fragment of the World Pillar. It is imperative that we recover all of the fragments. The instability between worlds is increasing. Soon it may become too great even for mighty Thrall to hold at bay.
english.completed: Speak with Earthcaller Yevaa at the Temple of Earth in Deepholm.
english.objective1: Flint Oremantle introduced to Earthcaller Yevaa

text.title: 捕捉狮鲈鱼
text.objectives: 暴风城的凯瑟琳·利兰要你给她带去8条硬化狮鲈鱼。
text.description: 有些时候，我钓鱼是为了乐趣；有些时候是为了放松；还有些时候是为了挑战，比方说狮鲈鱼吧。我们钓这种鱼不是为了饱口福，而是挑战自己的技术。你可以在暴风城北边的暴风湖中找到狮鲈鱼，要不要去试试看？
text.progress: Was the challenge too much for you?
text.completion: Nice work $n!  I see you are quite the fisherman these days.  Might just have to take you out on the boat soon and see what you can really do!
text.completed: Return the fish to Catherine Leland in Stormwind City.

english.title: Hitting a Walleye
english.objectives: Catherine Leland in Stormwind City wants you to bring her 8 Hardened Walleye.
english.description: Sometimes, I fish for fun.  Other times to relax, but sometimes I want a challenge.  That's where the hardened walleye comes into the picture.  This prized fish is not caught for us to eat, but for the challenge.  You can find the walleye in Stormwind Lake just north of the city.  Think you are up to the challenge?
english.progress: Was the challenge too much for you?
english.completion: Nice work $n!  I see you are quite the fisherman these days.  Might just have to take you out on the boat soon and see what you can really do!
english.completed: Return the fish to Catherine Leland in Stormwind City.

text.title: 那么，来丛林吧
text.objectives: 去找奥格瑞玛的博特。
text.description: 我的指挥官派我来寻找有潜力的新兵，帮忙守卫北荆棘谷的格罗姆高营地。你熟悉荆棘谷吗？很远很远……在无尽之海的对面，东部王国的南端。你刚好符合他的要求……想不想离开卡利姆多一阵子？$B$B想的话，就跟我在奥格瑞玛的同僚博特谈一谈。他会帮你登上飞艇。$B$B告诉他我说“小样小样”。他知道什么意思。
text.completion: Hah!  That Cromula cracks me up. Oh, right, Stranglethorn.  You're really going?
text.completed: Report to Bort in Orgrimmar.

english.title: Well, Come to the Jungle
english.objectives: Report to Bort in Orgrimmar.
english.description: My commander has sent me to scout for potential recruits to assist in the defense of Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.  Are you familiar with Stranglethorn?  It's a long way away... across the Great Sea, on the southern tip of the Eastern Kingdoms.  You fit the build he was looking for... interested in leaving Kalimdor for a while?$b$bIf so, then go talk to my cohort Bort in Orgrimmar.  He'll help you board the zeppelin.$b$bAnd tell him I said "Woozle wozzle."  He'll know what it means.
english.completion: Hah!  That Cromula cracks me up. Oh, right, Stranglethorn.  You're really going?
english.completed: Report to Bort in Orgrimmar.

text.title: 北荆棘谷：覆灭的帝国
text.objectives: 前往北荆棘谷，向格罗姆高营地的指挥官阿格罗戈什报到。
text.description: 指挥官阿格罗戈什正在募集忠诚的部落成员，以协助他在格罗姆高的行动。如果你感兴趣的话，就到飞艇塔上去，搭乘开往格罗姆高的飞艇。就这么简单！$B$B说真的，荆棘谷是个好去处……那里有数不清的机遇，而且没有遭到很严重的破坏，你看石爪山成了什么样子……真希望我也能跟你一起去。
text.completion: Glad you could make it!  Let's get to work, shall we?
text.completed: Report to Commander Aggro'gosh at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

english.title: Northern Stranglethorn: The Fallen Empire
english.objectives: Report to Commander Aggro'gosh at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.
english.description: Commander Aggro'gosh is looking for devoted members of the Horde to assist him and his mission in Grom'gol.  If you're interested, just hop on up to the top of that zeppelin tower and board the Grom'gol zeppelin.  It's that easy!$b$bSeriously, Stranglethorn is the place to be right now... there's plenty of action to be found, and not nearly as much cataclysmic damage as, say... Stonetalon Mountains.  I wish I could go with you.
english.completion: Glad you could make it!  Let's get to work, shall we?
english.completed: Report to Commander Aggro'gosh at Grom'gol Base Camp in Northern Stranglethorn.

text.title: 沙德拉之壳
text.objectives: 杀死守护者奇尔加，获得沙德拉之壳。
text.description: 还剩最后一件，我们就都齐了。$B$B掌握沙德拉之壳的，是蜘蛛之神最后一名活着的高阶女祭司，守护者奇尔加。她站在祖尔祭坛的顶端，被其他盲信的狂热者所守护着。$B$B很简单吧？登上祭坛顶端，让她的脑袋从上面滚下来。把壳带给我，我们就终于能够召唤沙德拉了。
text.progress: Do you have it?
text.completion: Yes... it's finally time. Shadra will be ours!
text.completed: Return to Darkcleric Marnal at Hiri'watha Research Station in The Hinterlands.
text.giverWindow: Qiaga is a devoted disciple of Shadra.  She will not part with the shell easily.

english.title: The Shell of Shadra
english.objectives: Kill Qiaga the Keeper and collect the Shell of Shadra.
english.description: We've one last part to collect, and then we'll have everything we need.$B$BThe Shell of Shadra is held by the spider god's last living high priestess, Qiaga the Keeper. She stands atop the Altar of Zul, guarded by other fanatical zealots.$B$BSimple enough, no? Get up the steps of the altar and send her head rolling back down them. Bring the shell to me and we will have Shadra at last.
english.progress: Do you have it?
english.completion: Yes... it's finally time. Shadra will be ours!
english.completed: Return to Darkcleric Marnal at Hiri'watha Research Station in The Hinterlands.
english.giverWindow: Qiaga is a devoted disciple of Shadra.  She will not part with the shell easily.

text.title: 毒蜘蛛女王沙德拉
text.objectives: 杀死毒蜘蛛女王沙德拉
text.description: <神像被放上了祭坛，大地开始震颤，湖水开始翻涌！沙德拉就要出现了！>
text.completion: Excellently done. You have served the Dark Lady well today, $n. This virulent blood will supply our armies with all manner of powerful weapons against the disgusting Alliance. We will wipe them from these lands. For the Horde, of course... and all thanks to you.
text.completed: Return to Darkcleric Marnal at Hiri'watha Research Camp in The Hinterlands.

english.title: Shadra the Venom Queen
english.objectives: Kill Shadra the Venom Queen.
english.description: <The ground rumbles as the idol sits on the altar, and the lake below roils! Shadra is emerging!>
english.completion: Excellently done. You have served the Dark Lady well today, $n. This virulent blood will supply our armies with all manner of powerful weapons against the disgusting Alliance. We will wipe them from these lands. For the Horde, of course... and all thanks to you.
english.completed: Return to Darkcleric Marnal at Hiri'watha Research Camp in The Hinterlands.

text.title: 挖蚯蚓
text.objectives: 在奥莉维亚的水池附近找到一条发育过剩的蚯蚓，用它当鱼饵，钓起一条水晶鲈鱼。你可以在暴风城北面的奥莉维亚的水池中找到水晶鲈鱼。
text.description: 你好啊，钓鱼高手！阿诺德跟我说，你正在寻找新的钓鱼场所，我正好知道一个地方。在暴风城北边有一个钓鱼的好去处，名叫奥莉维亚的水池。$B$B那片水池中每年都产出许多水晶鲈鱼，不过很难捕捉。它们只吃一种鱼饵……那就是发育过剩的蚯蚓。如果你在池塘的岸边找一找，应该可以找到大量蚯蚓。
text.progress: Did the bait work?
text.completion: Those look like some nice bass, $n.  Let's fry em' up and see how they taste!
text.completed: Return with your catch to Catherine Leland in Stormwind City.

english.title: Diggin' For Worms
english.objectives: Find an Overgrown Earthworm near Olivia's Pond and use it as bait to catch a Crystal Bass.  Crystal Bass can be found in Olivia's Pond, north of Stormwind.
english.description: Hey there, Angler!  Arnold here tells me that you have been looking for a new fishing spot and I think I know just the place.  North of Stormwind there is a great little spot called Olivia's Pond.$b$bThe pond is stocked with crystal bass every year but they are hard to catch.  They only bite on a very specific type of bait... overgrown earthworms.  If you search the shore around the pond, you should find plenty of worms to use as bait.
english.progress: Did the bait work?
english.completion: Those look like some nice bass, $n.  Let's fry em' up and see how they taste!
english.completed: Return with your catch to Catherine Leland in Stormwind City.

text.title: 晋见大工匠
text.objectives: 在新工匠镇里，向大工匠梅卡托克进行自我介绍。
text.description: 我不知道你是否还记得梅卡托克。内温跟我说，诺莫瑞根的幸存者普遍患有失忆症。$B$B梅卡托克，更正式地说，大工匠梅卡托克，是所有侏儒的领袖。他有个习惯，就是要亲自接见每一位幸存者。你应该去见见他。他就在镇中心的帐篷里，跟他的军事参谋们在一起。
text.completion: It's good to meet you, $n. You've probably heard others speaking of Operation: Gnomeregan. Let me tell you a bit about what happened and why we left the dwarven city of Ironforge.
text.completed: Introduce yourself to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown.

english.title: Meet the High Tinker
english.objectives: Introduce yourself to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown.
english.description: I don't know if you'll remember Mekkatorque or not. Nevin tells me that memory loss is pretty common for a Gnomeregan survivor.$B$BMekkatorque, or more properly, the High Tinker Mekkatorque is the leader of all the gnomes. He has made a habit of meeting with every rescued survivor personally. You should introduce yourself to him. He'll be with his war council beneath the tent in the center of town.
english.completion: It's good to meet you, $n. You've probably heard others speaking of Operation: Gnomeregan. Let me tell you a bit about what happened and why we left the dwarven city of Ironforge.
english.completed: Introduce yourself to High Tinker Mekkatorque in New Tinkertown.

text.title: 狂风怒啸
text.objectives: 去找亘久者翡尔森，让他指引你前往碎岩之渊。
text.description: 有一个任务我可以交给你。$B$B很危险的任务。完成它可以让你取信于更顽固的石领主。$B$B西北便是蚀沙荒漠，狂风猛烈地吹打着顽石，掩盖了真正的威胁。$B$B蚀沙荒漠里住着旋岩虫。它们以岩石为食，穿行其中，犹如在水中游动。它们也能对我们的石头皮肤造成同样的伤害。$B$B去找亘久者翡尔森，让他指引你前往碎岩之渊，你到那里之后，我再同你交谈。
text.completion: <The ground rumbles slightly as you approach the cave. This looks to be the entrance that Diamant and Felsen spoke of.>
text.completed: Find the entrance to the Crumbling Depths.
text.objective2: Find the entrance to the Crumbling Depths

english.title: Violent Gale
english.objectives: Find Felsen the Enduring and follow his instruction towards the entrance to the Crumbling Depths.
english.description: There is a task that I can set before you.$B$BIt is a dangerous task. Completing it will help impress the more stubborn Stone Lords.$B$BTo the northwest is the Scoured Reach. Severe winds batter the rock and hide the true living threat underneath.$B$BWithin the Scoured Reach are Gyreworms. They devour rock and move through it as if it were water. They do the same thing to our rocky skin.$B$BFind Felsen the Enduring. Have him direct you to the Crumbling Depths. I will speak to you once you get that far.
english.completion: <The ground rumbles slightly as you approach the cave. This looks to be the entrance that Diamant and Felsen spoke of.>
english.completed: Find the entrance to the Crumbling Depths.
english.objective2: Find the entrance to the Crumbling Depths

text.title: 没有船长也没有船员
text.objectives: 把一瓶威士忌酒和一捆绳子交给大副穆迪。
text.description: 不知道你是跟谁一边的，不过你看来不像是……他们那头的。$B$B我不清楚发生了什么事。开晚饭的时候我睡过头了，醒来后只见船上到处都是死人和凶手。$B$B不知道你是不是打算把我杀掉，不过你可以不用麻烦了。$B$B<你发现穆迪失血过多，大概是没救了。>$B$B我勉强还能驾驶一会儿。趁我还有一口气，给我弄点绳子，还有朗姆酒来就行……不，还是威士忌吧。
text.progress: You have what I asked for?
text.completion: All right, help me get tied to the wheel.

english.title: Without a Captain or Crew
english.objectives: Bring First Mate Moody a Bottle of Whiskey and a Spool of Rope.
english.description: Not sure who you're with, but you don't look like one of... them.$B$BI'm not sure what happened.  I slept through supper and woke up to a ship full of dead people and murderers.$B$BNot sure if you want to kill me or not, but I'll spare you the trouble.$B$B<Moody points to a wound in his stomach.  His insides are not where they should be.>$B$BI can keep steering the ship for a while longer.  You don't die from a gut wound immediately.  Just bring me some rope and some rum... no, whiskey.
english.progress: You have what I asked for?
english.completion: All right, help me get tied to the wheel.

text.title: 科娜塔一家
text.objectives: 拿下科娜塔·达比雷、法迪尔·达比雷和马塞尔·达比雷的徽记。
text.description: 混账！猪狗！科娜塔还活着，她的家族尽享天伦，生生不息，而我却吃尽苦头。好个被遗忘者！$B$B我的家人都丧生于瘟疫。我们的家产在战时遭到侵占洗劫，被付之一炬。除此之外，她和她可恶的子孙们厚颜无耻地将我仅存的宝贵财物都偷走了。$B$B那些被偷的东西我已经不在乎了。我要的是他们的命！$B$B把他们给我杀了！到避难谷地东北边阿拉希的达比雷农场去。
text.progress: 杀光他们，把他们的头拿来!
text.completion: 你是代表着复仇信念的$C，我要对你鞠躬以表示感谢。$B$B既然那母牛已经死了，她的野种也不会再在艾泽拉斯大陆上出现了，这样我就可以把我的全部精力投入到一些对自己更有利的事情中。你把她们都给结果了以後没忘记搜搜那个农场吧?$B$B
text.completed: Return to Genavie Callow at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.
text.giverWindow: She will pay with her head!

english.title: To Steal From Thieves
english.objectives: Take the heads of Kenata Dabyrie, Fardel Dabyrie, and Marcel Dabyrie.
english.description: The harlot! The swine! Kenata still lives; her family healthy and prospering while I suffer. Forsaken indeed!$B$BMy family is gone, taken by the plague. Our estate also forfeit; looted and burned during the war. And after all that, she and her lousy children had the audacity to steal the only precious belongings I had left.$B$BI don't care about the things they stole any more. What I want now are their heads!$B$BKill them for me! Go to the Dabyrie Farmstead in Arathi, northeast of Refuge Point.
english.progress: Kill them all and bring me their heads!
english.completion: You stand before me as a figure of vengeance, and I bow down before you in thanks. With that cow's death, and knowing that their seed will no longer spread over the face of Azeroth, I can put my energy into something more lucrative. I hope you looted their farmstead after you finished them off.
english.completed: Return to Genavie Callow at Galen's Fall in Arathi Highlands.
english.giverWindow: She will pay with her head!

text.title: 捣毁枯木
text.objectives: 杀死枯木的10名掷斧者、10名猎头者和8名巫医。
text.description: 枯木巨魔和阿拉希的石拳食人魔联合起来，要把我们赶出这片土地，但我们决不会把命运交给他们掌控！我们要除掉他们，让他们知道谁是这儿真正的主宰。$B$B巨魔背弃了我们，食人魔想要把我们当作美味的食物——我们决不能允许这种事情发生。$B$B现在，让我们从南边的枯木巨魔开始吧。去杀掉他们，让他们血流成河！
text.completion: 你的眉角边滴淌着汗水，你的脸上弥漫着杀气。好样的，你干得很棒。$B$B
text.completed: Return to Drum Fel at Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands.

english.title: Crush the Witherbark
english.objectives: Slay 10 Witherbark Axe Throwers, 10 Headhunters and 8 Witch Doctors.
english.description: The Witherbark trolls and Boulderfist ogres of Arathi are working together to rid us from this land, but we shall not meet our fates at their, or anyone else's, hand. We will slay them and show them that we, too, have a home here. $B$BThe trolls turned their backs to us; the ogres would use us for food and bedding if we allowed them to--these things shall not be.$B$BWe start our attack on the Witherbark trolls to the south of here. Slay them in droves, and only return when their camps run thick with blood.
english.completion: The signs of war are upon your garments, and sweat drips from your brow. Good, very good indeed.
english.completed: Return to Drum Fel at Hammerfall in Arathi Highlands.

text.title: 恶齿村
text.objectives: 跟辛特兰恶齿村的断齿长者谈一谈。
text.description: Not all forest trolls are foul nuisances like the Witherbark. North of here in the Hinterlands is Revantusk Village, home to the only forest troll tribe still allied with the Horde.$B$BEven they cannot escape the cruelty of their bretheren. The Vilebranch tribe wars with them, distracting them from our battle with the Alliance.$B$BYou have fought well here. Speak with Urda if you wish to fly to Revantusk. Their village will have use of your strength.
text.completion: Welcome to Revantusk, $c. I hope fighting the Witherbark hasn't exhausted you; the Vilebranch are even worse.

english.title: Revantusk Village
english.objectives: Travel to Revantusk Village in The Hinterlands and speak with Elder Torntusk.
english.description: Not all forest trolls are foul nuisances like the Witherbark. North of here in the Hinterlands is Revantusk Village, home to the only forest troll tribe still allied with the Horde.$B$BEven they cannot escape the cruelty of their bretheren. The Vilebranch tribe wars with them, distracting them from our battle with the Alliance.$B$BYou have fought well here. Speak with Urda if you wish to fly to Revantusk. Their village will have use of your strength.
english.completion: Welcome to Revantusk, $c. I hope fighting the Witherbark hasn't exhausted you; the Vilebranch are even worse.

text.title: 考古学
text.objectives: Accept this quest to find archaeology points on your map!
text.description: Accept this quest to find archaeology points on your map!

english.title: Archaeology
english.objectives: Accept this quest to find archaeology points on your map!
english.description: Accept this quest to find archaeology points on your map!

text.title: 辛萨罗失陷
text.objectives: 去找辛特兰辛萨罗的断齿族长。
text.description: 我们要对付的不仅是矮人，伙计。我照看着村子，而我的配偶断齿族长已经领着战士们前去征讨邪恶的邪枝部落了。$B$B他们杀了我们的兄弟，我也被他们俘虏过一次。不会再发生这种事了！这一次，辛萨罗将属于我们。$B$B到辛萨罗去和我的配偶谈谈。她在城市入口占领了一处营地。
text.completion: Welcome, $c. We're gonna make the Vilebranch regret ever crossin' us.

english.title: The Fall of Jintha'Alor
english.objectives: Find Primal Torntusk at Jintha'Alor in The Hinterlands.
english.description: We've got more to deal with than just dwarves, mon. While I watch the village, my mate Primal Torntusk has gone to lead our warriors against the wicked Vilebranch tribe.$B$BThey've killed our brothers, and I was even taken prisoner by them once. No more! This time, the city of Jintha'Alor falls to us.$B$BGo to Jintha'Alor and speak with my mate. She's captured a camp near the entrance to the city.
english.completion: Welcome, $c. We're gonna make the Vilebranch regret ever crossin' us.

text.title: 澄澈圣水
text.objectives: 从荆棘谷海角纳克迈尼圣泉里打上澄澈圣水。
text.description: Skeezy said you'd be coming.  Let's identify this... thing.$b$bTo start out, I'm going to need you to obtain The Holy Water of Clarity.  The nagas to our southeast maintain a hallowed shrine that dispenses a water so clean, so fresh, and so mouthwateringly pure, that when the imbiber quaffs but a mouthful of the sacred stuff, their mind is cleansed and their best path made clear.$b$bSounds good, doesn't it?$b$bObtain it from the Nek'mani Wellspring at the peak of the naga camp.  Good luck!
text.progress: The Holy Water of Clarity?  Is it here!?
text.completion: Ahh... do you know how hard it is to get fresh water in Stranglethorn?  It's no wonder that the nagas guard their shrine so ferociously! Oh, right... your artifact, and clarity.  Clarity... I've got it!
text.completed: Return to Flem Gizzix at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: The Holy Water of Clarity
english.objectives: Obtain The Holy Water of Clarity from the Nek'mani Wellspring in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.description: Skeezy said you'd be coming.  Let's identify this... thing.$b$bTo start out, I'm going to need you to obtain The Holy Water of Clarity.  The nagas to our southeast maintain a hallowed shrine that dispenses a water so clean, so fresh, and so mouthwateringly pure, that when the imbiber quaffs but a mouthful of the sacred stuff, their mind is cleansed and their best path made clear.$b$bSounds good, doesn't it?$b$bObtain it from the Nek'mani Wellspring at the peak of the naga camp.  Good luck!
english.progress: The Holy Water of Clarity?  Is it here!?
english.completion: Ahh... do you know how hard it is to get fresh water in Stranglethorn?  It's no wonder that the nagas guard their shrine so ferociously! Oh, right... your artifact, and clarity.  Clarity... I've got it!
english.completed: Return to Flem Gizzix at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 力量的源生材料
text.objectives: 剥来4张柔软的虎皮和4张光滑的猎豹皮。
text.description: 我看明白了……鉴定这条神秘的护符关键是要获得一些稀有而珍贵的物品。这些力量的源生材料，按正确的方式组合后，将为我们揭露宝物的来源。$B$B到北边去，就在古拉巴什竞技场西侧，打几头游荡在丛林里的虎豹来。它们那毛茸茸的皮草将会把我们领往真相！
text.progress: Make sure the reagents are extra-cushy, $n.  A scratchy reagent simply won't do.
text.completion: Excellent work, $n!  These reagents will serve perfectly.
text.completed: Return to Flem Gizzix at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Primal Reagents of Power
english.objectives: Obtain 4 Supple Tiger Furs and 4 Velvety Panther Furs.
english.description: I see clearly now... the key to identifying this mysterious talisman revolves around obtaining some rare and precious items.  These Primal Reagents of Power, when properly combined, will reveal to us the origin of our treasure.$b$bTravel north, to the western side of the Gurubashi Arena, and hunt the cats that roam the jungle.  Their fleecy furs will lead us to the truth!
english.progress: Make sure the reagents are extra-cushy, $n.  A scratchy reagent simply won't do.
english.completion: Excellent work, $n!  These reagents will serve perfectly.
english.completed: Return to Flem Gizzix at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 我是个大骗子
text.objectives: 把打开的莫什奥格的馈赠带给荆棘谷海角藏宝海湾的格尔蕾·逐光。
text.description: 我不知道这神器是什么玩意。我甚至不知道怎么着手去分析这东西。$B$B事实上，我不知道为什么所有人都觉得我能把它鉴定出来。$B$B我要水是因为我渴了。我要珠宝和皮草是因为……嗯，因为我女朋友要。$B$B好在我可以给你指条明路。藏宝海湾的格尔蕾·逐光是神圣遗物学会的成员，她可能比我更有用。$B$B对不起。
text.progress: Yes, $r?  I'm quite busy.
text.completion: Fascinating! I'll need some time to study this.  Why don't you have a look around Booty Bay and come back later?

english.title: I'm A Huge Liar and a Fraud
english.objectives: Bring the Opened Mosh'ogg Bounty to Garley Lightrider at Booty Bay in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.description: I have no idea what this artifact is.  I have no idea where I would even START finding out what it is.$b$bIn fact, I have no idea why anybody expected ME to be able to identify it in the first place.$b$bI asked for water because I was thirsty.  I asked for the jewelry and furs for... well, they're for my girlfriend.$b$bHopefully I can at least point you in the right direction.  Garley Lightrider in Booty Bay is a member of the Reliquary, and might be of more use than me.$b$bSorry.
english.progress: Yes, $r?  I'm quite busy.
english.completion: Fascinating! I'll need some time to study this.  Why don't you have a look around Booty Bay and come back later?

text.title: 根深蒂固
text.objectives: 去找颤石塔林的恒定者柯尔。
text.description: 你的目的看来是真的。$B$B我会将我谨慎的信任也传达给其它石领主。$B$B这样，他们才会同你交谈。$B$B更重要的是，他们才会聆听你的话语。$B$B赢得他们的好感需要时间，赢得石母的好感更是需要时间。时间是最有诚意的赠物，因此不要吝惜。$B$B在西北方远处的颤石塔林，你可以找到恒定者柯尔。他性格已经沉稳下来了。他的状况恰能让他寻求外来者的帮助。$B$B去找他吧。
text.completion: Diamant says you are to be trusted. Diamant is patient and wise, so I shall allow you to prove yourself.$B$BAs it happens, I could use hands that are more... mobile.

english.title: Entrenched
english.objectives: Seek out Kor the Immovable among the Shuddering Spires.
english.description: Your intentions appear true.$B$BI will impress upon the other Stone Lords my wary trust.$B$BWith this, they should speak to you.$B$BMore importantly, they should listen.$B$BEarning their favor may take time. Earning the Stonemother's favor may take more time. Time is a potent offering, so be generous with it.$B$BAmong the Shuddering Spires far to the northwest, you shall find Kor the Immovable. He is evenly tempered. His situation lends itself well to seeking outside aid.$B$BGo to him.
english.completion: Diamant says you are to be trusted. Diamant is patient and wise, so I shall allow you to prove yourself.$B$BAs it happens, I could use hands that are more... mobile.

text.title: 清澈如水晶
text.objectives: 收集8簇粉白水晶阵列。
text.description: 颤石塔林里有一种水晶。如垩土一般粉白的水晶。我们可以将这种水晶吸收到皮肤里去。洗涤自己。净化自己。$B$B我不再混迹于岩石中。我已同大地融为一体。这会带来许多益处，但也使我无法亲自取得水晶。$B$B将水晶给我带来，我才能更加强大。不要给那些掠石虫。不要给我的孩子们。这荣耀将只属于我。
text.progress: Have you done this favor that I asked of you? Did you bring the crystals?
text.completion: Ahh... invigorating. Thank you, fleshling.
text.completed: Return to Kor the Immovable amongst the Shuddering Spires in Deepholm.

english.title: Making Things Crystal Clear
english.objectives: Collect 8 Chalky Crystal Formations.
english.description: Among the Shuddering Spires are crystals. White, chalky crystals. We can absorb these crystals into our skin. To cleanse us. Purify us.$B$BI do not stride among the stones any longer. I am one with the earth. This carries many boons, but I can no longer retrieve the crystals for myself.$B$BBring me the crystals that I might be stronger. Carry them away from the flayers. Away from my sons. This honor should be mine.
english.progress: Have you done this favor that I asked of you? Did you bring the crystals?
english.completion: Ahh... invigorating. Thank you, fleshling.
english.completed: Return to Kor the Immovable amongst the Shuddering Spires in Deepholm.

text.title: 干涉介入
text.objectives: 消灭12名玉角掠石虫。
text.description: 掠石虫们因饥饿而变得疯狂。它们的钻探原本还算是可以忍受。而现在它们的饥饿无法消除。它们变得异常狂暴。$B$B掠石虫开始对我的孩子们下手。它们为数众多。杀掉它们。必须阻止它们。$B$B杀死那些掠石虫，它们对大地没有益处。它们的死亡不会被怀念。拯救我的孩子们。杀掉你能找到的所有掠石虫。
text.completion: You've proven useful, $r.
text.completed: Return to Kor the Immovable amongst the Shuddering Spires in Deepholm.

english.title: Intervention
english.objectives: Kill 12 Jaspertip rockflayers.
english.description: The flayers have gone crazy with hunger. Their digging was once tempered and moderate. Now their hunger cannot be quenched. They grow murderously violent.$B$BThe flayers have turned on my sons. They overwhelm them. Kill them. It must stop.$B$BKill the flayers. They serve no purpose to the earth. Their passing will not be missed. Save my sons. Slaughter any flayers you find.
english.completion: You've proven useful, $r.
english.completed: Return to Kor the Immovable amongst the Shuddering Spires in Deepholm.

text.title: 拼成一块儿
text.objectives: 帮助6名休眠的石缚元素重新塑形。
text.description: $R. If you act in the service of the Stone Lords, there are those that might aid you.$B$BWatch for the Stonebound. They lie dormant all around the Shuddering Spires. It should not take much prompting to rebind them to service against the flayers.
text.completion: 谢谢你，$R。
text.completed: Return to Berracite amongst the Shuddering Spires in Deepholm.

english.title: Putting the Pieces Together
english.objectives: Aid 6 Dormant Stonebound Elementals in reforming.
english.description: $R. If you act in the service of the Stone Lords, there are those that might aid you.$B$BWatch for the Stonebound. They lie dormant all around the Shuddering Spires. It should not take much prompting to rebind them to service against the flayers.
english.completion: Thank you, $r.
english.completed: Return to Berracite amongst the Shuddering Spires in Deepholm.

text.title: Clingy
text.objectives: Bring Pebble to the large crystal formation in the Shuddering Spires.
text.description: <A miniscule elemental seems to have taken a liking to you.>$B$BCaris... carstr... crystal? <Pebble looks up at you expectantly.>$B$B<You did notice a very large crystal formation towards the middle of the Shuddering Spires. Perhaps you should take him there?>
text.progress: <Pebble looks up at you expectantly.>
text.completion: <The stones in Pebble's body bounce up and down happily. He seems very appreciative.>
text.completed: Speak to Pebble. You last saw him in the Shuddering Spires.

english.title: Clingy
english.objectives: Bring Pebble to the large crystal formation in the Shuddering Spires.
english.description: <A miniscule elemental seems to have taken a liking to you.>$B$BCaris... carstr... crystal? <Pebble looks up at you expectantly.>$B$B<You did notice a very large crystal formation towards the middle of the Shuddering Spires. Perhaps you should take him there?>
english.progress: <Pebble looks up at you expectantly.>
english.completion: <The stones in Pebble's body bounce up and down happily. He seems very appreciative.>
english.completed: Speak to Pebble. You last saw him in the Shuddering Spires.

text.title: So Big, So Round...
text.objectives: Speak to Kor to find out what kind of food Pebble might like.
text.description: <Pebble looks around, excited by something. After a few seconds of confusion, he stops and stares up at you with big, glowy gem eyes.>$B$BHug-nery... hungry...$B$B<Try as you might, there's no resisting those eyes. Maybe Kor knows what mini-mentals like to eat?>
text.completion: You've made a friend, have you?$B$BAre you certain you want to feed him? He might become attached.

english.title: So Big, So Round...
english.objectives: Speak to Kor to find out what kind of food Pebble might like.
english.description: <Pebble looks around, excited by something. After a few seconds of confusion, he stops and stares up at you with big, glowy gem eyes.>$B$BHug-nery... hungry...$B$B<Try as you might, there's no resisting those eyes. Maybe Kor knows what mini-mentals like to eat?>
english.completion: You've made a friend, have you?$B$BAre you certain you want to feed him? He might become attached.

text.title: 岩虾
text.objectives: 从暴风城港口码头下的笼子里收集6只岩虾。小心鲨鱼！
text.description: 如果我可以选择自己的最后一顿晚餐，那我肯定会选新鲜的龙虾。这种美味简直是无法抵挡！我们最近开始设陷阱捕捉暴风城外的龙虾了。你能去帮我看看陷阱的情况吗？$B$B哦，对了，你要小心鲨鱼，那可不是闹着玩的。
text.progress: Looks like you were able to avoid the sharks.  Were there any lobsters in the traps?
text.completion: Looks like the traps are working!  Thanks $n!
text.completed: Deliver the lobsters to Catherine Leland in Stormwind City.

english.title: Rock Lobster
english.objectives: Collect 6 Rock Lobsters from the cages below the docks in Stormwind Harbor.  Watch out for sharks!
english.description: If I could choose my last meal, it would definitely be fresh lobster tail.  Something about that tasty crustacean is just irresistible!  We recently started trapping lobsters here in Stormwind.  Would you mind heading out and checking the traps for me?$b$bOne more thing, watch out for the sharks.  They can be vicious down there.
english.progress: Looks like you were able to avoid the sharks.  Were there any lobsters in the traps?
english.completion: Looks like the traps are working!  Thanks $n!
english.completed: Deliver the lobsters to Catherine Leland in Stormwind City.

text.title: 恶魔的计划
text.objectives: 将恶魔的计划交给灰谷战歌伐木营地的守备官维达尔。
text.description: 恶魔掉落的这张羊皮纸上，居然写着通用语！上面提到了两个控制此地恶魔的恐惧魔王——迪亚索鲁斯和戈加农。$B$B这份计划细述了恶魔准备进行一次进攻，目标是北方的林歌神殿，德莱尼人在那里新建了一处聚居地。$B$B或许战歌伐木营地的守备官维达尔会对此感兴趣？
text.progress: What do you have there, sir?
text.completion: By the Seven Crystals of Ata'mal, this cannot be! They plan to attack Forest Song?! Not on my watch! No. We will not allow this to happen!

english.title: Diabolical Plans
english.objectives: Deliver the Diabolical Plans to Vindicator Vedaar at the Warsong Lumber Camp in Ashenvale.
english.description: The demon dropped this parchment, which is amazingly written in the Common tongue!  The ones mentioned in it, Diathorus and Gorgannon, are the two infamous dreadlords that control the demons hereabouts.$B$BThe plans detail preparations for a demonic attack on Forest Song to the north, the location where a new draenei settlement is being established.$B$BPerhaps Vindicator Vedaar at the Warsong Lumber Camp would be interested in these?
english.progress: What do you have there, sir?
english.completion: By the Seven Crystals of Ata'mal, this cannot be! They plan to attack Forest Song?! Not on my watch! No. We will not allow this to happen!

text.title: 毁灭燃烧军团
text.objectives: 消灭冥火岭、屠魔峡谷和屠魔山的任意15名恶魔。
text.description: 我不能容忍他们存在于这个世界上！燃烧军团几乎将我们灭族，我们只好逃到一个新世界来安居。一次又一次地，他们紧追不舍，我们节节败退。$B$B不能再这样下去了！$B$B在南部和西部被称为冥火岭、屠魔峡谷和屠魔山的地区里，还有一支军团的残部。他们是很久以前入侵这个世界时所遗留下来的部队。$B$B去尽你所能把他们消灭掉，不然一切都晚了！
text.completion: You have my respect and thanks, $c. Perhaps we'll be able to create a new home here without having to worry about the Burning Legion yet again.
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Vedaar at the Warsong Lumber Camp in Ashenvale.

english.title: Destroy the Legion
english.objectives: Slay any 15 demons at Felfire Hill, Demon Fall Canyon, and Demon Fall Ridge.
english.description: I will not tolerate their existence on this world! The Burning Legion all but destroyed our race and we fell back to settle a new home on a new world. Then they came again and we retreated, over and over.$B$BNo more!$B$BThere is a remnant of the Legion to the south and west in the regions known as Felfire Hill, Demon Fall Canyon and Demon Fall Ridge. They are what is leftover from a force that once long ago invaded this world.$B$BGo and destroy as many as you can before it is too late!
english.completion: You have my respect and thanks, $c. Perhaps we'll be able to create a new home here without having to worry about the Burning Legion yet again.
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Vedaar at the Warsong Lumber Camp in Ashenvale.

text.title: 绝不再会了！
text.objectives: 获得戈加农的烈焰之锋和寻觅者的魔化长矛。
text.description: $N，能否阻止燃烧军团的进攻，就全看你的了。你必须去把他们的首领干掉。没有了他们，恶魔就会陷入混乱。$B$B你可以在冥火岭南边的屠魔峡谷找到戈加农，就在玛诺洛斯漂浮的折矛附近。$B$B搜寻者迪亚索鲁斯则位于屠魔山顶的兽穴某处。从格罗姆·地狱咆哮的部落纪念碑附近的屠魔峡谷的坡道上去，就能到达屠魔山。$B$B把他俩的武器带回来。
text.progress: Our night elf scouts report that preparations for the attack are almost complete. Those dreadlords must die soon, $n!
text.completion: Never again will the Burning Legion threaten Ashenvale! You have delivered us from a fight we very likely would have lost, $c. I give you thanks, $n, and the deepest gratitude of the Hand of Argus. It honors me to have you at our side!
text.completed: Return to Vindicator Vedaar at the Warsong Lumber Camp in Ashenvale.

english.title: Never Again!
english.objectives: Obtain Gorgannon's Flaming Blade and the Seeker's Fel Spear.
english.description: $N, it falls to you to see that this attack by the Burning Legion never comes to pass. You must go and slay their leaders.  Without them the demons will be mindless.$B$BYou will find Gorgannon in Demon Fall Canyon south beyond Felfire Hill, near Mannoroth's floating, broken spear.$B$BDiathorus the Seeker resides somewhere in the barrow den atop Demon Fall Ridge. To find the ridge, look for a ramp up from Demon Fall Canyon near the Horde's monument to Grom Hellscream.$B$BBring me their weapons.
english.progress: Our night elf scouts report that preparations for the attack are almost complete. Those dreadlords must die soon, $n!
english.completion: Never again will the Burning Legion threaten Ashenvale! You have delivered us from a fight we very likely would have lost, $c. I give you thanks, $n, and the deepest gratitude of the Hand of Argus. It honors me to have you at our side!
english.completed: Return to Vindicator Vedaar at the Warsong Lumber Camp in Ashenvale.

text.title: 夺回冥火岭
text.objectives: 在肥沃的土壤里种植8棵小树苗。
text.description: 小个子，西南边就是夜歌森林里那块最近被称为冥火岭的地方。看见恶魔在那里横行，散播着腐化就令人心痛不已。$B$B你能不能帮忙把那里夺回来？$B$B我有一些为此而存下的种子。把它们带到冥火岭去，将它们种在肥沃的土壤里。
text.completion: Good. Though it may take a great deal of your years for the seedlings to grow into ancients, in the fullness of time they will aid us in our fight against all of the enemies of Ashenvale.
text.completed: Return to Gnarl at the Warsong Lumber Camp in Ashenvale.

english.title: Reclaiming Felfire Hill
english.objectives: Plant 8 Tree Seedlings in the Fertile Dirt Mounds.
english.description: Little one, to the southwest is an area of Nightsong Woods that has in recent times come to be called Felfire Hill. It is very sad to see the demons crawling over it, spreading their corruption.$B$BWould you do something to help take back the land?$B$BI have a number of seeds that I have been saving for such a purpose. Take them to Felfire Hill and plant them in the fertile dirt mounds.
english.completion: Good. Though it may take a great deal of your years for the seedlings to grow into ancients, in the fullness of time they will aid us in our fight against all of the enemies of Ashenvale.
english.completed: Return to Gnarl at the Warsong Lumber Camp in Ashenvale.

text.title: 恶魔的计划
text.objectives: 将恶魔的计划交给灰谷碎木岗哨的瓦鲁莎。
text.description: 恶魔掉落的这张羊皮纸上，居然写着通用语！上面提到了两个控制此地恶魔的恐惧魔王——迪亚索鲁斯和戈加农。$B$B这份计划细述了恶魔准备进行一次进攻，目标是西北方的碎木岗哨。$B$B你肯定碎木岗哨的瓦鲁莎会对此感兴趣。
text.progress: What do you have there, scout?
text.completion: Dreadlords!  They plan to attack us here at Splintertree Post?! Not while I still draw breath! No.  We will not allow this to happen!  They are a blight upon our world!

english.title: Diabolical Plans
english.objectives: Deliver the Diabolical Plans to Valusha at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale.
english.description: The demon dropped this parchment, which is amazingly written in the Orcish tongue!  The ones mentioned in it, Diathorus and Gorgannon, are the two infamous dreadlords that control the demons hereabouts.$B$BThe plans detail preparations for a demonic attack on Splintertree Post to the northwest.$B$BYou're certain that Valusha at Splintertree Post would be interested in these.
english.progress: What do you have there, scout?
english.completion: Dreadlords!  They plan to attack us here at Splintertree Post?! Not while I still draw breath! No.  We will not allow this to happen!  They are a blight upon our world!

text.title: 毁灭燃烧军团
text.objectives: 消灭冥火岭、屠魔峡谷和屠魔山的任意15名恶魔。
text.description: 长久以来，燃烧军团的余孽是我们的眼中钉、肉中刺！$B$B不能再这样下去了！$B$B恶魔们从东边的冥火岭、屠魔峡谷和屠魔山这几个地区发动了进攻。$B$B去尽你所能把他们消灭，将荣耀带给部落，还有你自己！
text.completion: That's better!  There's nothing quite like ridding our world of a demon.  And they make for worthy opponents as well, unlike the weak races of the Alliance.
text.completed: Speak to Valusha at Splintertree Post.

english.title: Destroy the Legion
english.objectives: Slay 15 of any demon type at Felfire Hill, Demon Fall Canyon, or Demon Fall Ridge.
english.description: The remains of the demonic Burning Legion have been a thorn in our side for far too long!$B$BNo more!$B$BThe demons are attacking from the areas known as Felfire Hill, Demon Fall Canyon and Demon Fall Ridge to the east.$B$BGo and destroy as many as you can to bring glory to both yourself and the Horde!
english.completion: That's better!  There's nothing quite like ridding our world of a demon.  And they make for worthy opponents as well, unlike the weak races of the Alliance.
english.completed: Speak to Valusha at Splintertree Post.

text.title: 绝不再会了！
text.objectives: 获得戈加农的烈焰之锋和寻觅者的魔化长矛。
text.description: $N，能否阻止燃烧军团的进攻，就全看你的了。去杀掉那些恐惧魔王！没有了他们，恶魔们根本上就是无头苍蝇。$B$B你可以在冥火岭南边的屠魔峡谷找到戈加农，就在玛诺洛斯漂浮的折矛附近。$B$B寻觅者迪亚索鲁斯则位于屠魔山顶的兽穴某处。$B$B把他们的武器带回来作为成功的证明。
text.progress: Those dreadlords must die soon, $n!
text.completion: Never again will the Burning Legion make slaves of the orcs, or any other race of the Horde! Bravely fought, $c!  You have the true heart of the Horde beating inside of you!  You give us much honor!
text.completed: Return to Velusha at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale.

english.title: Never Again!
english.objectives: Obtain Gorgannon's Flaming Blade and the Seeker's Fel Spear.
english.description: $N, you will see to it that this attack by the Burning Legion never comes to pass!  Go and slay these dreadlords!  Without them the rest of the demons are essentially mindless.$B$BYou will find Gorgannon in Demon Fall Canyon south beyond Felfire Hill, near Mannoroth's floating, broken spear.$B$BDiathorus the Seeker resides somewhere in the barrow den atop Demon Fall Ridge.$b$bReturn to me with their weapons as proof of your deeds.
english.progress: Those dreadlords must die soon, $n!
english.completion: Never again will the Burning Legion make slaves of the orcs, or any other race of the Horde! Bravely fought, $c!  You have the true heart of the Horde beating inside of you!  You give us much honor!
english.completed: Return to Velusha at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale.

text.title: 要是他们就把它们那么搁着的话……
text.objectives: 从荆棘谷海角南野人海岸获得6尊纳迦雕像。
text.description: 我正在寻思，$N。那些纳迦有的可不只是海草。他们喜欢在祭坛周围放置小雕像，沙子里啊，树下啊。他们也不想是要用的样子。$B$B我可用的着啊！我可以……把它们放在营地周围，让这里有家的感觉。啥都比该死的骑恐龙尸体玩要强啊。$B$B我可以拿来当纪念品卖。$B$B我可以把它们还卖给纳迦！$B$B你为什么不去给我弄几个来呢，我可以再想想。
text.progress: Let's see 'em!
text.completion: Nice work, $n.  Now I've just got to decide what to do with all of these...
text.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: If They're Just Going to Leave Them Lying Around...
english.objectives: Obtain 6 Naga Icons from the Southern Savage Coast in the Cape of Stranglethorn.
english.description: I was just thinking about something, $N.  Those naga have more than just reeds down there.  They tend to keep little statues lying around on their shrines, in the sand, under their trees.  They don't seem to be USING them.$b$bI could use those statues!  I could... put 'em around the camp, make it feel a little more homey.  Anything's better than a bloody dinosaur corpsepump.  I could sell them as souvenirs.$b$bI could sell them back to the naga!$b$bWhy don't you go grab a couple while I figure this out.
english.progress: Let's see 'em!
english.completion: Nice work, $n.  Now I've just got to decide what to do with all of these...
english.completed: Return to Sassy Hardwrench at Hardwrench Hideaway in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 古拉巴什的挑战：竞技场混战
text.objectives: 将古拉巴什挑战之旗插在大竞技场里，然后打败古拉巴什竞技场挑战者。
text.description: 竞技场是个与众不同的战场。在那里，你没有朋友可言。所谓的联盟不过是过眼云烟，你的盟友可以转瞬背叛你。部落对联盟，联盟对联盟，部落对部落……什么可能都有。$B$B带上这面战旗，$R，把它插在竞技场里。打败召唤出来的挑战者，然后回到我这里来。$B$B保持警惕，$R。在古拉巴什竞技场里可是什么事情都有可能发生。
text.completion: Well done, $r!  Did you feel it?  The rush of the melee?  The true risk of free-for-all combat? As today is your first day here, I'll let you perform in one more competition for another reward.  If you return in the future, you may compete again, once a day.  Your rewards will, of course, improve as you become stronger.
text.completed: Return to Stone Guard Towhide at The Great Arena in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Gurubashi Challenge: Free-For-All Arena Combat
english.objectives: Place the Gurubashi Challenge Flag down inside the Battle Ring, then defeat the Gurubashi Arena Challenger.
english.description: The arena is a place of battle unlike any other.  Inside, you have no friends.  Alliances that do form are fleeting, as your allies can turn on you in the blink of an eye.  Horde vs. Alliance, Alliance vs. Alliance, Horde vs. Horde... anything goes.$b$bTake this battle standard, $r, and place it down on the arena floor.  Defeat the summoned combatant, then return to me.$b$bStay on your toes, $r.  Anything goes inside the Gurubashi Arena.
english.completion: Well done, $r!  Did you feel it?  The rush of the melee?  The true risk of free-for-all combat? As today is your first day here, I'll let you perform in one more competition for another reward.  If you return in the future, you may compete again, once a day.  Your rewards will, of course, improve as you become stronger.
english.completed: Return to Stone Guard Towhide at The Great Arena in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 古拉巴什的挑战
text.objectives: 将古拉巴什挑战之旗插在大竞技场里，然后打败古拉巴什竞技场挑战者。
text.description: 你回来了，$R。这说明你再次感受到了竞技场的召唤。很好。$B$B带上这面战旗，$R，把它插在竞技场里。打败召唤出来的挑战者，然后回到我这里来。$B$B保持警惕，$R。在古拉巴什竞技场里可是什么事情都有可能发生
text.completion: Well done, $r!  I look forward to seeing you fight again soon.
text.completed: Return to Stone Guard Towhide at The Great Arena in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

english.title: Gurubashi Challenge
english.objectives: Place the Gurubashi Challenge Flag down inside the Battle Ring, then defeat the Gurubashi Arena Challenger.
english.description: You've returned, $r.  That means you've felt the call of the arena once more.  Very well.$b$bTake this battle standard, $r, and place it down on the arena floor.  Defeat the summoned combatant, then return to me.$b$bStay on your toes, $r.  Anything goes inside the Gurubashi Arena.
english.completion: Well done, $r!  I look forward to seeing you fight again soon.
english.completed: Return to Stone Guard Towhide at The Great Arena in the Cape of Stranglethorn.

text.title: 援助之手
text.objectives: 跟灰谷林歌神殿的建筑师尼莫斯谈一谈。$B$B守备官帕兰纳尔可以为你提供坐骑，让你迅速抵达。
text.description: 在建筑师尼莫斯和守备官维达尔的监督下，我的人正让灰谷东部一所暗夜精灵的旧前哨重新恢复运转。$B$B建筑工作可不容易，$N，他们要面对众多的敌人和艰巨的挑战。我知道建筑师尼莫斯和他的同胞非常乐于接受任何帮助，他关照过我，如果有能干的人，就立刻给他派去。$B$B再和我谈一谈，我会安排你搭一趟快运到他们那儿去。
text.completion: It's good to see another new arrival here at Forest Song. Vindicator Palanaar is sending as much help as she can muster and each set of hands is appreciated. Take a look around, $c. It may not be much now, but with time and help from our night elf allies, we'll build a settlement worthy of calling home. There is much to be done here and any help you can provide would be welcome.

english.title: A Helping Hand
english.objectives: Speak with Architect Nemos at Forest Song in Ashenvale.$B$BVindicator Palanaar can offer you a ride to get you there more swiftly.
english.description: Under the supervision of Architect Nemos and Vindicator Vedaar, my people are revitalizing an old night elf outpost in the eastern part of Ashenvale.$B$BThe task of building won't be easy, $N, for the challenges and enemies they face are many. I know Architect Nemos and his compatriots at Forest Song would appreciate any help they can get, and he has asked me to send any interested $g men:women; his way.$B$BSpeak to me again and I will arrange for fast transport for you to their location.
english.completion: It's good to see another new arrival here at Forest Song. Vindicator Palanaar is sending as much help as she can muster and each set of hands is appreciated. Take a look around, $c. It may not be much now, but with time and help from our night elf allies, we'll build a settlement worthy of calling home. There is much to be done here and any help you can provide would be welcome.

text.title: 可耻的浪费
text.objectives: 收集15份萨提纳尔木材。
text.description: 欢迎来到林歌神殿，$C。那些搭着帐篷的地方，总有一天会树立起建筑，但如此的雄心大志也需要稳定的资材支持。我不能给工人下令去砍伐林地里的古树，但我们西边的邻居对森林可没什么敬意。$B$B我们应该把被污染的木材从西边的萨提纳尔里抢出来。将这些木头交给战歌伐木营地的纳亚尔。他是一棵古树，可以把木头净化好了让我们使用。
text.progress: Architect Nemos said that you might be bringing wood salvaged from befouled Satyrnaar.
text.completion: Wood warped by foul demonic magic is of no use to the draenei at Forest Song. Nothing sound can be built with it, but I shall purify it and return it in good time to Architect Nemos and his people for their use. Some good will come from this tragedy, after all.
text.completed: Speak with Gnarl at the Warsong Lumber Camp in Ashenvale.

english.title: A Shameful Waste
english.objectives: Collect 5 Satyrnaar Fel Wood.
english.description: Welcome to Forest Song, $c. Where you see tents, there will one day be buildings, but such ambition requires a steady stream of materials. I cannot bring myself to order our workers to fell any of the ancient trees of this grove, but our neighbors to the west have no such reverence for the forest.$B$BWe shall reclaim the tainted wood from Satyrnaar to the west. Take the wood to Gnarl at the Warsong Lumber Camp. He is an Ancient who will purify it for our use.
english.progress: Architect Nemos said that you might be bringing wood salvaged from befouled Satyrnaar.
english.completion: Wood warped by foul demonic magic is of no use to the draenei at Forest Song. Nothing sound can be built with it, but I shall purify it and return it in good time to Architect Nemos and his people for their use. Some good will come from this tragedy, after all.
english.completed: Speak with Gnarl at the Warsong Lumber Camp in Ashenvale.

text.title: 失落的圣杯
text.objectives: 获得艾露恩的圣杯。
text.description: 我们西边有一处叫作萨提纳尔的地方，过去曾是由我的人民所建的重要神殿。里面藏有一件名叫艾露恩的圣杯的无价圣物，艾露恩的祭司们曾将它交给神殿的守卫保管。据说这圣杯具有治愈之力，所以曾有无数的朝圣者前去祭祀。$B$B或许这听起来像是老婆婆讲的故事，但假如确实如此，那么或许这件圣物将是治愈这片森林的关键所在。我必须了解清楚，$N。
text.progress: Can you feel it, $n, the touch of corruption upon the wind? If we do nothing, it will continue to advance. That is why I seek the Chalice of Elune. Were you able to find it?
text.completion: Excellent work, $n. There is certainly a latent power here, one that not even constant exposure to the corruption of the satyr can dim. Do you see how it still shines, after all these years?
text.completed: Return to Kayneth Stillwind at Forest Song in Ashenvale.

english.title: The Lost Chalice
english.objectives: Obtain the Chalice of Elune.
english.description: The area to our west, now called Satyrnaar, was once a prominent shrine built by my people. It housed a priceless relic, the Chalice of Elune, entrusted to the shrine's keepers by the priests of Elune. Pilgrims once traveled to the shrine to experience the healing powers the chalice was rumored to hold.$B$BThese stories might be nothing but old wives' tales, but if there is any truth to them, the relic may hold the key to rejuvenating the wounded forest. I must know, $N.
english.progress: Can you feel it, $n, the touch of corruption upon the wind? If we do nothing, it will continue to advance. That is why I seek the Chalice of Elune. Were you able to find it?
english.completion: Excellent work, $n. There is certainly a latent power here, one that not even constant exposure to the corruption of the satyr can dim. Do you see how it still shines, after all these years?
english.completed: Return to Kayneth Stillwind at Forest Song in Ashenvale.

text.title: 北方前线的报告
text.objectives: 将哨兵梅丽瑞亚的报告送给灰谷银翼树林的哨兵艾蒂亚·轻歌。
text.description: 与部落的战斗可不仅仅在林中树塔展开，$N。在东南方靠近贫瘠之地边界的银翼树林，还有一处更为坚固的银翼哨兵据点。在树林的那一侧，哨兵轻歌负责领导着我军力量对抗那些试图破坏森林的敌人。$B$B我已经很长一段时间没有给她送出我们的报告了，但目前的局势让我完全无法离开树塔。$B$B我迫切需要你帮我将这报告尽快送给她！
text.progress: What's that you have there, $c?
text.completion: Thank you for delivering this report, $c. From what Sentinel Melyria writes, it seems our worst fears have come to pass. With each advance we make, the Horde appears more determined to do as much damage as possible. We can't afford to back down; the fate of our ancestral lands hangs in the balance. With more people like you on the frontlines, I'm certain we could triumph. Will you join our fight? A new front has just opened in Warsong Gulch to the south.

english.title: Report from the Northern Front
english.objectives: Deliver Sentinel Melyria's report to Sentinel Farsong at Silverwing Grove in Ashenvale.
english.description: The battle against the Horde isn't being waged from Raynewood Tower alone, $N. There's a more substantial Silverwing Sentinel presence at Silverwing Grove to the southeast, near the border with the Barrens. From the grove, Sentinel Farsong directs our efforts against those who would destroy our lands.$B$BI'm a bit late in sending my latest report to her, but also hesitant to leave the tower unattended.$B$BI am in dire need of your help in getting this report to her as soon as possible!
english.progress: What's that you have there, $c?
english.completion: Thank you for delivering this report, $c. From what Sentinel Melyria writes, it seems our worst fears have come to pass. With each advance we make, the Horde appears more determined to do as much damage as possible. We can't afford to back down; the fate of our ancestral lands hangs in the balance. With more people like you on the frontlines, I'm certain we could triumph. Will you join our fight? A new front has just opened in Warsong Gulch to the south.

text.title: 毁灭的使者
text.objectives: 杀死监工古尔萨克和战歌伐木营地的12名部落。
text.description: 战歌伐木营地就是我们如锦缎般美丽的大地上的一处锈斑。每次我们暂时成功地阻止了他们，监工古尔萨克就会让他手下的伐木工加倍砍伐我们的树木！$B$B现在，兽人砍伐下的树木已经远远超过了他们所需要的，他们甚至就让那些砍下来的新鲜树木堆在一旁腐烂！这绝对不是我们所能容忍的，$N，我们一定要让他们知道，我们是绝对不会容忍任何毁灭我们土地的行为！$B$B去吧，战斗吧，直到监工古尔萨克和他的手下全都死掉为止！
